units.slavonic_diplomatic: 11. On Sunday, after Psalm 50, the Triadic Canon and the “It is meet,” the Trisagion, the Apolytikion of the Feast and the Exapsalmos. At “God is the Lord”: the Resurrection Apolytikion, that of the Saints, and that of the Feast, the Psalter and the Amomos. The Resurrection Kathismata and those of the Feast in place of the Theotokia; the Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode and the Prokimenon. The Canons of the Resurrection and of the Saints. After the 3rd Ode, the Kathisma of the Saints “Joachim and Anna celebrate”; after the 6th Ode, the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos and the Minologion of the Saints. The Katavasie “Moses, having etched the sign of the Cross,” and the entire order of the Matins Gospel; then we sing “More honorable.” The Resurrection Exapostilarion and that of the Feast “Be renewed, O Adam.” At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and the 4 Stichira of the Post-feast “By grace of the Saviour,” Glory the Eothinon, Now and ever, “Most blessed,” Great Doxology and “Today salvation.” 12.
units.english_cohort_translation: 11. On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 LXX, the Triadic Canon and the Triadic hymn **"It is meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); the Trisagion, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Saints, and that of the Feast; the Psalter and the Amomos [Psalm 118 LXX]. The Resurrection Kathismata, and those of the Feast in place of the Theotokia; the Sunday Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. Canons: the Resurrection Canon and that of the Saints. After the Third Ode: the Kathisma of the Saints: **"Joachim and Anna celebrate"** (*Ἰωακεὶμ καὶ ἡ Ἄννα πανηγυρίζουσιν*); after the Sixth Ode: the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, and the Synaxarion of the Saints. The Katavasiai: **"Moses, having etched the cross"** (*Σταυρὸν χαράξας*), and the entire order of the Sunday Morning Gospel; then we sing the biblical canticle with **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrection Exapostilarion and that of the Feast: **"Be renewed, O Adam"** (*Ἀδὰμ ἀνακαινίσθητι*). At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 Stichira of the Afterfeast: **"Thanksgiving unto the Redeemer"** (*Χάρις τῷ Λυτρωτῇ*); **"Glory"**: the appointed Sunday Eothinon Doxastikon; **"Both now"**: **"Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις*); the Great Doxology, and the Sunday Dismissal Troparion: **"Today salvation has come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 14. Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν καὶ τὸ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον δίς, καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς ἅπαξ· τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος. Καθίσματα εἰς τὴν α΄ καὶ β΄ στιχολογοῦμεν ἀνὰ β΄ Ἀναστάσιμα καὶ ἀνὰ α΄ τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κάθισμα μεθέορτον, ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων τῆς ἡμέρας, αἱ Καταβασίαι Σταυρὸν χαράξας καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον καὶ τὸ μεθέορτον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ μεθέορτα δ΄, Δόξα τὸ Ἑωθινόν, Καὶ νῦν Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μ. Σήμερον σωτηρία καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία μετὰ τῶν Τυπικῶν καὶ Μακαρισμῶν (ἐν οἷς δ΄ ἐκ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ δ΄ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Κανόνος τῆς ἑορτῆς), ὁ Ἀπόστολος καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς πρὸ τῆς Ὑψώσεως, Κοινωνικὸν Αἰνεῖτε, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 15. Εἰ τύχοι ἡ Ἀπόδοσις ἐν πάσῃ ἄλλῃ ἡμέρᾳ πλὴν Κυριακῆς, ἡ Ἀκολουθία ψάλλεται ὡς ἐν τῇ ἰδίᾳ τῆς ἑορτῆς ἡμέρᾳ, ἐξαιρουμένων ἐν μὲν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ τοῦ Ψαλτηρίου καὶ τῶν Ἀναγνωσμάτων, ἐν δὲ τῷ Ὄρθρῳ τῆς Λιτῆς, τοῦ Εὐαγγελίου τοῦ Ὄρθρου καὶ τοῦ Πολυελέου· ἐν τῇ Λειτουργίᾳ, λέγεται Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς ἡμέρας.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 14. On Sunday in Matins after Psalm 50, the Triadic Canon and the “It is meet”; the Trisagion, the Apolytikion of the Feast and the Exapsalmos. At “God is the Lord”: the Resurrection Apolytikion twice, and that of the Feast once; the Psalter and the Amomos. The Resurrection Kathismata and those of the Feast in place of the Theotokia; the Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode and the Prokimenon. The Canons of the Resurrection and of the Feast. After the 3rd Ode, the Kathisma of the Post-feast; after the 6th Ode, the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos and the Minologion of the Saints of the day. The Katavasie “Moses, having etched the sign of the Cross,” and the entire order of the Matins Gospel; then we sing “More honorable.” The Resurrection Exapostilarion and that of the Post-feast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and the 4 Stichira of the Post-feast, Glory the Eothinon Now and ever, “Most blessed,” Great Doxology and “Today salvation.” Then follows the Liturgy, with the Typika, and the Beatitudes (in which we sing 4 hymns of the Mode and 4 hymns from the 6th Ode of the Canon of the Feast), Apostolos and Gospel of the Sunday before the Elevation, Communion Hymn “Praise,” “We have seen the [true] light,” and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 14. On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 LXX, the Triadic Canon and the Triadic hymn **"It is meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion twice, and that of the Feast once; the Psalter and the Amomos [Psalm 118 LXX]. Kathismata: at the First and Second Stichologia we sing 2 Resurrection Kathismata each and 1 of the Feast; the Sunday Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. Canons: the Resurrection Canon and that of the Feast. After the Third Ode: the Kathisma of the Afterfeast; after the Sixth Ode: the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, and the Synaxarion of the Saints of the day from the Menaion. The Katavasiai: **"Moses, having etched the cross"** (*Σταυρὸν χαράξας*), and the entire order of the Sunday Morning Gospel; then we sing the biblical canticle with **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrection Exapostilarion and that of the Afterfeast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 Stichira of the Afterfeast; **"Glory"**: the appointed Sunday Eothinon Doxastikon; **"Both now"**: **"Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις*); the Great Doxology, and the Sunday Dismissal Troparion: **"Today salvation has come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*). Then follows the Divine Liturgy, with the Typika, and the Beatitudes (in which we sing 4 hymns of the Tone and 4 Troparia from the Sixth Ode of the Canon of the Feast); the Epistle and Gospel of the Sunday before the Exaltation of the Precious Cross [Gal. 6:11–18; John 3:13–17]; Communion Verse: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 148:1 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν*), and Dismissal.

Kathismata: at the First and Second Stichologia we sing 2 Resurrection Kathismata each and 1 of the Feast; the Sunday Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. Canons: the Resurrection Canon and that of the Feast. After the Third Ode: the Kathisma of the Afterfeast; after the Sixth Ode: the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, and the Synaxarion of the Saints of the day from the Menaion. The Katavasiai: **"Moses, having etched the cross"** (*Σταυρὸν χαράξας*), and the entire order of the Sunday Morning Gospel; then we sing the biblical canticle with **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrection Exapostilarion and that of the Afterfeast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 Stichira of the Afterfeast; **"Glory"**: the appointed Sunday Eothinon Doxastiko

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 15. If the Leave-taking occurs on any day other than Sunday, the Service is chanted as on the day of the Feast, with the following exceptions. In Vespers: of the Psalter and the Readings; in Matins: of the Liti, the Gospel of Matins and the Polyeleos. In the Liturgy, we do the Apostolos and Gospel of the day.
units.english_cohort_translation: 15. If the Apodosis occurs on any weekday except Sunday: the entire service is sung as on the day of the Feast itself, with the following exceptions: at Vespers: the Psalter and the Old Testament Readings are omitted; at Matins: the Liti, the Matins Gospel, and the Polyeleos are omitted. In the Divine Liturgy: the Epistle and Gospel appointed are those of the weekday.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 16. If the Leave-taking occurs on a Sunday, then on Saturday in Vespers, following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter, at “Lord, I have cried” we sing 4 Resurrection Stichira and 6 Stichira of the Feast, Glory of the Feast, Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, “O Gladsome Light” and the Prokimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory, Now and ever of the Aposticha of the Feast; the Resurrection Apolytikion, that of the Feast twice, and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 16. If the Apodosis occurs on a Sunday: then on Saturday evening at Great Vespers, following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter [Kathisma 1], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 4 Resurrection Stichira and 6 Stichira of the Feast; **"Glory"**: of the Feast; **"Both now"**: the First Dogmatic Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; **"Glory"**, **"Both now"**: from the Aposticha of the Feast; Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrection Troparion, that of the Feast twice, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_incipit: Ἄμωμος. Καθίσματα εἰς τὴν α΄ καὶ
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Ἄμωμος. Καθίσματα εἰς τὴν α΄ καὶ β΄ Στιχολογίαν ἀνὰ δύο Ἀναστάσιμα, καὶ ἀνὰ ἓν τῆς ἑορτῆς, εἶτα τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος, καὶ οἱ τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κάθισμα Ἡ Παρθένος Μαριὰμ ἅπαξ, ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα, καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων τῆς ἡμέρας, αἱ Καταβασίαι Σταυρὸν χαράξας καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, καὶ μετ’ αὐτὴν ψάλλεται ἡ Θ΄ τῆς ἑορτῆς. Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς δ΄, Δόξα Αὕτη ἡμέρα Κυρίου, Καὶ νῦν Ὑπερευλογημένη· Δοξολογία Μεγάλη, Σήμερον σωτηρία, καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία μετὰ τῶν Ἀντιφώνων ὡς ἐν τῇ ἰδίᾳ ἡμέρᾳ τῆς ἑορτῆς, ὁ Ἀπόστολος καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς πρὸ τῆς Ὑψώσεως. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως Ἀλλότριον τῶν μητέρων· Κοινωνικὸν Ποτήριον σωτηρίου, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

At the Aposticha: **"Glory"** of the Saint; **"Both now"** of the Forefeast; the Dismissal Troparion of the Saint is likewise chanted).

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 2.    Ἄν τύχωσι τὰ Ἐγκαίνια ἐν Κυριακῇ, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ δ΄, τῶν Ἐγκαινίων γ΄ καὶ Προεόρτια τοῦ Σταυροῦ γ΄ τὰ ἐν τῷ μικρῷ Ἑσπερινῷ Ὑψουμένου σου Δέσποτα· Δόξα Τὴν μνήμην τῶν Ἐγκαινίων· Καὶ νῦν τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρὸν, τὸ Προκείμενον, καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τῶν Ἐγκαινίων. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, Δόξα καὶ νῦν Σύ μου σκέπη κραταιὰ, Ἀπολυτίκια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τῶν Ἐγκαινίων, τὸ Προεόρτιον Τὸν ζωοποιὸν Σταυρὸν καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_incipit: Feast in place of the Theotokia,
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Feast in place of the Theotokia, the Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode and the Prokimenon. The Canons of the Resurrection and of the Feast. After the 3rd Ode, the Kathisma “The Virgin Mary” once; after the 6th Ode, the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos and the Minologion of the Saints of the day. The Katavasie “Moses, having etched the sign of the Cross,” and the entire order of the Matins Gospel; then we sing “More honorable,” and after that the 9th Ode of the Feast is sung. The Resurrection Exapostilarion and that of the Feast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and the 4 Stichira of the Feast, Glory, “This is the day of the Lord,” Now and ever, “Most blessed,” Great Doxology and “Today salvation.” Then follows the Liturgy, with the Antiphons as on the day of the Feast, Apostolos and Gospel of the Sunday before the Elevation.
units.english_cohort_translation: ...Feast in place of the Theotokia; the Sunday Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: the Resurrection Canon and that of the Feast. After the Third Ode: the Kathisma: **"The Virgin Mary"** (*Ἡ Παρθένος Μαριάμ*) once; after the Sixth Ode: the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, and the Synaxarion of the Saints of the day from the Menaion. The Katavasiai: **"Moses, having etched the cross"** (*Σταυρὸν χαράξας*), and the entire order of the Sunday Morning Gospel; then we sing the biblical canticle with **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*), and after that the Ninth Ode of the Feast is sung. Exapostilaria: the Resurrection Exapostilarion and that of the Feast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 Stichira of the Feast; **"Glory"**: **"This is the day of the Lord"** (*Αὕτη ἡ ἡμέρα Κυρίου*); **"Both now"**: **"Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις*); the Great Doxology, and the Sunday Dismissal Troparion: **"Today salvation has come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*). Then follows the Divine Liturgy, with the Antiphons as on the day of the Feast; the Epistle and Gospel of the Sunday before the Exaltation of the Precious Cross [Gal. 6:11–18; John 3:13–17]. At the Megalynarion [Zadostoinyk]: **"Virginity is foreign to mothers"** (*Ἀλλότριον τῶν μητέρων ἡ παρθενία*). Communion Verse: **"I will take the cup of salvation"** (*Ποτήριον σωτηρίου*, Ps. 115:4 LXX), **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν*), and Dismissal.

Feast in place of the Theotokia, the Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode and the Prokimenon. The Canons of the Resurrection and of the Feast. After the 3rd Ode, the Kathisma “The Virgin Mary” once; after the 6th Ode, the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos and the Minologion of the Saints of the day. The Katavasie “Moses, having etched the sign of the Cross,” and the entire order of the Matins Gospel; then we sing “More honorable,” and after that the 9th Ode of the Feast is sung. The Resurrection Exapostilarion and that of the Feast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and the 4 Stichira of the Feast, Glory, “This is the day of the Lord,” Now and ever, “Most blessed,” Great Doxology and “Today salvation.” Then follows the Liturgy, with the Antiphons as on the day of the Feast, Apostolos and Gospel of the Sunday before the Elevation. At “Especially,” “Virginity is alien to motherhood,” Communion Hymn “I will receive the cup of salvation,” “We have seen the [true] light,” and Dismissal

Note that, when the Leave-taking occurs on Saturday, the Apostolos and Gospel of the Saturday before the Elevation are recited.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 2.    If the Consecration occurs on Sunday, Saturday in Vespers, following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter, at “Lord, I have cried” we sing 4 Resurrection Stichira , 3 of the Consecration, and 3 of the Pre-feast of the Cross, from the Small Vespers “Lifted high upon the Cross”; Glory, “The commemoration of the Consecration”; Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, “O Gladsome Light,” the Prokimenon, and the Readings of the Consecration. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory, Now and ever, “You my powerful protection”; the Resurrection Apolytikion, that of the Consecration, that of the Pre-feast “The Life-creating Cross,” and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 2.    If the Consecration occurs on Sunday: on Saturday evening at Great Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter [Kathisma 1], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 4 Resurrection Stichira, 3 Stichira of the Consecration, and 3 Stichira of the Forefeast of the Cross from Small Vespers: **"Lifted high upon the Cross, O Master"** (*Ὑψουμένου σου Δέσποτα*); **"Glory"**: **"The commemoration of the Consecration"** (*Τὴν μνήμην τῶν Ἐγκαινίων*); **"Both now"**: the First Dogmatic Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Readings of the Consecration [1 Kings 8:22–30; Prov. 3:19–34; Prov. 9:1–11]. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; **"Glory"**, **"Both now"**: **"Thou art my powerful protection"** (*Σύ μου σκέπη κραταιὰ ὑπάρχεις*). Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Consecration, that of the Forefeast: **"The Life-creating Cross of Thy goodness"** (*Τὸν ζωοποιὸν Σταυρὸν*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_incipit: ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα καὶ τὰ τῶν Ἐγκαινίων
units.slavonic_diplomatic: ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα καὶ τὰ τῶν Ἐγκαινίων ἀντὶ Θεοτοκίων· τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος, ὁ τοῦ Σταυροῦ καὶ ὁ τῶν Ἐγκαινίων· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κάθισμα τῶν Ἐγκαινίων Ἐν πίστει τὰ Ἐγκαίνια ἅπαξ, ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος, τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων τῆς ἡμέρας, αἱ Καταβασίαι Σταυρὸν χαράξας καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, εἶτα Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τῶν Ἐγκαινίων Μέσον τῆς γῆς ὁ Κύριος καὶ Μετ’ εὐφροσύνης κράξωμεν. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τῶν Ἐγκαινίων δ΄, Σήμερον ὁ ἔνθεος, οἱ Στίχοι ὁ α΄ Κύριε ἠγάπησα εὐπρέπειαν οἴκου σου καὶ τόπον σκηνώματος δόξης σου· ὁ β΄ Σοὶ πρέπει ὕμνος ὁ Θεὸς ἐν Σιών, καὶ σοὶ ἀποδοθήσεται εὐχὴ ἐν Ἱερουσαλήμ· Δόξα τὸ Ἑωθινόν, Καὶ νῦν Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μ. καὶ τὸ Σήμερον Σωτηρία.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 4.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄ καὶ δ΄ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Κανόνος τῶν Ἐγκαινίων, μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ Προεόρτιον Τὸν ζωοποιὸν Σταυρὸν τῆς σῆς ἀγαθότητος, τῶν Ἐγκαινίων Ὡς τοῦ ἄνω στερεώματος, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, καὶ Κοντάκιον Οὐρανὸς πολύφωτος ἡ Ἐκκλησία, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς πρὸ τῆς Ὑψώσεως. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, Κοινωνικὸν Αἰνεῖτε, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_incipit: those of the Consecration in place
units.slavonic_diplomatic: those of the Consecration in place of the Theotokia; the Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode and the Prokimenon. The Canons of the Resurrection, of the Cross and of the Consecration. After the 3rd Ode, the Kathisma of the Consecration “In faith the Consecration” once; after the 6th Ode, the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos and the Minologion of the Saints. The Katavasie “Moses, having etched the sign of the Cross,” and the entire order of the Matins Gospel; then we sing “More honorable.” The Resurrection Exapostilarion and those of the Consecration: “In the midst of the earth, the Lord” and “With gladness let us cry.” At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 Stichira of the Consecration “Today the God-inspired” with the following 2 Verses: #1 “Lord, I have loved the comeliness of Your house, and the place where Your glory dwells.” #2 “Praise is awaiting You, O God, in Zion; and to You the vow shall be paid.” Glory the Eothinon, Now and ever, “Most blessed,” Great Doxology and “Today salvation.”
units.english_cohort_translation: ...those of the Consecration in place of the Theotokia; the Sunday Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: the Resurrection Canon, that of the Cross, and that of the Consecration. After the Third Ode: the Kathisma of the Consecration: **"In faith the Consecration is celebrated"** (*Ἐν πίστει τὰ Ἐγκαίνια*) once; after the Sixth Ode: the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, and the Synaxarion of the Saints of the day from the Menaion. The Katavasiai: **"Moses, having etched the cross"** (*Σταυρὸν χαράξας*), and the entire order of the Sunday Morning Gospel; then we sing the biblical canticle with **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrection Exapostilarion and those of the Consecration: **"In the midst of the earth the Lord wrought salvation"** (*Μέσον τῆς γῆς ὁ Κύριος*) and **"With gladness let us cry aloud"** (*Μετ’ εὐφροσύνης κράξωμεν*). units.slavonic_diplomatic: 4.    In the Liturgy, the Typika, and 4 Beatitudes of the Mode and 4 hymns from the 6th Ode of the Canon of the Consecration. After the Entrance, the Resurrection Apolytikion, that of the Pre-feast “The Life-creating Cross of your goodness,” that of the Consecration “As You had shown from on high,” that of Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion “A fully illumined heaven, the Church”; Apostolos and Gospel of the Sunday before the Elevation. At “Especially,” “It is meet,” Communion Hymn “Praise,” “We have seen the [true] light,” and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 4.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Typika, and 4 Beatitudes of the Tone and 4 Troparia from the Sixth Ode of the Canon of the Consecration. After the Little Entrance: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, the Forefeast Troparion: **"The Life-creating Cross of Thy goodness"** (*Τὸν ζωοποιὸν Σταυρὸν τῆς σῆς ἀγαθότητος*), that of the Consecration: **"As Thou hadst shown from on high"** (*Ὡς τοῦ ἄνω στερεώματος*), that of the Patron Saint of the temple, and the Kontakion: **"A fully illumined heaven is the Church"** (*Οὐρανὸς πολύφωτος ἡ Ἐκκλησία*); the Epistle and Gospel of the Sunday before the Exaltation of the Precious Cross [Gal. 6:11–18; John 3:13–17]. At the Megalynarion: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Verse: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 148:1 LXX), **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν*), and Dismissal.

His service, however, is not chanted on the day of the Exaltation; rather, his commemoration is transferred to November 13, so that the hymns of his service may remain complete and undiminished.)*

units.slavonic_incipit: εἰς στ΄. Δόξα Καὶ νῦν, Δεῦτε
units.slavonic_diplomatic: εἰς στ΄. Δόξα Καὶ νῦν, Δεῦτε ἅπαντα τὰ ἔθνη, Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ Προσόμοια Χαίροις ὁ ζωηφόρος Σταυρός· οἱ Στίχοι Ὑψοῦτε Κύριον τὸν θεὸν ἡμῶν καὶ προσκυνεῖτε τῷ ὑποποδίῳ τῶν ποδῶν αὐτοῦ· ἕτερος, Ὁ δὲ θεὸς βασιλεὺς ἡμῶν πρὸ αἰώνων εἰργάσατο σωτηρίαν ἐν μέσῳ τῆς γῆς· Δόξα. Καὶ νῦν, Ὅνπερ πάλαι Μωϋσῆς, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον Σῶσον, Κύριε, τὸν λαόν σου ἐκ τρίτου καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 6.    Εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν ἡ Λιτή, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον ἐκ τρίτου, εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος· τὰ Καθίσματα κατὰ σειρὰν ἐκ δευτέρου, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον, Εἴδοσαν πάντα τὰ πέρατα τῆς γῆς τὸ σωτήριον τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν· Πᾶσα πνοὴ καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον, τὸ Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ (ὅπερ λέγεται εἰς οἱανδήποτε ἡμέραν τύχῃ ἡ Ὕψωσις τοῦ Σταυροῦ) καὶ ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα, Δόξα, Σύ μου σκέπη κραταιὰ ὑπάρχεις. Καὶ νῦν, τὸ αὐτό. Στίχος Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός, καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Σταυρὲ τοῦ Χριστοῦ, ὁ Κανὼν εἰς ἕξ ἄνευ Στίχων, ἐκτὸς τοῦ Δόξα. Καὶ νῦν ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς, τὸ Κάθισμα ἅπαξ, ἀφ’ ς΄, τὸ Κοντάκιον, ὁ Οἶκος καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι Σταυρὸν χαράξας, εἶτα ψάλλονται τῆς Θ΄ καὶ αἱ δύο Ὠδαί, καὶ αἱ δύο Καταβασίαι Μυστικὸς εἶ Θεοτόκε, καὶ Ὁ διὰ βρώσεως τοῦ ξύλου, τὸ α΄ Ἐξαποστειλάριον δὶς καὶ τὸ β΄ ἅπαξ. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους τὰ Προσόμοια Ὢ τοῦ παραδόξου θαύματος εἰς δ΄ (εἰς τὸ Αἰνεῖτε ὁ Πατριάρχης ἢ ὁ Ἀρχιερεὺς οὐ προσκυνεῖ ὡς συνήθως, διότι μετ’ ὀλίγον μέλλει προσκυνῆσαι τὸν τίμιον Σταυρόν), Δόξα. Καὶ νῦν Σήμερον προέρχεται, Δοξολογία μεγάλη εἰς ἦχον δ΄ εἰς δὲ τὸ Ἀσματικὸν Ἅγιος ὁ θεός, γίνεται ἡ Εἴσοδος τοῦ τιμίου Σταυροῦ κατὰ τὴν ἑξῆς διάταξιν. Ὁ ἱερουργῶν ἱερεὺς στὰς ἐνώπιον τῆς Ἁγίας Τραπέζης καὶ θυμιάσας τὸν τίμιον Σταυρὸν κείμενον ἐπὶ ταύτης ἐν δίσκῳ μετὰ κλάδων βασιλικοῦ καὶ τριῶν κηρίων, αἴρει τὸν δίσκον καὶ τίθησιν αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τῆς κεφαλῆς· στραφεὶς δὲ περὶ τὴν Ἁγίαν Τράπεζαν ἐκ δεξιῶν πρὸς τὰ ἀριστερά, τῶν Ἱεροδιακόνων θυμιώντων καὶ τῶν λαμπάδων, τῶν ἑξαπτερύγων, καὶ τῶν Ψαλτῶν προπορευομένων καὶ μετὰ τούτους τοῦ Πριμικηρίου φέροντος τὸ Διδάμβουλον, τῶν Ψαλτῶν δὲ ψαλλόντων τὸ Ἅγιος ὁ θεός, φέρει τὸν Σταυρὸν ἐν τῷ μέσῳ τοῦ Ναοῦ, ἔνθα ἵσταται τὸ Τετραπόδιον ηὐτρεπισμένον καὶ κύκλῳ αὐτοῦ περιελθὼν τρὶς ἵσταται, καὶ βλέπων πρὸς Ἀνατολάς, κρατῶν δὲ εἰς χεῖρας τὸν δίσκον ἐκφωνεῖ Σοφία, ὀρθοί, καὶ τίθησιν αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τοῦ τετραποδίου· εἶτα θυμιάζων κύκλῳ αὐτοῦ σταυροειδῶς,

units.slavonic_diplomatic: high,” in six. Glory, Now and ever, “Come, all you nations.” Entrance, “O Gladsome Light,” the Prokimenon, and the Readings. At the Aposticha: the Prosomia “Hail! Life-creating Cross,” with the Verse “Extol the Lord our God; worship at His footstool. For He is holy!” or another “Yet God, my King, is from old, working salvation in the earth.” Glory, Now and ever, “Whom Moses again.” The Apolytikion “O Lord, save Your people” three times, and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: ...high"** (*Σταυρὸς ἀνυψούμενος*), doubled to 6; **"Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit"**, **"Both now and ever, and unto the ages of ages. units.slavonic_diplomatic: 6.    In Matins, after Psalm 50, the Liti, the Trisagion, the Apolytikion and the Exapsalmos. At “God is the Lord”: the Apolytikion [of the Feast] three times, then the Psalter and the Polyeleos. The Kathismata in order twice each, the Anavathmi of the first Antiphon of Mode IV, and the Prokimenon “All the ends of the earth have seen the victory of our God.” Then “Let everything that has breath” and the [Morning] Gospel; then “We have seen the Resurrection of Christ” (which is said on whatever day of the week the Feast of the Elevation may fall) and Psalm 50 (read). Glory, “You are my powerful protection,” Now and ever, the same. The Verse “Have mercy upon me,” and the Idiomelon “O Cross of Christ.” The Canon in six without Verses, except for Glory. Now and ever. After the 3rd Ode, the Kathisma once; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion, the Ikos and the Minologion. The Katavasie “Moses, having etched the sign of the Cross; then are sung both Odes of the 9th Ode and the two Katavasie “O Theotokos, you are a mystical paradise” and “Through the eating of the tree.” The first Exapostilarion twice and the second once. At the Praises: the Prosomia “O marvellous wonder!” in four (at “Praise,” the Patriarch or the Arch-priest does not venerate as usual, because in a short while he will venerate the Holy Cross), Glory, Now and ever, “Today goes forth,” Great Doxology in Mode IV. At the Asmatikon [elaborate] “Holy God” [at the end of the Doxology], the Entrance [Procession] of the Holy Cross takes place in the following order: The officiating Priest stands before the Holy Table and censes the Precious Cross, which already lies on it in a tray with sprigs of basil and three candles. Then he raises the tray and, placing it against the top of his forehead, he proceeds around the Holy Table from the right to the left [counter clockwise], while the Deacons cense. The processional candles, the Exapteryga [six-winged fans], and the Chanters precede the Cross. After these follows the Primikyrios [Chief Priest] carrying the Didamvulon [two-wicked candle]. While the Chanters sing “Holy God,” the Priest brings the Cross to the center of the Church where a Tetrapod [four-legged table] stands adorned. Having gone around this table three times, the Priest stops and stands in front of it. Facing to the East and holding the tray in his hands,
units.english_cohort_translation: 6.    At Matins: after Psalm 50 LXX, the Litē, the Trisagion, the Dismissal Troparion, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the festal Dismissal Troparion thrice; then the Psalter and the Polyeleos; the Kathismata in order, chanted twice each; the Anavathmoi: the First Antiphon of Tone 4 [**"From my youth"** (*Ἐκ νεότητός μου*)]; and the Prokeimenon: **"All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God"** (*Εἴδοσαν πάντα τὰ πέρατα τῆς γῆς τὸ σωτήριον τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν*, Ps. 97:3 LXX). Then **"Let every breath"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*), and the festal Matins Gospel [John 12:28–36]; then **"Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ"** (*Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ θεασάμενοι*, which is chanted on whatever day of the week the Feast of the Exaltation falls), and Psalm 50 LXX (recited). **"Glory"**: **"Thou art my powerful protection"** (*Σύ μου σκέπη κραταιὰ ὑπάρχεις*); **"Both now"**: repeat the same hymn. Then the verse: **"Have mercy on me, O God, according to Thy great mercy"** (*Ἐλέησόν με, ὁ Θεός*, Ps. 50:1 LXX), and the Idiomelon: **"O Cross of Christ"** (*Σταυρὲ τοῦ Χριστοῦ*). The Canon of the Feast is sung in 6 without biblical verses, except for **"Glory"**, **"Both now"**. After the Third Ode: the Kathisma once; after the Sixth Ode: the Kontakion, the Ikos, and the Synaxarion from the Menaion. The Katavasiai: **"Moses, having etched the cross"** (*Σταυρὸν χαράξας*); then both Ninth Odes of the Feast are sung, along with the two Katavasiai: **"A mystical paradise art Thou, O Theotokos"** (*Μυστικὸς εἶ Θεοτόκε*) and **"Death, which came upon mankind through the eating of the tree"** (*Ὁ διὰ βρώσεως τοῦ ξύλου*). The First Exapostilarion: **"The Cross is the guardian of the whole world"** (*Σταυρὸς ὁ φύλαξ πάσης τῆς οἰκουμένης*) twice, and the Second Exapostilarion: **"The Cross is exalted today"** (*Σταυρὸς ὑψοῦται σήμερον*) once. At the Praises: the Prosomia Stichira: **"O marvelous wonder!"** (*Ὢ τοῦ παραδόξου θαύματος*) in 4 (at the singing of **"Praise the Lord"** [*Αἰνεῖτε*], the Patriarch or presiding Bishop does not venerate the icons as usual, because shortly he is to venerate the Precious Cross); **"Glory"**, **"Both now"**: **"Today the Cross goes forth"** (*Σήμερον προέρχεται*); the Great Doxology is sung in Tone 4. At the concluding Asmatikon [slow and elaborate chant of the Trisagion]: **"Holy God"** (*Ἅγιος ὁ Θεός*), the solemn Entrance of the Precious Cross takes place in the following order:[^150] The officiating Priest stands before the Holy Table and censes the Precious Cross, which already lies upon it in a tray adorned with sprigs of basil and three lighted candles. The Priest raises the tray and, placing it upon his head, he proceeds around the Holy Table from right to left [counter-clockwise], while the Deacons cense. The processional candles, the Exapteryga [six-winged fans], and the Chanters precede the Cross; following them comes the Primikyrios bearing the Didamvulon [two-wicked candle / double taper]. While the Chanters sing the Asmatikon **"Holy God"**, the Priest brings the Cross to the center of the temple, where the adorned Tetrapod stands. Having circled this Tetrapod three times, the Priest stops and stands before it. Facing East and holding the tray in his hands,...

units.slavonic_incipit: ψάλλει τὸ Σῶσον Κύριε ἅπαξ, τὸ
units.slavonic_diplomatic: ψάλλει τὸ Σῶσον Κύριε ἅπαξ, τὸ αὐτὸ καὶ οἱ δύο χοροὶ ἀνὰ μίαν· μετὰ ταῦτα βαλὼν μετανοίας τρεῖς (ἐν οἵᾳ ἡμέρᾳ τύχῃ), καὶ λαβὼν ἀνὰ χεῖρας τὸν Τίμιον Σταυρὸν μετὰ κλάδων βασιλικοῦ καὶ βλέπων πρὸς Ἀνατολάς, ὑψοῖ αὐτὸν καὶ λέγει μεγαλοφώνως. Ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς ὁ Θεὸς κατὰ τὸ μέγα ἔλεός σου, δεόμεθά σου ἐπάκουσον καὶ ἐλέησον, καὶ ἄρχονται οἱ χοροὶ τῆς α΄ ἑκατοντάδος τοῦ Κύριε ἐλέησον, τοῦ Ἱερέως σφραγίζοντος ἐν ταῖς ἐνάρξεσι μετὰ τοῦ τιμίου Σταυροῦ τρίς, καὶ κλίνοντος τὴν κεφαλὴν ἠρέμα, ὅσον σπιθαμὴν ἀπέχειν ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς· ἀνίσταται δὲ αὖθις κατὰ μικρὸν ἄχρι τῆς συμπληρώσεως τῆς α΄ ἑκατοντάδος· εἶτα στραφεὶς πρὸς τὰ δεξιὰ καὶ βλέπων πρὸς Βορρᾶν λέγει· Ἔτι δεόμεθα ὑπὲρ τῶν εὐσεβῶν καὶ ὀρθοδόξων χριστιανῶν, καὶ οἱ Χοροὶ ἄρχονται τῆς β΄ ἑκατοντάδος, ὁ δὲ Ἱερεὺς ποιεῖ τὴν β΄ ὕψωσιν ὡς προδιεγράφη· εἶθ’ οὕτως στραφεὶς πρὸς Δυσμάς, λέγει· Ἔτι δεόμεθα ὑπὲρ τοῦ Ἀρχιεπισκόπου ἡμῶν . . . καὶ οἱ Χοροὶ ἄρχονται τῆς γ΄ ἑκατοντάδος· πληρουμένης δὲ ταύτης, ὁ Ἱερεὺς στρέφεται πρὸς τὸ Νότιον μέρος καὶ λέγει· Ἔτι δεόμεθα ὑπέρ τῶν ἐνδημούντων ἁγίων Ἀρχιερέων καὶ τῶν ἀποδημούντων ἐν ταῖς ἐπαρχίαις αὐτῶν, καὶ γίνεται ἡ δ΄ ὕψωσις· καὶ αὖθις ὁ Ἱερεὺς στραφεὶς πρὸς Ἀνατολάς, λέγει· Ἔτι δεόμεθα ὑπὲρ τῶν διακονούντων καὶ διακονησάντων ἐν τῇ ἁγίᾳ ταύτῃ τοῦ Χριστοῦ Μεγάλῃ Ἐκκλησίᾳ καὶ ὑπὲρ πάσης ψυχῆς χριστιανῶν ὀρθοδόξων, ὑγείας τε καὶ σωτηρίας καὶ ἀφέσεως τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν αὐτῶν, καὶ οἱ Χοροὶ ἄρχονται τῆς ε΄ ἑκατοντάδος· εἶτα τίθησιν ὁ Ἱερεὺς τὸν τίμιον Σταυρὸν ἐπὶ τοῦ δίσκου, καὶ προσελθὼν ὁ Πατριάρχης (ἢ ὁ Ἀρχιερεὺς) καὶ λαβὼν αὐτὸν μετὰ κλάδων βασιλικοῦ, βλέπων πρὸς Ἀνατολάς, ὑψοῖ αὐτὸν ψάλλων τὸ· Ὁ Ὑψωθεὶς ἐν τῷ Σταυρῷ ἑκουσίως· θεὶς δὲ τὸν Σταυρὸν ἐπὶ τοῦ δίσκου καὶ προσκυνῶν ψάλλει· Τὸν Σταυρόν σου προσκυνοῦμεν Δέσποτα, ἅπαξ τὸ αὐτὸ ψάλλουσι καὶ οἱ Χοροὶ ἀνὰ μίαν· εἶτα ἀσπασάμενος τὸν τίμιον Σταυρὸν εὐλογεῖ τὸν λαὸν καὶ ἀνέρχεται εἰς τὸν θρόνον, τῶν Χορῶν ψαλλόντων τὸ Εἰς πολλὰ ἔτη. Μετὰ τοῦτο προσέρχονται οἱ Ἀρχιερεῖς ἀνὰ δύο κατὰ τάξιν καὶ προσκυνοῦσι τὸν τίμιον Σταυρόν· προσερχόμενοι δὲ λαμβάνουσι παρὰ τοῦ Πατριάρχου τοὺς κλάδους τοῦ βασιλικοῦ ἀσπαζόμενοι τὴν δεξιὰν αὐτοῦ· ὡσαύτως καὶ πάντες οἱ Ἐκκλησιαστικοὶ Ὀφφικιάλοι· ἐν τῷ μεταξὺ τούτῳ, ὁ β΄ Χορὸς ψάλλει τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Δεῦτε πιστοί, καὶ τούτου πληρωθέντος, ψάλλεται τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον καὶ ἄρχεται ἡ Λειτουργία.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: he exclaims: “Wisdom, arise.” Then he places the Cross upon the table. Then, censing the Cross circularly in the form of a cross [from each of the four sides of the table], he chants “O Lord, save Your people” once; this hymn is then repeated once by each of the two Choirs. After this, the Priest makes three prostrations (whatever day it may be) and taking the Precious Cross with the sprigs of basil, he faces towards the East, raises it and says in a loud voice “Have mercy upon us, O God, according to Your great mercy; we pray to You, hear and have mercy.” The Choirs begin to sing the first 100 “Lord, have mercy”; the Priest makes the sign of the Cross three times with the Precious Cross, and then slowly bends down so that his head comes quite close to the ground. After this he slowly rises again, as the Choir comes to the end of the first 100 “Lord, have mercy.” Then he stands on the right side of the table and, facing towards the North, he says “Again we pray for all pious and Orthodox Christians.” He then raises the Cross as before, while the Choirs sing the second 100 “Lord, have mercy”; then the Priest performs the 2nd Elevation, as described before. He then stands on the East side of the table and, facing towards the West, he says “Again we pray for our Archbishop (name)”; the Choirs begin to sing the third 100 “Lord, have mercy,” while he raises the Cross as before for the 3rd Elevation. He then goes to the left side of the table and, turning towards the South, he says “Again we pray for the local holy Archpriests and those departed to their eparchies.” The Choirs begin to sing the fourth 100 “Lord, have mercy” as he raises the Cross, and the 4th Elevation is done. Finally he returns to the front of the table and, facing towards the East again, he says “Again we pray for those who serve or have served in this holy Great Church of Christ and for the souls of all Orthodox Christians, for their health and salvation, and the remission of their sins.” The Choirs begin to sing the fifth and final 100 “Lord, have mercy,” while the Cross is elevated for the 5th and last Elevation. Then the Priest places the Precious Cross on the tray, and the Patriarch (or Archpriest) takes the Cross with the sprigs of basil and, facing East, raises it up and chants “Lifted up of Your own will upon the Cross.” Then, he lays the Cross on the tray, and venerating it, chants “We venerate Your Cross, O Master” (once); this is repeated once by each of the two Choirs. Then, after kissing the Precious Cross, he blesses the people and returns to his throne, the Choirs singing “Many years, O Master.” After this the Archpriests come forth two by two in order of rank and venerate the Precious Cross; coming forward, they, as well as all the Ecclesiastical Officials, receive basil sprigs from the Patriarch, kissing his right hand; meanwhile, the 2nd Choir sings the Idiomelon “Come, you faithful.” And when this is completed, the Apolytikion is sung and the Liturgy begins.
units.english_cohort_translation: ...the Priest exclaims: **"Wisdom! Let us attend!"** (*Σοφία, ὀρθοί*), and places the tray upon the Tetrapod. Then, censing the Cross circularly in the form of a cross [from all four sides of the Tetrapod], he chants the Dismissal Troparion: **"Save, O Lord, Thy people"** (*Σῶσον, Κύριε, τὸν λαόν σου*) once; this hymn is then repeated once by each of the two Choirs. After this, making three prostrations (on whatever day the feast falls), the Priest takes the Precious Cross in his hands with the sprigs of basil and, facing East, raises it aloft and says with a loud voice: **"Have mercy on us, O God, according to Thy great mercy, we pray Thee: hear and have mercy!"** (*Ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς, ὁ Θεός, κατὰ τὸ μέγα ἔλεός σου, δεόμεθά σου, ἐπάκουσον καὶ ἐλέησον*). The Choirs begin the first hundred chants of **"Lord, have mercy"** (*Κύριε, ἐλέησον*). At the beginning, the Priest signs thrice with the Precious Cross, and then slowly lowers his head until it comes within a span of the ground; he then rises again gradually until the completion of the first hundred **"Lord, have mercy"**. Then, turning to the right and facing North, the Priest says: **"Again we pray for all pious and Orthodox Christians"** (*Ἔτι δεόμεθα ὑπὲρ τῶν εὐσεβῶν καὶ ὀρθοδόξων χριστιανῶν*). The Choirs begin the second hundred **"Lord, have mercy"**, and the Priest performs the Second Elevation as described above. Then, turning toward the West, the Priest says: **"Again we pray for our Archbishop [Name]"** (*Ἔτι δεόμεθα ὑπὲρ τοῦ Ἀρχιεπισκόπου ἡμῶν...*); the Choirs begin the third hundred **"Lord, have mercy"**, while the Priest performs the Third Elevation. When this is completed, the Priest turns toward the South and says: **"Again we pray for the resident holy Hierarchs and for those absent in their eparchies"** (*Ἔτι δεόμεθα ὑπὲρ τῶν ἐνδημούντων ἁγίων Ἀρχιερέων καὶ τῶν ἀποδημούντων ἐν ταῖς ἐπαρχίαις αὐτῶν*), and the Fourth Elevation takes place. Then the Priest, turning toward the East again, says: **"Again we pray for those who serve and have served in this holy Great Church of Christ, and for every soul of Orthodox Christians, for their health, salvation, and the remission of their sins"** (*Ἔτι δεόμεθα ὑπὲρ τῶν διακονούντων καὶ διακονησάντων ἐν τῇ ἁγίᾳ ταύτῃ τοῦ Χριστοῦ Μεγάλῃ Ἐκκλησίᾳ καὶ ὑπὲρ πάσης ψυχῆς χριστιανῶν ὀρθοδόξων, ὑγείας τε καὶ σωτηρίας καὶ ἀφέσεως τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν αὐτῶν*). The Choirs begin the fifth and final hundred **"Lord, have mercy"**, and the Fifth Elevation is performed.[^151] Then the Priest places the Precious Cross upon the tray. The Patriarch (or presiding Bishop) comes forward and, taking the Cross with the sprigs of basil, faces East, raises it aloft, and chants: **"Thou Who wast lifted up of Thine own will upon the Cross"** (*Ὁ ὑψωθεὶς ἐν τῷ Σταυρῷ ἑκουσίως*). Then, placing the Cross upon the tray and venerating it, he chants: **"We venerate Thy Cross, O Master, and we glorify Thy holy Resurrection"** (*Τὸν Σταυρόν σου προσκυνοῦμεν, Δέσποτα, καὶ τὴν ἁγίαν σου Ἀνάστασιν δοξάζομεν*) once; this is likewise chanted once by each of the two Choirs. Then, kissing the Precious Cross, the Patriarch blesses the people and ascends his throne, while the Choirs chant: **"Many years, O Master"** (*Εἰς πολλὰ ἔτη*). After this, the Bishops approach two by two in order of seniority and venerate the Precious Cross; as they come forward, they receive basil sprigs from the Patriarch, kissing his right hand; likewise all the Ecclesiastical Officials. In the meantime, the Second Choir chants the Idiomelon: **"Come, ye faithful, let us worship the Life-creating Wood"** (*Δεῦτε πιστοί, τὸ ζωοποιὸν ξύλον προσκυνήσωμεν*). When this is concluded, the Dismissal Troparion: **"Save, O Lord, Thy people"** is chanted, and the Divine Liturgy begins.

units.english_cohort_translation: *(Σημ. Ἰστέον ὅτι ἡ τάξις αὕτη τῆς Ὑψώσεως τοῦ Σταυροῦ γίνεται ἐν τῇ Μ. Ἐκκλησίᾳ καὶ ἔνθα ἄν εὑρίσκηται χοροστατῶν Ἀρχιερεύς· ἀπόντος δὲ τοῦ Πατριάρχου ἢ τοῦ Ἀρχιερέως, μόνος ὁ Ἱερεὺς ποιεῖ τὴν Ὕψωσιν, ὡς καὶ ἐν ταῖς λοιπαῖς Ἱεραῖς Ἐκκλησίαις· ἀλλὰ κατὰ τὴν δ΄ ἑκατοντάδα ὁ Ἱερεὺς λέγει· *Ἔτι δεόμεθα ὑπὲρ ἐλέους, ζωῆς, εἰρήνης, ὑγείας, σωτηρίας, συγχωρήσεως καὶ ἀφέσεως τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν τῶν δούλων τοῦ Θεοῦ, τῶν Ἐπιτρόπων, ἐνοριτῶν καὶ συνδρομητῶν τῆς ἁγίας Ἐκκλησίας ταύτης σὺν γυναιξὶ καὶ τέκνοις αὐτῶν*· κατὰ δὲ τὴν ε΄ ἑκατοντάδα λέγει, *ἔτι δεόμεθα ὑπὲρ πάσης ψυχῆς Χριστιανῶν Ὀρθοδόξων, ὑγείας τε καὶ σωτηρίας καὶ ἀφέσεως τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν αὐτῶν*).*

units.english_cohort_translation: *(Rubrical Note: One must bear in mind that this order of the Elevation of the Cross takes place in the Great Church and wherever a Hierarch presides; but in the absence of the Patriarch or Bishop, the Priest alone performs the Elevation, as is customary in other holy churches. In such cases, at the fourth hundred, the Priest says: **"Again we pray for mercy, life, peace, health, salvation, visitation, pardon, and remission of the sins of the servants of God, the churchwardens, parishioners, and benefactors of this holy church, with their wives and children"**; and at the fifth hundred, he says: **"Again we pray for every soul of Orthodox Christians, for their health, salvation, and the remission of their sins."*)

units.slavonic_incipit: Εἰσοδικὸν Ὑψοῦτε Κύριον τὸν θεὸν ἡμῶν
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Εἰσοδικὸν Ὑψοῦτε Κύριον τὸν θεὸν ἡμῶν καὶ προσκυνεῖτε τῷ ὑποποδίῳ τῶν ποδῶν αὐτοῦ, ὅτι Ἅγιός ἐστι, Σῶσον ἡμᾶς Υἱὲ Θεοῦ ὁ σαρκὶ Σταυρωθείς, ψάλλοντάς σοι, Ἀλληλούϊα· τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον Σῶσον Κύριε, τὸ Κοντάκιον Ὁ Ὑψωθείς, ἀντὶ τοῦ Τρισαγίου τὸν Σταυρόν σου προσκυνοῦμεν, ὁ Ἀπόστολος Ὁ λόγος ὁ τοῦ Σταυροῦ, τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον Συμβούλιον ἐποίησαν οἱ Ἀρχιερεῖς μέχρι τοῦ κλίνας τὴν κεφαλὴν παρέδωκε τὸ πνεῦμα. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως Μυστικὸς εἶ θεοτόκε, Κοινωνικὸν Ἐσημειώθη ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον Σῶσον Κύριε, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.
units.english_cohort_translation: Εἰσοδικὸν *Ὑψοῦτε Κύριον τὸν θεὸν ἡμῶν καὶ προσκυνεῖτε τῷ ὑποποδίῳ τῶν ποδῶν αὐτοῦ, ὅτι Ἅγιός ἐστι, Σῶσον ἡμᾶς Υἱὲ Θεοῦ ὁ σαρκὶ Σταυρωθείς, ψάλλοντάς σοι, Ἀλληλούϊα*· τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον *Σῶσον Κύριε*, τὸ Κοντάκιον *Ὁ Ὑψωθείς*, ἀντὶ τοῦ Τρισαγίου *Τὸν Σταυρόν σου προσκυνοῦμεν*, ὁ Ἀπόστολος *Ὁ λόγος ὁ τοῦ Σταυροῦ*, τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον *Συμβούλιον ἐποίησαν οἱ Ἀρχιερεῖς* μέχρι τοῦ *κλίνας τὴν κεφαλὴν παρέδωκε τὸ πνεῦμα*. Εἰς τὸ *Ἐξαιρέτως* *Μυστικὸς εἶ θεοτόκε*, Κοινωνικὸν *Ἐσημειώθη ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς*, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον *Σῶσον Κύριε*, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_incipit: Σημειωτέον ὅτι ἐν ᾗ ἄν ἡμέρᾳ
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Σημειωτέον ὅτι ἐν ᾗ ἄν ἡμέρᾳ τύχῃ ἡ ἑορτὴ τῆς Ὑψώσεως, ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ τῆς αὐτῆς ἡμέρας, Προκείμενον ψάλλεται τὸ Ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ καὶ ἐν τῇ γῇ μετὰ τῶν Στίχων αὐτοῦ. Προσεπισημιωτέον ὅτι ἐν τῇ πανσέπτῳ ταύτῃ ἑορτῇ, φερούσῃ τὰ ἴσα τῆς ἁγίας καὶ Μ. Παρασκευῆς, τελοῦμεν νηστείαν, μόνον δὲ ἂν συμπέσῃ ἐν Σαββάτῳ ἢ Κυριακῇ, γίνεται κατάλυσις οἴνου καὶ ἐλαίου.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 8.    Σαββάτῳ μετὰ τὴν Ὕψωσιν. Ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ ψάλλεται ἡ ἐν τῷ Μηναίῳ ἐνδιάτακτος μεθέορτος τοῦ Ἑσπερινοῦ Ἀκολουθία, ἐν τῷ Ὄρθρῳ λέγονται οἱ Κανόνες τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ τοῦ τυχόντος Ἁγίου χῦμα, εἰς τὴν η΄ Ὠδὴν ψάλλεται ὁ Εἱρμὸς καὶ στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν μετὰ τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον τοῦ τυχόντος Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τοῦ μικροῦ Ἑσπερινοῦ, ὡς καὶ τὸ Δόξα Καὶ νῦν. Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Ἀντίφωνα τῆς ἑορτῆς, μετὰ δὲ τὴν Εἴσοδον Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν ... ὁ σαρκὶ σταυρωθείς, Ἀπολυτίκιον καὶ Κοντάκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς. Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Σαββάτου μετὰ τὴν Ὕψωσιν, εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, Κοινωνικὸν Μακάριοι οὓς ἐξελέξω, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Isodikon [Entrance Hymn] “Extol the Lord our God; worship at his footstool. For He is holy! O Son of God, crucified in the flesh, save us who sing to You: Alleluia!” The Apolytikion “O Lord, save Your people” and the Kontakion “Lifted up of Your own will upon the Cross.” Instead of the Trisagios Hymn, we sing “We venerate Your Cross”; the Apostolos “The preaching of the Cross”; the Gospel “At that time the chief Priests and elders of the people took counsel” until “bowing His head, He gave up his spirit.” At “Especially,” “O Theotokos, you are a mystical Paradise,” Kinonikon [Communion Hymn] “The light of Your countenance is marked upon us, O Lord.” The Apolytikion “O Lord, save Your people,” and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: Entrance Hymn [Isodikon]: **"Exalt the Lord our God, and worship at His footstool, for He is holy. Save us, O Son of God, Who wast crucified in the flesh, who sing unto Thee: Alleluia!"** (*Ὑψοῦτε Κύριον τὸν Θεὸν ἡμῶν καὶ προσκυνεῖτε τῷ ὑποποδίῳ τῶν ποδῶν αὐτοῦ, ὅτι Ἅγιός ἐστιν· Σῶσον ἡμᾶς, Υἱὲ Θεοῦ, ὁ σαρκὶ σταυρωθείς, ψάλλοντάς σοι· Ἀλληλούϊα*, Ps. 98:5 LXX). The Dismissal Troparion: **"Save, O Lord, Thy people"** (*Σῶσον, Κύριε, τὸν λαόν σου*), and the Kontakion: **"Thou Who wast lifted up of Thine own will upon the Cross"** (*Ὁ ὑψωθεὶς ἐν τῷ Σταυρῷ*). Instead of the Trisagion Hymn, we sing: **"We venerate Thy Cross, O Master, and we glorify Thy holy Resurrection"** (*Τὸν Σταυρόν σου προσκυνοῦμεν, Δέσποτα, καὶ τὴν ἁγίαν σου Ἀνάστασιν δοξάζομεν*); the Epistle [Apostolos]: **"For the preaching of the Cross"** (*Ὁ λόγος γὰρ ὁ τοῦ σταυροῦ*, 1 Cor. 1:18–24); the Gospel: **"At that time, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel"** unto **"and bowing His head, He gave up the ghost"** (*Συμβούλιον ἔλαβον πάντες οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς... ἕως τοῦ· καὶ κλίνας τὴν κεφαλὴν παρέδωκε τὸ πνεῦμα*, John 19:6–11, 13–20, 25–28, 30–35). At the Megalynarion [Zadostoinyk]: **"O Theotokos, thou art a mystical paradise"** (*Μυστικὸς εἶ, Θεοτόκε, παράδεισος*). Communion Verse: **"The light of Thy countenance is marked upon us, O Lord"** (*Ἐσημειώθη ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς τὸ φῶς τοῦ προσώπου σου, Κύριε*, Ps. 4:7 LXX). The Dismissal Troparion: **"Save, O Lord, Thy people"**, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: It must be noted that, no matter on what day the Feast of the Elevation occurs, in the Vespers of that day, the following Prokimenon with its verses is sung: “Our God is in the heavens and on earth.” Also note that this Feast is equal in stature to Holy and Great Friday. It is observed as a fast. Only if the Feast occurs on a Saturday or Sunday, may wine and oil be consumed.
units.english_cohort_translation: It must be noted that, on whatever day the Feast of the Exaltation falls, at Vespers on the evening of that same day, the following Great Prokeimenon is sung with its verses: **"Our God is in heaven and on earth: all things whatsoever He willed, He hath done"** (*Ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ καὶ ἐν τῇ γῇ, πάντα ὅσα ἠθέλησεν ἐποίησεν*, Ps. 113:11 LXX). Also note that this all-venerable Feast bears equal rank to Holy and Great Friday: it is observed as a strict fast; only if the Feast concurs with a Saturday or Sunday is dispensation granted for wine and oil.[^153]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 8.    Saturday after the Elevation: In Vespers, we sing the Post-feast Vespers of the day as prescribed in the Mineon; in Matins the Canons of the Feast and of the occurring Saint are read; at the 9th Ode, the Irmos is sung and then the “More honorable” followed by the Exapostilarion of the Saint and that of the Feast. At the Praises: the Aposticha as well as the Glory, Now and ever of the Small Vespers. In the Liturgy, the Antiphons of the Feast, with the Isodikon “Come let us worship...who was crucified,” Apolytikion and Kontakion of the Feast. Apostolos and Gospel of the Saturday after the Elevation. At “Especially,” “It is meet,” Communion Hymn “Blessed are those whom you have chosen,” “We have seen the [true] light,” and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 8.    Saturday after the Exaltation. At Vespers: we sing the post-festal Vespers of the day as prescribed in the Menaion. At Matins: the Canons of the Feast and of the occurring Saint are read in direct sequence [*χῦμα*]; at the Eighth Ode, the Heirmos is sung, and then the biblical canticle with **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*), followed by the Exapostilarion of the occurring Saint and that of the Feast. At the Praises: the Stichira of the Aposticha of Small Vespers, as well as its **"Glory"**, **"Both now"**. At the Divine Liturgy: the Antiphons of the Feast, with the Entrance Hymn: **"Come, let us worship and fall down before Christ; save us, O Son of God, Who wast crucified in the flesh, who sing unto Thee: Alleluia!"** (*Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν καὶ προσπέσωμεν Χριστῷ· σῶσον ἡμᾶς, Υἱὲ Θεοῦ, ὁ σαρκὶ σταυρωθείς, ψάλλοντάς σοι· Ἀλληλούϊα*); Dismissal Troparion and Kontakion of the Feast. The Epistle and Gospel of the Saturday after the Exaltation [1 Cor. 1:26–29; John 8:21–30]. At the Megalynarion: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Verse: **"Blessed are they whom Thou hast chosen and taken to Thyself, O Lord"** (*Μακάριοι οὓς ἐξελέξω καὶ προσελάβου, Κύριε*, Ps. 64:5 LXX), **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 9.    Sunday after the Elevation. On Saturday in Vespers, following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter, at “Lord, I have cried” we sing 6 Resurrection Stichira and 4 Stichira of the Post-feast, Glory of the Post-feast, Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, “O Gladsome Light,” and the Prokimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory, Now and ever of the Post-feast; the Resurrection Apolytikion and that of the Feast (once each), and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 9.    Sunday after the Exaltation. On Saturday evening at Great Vespers: following the Introductory Psalm [Psalm 103 LXX] and the First Kathisma of the Psalter [Kathisma 1: *Blessed is the man*], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 6 Resurrection Stichira and 4 post-festal Stichira of the Feast; **"Glory"**: of the Feast; **"Both now"**: the First Dogmatic Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon: **"The Lord is king"** (*Ὁ Κύριος ἐβασίλευσεν*, Ps. 92:1 LXX). At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; **"Glory"**, **"Both now"**: of the Feast; Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Feast (once each), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_incipit: Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος· τὰ ἀναστάσιμα
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος· τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα καὶ ἀνὰ ἓν τῆς ἑορτῆς ἀντὶ τῶν Θεοτοκίων· τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κάθισμα τοῦ τυχόντος Ἁγίου καὶ μεθέορτον· ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων τῆς ἡμέρας· αἱ Καταβασίαι Σταυρὸν χαράξας καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, εἶτα Στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἐξαποστειλάριον, καὶ μεθέορτον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ μεθέορτα δ΄. Δόξα τὸ Ἑωθινον, Καὶ νῦν Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 11.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄ καὶ δ΄ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Κανόνος τῆς ἑορτῆς· μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τῆς ἑορτῆς, τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, καὶ τὸ Κοντάκιον Ὁ ὑψωθείς. Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς μετὰ τὴν Ὕψωσιν. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, Κοινωνικὸν Αἰνεῖτε, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 13.    Εἰ τύχοι ἐν Κυριακῇ, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ δ΄, μεθέορτα τοῦ Σταυροῦ γ΄ καὶ τῆς Ἁγίας γ΄, Δόξα τῆς Ἁγίας Ἡ διηνθισμένη ταῖς ἀρεταῖς, Καὶ νῦν τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρὸν καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον Εἰς Ἀπόστιχα τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, Δόξα τὰ τῆς Ἁγίας, Καὶ νῦν μεθέορτον, Ἀπολυτίκια· τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τὸ τῆς Ἁγίας, τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 14.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα μετὰ τῶν μεθεόρτων, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος, ὁ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ τῆς Ἁγίας· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κάθισμα τῆς Ἁγίας

units.slavonic_incipit: and one of the Feast in
units.slavonic_diplomatic: and one of the Feast in place of each of the Theotokia; the Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode and the Prokimenon. The Canons of the Resurrection and of the Feast. After the 3rd Ode, the Kathisma of the Saint of the day and the Post-feast; after the 6th Ode, the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos and the Minologion of the Saints of the day. The Katavasie “Moses, having etched the sign of the Cross,” and the order of the Matins Gospel; then we sing “More honorable,” the Resurrection Exapostilarion and that of the Post-feast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 Stichira of the Post-feast, Glory the Eothinon, Now and ever, “Most blessed,” Great Doxology and “Today salvation.”
units.english_cohort_translation: ...the Psalter and the Amomos [Psalm 118 LXX]: the Resurrection Kathismata and one of the Feast in place of each of the Theotokia; the Sunday Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: the Resurrection Canon and that of the Feast. After the Third Ode: the Kathisma of the occurring Saint and the post-festal Kathisma; after the Sixth Ode: the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, and the Synaxarion of the Saints of the day from the Menaion. The Katavasiai: **"Moses, having etched the cross"** (*Σταυρὸν χαράξας*), and the entire order of the Sunday Morning Gospel; then we sing the biblical canticle with **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*); the Resurrection Exapostilarion, and that of the Feast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 post-festal Stichira; **"Glory"**: the appointed Sunday Eothinon Doxastikon; **"Both now"**: **"Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις*); the Great Doxology, and the Sunday Dismissal Troparion: **"Today salvation has come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 11.    In the Liturgy, the Typika, and 4 Beatitudes of the Mode and 4 hymns from the 6th Ode of the Canon of the Feast. After the Entrance, the Resurrection Apolytikion, that of the Feast, that of the Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion “Lifted up on the Cross.” The Apostolos and Gospel of the Sunday after the Elevation. At “Especially,” “It is meet,” Communion Hymn “Praise the Lord,” “We have seen the [true] light,” and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 11.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Typika, and 4 Beatitudes of the Tone and 4 Troparia from the Sixth Ode of the Canon of the Feast. After the Little Entrance: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Feast, that of the Patron Saint of the temple, and the Kontakion: **"Thou Who wast lifted up of Thine own will upon the Cross"** (*Ὁ ὑψωθεὶς ἐν τῷ Σταυρῷ*). The Epistle and Gospel of the Sunday after the Exaltation [Gal. 2:16–20; Mark 8:34–9:1]. At the Megalynarion: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Verse: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον ἐκ τῶν οὐρανῶν*, Ps. 148:1 LXX), **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν*), and Dismissal.[^154]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 13.    If the Feast occurs on Sunday, Saturday in Vespers, following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter, at “Lord, I have cried” we sing 4 Resurrection Stichira, 3 Stichira of the Post-feast of the Cross and 3 of the Saint. Glory of the Saint “The one decorated by virtues,” Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, “O Gladsome Light” and the Prokimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory of the Saint, Now and ever of the Post-feast; the Resurrection Apolytikion, that of the Saint, and that of the Feast, and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 13.    If the feast occurs on Sunday: on Saturday evening at Great Vespers, following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 4 Resurrection Stichira, 3 post-festal Stichira of the Cross, and 3 Stichira of the Saint; **"Glory"** of the Saint: **"Adorned with the virtues"** (*Ἡ διηνθισμένη ταῖς ἀρεταῖς*); **"Both now"**: the First Dogmatic Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; **"Glory"** of the Saint; **"Both now"**: of the Feast; Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Saint [**"Thy lamb, O Jesus, Euphemia"** / *Ἡ ἀμνάς σου, Ἰησοῦ*], that of the Feast, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: καὶ μεθέορτον, ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων τῆς ἡμέρας· αἱ Καταβασίαι Σταυρὸν χαράξας καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, εἶτα Στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν· Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τὸ τῆς Ἁγίας καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς. units.slavonic_diplomatic: 15.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄ καὶ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Κανόνος τῆς Ἁγίας δ΄, μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ τῆς Ἁγίας, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ καὶ τὸ Κοντάκιον Ὁ Ὑψωθείς, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς μετὰ τὴν [Ὕψωσιν.] Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, Κοινωνικὸν Αἰνεῖτε, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Saint and of the Post-feast; after the 6th Ode, the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos and the Minologion of the Saints of the day. The Katavasie “Moses, having etched the sign of the Cross,” and the entire order of the Matins Gospel; then we sing “More honorable.” The Resurrection Exapostilarion, that of the Saint and that of the Feast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 Stichira of the Saint, Glory the Eothinon, Now and ever, “Most blessed,” Great Doxology and “Today salvation.”
units.english_cohort_translation: ...Saint and of the Afterfeast; after the Sixth Ode: the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, and the Synaxarion of the Saints of the day from the Menaion. The Katavasiai: **"Moses, having etched the cross"** (*Σταυρὸν χαράξας*), and the entire order of the Sunday Morning Gospel; then we sing the biblical canticle with **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). The Resurrection Exapostilarion, that of the Saint, and that of the Feast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 Stichira of the Saint; **"Glory"**: the Sunday Eothinon Doxastikon; **"Both now"**: **"Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις*); the Great Doxology, and the Sunday Dismissal Troparion: **"Today salvation has come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

units.english_cohort_translation: 15.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Typika, and 4 Beatitudes of the Tone and 4 Troparia from the Sixth Ode of the Canon of the Saint. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory of the Saint, Now and ever of the Post-feast, The Resurrection Apolytikion, that of the Saint, and that of the Feast, and Dismissal. In Matins, at “God is the Lord”: the Apolytikia as in Vespers. The Canons of the Resurrection, of the Feast, and of the Saint. After the 3rd Ode, the Kathisma of the Saint; the Resurrection Exapostilarion, that of the Saint and that of the Feast. In the Liturgy, after the Entrance, the Resurrection Apolytikion, of the Feast, of the Saint, that of the Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion “Lifted up on the Cross”; Apostolos and Gospel of the Sunday after the Elevation, etc.
units.english_cohort_translation: 16. At the Aposticha: **"Glory"** of the Saint; **"Both now"**: post-festal Doxastikon of the Feast; Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Saint [**"Thy martyrs, O Lord"** / *Οἱ μάρτυρές σου, Κύριε*], that of the Feast, and Dismissal. At Matins: at **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*), the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers. The Canons: of the Resurrection, of the Feast, and of the Saint. After the Third Ode: the Kathisma of the Saint; the Resurrection Exapostilarion, that of the Saint, and that of the Feast. At the Divine Liturgy: after the Little Entrance, the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Feast, that of the Saint, and that of the Patron Saint of the temple. The Epistle and Gospel of the Sunday after the Exaltation, etc.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 18.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ Ἀπόδοσις ἐν Κυριακῇ, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ δ΄, τῆς ἑορτῆς ς΄, Δόξα τῆς ἑορτῆς, Καὶ νῦν τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρὸν καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, Δόξα Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς, Ἀπολυτίκια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς δὶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 19.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος· εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον ἅπαξ, καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς δίς· τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος· τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα καὶ ἀνὰ ἓν τῆς ἑορτῆς ἀντὶ Θεοτοκίων, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κάθισμα τῆς ἑορτῆς ἅπαξ, καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων τῆς ἡμέρας· αἱ Καταβασίαι Σταυρὸν χαράξας καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα ψάλλεται ἡ Θ΄ Ὠδὴ τῆς ἑορτῆς μετὰ τῶν δύο Καταβασιῶν, Ἐξαποστειλάρια, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον καὶ τὰ δύο τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους Ἀναστάσιμα καὶ τὰ δύο τῆς ἑορτῆς δ΄. Δόξα τῆς ἑορτῆς. Καὶ νῦν Ὑπερευλογημένη, [Μ. Δοξολογία] καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία.

Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν τὰ Ἀντίφωνα τῆς ἑορτῆς, εἰς τὸ β Ἀντίφωνον Ὁ σαρκὶ σταυρωθείς, εἶτα τὸ Εἰσοδικὸν τῆς ἑορτῆς μετὰ τοῦ Ὁ ἀναστὰς ἐκ νεκρῶν, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ τοῦ ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ καὶ τὸ Κοντάκιον Ὁ ὑψωθεὶς ἐν τῷ Σταυρῷ, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς μετὰ τὴν Ὕψωσιν. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως Ὁ διὰ βρώσεως τοῦ ξύλου, Κοινωνικὸν Ἐσημειώθη ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς, τὸ Σῶσον Κύριε καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: the Liti, the Gospel of Matins and the Polyeleos. In the Liturgy, the Apostolos and Gospel of the day are recited. Kinonikon [Communion Hymn] “The light of Your countenance is marked upon us, O Lord,” the Apolytikion “O Lord, save Your people,” and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: ...the Liti, the Matins Gospel, and the Polyeleos are omitted. At the Divine Liturgy: the Epistle and Gospel of the day are read; Communion Verse: **"The light of Thy countenance is marked upon us, O Lord"** (*Ἐσημειώθη ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς τὸ φῶς τοῦ προσώπου σου, Κύριε*, Ps. 4:7 LXX), the Dismissal Troparion: **"Save, O Lord, Thy people"** (*Σῶσον, Κύριε, τὸν λαόν σου*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 18.    If the Leave-taking occurs on a Sunday, on Saturday in Vespers, following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter, at “Lord, I have cried,” we sing 4 Resurrection Stichira and 6 Stichira of the Feast, Glory of the Feast, Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, “O Gladsome Light,” and the Prokimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory, Now and ever of the Feast; the Resurrection Apolytikion, that of the Feast twice, and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 18.    If the Apodosis occurs on a Sunday: on Saturday evening at Great Vespers, following the Introductory Psalm [Psalm 103 LXX] and the First Kathisma of the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 4 Resurrection Stichira and 6 Stichira of the Feast; **"Glory"** of the Feast; **"Both now"**: the First Dogmatic Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; **"Glory"**, **"Both now"** of the Feast; Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Feast twice, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 19.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Triadic Canon, and the Triadic “It is meet”; the Trisagion, the Apolytikion of the Feast and the Exapsalmos. At “God is the Lord”: the Resurrection Apolytikion once and the Feast’s twice; the Psalter and the Amomos. The Resurrection Kathismata and the Kathismata of the Feast in place of the Resurrection Theotokia; the Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode and the Prokimenon. The Canons of the Resurrection and of the Feast. After the 3rd Ode, the Kathisma of the Feast once; after the 6th Ode, the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos and the Minologion of the Saints of the day. The Katavasie “Moses, having etched the sign of the Cross,” and the order of the Matins Gospel; then we sing the 9th Ode of the Feast with the two Katavasie; the Resurrection Exapostilarion and the two Exapostilaria of the Feast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and the 3 Stichira of the Feast, repeating the first, Glory of the Feast, Now and ever, “Most blessed,” [the Great Doxology] and “Today salvation”.
units.english_cohort_translation: 19.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 LXX, the Triadic Canon and the Triadic hymn: **"It is meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion once, and that of the Feast twice; the Psalter and the Amomos [Psalm 118 LXX]. The Resurrection Kathismata and the Kathismata of the Feast in place of each of the Resurrection Theotokia; the Sunday Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: the Resurrection Canon and that of the Feast. After the Third Ode: the Kathisma of the Feast once; after the Sixth Ode: the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, and the Synaxarion of the Saints of the day from the Menaion. The Katavasiai: **"Moses, having etched the cross"** (*Σταυρὸν χαράξας*), and the entire order of the Sunday Morning Gospel; then we sing the Ninth Ode of the Feast with the two Katavasiai; the Resurrection Exapostilarion and the two Exapostilaria of the Feast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and the 3 Stichira of the Feast, repeating the first [so as to make 4]; **"Glory"** of the Feast; **"Both now"**: **"Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις*); [the Great Doxology] and the Sunday Dismissal Troparion: **"Today salvation has come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 20.    In the Liturgy, the Antiphons of the Feast, at the 2nd Antiphon “Who was crucified in the flesh,” then the Isodikon of the Feast with “who is risen from the dead.” The Resurrection Apolytikion, that of the Feast, that of the Saint, that of the Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion “Lifted up on the Cross of Your own will.” Apostolos and Gospel of the Sunday after the Elevation. At “Especially,” “Through the eating of the tree,” Communion Hymn “The light of Your countenance,” [the Apolytikion] “O Lord, save Your people,” and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 20.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Antiphons of the Feast; at the Second Antiphon, the refrain is: **"Save us, O Son of God, Who wast crucified in the flesh..."** (*Ὁ σαρκὶ σταυρωθείς*); then the Entrance Hymn of the Feast with **"Who art risen from the dead"** (*Ὁ ἀναστὰς ἐκ νεκρῶν*). The Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Feast, that of the Patron Saint of the temple, and the Kontakion: **"Thou Who wast lifted up of Thine own will upon the Cross"** (*Ὁ ὑψωθεὶς ἐν τῷ Σταυρῷ*). The Epistle and Gospel of the Sunday after the Exaltation [Gal. 2:16–20; Mark 8:34–9:1]. At the Megalynarion [Zadostoinyk]: **"Through the tasting of the tree"** (*Ὁ διὰ βρώσεως τοῦ ξύλου*). Communion Verse: **"The light of Thy countenance is marked upon us, O Lord"** (*Ἐσημειώθη ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς*), [the Dismissal Troparion] **"Save, O Lord, Thy people"**, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 2.    Εἰ τύχοι ἐν Κυριακῇ, τῷ Σαββ. ἑσπέρας, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν Ἀναστάσιμα ς΄ καὶ τοῦ Προδρόμου δ΄, Δόξα τοῦ Προδρόμου, Καὶ νῦν τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου, Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρὸν καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, Δόξα τοῦ Προδρόμου, Καὶ νῦν Ὁ ποιητὴς καὶ λυτρωτής μου, Ἀπολυτίκια, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τοῦ Προδρόμου, Ἡ πρῴην οὐ τίκτουσα, τὸ Θεοτοκίον καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

Τῇ Κυρ. εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὴν ἐξ ἔθους Ἀκολουθίαν τῆς Κυριακῆς, οἱ Κανόνες ἀμφότεροι ὅ, τε Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ τοῦ Προδρόμου, ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κάθισμα Θυμιῶντι ἐν Ναῷ, [Δόξα,] Καὶ νῦν, Κατεπλάγη Ἰωσήφ, ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα, καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων τῆς ἡμέρας, αἱ Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου κτλ. Ἐξαποστειλάρια, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον, τὸ τοῦ Προδρόμου καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ δ΄ τοῦ Προδρόμου. Δόξα τὸ Ἑωθινόν, Καὶ νῦν Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μ., Σήμερον σωτηρία καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία, Ἀπόστολος τοῦ Προδρόμου καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς, Κοινωνικὸν Αἰνεῖτε, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 2.    If the Feast occurs on Sunday, then Saturday in Vespers, following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter, at “Lord, I have cried” we sing 6 Resurrection Stichira and 3 Stichira of the Forerunner, Glory of the Forerunner, Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, “O Gladsome Light” and the Prokimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory of the Forerunner, Now and ever, “My maker and Saviour”; the Resurrection Apolytikion, that of the Forerunner “You, the barren one,” the Theotokion, and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 2.    If the feast occurs on Sunday: on Saturday evening at Great Vespers, following the Introductory Psalm [Psalm 103 LXX] and the First Kathisma of the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 6 Resurrection Stichira and 4 Stichira of the Forerunner [the Greek reads 4; the first edition incorrectly translated 3]; **"Glory"** of the Forerunner; **"Both now"**: the First Dogmatic Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; **"Glory"** of the Forerunner; **"Both now"**: **"My Maker and Redeemer"** (*Ὁ ποιητὴς καὶ λυτρωτής μου*); the Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Forerunner: **"Rejoice, O barren one who previously didst not bear"** (*Ἡ πρῴην οὐ τίκτουσα*), the Theotokion, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 3.    On Sunday at Matins, after the customary Service of Sunday, the Canons both of the Resurrection and of the Forerunner. After the 3rd Ode, the Kathisma “Censing in the Temple,” and [Glory,] Now and ever, “Joseph struck with wonder”; after the 6th Ode, the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos and the Minologion of the Saints of the day; the Katavasie “I shall open my mouth,” etc. The Resurrection Exapostilarion, that of the Forerunner and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 Stichira of the Forerunner, Glory the Eothinon, Now and ever, “Most blessed,” Great Doxology and “Today salvation.” Then follows the Liturgy, Apostolos of the Forerunner and Gospel of the Sunday, Communion Hymn “Praise,” “We have seen the [true] light,” and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 3.    On Sunday at Matins: after the customary Sunday order, both Canons: that of the Resurrection and that of the Forerunner. After the Third Ode: the Kathisma: **"As Zacharias was offering incense in the temple"** (*Θυμιῶντι ἐν Ναῷ*), and [**"Glory"**,] **"Both now"**: **"Joseph was struck with wonder"** (*Κατεπλάγη Ἰωσήφ*); after the Sixth Ode: the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, and the Synaxarion of the Saints of the day from the Menaion; the Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*), etc. The Resurrection Exapostilarion, that of the Forerunner, and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 Stichira of the Forerunner; **"Glory"**: the appointed Sunday Eothinon Doxastikon; **"Both now"**: **"Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις*); the Great Doxology, and the Sunday Dismissal Troparion: **"Today salvation has come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*). Then follows the Divine Liturgy: the Epistle of the Forerunner [Gal. 4:22–31] and the Gospel of the Sunday; Communion Verse: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 148:1 LXX), **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν*), and Dismissal.[^157]

Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Readings of the Theotokos [Gen. 28:10–17; Ezek. 43:27–44:4; Prov. 9:1–11]. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; **"Glory"** of the Saint; **"Both now"** of the Theotokos. The Dismissal Troparia: of the Resurrection, of the Saint, and of the Theotokos...

If the commemoration occurs on Sunday, then in Vespers on Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter, at “Lord, I have cried” we sing 4 Stichira of the Resurrection, 3 Stichira of the Theotokos, and 3 of Saint Thekla, Glory, “Who will not wonder?” Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, “O Gladsome Light,” the Prokimenon and the Readings of the Theotokos. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory of the Saint, Now and ever of the Theotokos. The Apolytikia: of the Resurrection, of the Saint, and of the Theotokos

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 2.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν καὶ ἡ Λιτὴ τῆς Θεοτόκου, τὰ Τριαδικὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς Θεοτόκου καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον (ἀντὶ τῶν Θεοτοκίων) καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα καὶ ἀνὰ ἓν τῆς Θεοτόκου, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον, Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ τῆς Θεοτόκου, ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κάθισμα τῆς Ἁγίας καὶ τῆς Θεοτόκου, ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον· αἱ Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, εἶτα Στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν. Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τὸ τῆς Ἁγίας καὶ τῆς Θεοτόκου. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τῆς Θεοτόκου δ΄, Δόξα τὸ Ἑωθινόν, Καὶ νῦν Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μ. καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 2.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Triadic Canon and the Liti of the Theotokos, the Triadic “It is meet”; the Trisagion, the Apolytikion of the Theotokos and the Exapsalmos. At “God is the Lord”: the Apolytikia as in Vespers, the Psalter and the Amomos. The Resurrection Kathismata and the one of the Theotokos {in place of the Theotokia of the Paraklitiki}, the Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode and the Prokimenon. The Canons of the Resurrection and of the Theotokos. After the 3rd Ode, the Kathisma of the Saint and the Theotokos; after the 6th Ode, the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos and the Minologion.
units.english_cohort_translation: 2.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon and the Liti of the Theotokos; the Triadic hymn: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); the Trisagion, the Dismissal Troparion of the Theotokos, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; the Psalter and the Amomos [Psalm 118 LXX]; the Resurrection Kathismata and one of the Theotokos [in place of the Theotokia of the Octoechos]; the Sunday Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: the Resurrection Canon and that of the Theotokos. After the Third Ode: the Kathisma of the Saint and that of the Theotokos; after the Sixth Ode: the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, and the Synaxarion of the Saints of the day from the Menaion. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*), and the entire order of the Sunday Morning Gospel; then we sing the biblical canticle with **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrection Exapostilarion, that of the Saint, and that of the Theotokos. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 Stichira of the Theotokos; **"Glory"**: the appointed Sunday Eothinon Doxastikon; **"Both now"**: **"Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις*); the Great Doxology, and the Sunday Dismissal Troparion: **"Today salvation has come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

After the Little Entrance: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Theotokos, that of the Saint, that of the Patron Saint of the temple, and the Kontakion: **"O Protection of Christians that cannot be put to shame"** (*Προστασία τῶν χριστιανῶν ἀκαταίσχυντε*). The Epistle of the Saint [2 Tim. 3:10–15] and the Gospel of the Sunday. At the Megalynarion: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Verse: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 148:1 LXX), **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_incipit: Apolytikion of Saint Thekla, composed by
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Apolytikion of Saint Thekla, composed by the late Patriarch of Constantinople Cyril [the 6th] in 1813 Mode III Inflamed by desire for your Creator through the teaching of a divine preacher, you ignored the earthly things as transitory; and offering yourself to God as an auspicious sacrifice, you defied all punishments. Glorious Thekla, fellow-traveller of the divine Paul [the Apostle], beseech your Bridegroom Christ to grant to us the great mercy.
units.english_cohort_translation: **"Inflamed with desire for Thy Creator through the teaching of the divine preacher, thou didst disregard earthly things as transient; and offering thyself to God as a holy and pleasing sacrifice, thou didst brave all torments, O glorious Thecla, fellow-traveler of the divine Paul: intercede with Christ, thy Bridegroom, that He may grant unto us His great mercy."** (*Θείου κήρυκος διδασκαλίας, πόθῳ Κτίστου σου ἀναφλεχθεῖσα, τῶν γηηρῶν ὡς ρεόντων ἠλόγησας καὶ σεαυτὴν ἱερὸν καλλιέρημα τῷ Θεῷ δοῦσα, ποινῶν κατετόλμησας, Θέκλα ἔνδοξε, Παύλου τοῦ θείου συνέκδημε, τὸν σὸν νυμφίον Χριστὸν ἱκέτευε, δωρήσασθαι ἡμῖν τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.*)

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 1.    Ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὴν α΄ Στάσιν τοῦ Ψαλτηρίου, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν τὰ γ΄ Προσόμοια Ὁ θεατὴς τῶν ἀρρήτων εἰς ς΄. Δόξα Τὸν Υἱὸν τῆς βροντῆς, Καὶ νῦν Παρῆλθεν ἡ σκιά, Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον τῆς ἡμέρας καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα (καθ’ ἅ ἡμεῖς ἱστάμεθα, ὁ δὲ Διάκονος ἐκφωνεῖ Πρόσχωμεν, Σοφία, Πρόσχωμεν). Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τὰ Προσόμοια, Δόξα Ἀπόστολε Χριστοῦ, Καὶ νῦν Θεοτόκε σὺ εἶ ἡ ἄμπελος, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον Ἀπόστολε Χριστῷ τῷ Θεῷ· (Δόξα,) Καὶ νῦν Πάντα ὑπὲρ ἔννοιαν, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.
