units.slavonic_diplomatic: 3.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50, we do the Triadic Canon, and the Triadic "It is meet"; then the Trisagion, the Ypakoi and the Exapsalmos. At "God is the Lord": the Apolytikia as in Vespers; then the Psalter and the Amomos; the Resurrection Kathismata in order, the Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode and the Prokimenon. The Canons of the Resurrection and of the Saints. After the 3rd Ode, the Kathisma of the Saints and the Theotokion; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrection and the Minologion of the Saints. The Katavasie "I shall open my mouth," and the entire order of the Morning Gospel; then we sing "More honorable." Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection, of the Saints and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Saints (the Aposticha of Vespers). Glory the Eothinon, Now and ever, "Most blessed," Great Doxology and "Today salvation." Then the Liturgy follows, in which are sung the Typika and 4 Beatitudes of the Mode and 4 hymns from the 6th Ode of the Canon of the Saints. Apostolos of the Saints and Gospel of the Sunday, Communion Hymn "Praise," "We have seen the [true] light," and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 3.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon and the Triadic hymn: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion, the Hypakoe, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; then the Psalter and the Amomos [Psalm 118 LXX]; the Resurrection Kathismata in order, the Sunday Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: the Resurrection Canon and that of the Saints. After the Third Ode: the Kathisma of the Saints and the Theotokion; after the Sixth Ode: the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, and the Synaxarion of the Saints from the Menaion. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*), and the entire order of the Sunday Morning Gospel; then we sing the biblical canticle with **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrection Exapostilarion, that of the Saints, and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 Stichira of the Saints (the Aposticha of Vespers); **"Glory"**: the appointed Sunday Eothinon Doxastikon; **"Both now and ever"**: **"Most blessed art Thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); the Great Doxology, and **"Today salvation has come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*). Then the Divine Liturgy follows, in which are sung the Typika, and 4 Beatitudes of the Tone and 4 Troparia from the Sixth Ode of the Canon of the Saints. Epistle of the Saints [2 Cor. 4:6–15] and Gospel of the Sunday; Communion Verse: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε*, Ps. 148:1 LXX), **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.[^173]

units.english_cohort_translation: 1.    At Vespers: following the Introductory Psalm [Psalm 103 LXX] and the First Stasis of the Psalter [Kathisma 1, Psalms 1–3 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing the 3 Prosomoia of the Saint: **"The gold-wrought trumpet"** (*Τὴν χρυσήλατον Σάλπιγγα*), repeated twice to make 6; **"Glory"**: **"Righteous Father, thrice-blessed"** (*Ὅσιε τρισμάκαρ*); **"Both now and ever"**: **"Who will not call thee blessed, O all-holy Virgin?"** (*Τίς μὴ μακαρίσει σε*). Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς...*)...

units.slavonic_diplomatic: ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον τῆς ἡμέρας καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ γ΄ Προσόμοια, Δόξα Σάλπιγξ χρυσόφωνος, Καὶ νῦν Θεοτόκε σὺ εἶ ἡ ἄμπελος, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον Ἡ τοῦ στόματός σου καθάπερ, τὸ Θεοτοκίον Ὁ δι’ ἡμᾶς γεννηθεὶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 2.    Εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ἡ Λιτὴ τοῦ Ἁγίου, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον δὶς καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον ἅπαξ· τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος. Τὰ Καθίσματα κατὰ σειράν· οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον Τὸ στόμα μου λαλήσει σοφίαν, τὸ Πᾶσα πνοὴ καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον· εἶτα ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα, Δόξα Σήμερον σκιρτῶσιν ἐν πνεύματι, Καὶ νῦν Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου, ὁ Στίχος Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεὸς καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Ἐξεχύθη ἡ χάρις ἐν χείλεσί σου, Κανόνες ὁ τῆς Θεοτόκου Ὑγρὰν διοδεύσας, καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἁγίου· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κάθισμα καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον· ἀφ’ ς΄ τὸ Κοντάκιον, ὁ Οἶκος καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου, καὶ στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, εἶτα τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους τὰ Προσόμοια Χρυσοῦ τηλαυγέστερον, Δόξα Χρυσέοις ἔπεσι, Καὶ νῦν, Δέσποινα πρόσδεξαι, Δοξολογία Μ. καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον.

Τὰ Καθίσματα κατὰ σειράν· οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον *Τὸ στόμα μου λαλήσει σοφίαν*, τὸ *Πᾶσα πνοὴ* καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον· εἶτα ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα, *Δόξα* *Σήμερον σκιρτῶσιν ἐν πνεύματι*, *Καὶ νῦν* *Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου*, ὁ Στίχος *Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεὸς* καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον *Ἐξεχύθη ἡ χάρις ἐν χείλεσί σου*, Κανόνες ὁ τῆς Θεοτόκου *Ὑγρὰν διοδεύσας*, καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἁγίου· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κάθισμα καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον· ἀφ’ ς΄ τὸ Κοντάκιον, ὁ Οἶκος καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι *Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*, καὶ στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*, εἶτα τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους τὰ Προσόμοια *Χρυσοῦ τηλαυγέστερον*, *Δόξα* *Χρυσέοις ἔπεσι*, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Δέσποινα πρόσδεξαι*, Δοξολογία Μ. καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Gladsome Light," the Prokimenon of the day and the Readings. At the Aposticha: the 3 Prosomia, Glory, "The Golden-voiced Trumpet," Now and ever, "Theotokos, you are the vine"; the Apolytikion "Grace has shown forth from your mouth," the Theotokion "Born for our sakes," and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: ...Gladsome Light** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon of the day, and the Old Testament Readings [Composite 1: Prov. 10:7, 6, 3:13–16, 8:6 etc.; Composite 2: Prov. 10:31–11:12; Composite 3: Wis. 4:7–15]. At the Aposticha: the 3 Prosomoia; **"Glory"**: **"The golden-voiced trumpet"** (*Σάλπιγξ χρυσόφωνος*); **"Both now and ever"**: **"O Theotokos, thou art the vine"** (*Θεοτόκε σὺ εἶ ἡ ἄμπελος*); the Dismissal Troparion: **"The grace of thy mouth shining forth like a torch"** (*Ἡ τοῦ στόματός σου καθάπερ πυρσός*), the Theotokion: **"Thou who for our sake wast born"** (*Ὁ δι’ ἡμᾶς γεννηθείς*), and Dismissal.

units.english_text: ...Gladsome Light** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon of the day, and the Old Testament Readings [Composite 1: Prov. 10:7, 6, 3:13–16, 8:6 etc.; Composite 2: Prov. 10:31–11:12; Composite 3: Wis. 4:7–15]. At the Aposticha: the 3 Prosomoia; **"Glory"**: **"The golden-voiced trumpet"** (*Σάλπιγξ χρυσόφωνος*); **"Both now and ever"**: **"O Theotokos, thou art the vine"** (*Θεοτόκε σὺ εἶ ἡ ἄμπελος*); the Dismissal Troparion: **"The grace of thy mouth shining forth like a torch"** (*Ἡ τοῦ στόματός σου καθάπερ πυρσός*), the Theotokion: **"Thou who for our sake wast born"** (*Ὁ δι’ ἡμᾶς γεννηθείς*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 2.    At Matins, after Psalm 50, the Liti of the Saint, then the Trisagion, the Apolytikion and the Exapsalmos. At "God is the Lord": the Apolytikion twice, and the Theotokion once; the Psalter and the Polyeleos, the Kathismata in order, the Anavathmi, the first Antiphon of Mode IV, and the Prokimenon "My mouth proclaims wisdom." Then "Let everything that has breath," and the Gospel of [Matins]; then Psalm 50 (read), Glory, "Today rejoice in the Spirit," Now and ever, "Through the intercessions of the Theotokos," the Verse "O merciful One, have mercy upon me," and the Idiomelon "Grace has poured out in your lips." The Canon of the Theotokos "Passing the sea" {this is the Canon of the Small Paraklisis} and the Canon of the Saint. After the 3rd Ode, the Kathisma and the Theotokion; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos and the Minologion. The Katavasie "I shall open my mouth," then we sing "More honorable." Then the Exapostilarion and the Theotokion. At the Praises: the Prosomia, "More brilliant than gold," Glory, "Golden drops," Now and ever, "Lady, accept," Great Doxology and the Apolytikion.
units.english_cohort_translation: 2.    At Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Liti of the Saint; then the Trisagion, the Dismissal Troparion, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparion twice, and the Theotokion once; the Psalter and the Polyeleos; the Kathismata in order; the Anavathmoi: the First Antiphon of Tone 4; the Prokeimenon: **"My mouth shall speak wisdom, and the meditation of my heart understanding"** (*Τὸ στόμα μου λαλήσει σοφίαν*, Ps. 48:4 LXX); **"Let every breath"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*), and the Matins Gospel [John 10:9–16]; then Psalm 50 [LXX] (recited plain); **"Glory"**: **"Today the souls of the righteous leap in spirit"** (*Σήμερον σκιρτῶσιν ἐν πνεύματι*); **"Both now and ever"**: **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos"**; the Verse: **"Have mercy upon me, O God"** [Ps. 50:3 LXX], and the Idiomelon: **"Grace was poured out upon thy lips"** (*Ἐξεχύθη ἡ χάρις ἐν χείλεσί σου*, Ps. 44:3 LXX). The Canons: that of the Theotokos: **"Having traversed the water"** (*Ὑγρὰν διοδεύσας*), and that of the Saint; after the Third Ode: the Kathisma and the Theotokion; after the Sixth Ode: the Kontakion, the Ikos, and the Synaxarion from the Menaion. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*); then we sing the biblical canticle with **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*); then the Exapostilarion and the Theotokion. At the Praises: the Prosomoia: **"Shining more brightly than gold"** (*Χρυσοῦ τηλαυγέστερον*); **"Glory"**: **"With golden words"** (*Χρυσέοις ἔπεσι*); **"Both now and ever"**: **"O Lady, accept"** (*Δέσποινα πρόσδεξαι*); the Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 3.    In the Liturgy, the Typika and the Beatitudes, hymns from the 3rd and 6th Ode of the Canon of the Saint. After the Entrance, the Apolytikion of the Saint, that of the Saint of the Church and the Kontakion "The all-pure Temple"; the Apostolos and the Gospel. At "Especially," "It is meet," Communion Hymn "In eternal memory," "We have seen the [true] light," and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 3.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Typika and the Beatitudes, with Troparia from the Third and Sixth Odes of the Canon of the Saint. After the Little Entrance: the Dismissal Troparion of the Saint, that of the Patron Saint of the temple, and the Kontakion: **"The most pure Temple of the Saviour"** (*Ὁ καθαρώτατος ναός*); the Epistle [Heb. 7:26–8:2] and the Gospel [John 10:9–16]. At the Megalynarion: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Verse: **"The righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance"** (*Εἰς μνημόσυνον αἰώνιον ἔσται δίκαιος*, Ps. 111:6 LXX), **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 4.    If the Feast of the Saint occurs on a Sunday, in Vespers on Saturday evening following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter, at "Lord, I have cried," we sing 6 Stichira of the Resurrection, and 4 of the Saint, Glory of the Saint, Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, "O Gladsome Light," the Prokimenon and the Readings. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory of the Saint, Now and ever, "My creator and saviour"; the Apolytikion of the Resurrection, that of the Saint, the Theotokion, and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 4.    If the feast of the Saint occurs on a Sunday: at Vespers on Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm [Psalm 103 LXX] and the First Kathisma of the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 6 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Saint; **"Glory"**: of the Saint; **"Both now and ever"**: the First Dogmatic Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Readings. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; **"Glory"**: of the Saint; **"Both now and ever"**: **"My Maker and Redeemer"** (*Ὁ ποιητὴς καὶ ὁ λυτρωτής μου*); the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Saint, the Theotokion, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_incipit: Πολυέλεος· τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα κατὰ σειρὰν,
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Πολυέλεος· τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα κατὰ σειρὰν, καὶ τὰ τῆς γ΄ στιχολογίας Καθίσματα τοῦ Ἁγίου μετὰ τοῦ Θεοτοκίου, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἁγίου. Ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὰ ἀναστάσιμα, Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος χῦμα, εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον, ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν. Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου δ΄, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μ. καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία.

Δόξα τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, Καὶ νῦν τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρὸν, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ, Δόξα τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ Καὶ νῦν Ὁ ποιητὴς καὶ λυτρωτὴς μου, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, τὸ Θεοτοκίον Σὲ τὴν μεσιτεύσασαν καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: at the third Stasis [Stichologia] that of the Saint with the Theotokion; the Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode and the Prokimenon. The Canons of the Resurrection and of the Saint. After the 3rd Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrection (read), then the Kathisma of the Saint and the Theotokion; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saint, and the Minologion. The Katavasie "I shall open my mouth," and the entire order of the Morning Gospel; then we sing "More honorable." Exapostilaria of the Resurrection, of the Saint and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Saint, Glory of the Saint, Now and ever, "Most blessed," Great Doxology and "Today salvation."
units.english_cohort_translation: ...and at the third Stichologia the Kathismata of the Saint with their Theotokion; the Sunday Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: the Resurrection Canon and that of the Saint. After the Third Ode: the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos (recited plain), then the Kathisma of the Saint and the Theotokion; after the Sixth Ode: the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saint, and the Synaxarion from the Menaion. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*), and the entire order of the Sunday Morning Gospel; then we sing the biblical canticle with **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrection Exapostilarion, that of the Saint, and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 Stichira of the Saint; **"Glory"**: of the Saint; **"Both now and ever"**: **"Most blessed art Thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); the Great Doxology, and **"Today salvation has come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 6.    In the Liturgy, the Typika and 4 Beatitudes of the Mode and 4 hymns from the 6th Ode of the Canon of the Saint. units.english_cohort_translation: 6.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Typika, and 4 Beatitudes of the Tone and 4 Troparia from the Sixth Ode of the Canon of the Saint. After the Little Entrance: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Saint, that of the Patron Saint of the temple, and the Kontakion: **"The most pure Temple of the Saviour"** (*Ὁ καθαρώτατος ναός*). units.slavonic_diplomatic: 2.    If the Feast occurs on a Sunday, in Vespers on Saturday evening following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter, at "Lord, I have cried," we sing 6 Stichira of the Resurrection, and 4 of the Evangelist, Glory of the Evangelist, Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, "O Gladsome Light" and the Prokimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory of the Evangelist, Now and ever, "My creator and saviour"; the Apolytikia of the Resurrection, of the Evangelist, the Theotokion "You, the intercessor," and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 2.    If the feast occurs on a Sunday: at Vespers on Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm [Psalm 103 LXX] and the First Kathisma of the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 6 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Evangelist; **"Glory"**: of the Evangelist; **"Both now and ever"**: the First Dogmatic Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*) and the Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; **"Glory"**: of the Evangelist; **"Both now and ever"**: **"My Maker and Redeemer"** (*Ὁ ποιητὴς καὶ λυτρωτής μου*); the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Evangelist, the Theotokion: **"Thou who hast mediated for our race"** (*Σὲ τὴν μεσιτεύσασαν*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 3.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν, καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν· εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἀποστόλου καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινὸν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος· τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα κατὰ σειρὰν, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς μετὰ τὸ Κοντάκιον τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, τὸ Κάθισμα τοῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον· ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα, καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν. Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τὸ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ δ΄. Δόξα τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, Καὶ νῦν Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μ. καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία· καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία, ἐν ᾗ ψάλλονται τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄ καὶ δ΄ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Κανόνος τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ· Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, Κοινωνικὸν Εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

Δόξα Σήμερον ὁ θεοχώρητος Ναὸς, Καὶ νῦν τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρὸν καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. units.slavonic_diplomatic: 3.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Triadic Canon, and the Triadic "It is meet," then the Trisagion, the Apolytikion of the Apostle and the Exapsalmos. At "God is the Lord": the Apolytikia as in Vespers; then the Psalter and the Amomos. The Resurrection Kathismata in order, the Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode and the Prokimenon. The Canons of the Resurrection and of the Evangelist. After the 3rd Ode, the Kontakion of the Evangelist, his Kathisma and the Theotokion; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrection, and the Minologion; the Katavasia "I shall open my mouth," and the entire order of the Morning Gospel; then we sing "More honorable." Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection, of the Evangelist and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Evangelist, Glory of the Evangelist, Now and ever, "Most blessed," Great Doxology and "Today salvation." Then follows the Liturgy, in which are sung the 4 Typika and Beatitudes of the Mode and 4 hymns from the 6th Ode of the Canon of the Evangelist. Apostolos and Gospel of the Evangelist, Communion Hymn "To all the earth," "We have seen the [true] light," and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 3.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon and the Triadic hymn: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion, the Dismissal Troparion of the Apostle, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; then the Psalter and the Amomos [Psalm 118 LXX]. The Resurrection Kathismata in order, the Sunday Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: the Resurrection Canon and that of the Evangelist. After the Third Ode: after the Kontakion of the Evangelist, his Kathisma and the Theotokion; after the Sixth Ode: the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, and the Synaxarion from the Menaion; the Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*), and the entire order of the Sunday Morning Gospel; then we sing the biblical canticle with **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrection Exapostilarion, that of the Evangelist, and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 Stichira of the Evangelist; **"Glory"**: of the Evangelist; **"Both now and ever"**: **"Most blessed art Thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); the Great Doxology, and **"Today salvation has come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*). Then follows the Divine Liturgy, in which are sung the Typika, and 4 Beatitudes of the Tone and 4 Troparia from the Sixth Ode of the Canon of the Evangelist. Epistle [1 Cor. 4:9–16] and Gospel [Matt. 9:9–13] of the Evangelist; Communion Verse: **"Their sound hath gone forth into all the earth"** (*Εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν*, Ps. 18:5 LXX), **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.[^176]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 2.    If the Pre-feast occurs on a Sunday, in Vespers on Saturday evening following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter, at "Lord, I have cried," we sing 6 Stichira of the Resurrection, and 4 of the Pre-feast. Glory, "Today, the Temple that is to hold God," Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, "O Gladsome Light" the Prokimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory, Now and ever, "Come all the faithful"; the Apolytikia of the Resurrection, of the Pre-feast "Anna is now preparing a great joy," and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 2.    If the Forefeast occurs on a Sunday: at Vespers on Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm [Psalm 103 LXX] and the First Kathisma of the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 6 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Forefeast; **"Glory"**: **"Today the temple that is to receive God"** (*Σήμερον ὁ θεοχώρητος Ναὸς*); **"Both now and ever"**: the First Dogmatic Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*) and the Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; **"Glory"**; **"Both now and ever"**: **"Come, all ye faithful"** (*Δεῦτε πάντες οἱ πιστοί*); Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Forefeast: **"Anna betroths unto us joy today"** (*Χαρὰν προμνηστεύεται*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_incipit: Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα, καὶ ἀντὶ τῶν Θεοτοκίων τὰ Προεόρτια, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ Προεόρτιος, ὁ Στίχος Ὑπεραγία Θεοτόκε· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κάθισμα τὸ Προεόρτιον Εὐφροσύνης σήμερον ἅπαξ· {Αὐτὸ πρέπει νὰ εἶναι λάθος, διότι ὁ ὕμνος Εὐφροσύνης σήμερον εἶναι τὸ προεόρτιον Κοντάκιον — ὅρα §4 κάτωθι — ἐνῷ τὸ Κάθισμα τὸ ὁποῖον συνιστᾷ τὸ Μηναῖον εἶναι τὸ Ὁ ναὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ}· ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν. Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον καὶ τὸ Προεόρτιον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ Προεόρτια (τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τῶν Αἴνων) δ΄. Δόξα τὸ Ἑωθινὸν, Καὶ νῦν Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μ. καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία·

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 4.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄ καὶ δ΄ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Προεορτίου Κανόνος. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ προεόρτιον, τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, καὶ Κοντάκιον Εὐφροσύνης σήμερον, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, Κοινωνικὸν Αἰνεῖτε, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 5.    Ἐν τῷ Μ. Ἑσπερινῷ μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὴν α΄ Στάσιν τοῦ Ψαλτηρίου, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν εἰς ς΄ τὰ Στιχηρὰ (τῆς ἑορτῆς) Σήμερον πιστοὶ καὶ τὰ Τῶν Ἁγίων εἰς Ἅγια. Δόξα Καὶ νῦν, Μετὰ τὸ τεχθῆναί σε. Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον τῆς ἡμέρας καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ Προσόμοια Χαίρει ὁ οὐρανὸς καὶ ἡ γῆ, Δόξα Καὶ νῦν Σήμερον τὰ στίφη τῶν πιστῶν, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον Σήμερον τῆς εὐδοκίας ἐκ τρίτου καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: tion Kathismata and, in place of the Theotokia, we do the Kathismata of the Pre-feast. The Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode and the Prokimenon. The Canons of the Resurrection and of the Pre-feast, with the Verse "Most Holy Theotokos." After the 3rd Ode, the Kathisma of the Pre-feast "Filled with joy today," once {Note: This must be an error since the hymn "Filled with joy today" is in actuality the Kontakion of the Pre-feast — see Paragraph 4 below — whereas the Kathisma indicated in the Mineon is "The temple of God"}; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrection, and the Minologion. The Katavasie "I shall open my mouth," and the entire order of the Morning Gospel; then we sing "More honorable." Exapostilaria of the Resurrection and of the Pre-feast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Pre-feast (the Aposticha of the Praises). Glory the Eothinon, Now and ever, "Most blessed," Great Doxology and "Today salvation"
units.english_cohort_translation: ...tion Kathismata and, in place of the Theotokia, the Kathismata of the Forefeast. The Sunday Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: the Resurrection Canon and that of the Forefeast, with the verse: *Most Holy Theotokos, save us*. After the Third Ode: the Kathisma of the Forefeast: **"Filled with joy today"** (*Εὐφροσύνης σήμερον*), once {Note: This must be an error, since the hymn **"Filled with joy today"** is in actuality the Kontakion of the Forefeast — see Paragraph 4 below — whereas the Kathisma appointed in the Menaion is **"The temple of God"** (*Ὁ ναὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ*)}; after the Sixth Ode: the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, and the Synaxarion from the Menaion. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*), and the entire order of the Sunday Morning Gospel; then we sing the biblical canticle with **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrection Exapostilarion and that of the Forefeast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Forefeast (the Aposticha of the Praises); **"Glory"**: the appointed Sunday Eothinon Doxastikon; **"Both now and ever"**: **"Most blessed art Thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); the Great Doxology, and **"Today salvation has come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 4.    In the Liturgy, the Typika and 4 Beatitudes of the Mode and 4 hymns from the 6th Ode of the Canon of the Pre-feast. After the Entrance, the Resurrection Apolytikion, that of the Pre-feast, that of the Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion "Filled with joy today." Apostolos and Gospel of the Sunday. At "Especially," "It is meet," Communion Hymn "Praise," "We have seen the [true] light," and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 4.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Typika, and 4 Beatitudes of the Tone and 4 Troparia from the Sixth Ode of the Canon of the Forefeast. After the Little Entrance: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Forefeast, that of the Patron Saint of the temple, and the Kontakion: **"Filled with joy today"** (*Εὐφροσύνης σήμερον*). Epistle and Gospel of the Sunday. At the Megalynarion: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Verse: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε*, Ps. 148:1 LXX), **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.[^177]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 5.    In Great Vespers, following the Introductory Psalm and the first Stasis of the Psalter, at "Lord, I have cried," we sing 6 Stichira [of the Feast] "Today the faithful" and "In the Holy of Holies." Glory, Now and ever, "After your birth." Entrance, "O Gladsome Light," the Prokimenon of the day and the Readings. At the Aposticha: the Prosomia "Heaven and earth rejoice," Glory, Now and ever, "Today the masses of the faithful"; the Apolytikion "Today is the foreshadowing" (3 times), and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 5.    At Great Vespers: following the Introductory Psalm [Psalm 103 LXX] and the First Stasis of the Psalter [Psalms 1–3 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 6 Stichira [of the Feast]: **"Today the faithful"** (*Σήμερον πιστοί*) and **"In the Holy of Holies"** (*Τῶν Ἁγίων εἰς Ἅγια*); **"Glory"**; **"Both now and ever"**: **"After thy birth, O Lady"** (*Μετὰ τὸ τεχθῆναί σε*). Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon of the day, and the Old Testament Readings [Exodus 40:1–5, 9–10, 16, 34–35; 1 Kings 8:1, 3–7, 9–11; Ezekiel 43:27–44:4]. At the Aposticha: the Prosomoia: **"Heaven and earth rejoice"** (*Χαίρει ὁ οὐρανὸς καὶ ἡ γῆ*); **"Glory"**; **"Both now and ever"**: **"Today the choirs of the faithful"** (*Σήμερον τὰ στίφη τῶν πιστῶν*); the Dismissal Troparion: **"Today is the prelude of the goodwill of God"** (*Σήμερον τῆς εὐδοκίας θεοῦ τὸ προοίμιον*) thrice, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 6.    In Matins, after Psalm 50, the Liti; then the Trisagion, the Apolytikion [of the Feast] and the Exapsalmos. At "God is the Lord": the Apolytikion (3 times) the Psalter and the Polyeleos "My heart is overflowing." The Kathismata in order, the Anavathmi, the first Antiphon of Mode IV and the Prokimenon "Listen, O daughter, and see"; then the "Let everything that has breath" and the Gospel "And Mary arose," then Psalm 50 (read). Glory, "Today the living temple," Now and ever repeat the same hymn,
units.english_cohort_translation: 6.    At Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Liti; then the Trisagion, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparion thrice; then the Psalter and the Polyeleos: **"My heart hath poured forth a good word"** (*Ἐξηρεύξατο ἡ καρδία μου*, Psalm 44 LXX). The Kathismata in order; the Anavathmoi: the First Antiphon of Tone 4; the Prokeimenon: **"Hear, O daughter, and see, and incline thine ear"** (*Ἄκουσον, θύγατερ, καὶ ἴδε*, Ps. 44:11 LXX); **"Let every breath"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*), and the Matins Gospel: **"Mary arose"** (*Ἀναστᾶσα Μαριάμ*, Luke 1:39–49, 56); then Psalm 50 [LXX] (recited plain); **"Glory"**: **"Today the living temple"** (*Σήμερον ὁ ναὸς ὁ ἔμψυχος*); **"Both now and ever"**: repeat the same hymn;...

units.slavonic_incipit: ὁ ναὸς ὁ ἔμψυχος, Καὶ νῦν
units.slavonic_diplomatic: ὁ ναὸς ὁ ἔμψυχος, Καὶ νῦν τὸ αὐτὸ· Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεὸς καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον, τῆς Λιτῆς Σήμερον ὁ θεοχώρητος Ναὸς, οἱ Κανόνες ἀμφότεροι, ὧν ὁ στίχος Ὑπεραγία Θεοτόκε· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὰ δύο Καθίσματα, ἀφ’ ς΄ τὸ Κοντάκιον, ὁ Οἶκος καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι Χριστὸς γεννᾶται· εἰς τὴν θ΄ ψάλλονται οἱ δύο Κανόνες τῆς θ΄ Ὠδῆς μετὰ τῶν Μεγαλυναρίων ὡς ἑξῆς·

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Katavasia "O my soul, magnify her who is greater in honor and more glorious than the hosts above. A strange and most wonderful mystery"; the Exapostilarion "Whom the multitude of Prophets foretold"
units.english_cohort_translation: Katavasia: **"Magnify, O my soul, her who is more honorable and more glorious than the hosts on high. A strange and wonderful mystery"** (*Μυστήριον ξένον*); the Exapostilarion: **"Whom the multitude of the Prophets foretold"** (*Ἥν πάλαι προκατήγγειλεν*) thrice. At the Praises: the 4 Prosomoia: **"The lamp-bearing virgins"** (*Λαμπαδηφόροι Παρθένοι*); **"Glory"**; **"Both now and ever"**: **"Today she is led into the temple"** (*Σήμερον τῷ ναῷ προσάγεται*); the Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion.[^178]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Εἰς τὴν Εἴσοδον Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν . . . ὁ ἐν Ἁγίοις θαυμαστός, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον Σήμερον τῆς εὐδοκίας καὶ Κοντάκιον, Ὁ καθαρώτατος Ναὸς, ὁ Ἀπόστολος Εἶχεν ἡ πρώτη σκηνὴ, καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον Εἰσῆλθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως Ἄγγελοι τὴν εἴσοδον τῆς Παρθένου . . . Ὡς ἐμψύχῳ θεοῦ Κιβωτῷ, Κοινωνικὸν Ποτήριον, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 8.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ ἑορτὴ ἐν Κυριακῇ, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν Ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ δ΄ καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς ς΄, Δόξα Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ. Δόξα Καὶ νῦν τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς δὶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 9.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν, ἡ Λιτὴ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς δὶς, εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος, τὰ Καθίσματα εἰς τὴν α΄ Στιχολογίαν, Ἀναστάσιμα β΄ καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς Δικαίων ὁ καρπός. Εἰς τὴν β΄ Στιχολογίαν, Ἀναστάσιμα β΄ καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς Δικαίων ὁ καρπός. Εἰς τὴν β΄ Στιχολογίαν Ἀναστάσιμα δύο καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς Δαβὶδ προοδοποίησον {Αὐτὸ τὸ Κάθισμα εἶναι ἡ 2α Στάσις ἀμφοτέρων τῆς 20 καὶ 22 Νοεμβρίου.} Εἰς τὴν γ΄ Στιχολογίαν, τὰ δύο τῆς ἑορτῆς, ἡ Αἴτησις, ἡ Ὑπακοη, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον τῆς ἑορτῆς Ἄκουσον θύγατερ καὶ ἴδε, τὸ Πᾶσα πνοὴ καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον Ἀναστᾶσα Μαριὰμ, τὸ Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ θεασάμενοι, καὶ ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα, Δόξα Σήμερον ὁ ναὸς ὁ ἔμψυχος Καὶ νῦν τὸ αὐτὸ, ὁ Στίχος Ἐλέησόν με ὁ θεὸς καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Σήμερον ὁ θεοχώρητος Ναὸς Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ οἱ δύο τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Κοντάκιον μετὰ τοῦ Οἴκου χῦμα, εἶτα τὰ δύο τῆς ἑορτῆς Καθίσματα {Αὐτὸ εἶναι πιθανὸν λάθος διότι τὸ Μηναῖον ἀναφέρει μόνον ἕν Κάθισμα ψαλλόμενον δίς}, ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι Χριστὸς γεννᾶται, εἶτα ψάλλονται οἱ δύο Κανόνες τῆς Θ΄ Ὠδῆς μετὰ τῶν Μεγαλυναρίων αὐτῶν καὶ ἡ Καταβασία Μεγαλυνον ψυχή μου . . . Μυστήριον ξένον, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἐξαποστειλάριον καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς δίς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς δ΄, Δόξα Σήμερον τῷ Ναῷ προσάγεται, Καὶ νῦν Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία.

Μυστήριον ξένον*, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἐξαποστειλάριον καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς δίς. units.slavonic_diplomatic: At the Entrance "O come let us worship ... wonderful in Your Saints," the Apolytikion "Today is the foreshadowing of the good pleasure of God" and the Kontakion "The all-pure Temple." The Apostolos "The first tent had," the Gospel "Jesus entered." At "Especially," "Beholding the entry of the Virgin ... Let no profane hand," Communion Hymn "[I will receive] the cup [of salvation]," "We have seen the [true] light," and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: At the Little Entrance: **"Come, let us worship and fall down before Christ: save us, O Son of God, Who art wonderful in the saints..."** (*Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν . . . ὁ ἐν Ἁγίοις θαυμαστός*), the Dismissal Troparion: **"Today is the prelude of the goodwill of God"** (*Σήμερον τῆς εὐδοκίας θεοῦ τὸ προοίμιον*), and the Kontakion: **"The most pure Temple of the Saviour"** (*Ὁ καθαρώτατος ναός*). The Epistle: **"The first tabernacle indeed had regulations"** (*Εἶχεν ἡ πρώτη σκηνή*, Heb. 9:1–7), and the Gospel: **"Jesus entered into a certain village"** (*Εἰσῆλθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς*, Luke 10:38–42; 11:27–28). At the Megalynarion: **"The Angels, beholding the Entrance of the Virgin..."** (*Ἄγγελοι τὴν εἴσοδον τῆς Παρθένου*) with **"As the living Ark of God, let no profane hand touch the Theotokos"** (*Ὡς ἐμψύχῳ θεοῦ Κιβωτῷ*); Communion Verse: **"I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the Lord"** (*Ποτήριον σωτηρίου λήψομαι*, Ps. 115:4 LXX), **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 8.    If the Feast occurs on a Sunday, in Vespers on Saturday evening following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter, at "Lord, I have cried" we sing 4 Stichira of the Resurrection, and 6 of the Feast. Glory, Now and ever of the Feast. Entrance, "O Gladsome Light," the Prokimenon and the Readings. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory, Now and ever of the Feast, the Apolytikia of the Resurrection, of the Feast (twice), and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 8.    If the feast occurs on a Sunday: at Vespers on Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm [Psalm 103 LXX] and the First Kathisma of the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 4 Resurrection Stichira and 6 of the feast; **"Glory"**; **"Both now and ever"**: of the feast. Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Readings [Ex. 40:1–5, 9–10, 16, 34–35; 1 Kgs. 8:1, 3–7, 9–11; Ezek. 43:27–44:4]. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; **"Glory"**; **"Both now and ever"**: of the feast; the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the feast twice, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 9.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Triadic Canon, the Liti of the Feast and the Triadic "It is meet"; then the Trisagion, the Apolytikion of the Feast and the Exapsalmos. At "God is the Lord": the Resurrection Apolytikion and that of the Feast twice, then the Psalter and the Polyeleos. The Kathismata in the First Stasis [Stichologia]: 2 of the Resurrection and the Feast's "The fruit of the righteous ones." In the Second Stasis, 2 of the Resurrection and the Feast's "David, pre-announce" {Note: this Kathisma is the Second Stasis of both November 20 and 22}. In the Third Stasis, the two Kathismata of the Feast "Before your conception" and "Let David the Psalmist" {Note: These are the 2nd and 3rd Kathismata of the Feast}, the Petition, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode and the Prokimenon of the Feast "Listen, O daughter." Then "Let everything that has breath" and the Gospel "And Mary arose," then Psalm 50 read. Glory, "Today the living temple," Now and ever repeat the same, then the Verse "Have mercy upon me" and the Idiomelon of the Liti "Today the God-containing temple." The Canons: of the Resurrection and the two of the Feast. After the 3rd Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrection, the two Kathismata of the Feast, {Note: This may be an error since the Mineon indicates only one Kathisma which is sung twice}; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Feast, and the Minologion. The Katavasie "Christ is born"; at the 9th Ode the two Canons of the 9th Ode are sung with their Megalynaria and the Katavasia "Magnify of my soul ... A strange mystery," Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection and that of the Feast (twice). At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Feast, Glory, "Today enters in the Temple," Now and ever, "Most blessed," Great Doxology and "Today salvation."
units.english_cohort_translation: 9.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon, the Litiya of the feast, and the Triadic hymn: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion, the Dismissal Troparion of the feast, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion once and that of the feast twice; then the Psalter and the Polyeleos. The Kathismata at the First Stichologia: 2 of the Resurrection and that of the feast: **"The fruit of the righteous"** (*Δικαίων ὁ καρπός*). At the Second Stichologia: 2 of the Resurrection and that of the feast: **"David, prepare the way"** (*Δαβὶδ προοδοποίησον*) {Note: This Kathisma is the second Kathisma appointed on both November 20 and 22}. At the Third Stichologia: the two Kathismata of the feast: **"Before thy conception, O pure Virgin"** (*Πρὸ συλλήψεως ἁγνή*) and **"Let David the psalmist leap for joy"** (*Δαβὶδ ὁ προπάτωρ* / *Σκιρτάτω ὁ Δαβίδ*) {Note: These are the second and third festal Kathismata in the Menaion}, the Litany, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon of the feast: **"Hear, O daughter, and see, and incline thine ear"** (*Ἄκουσον, θύγατερ, καὶ ἴδε*, Ps. 44:11 LXX); **"Let every breath"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*), and the Matins Gospel: **"Mary arose"** (*Ἀναστᾶσα Μαριάμ*, Luke 1:39–49, 56); **"Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ"** (*Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ θεασάμενοι*), and Psalm 50 [LXX] (recited plain); **"Glory"**: **"Today the living temple"** (*Σήμερον ὁ ναὸς ὁ ἔμψυχος*); **"Both now and ever"**: repeat the same hymn; the verse: **"Have mercy upon me, O God"** [Ps. 50:3 LXX], and the Idiomelon of the Litiya: **"Today the God-containing temple"** (*Σήμερον ὁ θεοχώρητος Ναός*). The Canons: the Resurrection Canon and the two Canons of the feast. After the Third Ode: the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos (recited plain), then the two Kathismata of the feast {Note: This is likely an editorial error in the printed Greek text, since the Menaion prescribes only one Kathisma sung twice}; after the Sixth Ode: the Kontakion and Ikos of the feast, and the Synaxarion from the Menaion. The Katavasiai: **"Christ is born, give ye glory"** (*Χριστὸς γεννᾶται*); then the two Canons of the Ninth Ode are sung with their Megalynaria, followed by the Katavasia: **"Magnify, O my soul, her who is more honorable... A strange and wonderful mystery"** (*Μεγάλυνον ψυχή μου . . . Μυστήριον ξένον*); the Resurrection Exapostilarion, and that of the feast twice. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the feast; **"Glory"**: **"Today into the Temple is brought"** (*Σήμερον τῷ Ναῷ προσάγεται*); **"Both now and ever"**: **"Most blessed art Thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); the Great Doxology, and **"Today salvation has come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).[^180]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 12.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν, {ἡ Λιτὴ τῆς ἑορτῆς} καὶ τὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον δὶς καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς ἅπαξ, εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα κατὰ σειρὰν καὶ ἀντὶ Θεοτοκίων τὰ μεθέορτα, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον, Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ δεύτερος τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κάθισμα μεθέορτον, ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι Χριστὸς γεννᾶται, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ μεθέορτα δ΄, Δόξα τὸ Ἑωθινὸν, Καὶ νῦν Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 10.    In the Liturgy, the Antiphons (see Paragraph 7) with "who is risen from the dead"; after the Entrance, the Resurrection Apolytikion, that of the Feast, and the Kontakion "The all-pure Temple." Apostolos and Gospel of the Feast. At "Especially," "Beholding the entry of the Virgin ... Let no profane hand," Communion Hymn "[I will receive] the cup [of salvation]," "We have seen the [true] light," and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 10.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Festal Antiphons (see Paragraph 7) with the refrain: **"Who art risen from the dead"** (*Ὁ ἀναστὰς ἐκ νεκρῶν*) at the Second Antiphon; after the Little Entrance: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the feast, and the Kontakion: **"The most pure Temple of the Saviour"** (*Ὁ καθαρώτατος ναός*). Epistle [Heb. 9:1–7] and Gospel [Luke 10:38–42; 11:27–28] of the feast. At the Megalynarion: **"The Angels, beholding the Entrance of the Virgin..."** (*Ἄγγελοι τὴν εἴσοδον τῆς Παρθένου*) with **"As the living Ark of God, let no profane hand touch the Theotokos"** (*Ὡς ἐμψύχῳ θεοῦ Κιβωτῷ*); Communion Verse: **"I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the Lord"** (*Ποτήριον σωτηρίου λήψομαι*, Ps. 115:4 LXX), **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 11.    On the Sunday after the Feast, in Vespers on Saturday evening following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter, at "Lord, I have cried" we sing 6 Stichira of the Resurrection, and 4 of the Post-Feast. Glory of the Feast, Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, "O Gladsome Light," and the Prokimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory, Now and ever of the Post-feast. The Apolytikia: of the Resurrection, of the Feast and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 11.    On the Sunday after the feast: at Vespers on Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm [Psalm 103 LXX] and the First Kathisma of the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 6 Resurrection Stichira and 4 Afterfeast Stichira from the Menaion series; **"Glory"**: of the feast; **"Both now and ever"**: the First Dogmatic Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*) and the Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; **"Glory"**; **"Both now and ever"**: of the Afterfeast; Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the feast, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 12.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Triadic Canon, {the Liti of the Feast} and the Triadic "It is meet"; then the Trisagion, the Apolytikion of the Feast and the Exapsalmos. At "God is the Lord": the Resurrection Apolytikion twice and that of the Feast once, then the Psalter and the Amomos. The Resurrection Kathismata in order and, in place of the Theotokia we do those of the Post-feast. The Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode and the Prokimenon. The Canons: of the Resurrection and the second of the Feast. After the 3rd Ode, the two Kathismata of the Post-feast; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrection, and the Minologion. The Katavasie "Christ is born," and the entire order of the Matins Gospel; then we chant the "More honorable." Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection and of the Feast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Post-feast, Glory the Eothinon, Now and ever, "Most blessed," Great Doxology and "Today salvation."
units.english_cohort_translation: 12.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon, {the Litiya of the feast}, and the Triadic hymn: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion, the Dismissal Troparion of the feast, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion twice and that of the feast once; then the Psalter and the Amomos [Psalm 118 LXX]. The Resurrection Kathismata in order and, in place of the Theotokia, the Kathismata of the Afterfeast. The Sunday Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: the Resurrection Canon and the second Canon of the feast. After the Third Ode: the Kathisma of the Afterfeast; after the Sixth Ode: the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, and the Synaxarion from the Menaion. The Katavasiai: **"Christ is born, give ye glory"** (*Χριστὸς γεννᾶται*), and the entire order of the Sunday Morning Gospel; then we sing the biblical canticle with **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrection Exapostilarion and that of the feast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Afterfeast; **"Glory"**: the appointed Sunday Eothinon Doxastikon; **"Both now and ever"**: **"Most blessed art Thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); the Great Doxology, and **"Today salvation has come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 13.    In the Liturgy, the Typika and 4 Beatitudes of the Mode and 4 hymns from the 6th Ode of the Canon of the Feast. After the Entrance, the Resurrection Apolytikion, that of the Feast, that of the Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion "The all-pure Temple." Apostolos and Gospel of the Sunday. At "Especially," "It is meet," Communion Hymn "Praise," "We have seen the [true] light," and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 13.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Typika, and 4 Beatitudes of the Tone and 4 Troparia from the Sixth Ode of the Canon of the feast. After the Little Entrance: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the feast, that of the Patron Saint of the temple, and the Kontakion: **"The most pure Temple of the Saviour"** (*Ὁ καθαρώτατος ναός*). Epistle and Gospel of the Sunday. At the Megalynarion: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Verse: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 148:1 LXX), **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.[^181]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 15.    Εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινὸν, εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον, τὰ Καθίσματα τῆς Ἁγίας καὶ τὰ τῆς ἑορτῆς, ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα, οἱ Κανόνες τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ τῆς Ἁγίας· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κάθισμα τῆς Ἁγίας καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἀφ’ ς΄ τὸ Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος τῆς Ἁγίας καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι Χριστὸς γεννᾶται καὶ ψάλλεται ἡ Θ΄ Ὠδὴ τῆς ἑορτῆς μετὰ τῶν Μεγαλυναρίων. Ἐξαποστειλάρια τῆς Ἁγίας καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους τῆς ἑορτῆς Προσόμοια γ΄ καὶ τῆς Ἁγίας γ΄, Δόξα τῆς Ἁγίας, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς, Δοξολογία Μ. καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς.

Ὡς ἐμψύχῳ Θεοῦ Κιβωτῷ, Κοινωνικὸν Ποτήριον, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 14.    In Great Vespers, following the Introductory Psalm, at "Lord, I have cried" we sing 3 Stichira Prosomia of the Feast and 3 of the Saint. Glory of the Saint, Now and ever of the Feast. Entrance, "O Gladsome Light," the Prokimenon. The Aposticha of the Feast: "Heaven and earth rejoice," Glory of the Saint, Now and ever of the Feast. The Apolytikion of the Feast, of the Saint, and again of the Feast, and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 14.    At Great Vespers: following the Introductory Psalm [Psalm 103 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 3 Prosomoia Stichira of the feast: **"Today, ye faithful, let us dance with joy"** (*Σήμερον πιστοὶ χορεύσωμεν*) and 3 of the Saint; **"Glory"**: of the Saint; **"Both now and ever"**: of the feast. Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*) and the Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Stichira of the feast: **"Heaven and earth rejoice today"** (*Χαίρει ὁ οὐρανὸς καὶ ἡ γῆ*); **"Glory"**: of the Saint; **"Both now and ever"**: of the feast; Dismissal Troparia: the Dismissal Troparion of the feast, that of the Saint, and again that of the feast, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 15.    In Matins, after Psalm 50, the Trisagion, the Apolytikion of the Feast and the Exapsalmos. At "God is the Lord": the Apolytikia as in Vespers, then the Psalter, the Kathismata of the Saint and the Feast, Psalm 50 read, both Canons of the Feast and the Saint's. After the 3rd Ode, the Kathisma of the Saint and the Feast; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saint and the Minologion. The Katavasie "Christ is born," and the 9th Ode of the Feast is sung with the Megalynaria. Exapostilaria: of the Saint and that of the Feast. At the Praises: 3 Prosomia of the Feast and 3 of the Saint, Glory of the Saint, Now and ever of the Feast, Great Doxology and the Apolytikion of the Feast.
units.english_cohort_translation: 15.    At Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Trisagion, the Dismissal Troparion of the feast, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; then the Psalter, the Kathismata of the Saint and of the feast, Psalm 50 [LXX] (recited plain), and both Canons of the feast and that of the Saint. After the Third Ode: the Kathisma of the Saint and that of the feast; after the Sixth Ode: the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saint, and the Synaxarion from the Menaion. The Katavasiai: **"Christ is born, give ye glory"** (*Χριστὸς γεννᾶται*), and the Ninth Ode of the feast is sung with the Megalynaria. Exapostilaria: that of the Saint and that of the feast. At the Praises: 3 Prosomoia of the feast and 3 of the Saint; **"Glory"**: of the Saint; **"Both now and ever"**: of the feast; the Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion of the feast.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 16.    In the Liturgy, the Antiphons of the Feast. After the Entrance, the Apolytikion of the Feast, that of the Saint, that of the Saint of the Church and the Kontakion "The all-pure Temple." The Apostolos and Gospel of the Saint. At "Especially," "Beholding the entry of the Virgin ... Let no profane hand," Communion Hymn "[I will receive] the cup [of salvation]," "We have seen the [true] light," and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 16.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Festal Antiphons of the feast. After the Little Entrance: the Dismissal Troparion of the feast, that of the Saint, that of the Patron Saint of the temple, and the Kontakion: **"The most pure Temple of the Saviour"** (*Ὁ καθαρώτατος ναός*). Epistle [Gal. 3:23–4:5] and Gospel [Mark 5:24–34] of the Saint. At the Megalynarion: **"The Angels, beholding the Entrance of the Virgin..."** (*Ἄγγελοι τὴν εἴσοδον τῆς Παρθένου*) with **"As the living Ark of God, let no profane hand touch the Theotokos"** (*Ὡς ἐμψύχῳ θεοῦ Κιβωτῷ*); Communion Verse: **"I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the Lord"** (*Ποτήριον σωτηρίου λήψομαι*, Ps. 115:4 LXX), **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 17.    If the Leave-taking occurs on a Sunday, in Vespers on Saturday evening following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter, at "Lord, I have cried" we sing 4 Stichira of the Resurrection, 3 of the Feast, and 3 of the Saint. Glory of the Feast, Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, "O Gladsome Light," and the Prokimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory of the Saint, Now and ever of the Feast. The Apolytikia of the Resurrection, of the Saint, and of the Feast. And Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 17.    If the Apodosis occurs on a Sunday: at Vespers on Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm [Psalm 103 LXX] and the First Kathisma of the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 4 Resurrection Stichira, 3 of the feast, and 3 of the Saint; **"Glory"**: of the feast; **"Both now and ever"**: the First Dogmatic Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*) and the Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; **"Glory"**: of the Saint; **"Both now and ever"**: of the feast; Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Saint, and that of the feast, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_incipit: καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον, Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος,
units.slavonic_diplomatic: καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον, Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος, ὁ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ τῆς Ἁγίας, ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κάθισμα τῆς Ἁγίας, καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα, καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον· αἱ Καταβασίαι Χριστὸς γεννᾶται, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου. Εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, καὶ ψάλλεται καὶ ἡ Θ΄ Ὠδὴ τῆς ἑορτῆς μετὰ τῶν Μεγαλυναρίων. Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τὸ τῆς Ἁγίας, καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄, καὶ τῆς Ἁγίας δ΄. Δόξα Σήμερον τῷ Ναῷ προσάγεται, Καὶ νῦν Ὑπερευλογημένη. Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία.

Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄, καὶ τῆς Ἁγίας δ΄. Δόξα Σήμερον τῷ Ναῷ προσάγεται, Καὶ νῦν Ὑπερευλογημένη. Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία.

Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς, τῆς Ἁγίας, τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, καὶ Κοντάκιον Ὁ καθαρώτατος Ναὸς, ὁ Ἀπόστολος τῆς Ἁγίας καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς. units.slavonic_incipit: of the Resurrection, of the Feast,
units.slavonic_diplomatic: of the Resurrection, of the Feast, and of the Saint. After the 3rd Ode, the Kathismata of the Saint and the Feast; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrection, and the Minologion. The Katavasie "Christ is born," and the entire order of the Matins Gospel. Then we sing "More honorable" and the 9th Ode of the Feast with its Megalynaria. Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection, of the Saint, and of the Feast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Saint, Glory, "Today enters in the Temple," Now and ever, "Most blessed," Great Doxology and "Today salvation."
units.english_cohort_translation: ...the Resurrection Canon, that of the feast, and that of the Saint. After the Third Ode: the Kathisma of the Saint and that of the feast; after the Sixth Ode: the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, and the Synaxarion from the Menaion. The Katavasiai: **"Christ is born, give ye glory"** (*Χριστὸς γεννᾶται*), and the entire order of the Sunday Morning Gospel. Then we sing the biblical canticle with **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*), and the Ninth Ode of the feast is sung with its Megalynaria. Exapostilaria: the Resurrection Exapostilarion, that of the Saint, and that of the feast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Saint; **"Glory"**: **"Today into the Temple is brought"** (*Σήμερον τῷ Ναῷ προσάγεται*); **"Both now and ever"**: **"Most blessed art Thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); the Great Doxology, and **"Today salvation has come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 19.    In the Liturgy, the Antiphons of the Feast, with "who is risen from the dead" at the second Antiphon. After the Entrance, the Resurrection Apolytikion, that of the Feast, that of the Saint, that of the Saint of the Church and the Kontakion "The all-pure Temple." Apostolos of the Saint and Gospel of the Sunday. At "Especially," "Angels beholding the entry of the Virgin ... Let no profane hand," Communion Hymn "The cup [of Salvation]," "We have seen the [true] light," and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 19.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Festal Antiphons of the feast, with the refrain: **"Who art risen from the dead"** (*Ὁ ἀναστὰς ἐκ νεκρῶν*) at the Second Antiphon. After the Little Entrance: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the feast, that of the Saint, that of the Patron Saint of the temple, and the Kontakion: **"The most pure Temple of the Saviour"** (*Ὁ καθαρώτατος ναός*). Epistle of the Saint [Gal. 3:23–4:5] and Gospel of the Sunday. At the Megalynarion: **"The Angels, beholding the Entrance of the All-pure..."** (*Ἄγγελοι τὴν εἴσοδον τῆς πανάγνου*) with **"As the living Ark of God, let no profane hand touch the Theotokos"** (*Ὡς ἐμψύχῳ θεοῦ Κιβωτῷ*); Communion Verse: **"I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the Lord"** (*Ποτήριον σωτηρίου λήψομαι*, Ps. 115:4 LXX), **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 1.    In Vespers, following the Introductory Psalm and the first Stasis of the Psalter, at "Lord, I have cried" we sing the 3 Prosomia twice each, Glory of the Saint, Now and ever of the Pre-feast "Dance, O Isaiah." Entrance, "O Gladsome Light," the Prokimenon of the day, and the Readings; then the Aposticha, Glory of the Saint "The kinsman of Peter", Now and ever of the Pre-feast "Joseph tell us." The Apolytikion "As the first-called of the Apostles," Now and ever, "The mystery hidden for centuries," and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 1.    At Vespers: following the Introductory Psalm [Psalm 103 LXX] and the First Stasis of the Psalter [Psalms 1–3 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing the 3 Prosomoia Stichira: **"Illumined with the light of the Forerunner"** (*Ὁ τῷ Προδρόμου φωτὶ μεμορφωμένος*) doubled to 6; **"Glory"**: **"Leaving the catching of fish"** (*Τὴν τῶν ἰχθύων ἄγραν*); **"Both now and ever"**: the Forefeast Theotokion: **"Rejoice, O Isaiah"** (*Ἡσαΐα χόρευε*). Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon of the day, and the Old Testament Readings [1 Pet. 1:1–2:6 composite; 1 Pet. 2:11–24 composite; 1 Pet. 3:8–4:11 composite]. Then the Aposticha; **"Glory"**: **"The kinsman of Peter"** (*Τὸν συναίμονα Πέτρου*); **"Both now and ever"**: the Forefeast Theotokion: **"Joseph, tell us"** (*Ἰωσὴφ εἰπὲ ἡμῖν*); the Dismissal Troparion: **"As the first-called of the Apostles"** (*Ὡς τῶν Ἀποστόλων πρωτόκλητος*); **"Both now and ever"**: **"The mystery hidden from the ages"** (*Τὸ ἀπ’ αἰῶνος ἀπόκρυφον*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_incipit: με ὁ θεὸς καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον
units.slavonic_diplomatic: με ὁ θεὸς καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Ὁ πρωτόκλητος μαθητής (ζήτει εἰς τὴν Λιτήν), ὁ Κανὼν τῆς Θεοτόκου, ὁ τοῦ Μηναίου καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἀποστόλου Τὴν τεθολωμένην μου ψυχήν, ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κάθισμα καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον, ἀφ’ ς΄ τὸ Κοντάκιον, ὁ Οἶκος καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον· αἱ Καταβασίαι Χριστὸς γεννᾶται· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, τὰ δύο Ἐξαποστειλάρια καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους τὰ Προσόμοια Βηθσαϊδὰ νῦν ἀγάλλου εἰς δ΄. Δόξα Τὸν κήρυκα τῆς πίστεως, Καὶ νυν Προεόρτιον Ὑπόδεξαι Βηθλεὲμ, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 3.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοί. Τροπάρια ἐκ τῆς γ΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ α΄ καὶ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ τοῦ β΄ Κανόνος. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἀποστόλου, τὸ τοῦ ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ καὶ Κοντάκιον Ἡ Παρθένος σήμερον, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ἀποστόλου. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, Κοινωνικὸν Εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 4.    Εἰ τύχοι ἐν Κυριακῇ, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν Ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ ς΄ καὶ τοῦ Ἀποστόλου δ΄. Δόξα τοῦ Ἀποστόλου, Καὶ νῦν τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρὸν, τὸ Προκείμενον καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ, Δόξα Τὸν συναίμονα Πέτρου, Καὶ νῦν Ἰωσὴφ εἰπὲ ἡμῖν, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τοῦ Ἀποστόλου, τὸ Θεοτοκίον καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

Εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν, ἡ Λιτὴ τοῦ Ἀποστόλου καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἀποστόλου καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινὸν, εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος, τὰ Καθίσματα ἀνὰ ἓν Ἀναστάσιμον καὶ ἓν τοῦ Ἀποστόλου μετὰ τοῦ Θεοτοκίου. Ἐν δὲ τῇ γ΄ Στιχολογίᾳ , τὸ τοῦ Ἀποστόλου καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ α΄ τοῦ Ἀποστόλου Τὴν τεθολωμένην μου ψυχήν, ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Κοντάκιον μετὰ τοῦ Οἴκου χῦμα καὶ τὸ Κάθισμα τοῦ Ἀποστόλου καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον· ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος τοῦ Ἀποστόλου καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι Χριστὸς γεννᾶται καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου. Εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον τοῦ Ἀποστόλου καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τοῦ Ἀποστόλου δ΄, Δόξα, ἀντὶ τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ, λέγεται τὸ τοῦ Ἀποστόλου, Καὶ νῦν Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: the Idiomelon "The first-called Disciple," (look for it in the Liti); the Canon of the Theotokos, that of the Mineon and that of the Apostle. After the 3rd Ode, the Kathisma and the Theotokion; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos and the Minologion. The Katavasie "Christ is born," then we sing "More honorable." The two Exapostilaria and the Theotokion. At the Praises: the Prosomia "Bethesda, now rejoice," Glory, "The proclaimer of faith," Now and ever, "Receive, Bethlehem," Great Doxology and the Apolytikion.
units.english_cohort_translation: ...the Idiomelon: **"The first-called Disciple and imitator of the Passion"** (*Ὁ πρωτόκλητος μαθητής*) (look for it in the Litiya). The Canon of the Theotokos, that of the Menaion, and that of the Apostle: **"My darkened soul"** (*Τὴν τεθολωμένην μου ψυχήν*). After the Third Ode: the Kathisma and the Theotokion; after the Sixth Ode: the Kontakion, the Ikos, and the Synaxarion from the Menaion. The Katavasiai: **"Christ is born, give ye glory"** (*Χριστὸς γεννᾶται*); then we sing the biblical canticle with **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). The two Exapostilaria and the Theotokion. At the Praises: the Prosomoia Stichira: **"Bethsaida, now leap for joy"** (*Βηθσαϊδὰ νῦν ἀγάλλου*) on 4; **"Glory"**: **"The herald of the faith"** (*Τὸν κήρυκα τῆς πίστεως*); **"Both now and ever"**: the Forefeast Theotokion: **"Receive, O Bethlehem"** (*Ὑπόδεξαι Βηθλεέμ*); the Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion of the Apostle.

The two Exapostilaria and the Theotokion. At the Praises: the Prosomoia Stichira: **"Bethsaida, now leap for joy"** (*Βηθσαϊδὰ νῦν ἀγάλλου*) on 4; **"Glory"**: **"The herald of the faith"** (*Τὸν κήρυκα τῆς πίστεως*); **"Both now and ever"**: the Forefeast Theotokion: **"Receive, O Bethlehem"** (*Ὑπόδεξαι Βηθλεέμ*); the Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion of the Apostle.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 4.    If the Feast of the Apostle occurs on a Sunday, in Vespers on Saturday evening following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter, at "Lord, I have cried" we sing 6 Stichira of the Resurrection, and 4 of the Apostle. Glory of the Apostle, Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, "O Gladsome Light," the Prokimenon and the Readings. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory of the Saint "The kinsman of Peter", Now and ever, "Joseph tell us." The Apolytikion of the Resurrection, that of the Apostle, the Theotokion, and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 4.    If the feast of the Apostle occurs on a Sunday: at Vespers on Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm [Psalm 103 LXX] and the First Kathisma of the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 6 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Apostle; **"Glory"**: of the Apostle; **"Both now and ever"**: the First Dogmatic Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Readings. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; **"Glory"**: **"The kinsman of Peter"** (*Τὸν συναίμονα Πέτρου*); **"Both now and ever"**: **"Joseph, tell us"** (*Ἰωσὴφ εἰπὲ ἡμῖν*); Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Apostle, the Theotokion, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 5.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Triadic Canon, the Liti of the Apostle and the Triadic "It is meet"; then the Trisagion, the Apolytikion of the Apostle and the Exapsalmos. At "God is the Lord": the Apolytikia as in Vespers; then the Psalter and the Polyeleos. The Kathismata, one of the Resurrection and one of the Apostle with the Theotokion. At the third Stasis [Stichologia], the Kathisma of the Apostle and the Theotokion; the Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode and the Prokimenon. The Canons of the Resurrection and the First of the Apostle "My turbid soul." After the 3rd Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrection read, then the Kathisma of the Apostle and the Theotokion; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Apostle, and the Minologion. The Katavasie "Christ is born," and the entire order of the Morning Gospel. Then we sing "More honorable." Exapostilaria of the Resurrection, of the Apostle and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Apostle, Glory, instead of the Eothinon, we sing that of the Apostle, Now and ever, "Most blessed," Great Doxology and "Today salvation."
units.english_cohort_translation: 5.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon, the Litiya of the Apostle, and the Triadic hymn: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion, the Dismissal Troparion of the Apostle, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; then the Psalter and the Polyeleos. The Kathismata: one of the Resurrection and one of the Apostle with the Theotokion. At the Third Stichologia: the Kathisma of the Apostle and the Theotokion; the Sunday Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: the Resurrection Canon and the first Canon of the Apostle: **"My darkened soul"** (*Τὴν τεθολωμένην μου ψυχήν*). After the Third Ode: the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos (recited plain), then the Kathisma of the Apostle and the Theotokion; after the Sixth Ode: the Kontakion and Ikos of the Apostle, and the Synaxarion from the Menaion. The Katavasiai: **"Christ is born, give ye glory"** (*Χριστὸς γεννᾶται*), and the entire order of the Sunday Morning Gospel. Then we sing the biblical canticle with **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrection Exapostilarion, that of the Apostle, and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Apostle; **"Glory"**: instead of the Sunday Eothinon, that of the Apostle is sung; **"Both now and ever"**: **"Most blessed art Thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); the Great Doxology, and **"Today salvation has come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).[^184]

Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ τοῦ Ἀποστόλου, τοῦ ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ καὶ τὸ Κοντάκιον Ἡ Παρθένος σήμερον, ὁ Ἀπόστολος καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ἀποστόλου. units.slavonic_diplomatic: 6.    In the Liturgy, the Typika and 4 Beatitudes of the Mode and 4 hymns from the 6th Ode of the second Canon of the Apostle. After the Entrance, the Resurrection Apolytikion, the Apolytikion of the Apostle, that of the Saint of the Church and the Kontakion "The Virgin today." Apostolos and Gospel of the Apostle. At "Especially," "It is meet," Communion Hymn "To all the earth," "We have seen the [true] light," and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 6.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Typika, and 4 Beatitudes of the Tone and 4 Troparia from the Sixth Ode of the Second Canon of the Apostle. After the Little Entrance: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Apostle, that of the Patron Saint of the temple, and the Kontakion: **"Today the Virgin comes unto the cave"** (*Ἡ Παρθένος σήμερον τὸν προαιώνιον Λόγον*). The Epistle [1 Cor. 4:9–16] and the Gospel [John 1:35–51] of the Apostle. At the Megalynarion: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Verse: **"Their sound hath gone forth into all the earth"** (*Εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν ἐξῆλθεν ὁ φθόγγος αὐτῶν*, Ps. 18:5 LXX), **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 2.    If the Feast occurs on a Sunday, in Vespers on Saturday evening following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter, at "Lord, I have cried" we sing 4 Stichira of the Resurrection, 3 of Saint Barbara and 3 of the Righteous {Saint John}, Glory of Saint Barbara, Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, "O Gladsome Light," the Prokimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory of Saint John, Now and ever, "My creator and saviour." The Apolytikia: of the Resurrection, of Saint Barbara, of Saint John, the Theotokion, and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 2.    If the feast occurs on a Sunday: at Vespers on Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm [Psalm 103 LXX] and the First Kathisma of the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 4 Resurrection Stichira, 3 of Saint Barbara, and 3 of the Venerable Father John; **"Glory"**: of Saint Barbara; **"Both now and ever"**: the First Dogmatic Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; **"Glory"**: of the Venerable Father; **"Both now and ever"**: **"My Maker and Redeemer, Christ the Lord"** (*Ὁ ποιητὴς καὶ λυτρωτής μου*). Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of Saint Barbara, that of the Venerable Father, the Sunday Dismissal Theotokion of the Tone, and Dismissal.

Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; **"Glory"**: of the Venerable Father; **"Both now and ever"**: **"My Maker and Redeemer, Christ the Lord"** (*Ὁ ποιητὴς καὶ λυτρωτής μου*). Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of Saint Barbara, that of the Venerable Father, the Sunday Dismissal Theotokion of the Tone, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Ἀναστάσιμα, καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων, αἱ Καταβασίαι Χριστὸς γεννᾶται καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου. Εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν. units.slavonic_diplomatic: 2.    Εἰ τύχοι ἐν Κυριακῇ, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν Ἀναστάσιμα ς΄ καὶ τοῦ Ὁσίου δ΄, Δόξα τοῦ Ὁσίου. Καὶ νῦν τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου, Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τοῦ Ὁσίου. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, Δόξα τοῦ Ὁσίου, Καὶ νῦν Ἀνύμφευτε Παρθένε. Ἀπολυτίκια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τοῦ Ὁσίου, τὸ Θεοτοκίον καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.english_cohort_translation: Resurrection, and the Synaxarion of the Saints. The Katavasiai: **"Christ is born, give ye glory"** (*Χριστὸς γεννᾶται*), and the entire order of the Sunday Morning Gospel. Then we sing biblical canticles with **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). units.slavonic_diplomatic: 2.    If the Feast occurs on a Sunday, in Vespers on Saturday evening following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter, at "Lord, I have cried" we sing 6 Stichira of the Resurrection, and 4 of the Saint, Glory of the Saint, Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, "O Gladsome Light," the Prokimenon and the Readings. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory of the Saint, Now and ever, "Unwedded Virgin." The Apolytikia of the Resurrection, of the Saint, the Theotokion, and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 2.    If the feast occurs on a Sunday: at Vespers on Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm [Psalm 103 LXX] and the First Kathisma of the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 6 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Venerable Father; **"Glory"**: of the Venerable Father; **"Both now and ever"**: the First Dogmatic Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Readings of the Venerable Father [Wisdom 3:1–9; Wisdom 5:15–6:3; Wisdom 4:7–15]. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; **"Glory"**: of the Venerable Father; **"Both now and ever"**: **"O unwedded Virgin"** (*Ἀνύμφευτε Παρθένε*). Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Venerable Father, the Sunday Dismissal Theotokion of the Tone, and Dismissal.

After the Third Ode: following the Kontakion and Ikos of the Venerable Father, the Kathisma and the Theotokion; after the Sixth Ode: the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, and the Synaxarion from the Menaion. units.slavonic_diplomatic: 4.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄ καὶ δ΄ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Κανόνος τοῦ Ὁσίου· Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τοῦ Ὁσίου, τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, καὶ Κοντάκιον Ἡ Παρθένος σήμερον, Ἀπόστολος τοῦ Ὁσίου καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, Κοινωνικὸν Αἰνεῖτε, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 1.    Ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν, καὶ τὴν α΄ Στάσιν τοῦ Ψαλτηρίου, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν εἰς ς΄ τὰ Προσόμοια Μύροις παροικήσας αἰσθητῶς 1, Δόξα Ἱεραρχῶν τὴν καλλονὴν, Καὶ νῦν Σπήλαιον εὐτρεπίζου, Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρὸν, τὸ Προκείμενον τῆς ἡμέρας καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ γ΄ Στιχηρὰ Προσόμοια, Δόξα Ἄνθρωπε τοῦ Θεοῦ, Καὶ νῦν Ἀνύμφευτε Παρθένε, πόθεν ἥκεις; Ἀπολυτίκιον Κανόνα πίστεως, τὸ Θεοτοκίον καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 2.    Εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν καὶ τὴν Λιτὴν, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον δὶς καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον ἅπαξ, τὸ Ψαλτήριον τῆς ἡμέρας καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος· τὰ Καθίσματα κατὰ σειρὰν, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ, τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον Τίμιος ἐναντίον Κυρίου, τὸ Πᾶσα πνοὴ καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον· εἶτα ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα. Δόξα Ταῖς τοῦ Ἱεράρχου, Καὶ νῦν Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου, ὁ Στίχος Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεὸς καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Εὖ 1.    Τὰ ἕτερα γ΄ Προσόμοια τὰ πρὸς τὸ Ποίοις εὐφημιῶν οὐ ψάλλονται διὰ τὸν λόγον ὅτι ὁ ποιητὴς αὐτῶν Νικόλαος Μαλαξός. Πρεσβύτερος Πελοποννήσιος καὶ Πρωτοϊερεὺς Ναυπλίου, ζήσας περὶ τὸ 1640, ἀνὴρ δαήμων τοῦ καθ' Ἕλληνας λόγου, ἐξ εὐλαβείας βουληθεὶς γενέσθαι καὶ μελουργὸς καὶ συντάξας ταῦτα, ὡς καὶ τὰ ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ τοῦ ἁγίου Γρηγορίου πρὸς τὸ Ποίοις εὐφημιῶν, καὶ τὰ τοῦ Χρυσοστόμου πρὸς τὸ Ὁ ἐξ Ὑψίστου κληθεὶς Προσόμοια, ἀπέστειλεν εἰς Ἐνετίαν καὶ συνεννοηθεὶς μετὰ τῶν ἐκεῖ τότε τυπογράφων, κατεχώρισεν αὐτὰ ἐν τοῖς ἐκδοθεῖσι τότε νέοις Μηναίοις αὐθαιρέτῳ γνώμῃ, ἐφ' ᾧ αὐτὸς μὲν παρὰ τῆς τότε ἐν Κωνσταντινουπόλει Ἱερᾶς Συνόδου διεκηρύχθη ὡς καινοτόμος τὰ δὲ ἐκδοθέντα ᾄσματα αὐτοῦ καθωρίσθη ἔκτοτε ἵνα μὴ ψάλλωνται ἐν ταῖς τοῦ Χριστοῦ Ἐκκλησίαις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 4.    In the Liturgy, the Typika and 4 Beatitudes of the Mode and 4 hymns from the 6th Ode of the Canon of the Saint. After the Entrance, the Resurrection Apolytikion, the Apolytikion of the Saint, that of the Saint of the Church and the Kontakion "The Virgin today," the Apostolos of the Saint and the Gospel of the Sunday. At "Especially," "It is meet," Communion Hymn "Praise," "We have seen the [true] light," and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 4.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Typika, and 4 Beatitudes of the Tone and 4 Troparia from the Sixth Ode of the Canon of the Venerable Father. After the Little Entrance: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Venerable Father, that of the Patron Saint of the temple, and the Kontakion: **"Today the Virgin comes unto the cave"** (*Ἡ Παρθένος σήμερον*). The Epistle of the Venerable Father [Gal. 5:22–6:2] and the Gospel of the Sunday. At the Megalynarion: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Verse: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 148:1 LXX), **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 1.    In Vespers, following the Introductory Psalm and the first Stasis of the Psalter, at "Lord, I have cried," we sing 6 Prosomia Stichira of the Saint1, Glory, "Let us come together," Now and ever, "O Cavern, make ready." Entrance, "O Gladsome Light," the Prokimenon of the day and the Readings. At the Aposticha: the 3 Prosomia Stichira, Glory, "Man of God," Now and ever, "O Groomless Virgin, from where do you come?" The Apolytikion "A rule of faith," the Theotokion, and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 1.    At Vespers, following the Introductory Psalm [Psalm 103 LXX] and the First Stasis of the Psalter [Psalms 1–3 LXX, "Blessed is the man"], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 6 Prosomoia Stichira of the Saint: **"Having dwelt in Myra in the flesh"** (*Μύροις παροικήσας αἰσθητῶς*),[^187] **"Glory"**: **"The beauty of hierarchs"** (*Ἱεραρχῶν τὴν καλλονήν*); **"Both now and ever"**: **"O cave, make ready"** (*Σπήλαιον εὐτρεπίζου*). Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon of the day, and the Old Testament Readings of the Hierarch [Proverbs 10:7, 6; 3:13–16; 8:6 etc.; Proverbs 10:31–11:12; Wisdom 4:7–15]. At the Aposticha: the 3 Prosomoia Stichira; **"Glory"**: **"O man of God and faithful servant"** (*Ἄνθρωπε τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ πιστὲ θεράπον*); **"Both now and ever"**: Forefeast Theotokion: **"O unwedded Virgin, whence art thou come?"** (*Ἀνύμφευτε Παρθένε, πόθεν ἥκεις;*). Dismissal Troparion: **"A rule of faith and a model of meekness"** (*Κανόνα πίστεως καὶ εἰκόνα πραότητος*), the Dismissal Theotokion, and Dismissal.
