units.english_cohort_translation: 6.    In the Divine Liturgy, the Antiphons; in the Second Antiphon: **"Save us, O Son of God, Who wast circumcised in the flesh..."**; at the Entrance: **"O come, let us worship and fall down before Christ; save us, O Son of God, Who art risen from the dead..."** The Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, that of the Feast, that of the Saint, [that of the Temple Patron], the Kontakion: **"The Lord of all endures circumcision"** (*Ὁ τῶν ὅλων Κύριος περιτομὴν ὑπομένει*, see after the Third Ode of the Canon). The Epistle of the Saint and the Gospel: **"The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God"**, and then the Divine Liturgy of Saint Basil the Great; at the Diptychs we sing the Megalynarion of the Saint (see above, Paragraph 3). units.slavonic_diplomatic: 1.    If the Sunday before Epiphany occurs on the 2nd, 3rd, or 4th of the month, the Service is sung as follows: on Saturday evening following the
units.english_cohort_translation: 1.    If the Sunday before Theophany occurs on the 2nd, 3rd, or 4th of the month, the Service is sung as follows: on Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the Psalter Kathisma, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 6 Resurrectional Stichira, and 4 Forefeast Idiomela: **"Pre-festal songs"** (*Προεόρτια ᾄσματα*, see January 2); **"Glory"**: **"He comes unto Jordan"** (*Ἔρχεται πρὸς Ἰορδάνην*); **"Both now and ever"**: the First Theotokion Dogmatikon of the Tone. Both now and ever..."**: **"O John the Baptist"** (*Ἰωάννη Βαπτιστά*, see in January 2 the Doxastikon of Matins). units.slavonic_diplomatic: Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ ᾿Αναστάσιμον καὶ τὸ Προεόρτιον Πῶς ῥεῖθρά σε ποτάμια (ζήτει τῇ Β΄ τοῦ μηνός). Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, ᾿Αναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ δ΄ Προεόρτια Αἱ Ἀγγελικαὶ προπορεύεσθε δυνάμεις. Δόξα τὸ Ἑωθινόν, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερευλογημένη. Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία.
units.english_cohort_translation: εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα κατὰ σειράν, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ τοῦ ἤχου, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον, Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ Προεόρτιος τῆς ἡμέρας. Ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κάθισμα *Ἀόρατε Θεὲ* ἅπαξ, ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων τῆς ἡμέρας· αἱ Καταβασίαι *Βυθοῦ ἀνεκάλυψε πυθμένα* καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*. Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον καὶ τὸ Προεόρτιον *Πῶς ῥεῖθρά σε ποτάμια* (ζήτει τῇ Β΄ τοῦ μηνός). Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ δ΄ Προεόρτια *Αἱ Ἀγγελικαὶ προπορεύεσθε δυνάμεις*. *Δόξα* τὸ Ἑωθινόν, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Ὑπερευλογημένη*. Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ *Σήμερον σωτηρία*.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 3.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄ καὶ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ προεορτίου Κανόνος δ΄· μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ ᾿Αναστάσιμον ᾿Απολυτίκιον, τὸ Προεόρτιον Ἑτοιμάζου Ζαβουλὼν καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ. Κοντάκιον Ἐν τοῖς ῥείθροις σήμερον, ᾿Απόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς πρὸ τῶν Φώτων.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 4.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ Κυριακὴ πρὸ τῶν Φώτων τῇ Παραμονῇ τῆς ἑορτῆς (τῇ Ε΄ τοῦ μηνός), τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν ᾿Αναστάσιμα ς΄ καὶ Προεόρτια α΄ Προεόρτια ᾄσματα. units.slavonic_diplomatic: 3.    In the Liturgy, the Typika and 4 Beatitudes of the Mode and 4 hymns from the 6th Ode of the Canon of the Pre-feast. After the Entrance, the
units.english_cohort_translation: Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons of the Resurrection and of the Forefeast of that day. After the Third Ode: the Kathisma: **"Invisible God"** (*Ἀόρατε Θεέ*) once (see January 2); after the Sixth Ode: the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrection and the Menologion of the Saints of the day. The Katavasiai: **"He uncovered the bottom of the deep"** (*Βυθοῦ ἀνεκάλυψε πυθμένα*), and the entire order of the Morning Gospel; then **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection and of the Forefeast: **"How shall river streams receive Thee"** (*Πῶς ῥεῖθρά σε ποτάμια*, see January 2). At the Praises: 4 Resurrectional Stichira and 4 of the Forefeast: **"O angelic hosts, go before"** (*Αἱ Ἀγγελικαὶ προπορεύεσθε δυνάμεις*); **"Glory"**: the Morning Eothinon Doxastikon; **"Both now and ever"**: **"Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); Great Doxology, and **"Today salvation"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

The Katavasiai: **"He uncovered the bottom of the deep"** (*Βυθοῦ ἀνεκάλυψε πυθμένα*), and the entire order of the Morning Gospel; then **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection and of the Forefeast: **"How shall river streams receive Thee"** (*Πῶς ῥεῖθρά σε ποτάμια*, see January 2). At the Praises: 4 Resurrectional Stichira and 4 of the Forefeast: **"O angelic hosts, go before"** (*Αἱ Ἀγγελικαὶ προπορεύεσθε δυνάμεις*); **"Glory"**: the Morning Eothinon Doxastikon; **"Both now and ever"**: **"Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); Great Doxology, and **"Today salvation"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 4.    If the Sunday before Epiphany occurs on the Eve of the Feast (the 5th of the month), on Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter, at “Lord, I have cried” we sing 6 Stichira of the Resurrec- tion, and the 4 of the Pre-feast “Pre-festal songs,” Glory, “Christ comes toward the Jordan,” Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode.
units.english_cohort_translation: 4.    If the Sunday before Theophany occurs on the Eve of the Feast (the 5th of the month): on Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the Psalter Kathisma, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 6 Resurrectional Stichira, and 4 Forefeast Idiomela: **"Pre-festal songs"** (*Προεόρτια ᾄσματα*); **"Glory"**: **"He comes unto Jordan"** (*Ἔρχεται πρὸς Ἰορδάνην*); **"Both now and ever"**: the First Theotokion Dogmatikon of the Tone. Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrectional Stichira; **"Glory... Both now and ever..."**: **"In the River Jordan"** (*Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ ποταμῷ*, see January 3). Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, of the Forefeast: **"The Jordan formerly turned back"** (*Ἀπεστρέφετό ποτε*), and the Dismissal.

units.slavonic_incipit: εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα Ὁ Μέγας ὑετός
units.slavonic_diplomatic: εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα Ὁ Μέγας ὑετός [ὅρα 5 Ἰανουαρίου], ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον ἐν τοῖς ῥείθροις σήμερον, ὁ Οἶκος καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων τῆς ἡμέρας· αἱ Καταβασίαι Βυθοῦ ἀνεκάλυψε πυθμένα καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου. Εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν. Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ ᾿Αναστάσιμον καὶ τὸ Προεόρτιον Πῶς ῥεῖθρά σε ποτάμια (ζήτει τῇ Β΄ τοῦ μηνός). Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, ᾿Αναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ δ΄ Προεόρτια Ἰδοὺ ὁ Βασιλεύς. Δόξα, Ἰωάννη Βαπτιστά, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία.
units.english_cohort_translation: εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα *Ὁ Μέγας ὑετός* [ὅρα 5 Ἰανουαρίου], ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον *Ἐν τοῖς ῥείθροις σήμερον*, ὁ Οἶκος καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων τῆς ἡμέρας· αἱ Καταβασίαι *Βυθοῦ ἀνεκάλυψε πυθμένα* καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου. Εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*. Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον καὶ τὸ Προεόρτιον *Πῶς ῥεῖθρά σε ποτάμια* (ζήτει τῇ Β΄ τοῦ μηνός). Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ δ΄ Προεόρτια *Ἰδοὺ ὁ Βασιλεύς*. *Δόξα*, *Ἰωάννη Βαπτιστά*, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Ὑπερευλογημένη*, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ *Σήμερον σωτηρία*.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 6.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄ καὶ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ προεορτίου Κανόνος δ΄. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον ᾿Απολυτίκιον, τὸ Προεόρτιον Ἀπεστρέφετό ποτε, τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ καὶ τὸ Κοντάκιον Ἐν τοῖς ῥείθροις σήμερον. ᾿Απόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς πρὸ τῶν Φώτων.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 1.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ ἑορτὴ τῶν Θεοφανείων ἐν ἡμέρᾳ Παρασκευῇ, τῇ Πέμπτῃ πρωΐ, μετὰ τὴν τοῦ Ὄρθρου ἐνδιάτακτον ᾿Ακολουθίαν, ψάλλονται αἱ Μ. Ὧραι κατὰ τὴν τάξιν τῆς Παραμονῆς τῶν Χριστουγέννων (Ὅρα ἐκεῖ τὴν διάταξιν ἐν περιπτώσει Α΄ § 2). Ὁ δὲ Μ. Ἑσπερινὸς καὶ ἡ Λειτουργία τοῦ Μ. Βασιλείου μετὰ τοῦ ἐν τῷ τέλει τῆς Λειτουργίας Ἁγιασμοῦ ψάλλονται ὡς ἑξῆς·

units.english_cohort_translation: 6.    In the Divine Liturgy, the Typika and 4 Beatitudes of the Tone and 4 hymns from the Sixth Ode of the Canon of the Forefeast. After the Entrance: the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, that of the Forefeast: **"The Jordan formerly turned back"** (*Ἀπεστρέφετό ποτε*), and that of the Temple Patron. Kontakion: **"Today in the streams of the Jordan"** (*Ἐν τοῖς ῥείθροις σήμερον*). The Epistle and Gospel of the Sunday before Theophany. At **"Especially"**: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Verse: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 148:1 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν*).

units.english_cohort_translation: After **"Blessed be the name of the Lord"** (*Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου*), the Idiomela: **"The voice of the Lord is upon the waters"** (*Φωνὴ Κυρίου ἐπὶ τῶν ὑδάτων*) etc. are sung, and the Service of the Great Blessing of the Waters is performed, as is customary, according to the order in the Menaion. Dismissal Troparion: **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** (*Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ βαπτιζομένου σου, Κύριε*) and Kontakion: **"Today in the streams of the Jordan"** (*Ἐν τοῖς ῥείθροις σήμερον*); after the conclusion of the Great Blessing of the Waters, while the faithful are blessed with holy water, the Second Choir sings the Idiomelon: **"Let us, the faithful, praise"** (*᾿Ανυμνήσωμεν οἱ πιστοί*), and the Dismissal. At table, wine and olive oil are allowed.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 2.    Μετὰ τὴν τῆς Θ΄ Ὥρας ἀπόλυσιν, ὁ Διάκονος Εὐλόγησον Δέσποτα, ὁ Ἱερεὺς Εὐλογημένη ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Πατρὸς κτλ. ὁ Πατριάρχης (ἢ ὁ Ἀρχιερεὺς) τὸν Προοιμιακόν, εἶτα ὁ Διάκονος τὴν Μ. Συναπτήν. Εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν τὰ δ΄ Ἰδιόμελα Τὸν φωτισμὸν ἡμῶν εἰς ς΄. Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπέκλινας κάραν τῷ Προδρόμῳ. Εἴσοδος μετὰ τοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, καὶ εὐθὺς ὁ Ἀναγνώστης τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα Ἐν ἀρχῇ ἐποίησεν ὁ Θεὸς τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν· μετὰ τὸ τέλος ἄρχεται ὁ α΄ Χορὸς ψάλλειν τὸ Τροπάριον Ἐπεφάνης ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ὁλόκληρον· ὁ β΄ ἐπαναλαμβάνει Ἵνα φωτίσῃς τοὺς ἐν σκότει καθημένους, Φιλάνθρωπε, δόξα σοι, ὅπερ ἐπαναλαμβάνεται ἑκατέρωθεν ἕως οὗ ὁ Κανονάρχης πληρώσῃ τοὺς Στίχους τοῦ ψαλμοῦ. Εἶτα αὖθις ὁ α΄ Χορὸς Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν τὸ Τροπάριον ὁλόκληρον. Μετὰ ταῦτα ὁ β΄ Κανονάρχης ἀναγινώσκει τὸ Ε΄ Ἀνάγνωσμα Εἶπεν Ἠλίας τῷ Ἐλισσαιέ· μετὰ τὸ τέλος ὁ β΄ Χορὸς ψάλλει Ἁμαρτωλοῖς καὶ τελώναις ὁλόκληρον· ἀπὸ δὲ τοῦ Ποῦ γὰρ εἶχε τὸ φῶς σου λάμψαι, ἐπαναλαμβάνεται ἐναλλὰξ ὑπὸ τῶν δύο Χορῶν, ἕως οὗ ὁ Κανονάρχης πληρώσῃ τοὺς Στίχους τοῦ ψαλμοῦ·
units.english_cohort_translation: 2.    Μετὰ τὴν τῆς Θ΄ Ὥρας ἀπόλυσιν, ὁ Διάκονος *Εὐλόγησον Δέσποτα*, ὁ Ἱερεὺς *Εὐλογημένη ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Πατρὸς κτλ.* ὁ Πατριάρχης (ἢ ὁ Ἀρχιερεὺς) τὸν Προοιμιακόν, εἶτα ὁ Διάκονος τὴν Μ. Συναπτήν. Εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν τὰ δ΄ Ἰδιόμελα *Τὸν φωτισμὸν ἡμῶν* εἰς ς΄. *Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν*, *Ὑπέκλινας κάραν τῷ Προδρόμῳ*. Εἴσοδος μετὰ τοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, *Φῶς ἱλαρόν*, καὶ εὐθὺς ὁ Ἀναγνώστης τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα *Ἐν ἀρχῇ ἐποίησεν ὁ Θεὸς τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν*· μετὰ τὸ τέλος ἄρχεται ὁ α΄ Χορὸς ψάλλειν τὸ Τροπάριον *Ἐπεφάνης ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ* ὁλόκληρον· ὁ β΄ ἐπαναλαμβάνει *Ἵνα φωτίσῃς τοὺς ἐν σκότει καθημένους, Φιλάνθρωπε, δόξα σοι*, ὅπερ ἐπαναλαμβάνεται ἑκατέρωθεν ἕως οὗ ὁ Κανονάρχης πληρώσῃ τοὺς Στίχους τοῦ ψαλμοῦ. Εἶτα αὖθις ὁ α΄ Χορὸς *Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν* τὸ Τροπάριον ὁλόκληρον. Μετὰ ταῦτα ὁ β΄ Κανονάρχης ἀναγινώσκει τὸ Ε΄ Ἀνάγνωσμα *Εἶπεν Ἠλίας τῷ Ἐλισσαιέ*· μετὰ τὸ τέλος ὁ β΄ Χορὸς ψάλλει *Ἁμαρτωλοῖς καὶ τελώναις* ὁλόκληρον· ἀπὸ δὲ τοῦ *Ποῦ γὰρ εἶχε τὸ φῶς σου λάμψαι*, ἐπαναλαμβάνεται ἐναλλὰξ ὑπὸ τῶν δύο Χορῶν, ἕως οὗ ὁ Κανονάρχης πληρώσῃ τοὺς Στίχους τοῦ ψαλμοῦ· ὁ α΄ αὖθις Κανονάρχης τὸ ς΄ Ἀνάγνωσμα *Παραγένετο Νεεμὰν βασιλέως Ἀσσυρίων* καὶ μετὰ τὸ τέλος τὴν μικρὰν Συναπτὴν *Τοῦ Κυρίου δεηθῶμεν*, καὶ ψάλλεται τὸ Τρισάγιον, εἶτα λέγεται ὁ Ἀπόστολος, καὶ μετὰ τὸ Ἀλληλούϊα τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον ἐπ’ ἄμβωνος καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία τοῦ Μ. Βασιλείου. Κοινωνικὸν *Αἰνεῖτε (τὸν) Κύριον* καὶ τὸ *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*. Μετὰ τὴν Ὀπισθάμβωνον Εὐχήν, ψάλλονται τὰ Ἰδιόμελα *Φωνὴ Κυρίου* καὶ τελεῖται ὑπὸ τοῦ λειτουργοῦντος Ἱερέως ὁ Ἁγιασμός, ὡς εἴθισται, κατὰ τὴν ἐν τῷ Μηναίῳ διάταξιν. Μετὰ τὸ τέλος τοῦ Ἁγιασμοῦ, ἁγιαζομένων τῶν Χριστιανῶν, ὁ β΄ Χορὸς ψάλλει τὸ Ἰδιόμελον *Ἀνυμνήσωμεν οἱ πιστοί*, καὶ μετὰ τοῦτο ἡ Ἀπόλυσις *Δόξα σοι . . . ὁ ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ ὑπὸ Ἰωάννου βαπτισθῆναι καταδεξάμενος διὰ τὴν ἡμῶν σωτηρίαν Χριστός . . . .* Ἐν δὲ τῇ τραπέζῃ ξηροφαγία.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 2.    After the Dismissal of the 9th Hour, the Deacon “Bless, Master,” the Priest “Blessed is the Kingdom of the Father” etc., the Patriarch (or
units.english_cohort_translation: 2.    After the Dismissal of the Ninth Hour, the Deacon intones: **"Bless, Master"** (*Εὐλόγησον, Δέσποτα*); the Priest: **"Blessed is the kingdom of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit, now and forever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen"** (*Εὐλογημένη ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Πατρὸς...*); the Patriarch (or Hierarch) reads the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX]; then the Deacon intones the Great Litany. At **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing the 4 Idiomela: **"Our illumination"** (*Τὸν φωτισμὸν ἡμῶν*), repeating the first two to make 6. **"Glory... Both now and ever..."**: **"Thou hast bowed Thy head unto the Forerunner"** (*Ὑπέκλινας κάραν τῷ Προδρόμῳ*). Entrance with the Gospel Book, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and immediately the Reader reads the Readings: **"In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth"** (*Ἐν ἀρχῇ ἐποίησεν ὁ Θεὸς τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν*, Genesis 1:1–13); at the conclusion, the First Choir begins singing the Troparion: **"Thou hast appeared in the world"** (*Ἐπεφάνης ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ*) in its entirety; the Second Choir repeats the refrain: **"To give light to those who sit in darkness; O Lover of mankind, glory to Thee!"** (*Ἵνα φωτίσῃς τοὺς ἐν σκότει καθημένους, Φιλάνθρωπε, δόξα σοι*), which is repeated alternately by both Choirs until the Canonarch completes the Verses of the Psalm [Ps. 66 LXX]. Then immediately the First Choir sings **"Glory to the Father and to the Son and to the Holy Spirit, both now and ever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen"**, and the entire Troparion. After this, the second Canonarch reads the Fifth Reading: **"And Elijah said unto Elisha"** (*Εἶπεν Ἠλίας τῷ Ἐλισσαιέ*, 4 Kingdoms 2:6–14 LXX); at the conclusion, the Second Choir sings: **"Unto sinners and tax-collectors"** (*Ἁμαρτωλοῖς καὶ τελώναις*) in its entirety; from the phrase: **"Where indeed should Thy light have shone"** (*Ποῦ γὰρ εἶχε τὸ φῶς σου λάμψαι*), it is repeated alternately by the two Choirs, until the Canonarch completes the verses of the Psalm [Ps. 92 LXX]; then the first Canonarch recites the Sixth Reading: **"So Naaman, captain of the host of the king of Syria"** (*Παραγένετο Νεεμὰν βασιλέως Ἀσσυρίων*, 4 Kingdoms 5:1–14 LXX). Then the Small Litany: **"Let us pray to the Lord"** (*Τοῦ Κυρίου δεηθῶμεν*), and the Trisagion Hymn is sung; then follows the Epistle [1 Corinthians 9:19–27] and, following the **"Alleluia"**, the Gospel [Luke 3:1–18] is proclaimed from the ambo, and then follows the Divine Liturgy of Saint Basil the Great. Communion Verse: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 148:1 LXX) and **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν*). After the Prayer behind the Ambon, the Idiomela: **"The voice of the Lord is upon the waters"** (*Φωνὴ Κυρίου ἐπὶ τῶν ὑδάτων*) are sung, and the Service of the Great Blessing of the Waters is celebrated, as is customary, according to the order in the Menaion by the celebrating Priest. After the conclusion of the Great Blessing of the Waters, while the faithful are blessed with holy water, the Second Choir sings the Idiomelon: **"Let us, the faithful, praise"** (*Ἀνυμνήσωμεν οἱ πιστοί*), and then the Dismissal: **"Glory to Thee, [O Christ God, our hope, glory to Thee]... May He Who deigned to be baptized by John in the Jordan for our salvation, Christ our true God..."** (*Δόξα σοι... ὁ ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ ὑπὸ Ἰωάννου βαπτισθῆναι καταδεξάμενος διὰ τὴν ἡμῶν σωτηρίαν Χριστὸς ὁ ἀληθινὸς Θεὸς ἡμῶν...*). At table, xerophagy [strict fast without wine or oil] is observed.

units.slavonic_incipit: Kontakion, the Ikos and the Minologion.
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Kontakion, the Ikos and the Minologion. Both (double) Katavasie and the 9th Ode with the Megalynaria:
units.english_cohort_translation: Then the 3 Kathismata, the Anavathmoi (first Antiphon of Tone 4), the Prokeimenon: **"The sea saw and fled, Jordan was driven back"** (*Ἡ θάλασσα εἶδε καὶ ἔφυγεν*, Ps. 113:3 LXX); then **"Let everything that hath breath praise the Lord"** (*Πᾶσα πνοὴ αἰνεσάτω τὸν Κύριον*) and the Gospel of Matins [Mark 1:9–11], and Psalm 50 [LXX] read. **"Glory"**: **"Today let all things greatly rejoice"** (*Τὰ σύμπαντα σήμερον ἀγαλλιάσθω*); **"Both now and ever"**: repeat the same hymn; the Verse: **"Have mercy upon me, O God, according to Thy great mercy"** [Ps. 50:3 LXX], and the Idiomelon: **"God the Word appeared in the flesh"** (*Θεὸς λόγος ἐπεφάνη ἐν σαρκί*). Both Canons are sung with 4 troparia from each Canon without verses except for **"Glory... Both now and ever..."** in each Ode. After the Third Ode, the Hypakoe: **"When at Thy manifestation"** (*Ὅτε τῇ ἐπιφανείᾳ σου*); after the Sixth Ode, the Kontakion: **"Thou hast appeared today to the universe"** (*Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον*), the Ikos, and the Menologion of the day. Both double Katavasiai: **"He uncovered the bottom of the deep"** (*Βυθοῦ ἀνεκάλυψε πυθμένα*) and **"The Lord, working wonders"** (*Στείβει θαλάσσης*), and the Ninth Ode is sung with the Megalynaria:

units.slavonic_incipit: Μετὰ τὸ Ἅγιος ἀθάνατος, ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Μετὰ τὸ Ἅγιος ἀθάνατος, ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς τοῦ Τρισαγίου τῆς Δοξολογίας, ψάλλονται τὰ γ΄ Ἰδιόμελα τοῦ Ἁγιασμοῦ¹ Φωνὴ Κυρίου ἐπὶ τῶν ὑδάτων, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Πρὸς τὴν φωνὴν τοῦ βοῶντος ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ. Τούτων ψαλλομένων, ἐξέρχεται ὁ Ἱερεὺς ἀπὸ τῆς Ὡραίας Πύλης μετὰ τοῦ τιμίου Σταυροῦ προπορευομένων λαμπάδων καὶ τῶν Διακόνων, ὁ δὲ Πατριάρχης (ἢ ὁ Ἀρχιερεὺς) κατέρχεται τοῦ Θρόνου καὶ ἔρχεται ἐν τῷ μέσῳ τοῦ Ναοῦ, ἔνθα κεῖται ἡ τράπεζα καὶ τὸ δοχεῖον τοῦ Ἁγιασμοῦ, φορῶν ἐπιτραχήλιον καὶ ὠμόφορον. Μετὰ τὸ τέλος τῶν Ἰδιομέλων ὁ Κανονάρχης ἢ ὁ Διάκονος εὐθὺς ἀναγινώσκει τὰς τρεῖς Προφητείας τοῦ Ἁγιασμοῦ καὶ ἀκολούθως τὸν Ἀπόστολον, ὁ δὲ Πατριάρχης τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον· μετὰ τὸ Εἰς πολλὰ ἔτη, ὁ Μ.
units.english_cohort_translation: Μετὰ τὸ *Ἅγιος ἀθάνατος, ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς* τοῦ Τρισαγίου τῆς Δοξολογίας, ψάλλονται τὰ γ΄ Ἰδιόμελα τοῦ Ἁγιασμοῦ *Φωνὴ Κυρίου ἐπὶ τῶν ὑδάτων*, *Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν*, *Πρὸς τὴν φωνὴν τοῦ βοῶντος ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ*. Τούτων ψαλλομένων, ἐξέρχεται ὁ Ἱερεὺς ἀπὸ τῆς Ὡραίας Πύλης μετὰ τοῦ τιμίου Σταυροῦ προπορευομένων λαμπάδων καὶ τῶν Διακόνων, ὁ δὲ Πατριάρχης (ἢ ὁ Ἀρχιερεὺς) κατέρχεται τοῦ Θρόνου καὶ ἔρχεται ἐν τῷ μέσῳ τοῦ Ναοῦ, ἔνθα κεῖται ἡ τράπεζα καὶ τὸ δοχεῖον τοῦ Ἁγιασμοῦ, φορῶν ἐπιτραχήλιον καὶ ὠμόφορον. Μετὰ τὸ τέλος τῶν Ἰδιομέλων ὁ Κανονάρχης ἢ ὁ Διάκονος εὐθὺς ἀναγινώσκει τὰς τρεῖς Προφητείας τοῦ Ἁγιασμοῦ καὶ ἀκολούθως τὸν Ἀπόστολον, ὁ δὲ Πατριάρχης τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον· μετὰ τὸ *Εἰς πολλὰ ἔτη*, ὁ Μ. Ἀρχιδιάκονος τὴν μεγάλην Συναπτὴν τοῦ Ἁγιασμοῦ, τοῦ Πατριάρχου μεταξὺ τούτου ἀναγινώσκοντος μυστικῶς τὴν Εὐχὴν *Κύριε Ἰησοῦ Χριστέ*· πληρωθείσης τῆς Εὐχῆς συνάμα καὶ τῆς Συναπτῆς, ἐκφωνεῖ τὴν Εὐχὴν *Τριὰς ὑπερούσιε*, ἐπισυνάπτων μετὰ τὸ τέλος ταύτης καὶ τὴν ἑτέραν Εὐχὴν *Μέγας εἶ Κύριε καὶ θαυμαστὰ τὰ ἔργα σου*, ὃ ἐπαναλαμβάνει τρίς, καὶ πᾶσαν δὲ ἐπανάληψιν οἱ Χοροὶ ψάλλουσι τὸ

units.english_cohort_translation: In the Great Doxology, after the phrase **"Holy Immortal, have mercy on us"** (*Ἅγιος ἀθάνατος, ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς*) of the Trisagion, we sing the 3 Idiomela of the Blessing of the Waters: **"The voice of the Lord is upon the waters"** (*Φωνὴ Κυρίου ἐπὶ τῶν ὑδάτων*); **"Glory... Both now and ever..."**: **"At the voice of one crying in the wilderness"** (*Πρὸς τὴν φωνὴν τοῦ βοῶντος ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ*). While these hymns are being sung, the Priest exits from the Holy Doors holding the Precious Cross, preceded by candle-bearers and Deacons. The Patriarch (or Hierarch), wearing the epitrachilion and small omophorion, descends from the Throne and comes to the center of the temple, where the table with the vessel of holy water has been prepared. At the conclusion of the Idiomela, the Canonarch or the Deacon immediately reads the 3 Prophecies of the Blessing of the Waters [Isaiah 35:1–10; Isaiah 55:1–13; Isaiah 12:3–6], and then follows the Epistle [1 Corinthians 10:1–4]; the Patriarch proclaims the Gospel [Mark 1:9–11]; after **"Many years"** (*Εἰς πολλὰ ἔτη*), the Great Archdeacon intones the Great Litany of the Blessing of the Waters Service. units.slavonic_diplomatic: Δόξα σοι Κύριε δόξα σοι· μετὰ τὸ τέλος τῆς Εὐχῆς βαπτίζει τὸν τίμιον Σταυρὸν μετὰ τοῦ ἁγιαστῆρος ἐν τῷ δοχείῳ, εἰς τρεῖς ἀναδύσεις καὶ καταδύσεις ψάλλων τὸ Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ βαπτιζομένου σου Κύριε, ὅπερ ἐπαναλαμβάνουσι καὶ οἱ Χοροὶ ἀνὰ μίαν, εἶτα ἁγιάζων σταυροειδῶς τὸν λαὸν καὶ ψάλλων τὸ Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον τῇ οἰκουμένῃ, ἀνέρχεται εἰς τὸν Θρόνον, τῶν Χορῶν ψαλλόντων τὸ Εἰς πολλὰ ἔτη· ἁγιαζομένων δὲ τῶν Ἀρχιερέων καὶ τῶν λοιπῶν κληρικῶν ὑπὸ τοῦ Πατριάρχου, οἱ Χοροὶ ψάλλουσιν ἐναλλὰξ ἀργῶς καὶ μετὰ μέλους τὸ Τροπάριον τῆς η΄ Ὠδῆς Τριάδος ἡ φανέρωσις, ἄχρις οὗ ἁγιασθῶσι πάντες, εἶτα ὁ β΄ Χορὸς τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ καὶ ἄρχεται ἡ Λειτουργία τοῦ Χρυσοστόμου.

Δόξα σοι Κύριε δόξα σοι· μετὰ τὸ τέλος τῆς Εὐχῆς βαπτίζει
τὸν τίμιον Σταυρὸν μετὰ τοῦ ἁγιαστῆρος ἐν τῷ δοχείῳ, εἰς τρεῖς
ἀναδύσεις καὶ καταδύσεις ψάλλων τὸ Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ βαπτιζομένου
σου Κύριε, ὅπερ ἐπαναλαμβάνουσι καὶ οἱ Χοροὶ ἀνὰ μίαν, εἶτα
ἁγιάζων σταυροειδῶς τὸν λαὸν καὶ ψάλλων τὸ Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον
τῇ οἰκουμένῃ, ἀνέρχεται εἰς τὸν Θρόνον, τῶν Χορῶν ψαλλόντων
τὸ Εἰς πολλὰ ἔτη· ἁγιαζομένων δὲ τῶν Ἀρχιερέων καὶ τῶν λοιπῶν
κληρικῶν ὑπὸ τοῦ Πατριάρχου, οἱ Χοροὶ ψάλλουσιν ἐναλλὰξ ἀργῶς
καὶ μετὰ μέλους τὸ Τροπάριον τῆς η΄ Ὠδῆς Τριάδος ἡ
φανέρωσις, ἄχρις οὗ ἁγιασθῶσι πάντες, εἶτα ὁ β΄ Χορὸς τὸ
Ἀπολυτίκιον Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ καὶ ἄρχεται ἡ Λειτουργία τοῦ
Χρυσοστόμου.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Cross and immerses it with the sprinkler into the water and then lifts it from the water. There are three immersions and at each immersion “When You, O Lord, were baptized in the Jordan” is sung, the first time by the Patriarch and once by each of the Choirs. Then the Patriarch blesses the people in a crosslike manner; singing “You have appeared today to the universe,” he returns to the Throne, the Choirs singing “Many years,” while the rest of the
units.english_cohort_translation: **"Glory to Thee, O Lord, glory to Thee!"** At the conclusion of the prayer, he immerses the Precious Cross with the sprinkler into the water vessel with three immersions and elevations, singing: **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** (*Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ βαπτιζομένου σου, Κύριε*), which the Choirs repeat once each. Then, blessing the people cruciformly with holy water and singing: **"Thou hast appeared today to the universe"** (*Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον τῇ οἰκουμένῃ*), he ascends the Throne, while the Choirs sing: **"Many years"** (*Εἰς πολλὰ ἔτη*); while the Hierarchs and the rest of the clergy are blessed with holy water by the Patriarch, the Choirs sing alternately with a slow, solemn melody the Troparion of the Eighth Ode: **"The manifestation of the Trinity"** (*Τριάδος ἡ φανέρωσις*), until all have been blessed; then the Second Choir chants the Dismissal Troparion: **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** (*Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*), and the Divine Liturgy of Saint John Chrysostom begins.

units.slavonic_incipit: Εἰσοδικόν Εὐλογημένος ὁ ἐρχόμενος ἐν ὀνόματι
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Εἰσοδικόν Εὐλογημένος ὁ ἐρχόμενος ἐν ὀνόματι Κυρίου, Θεὸς Κύριος καὶ ἐπέφανεν ἡμῖν. Σῶσον ἡμᾶς . . . κτλ, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ, καὶ τὸ Κοντάκιον Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον· ἀντὶ τοῦ Τρισαγίου, ψάλλεται τὸ Ὅσοι εἰς Χριστὸν ἐβαπτίσθητε, ὁ Ἀπόστολος καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως, Μεγάλυνον ψυχή μου τὴν τιμιωτέραν καὶ ἐνδοξοτέραν τῶν ἄνω στρατευμάτων Ἀπορεῖ πᾶσα γλῶσσα, Κοινωνικὸν Ἐπεφάνη ἡ χάρις τοῦ Θεοῦ· ἀντὶ τοῦ Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς, λέγεται τὸ Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_incipit: O give thanks to the Lord,
units.slavonic_diplomatic: O give thanks to the Lord, for He is good! For His mercy endures forever!
units.english_cohort_translation: Little Entrance Verse: **"Blessed is He that comes in the name of the Lord; the Lord is God, and hath appeared unto us. Save us, O Son of God, Who wast baptized by John in the Jordan, who sing to Thee: Alleluia."** (*Εὐλογημένος ὁ ἐρχόμενος ἐν ὀνόματι Κυρίου, Θεὸς Κύριος καὶ ἐπέφανεν ἡμῖν. Σῶσον ἡμᾶς Υἱὲ Θεοῦ, ὁ ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ ὑπὸ Ἰωάννου βαπτισθείς, ψάλλοντάς σοι, Ἀλληλούϊα*, Ps. 117:26, 27 LXX). The Dismissal Troparion: **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** (*Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*), and the Kontakion: **"Thou hast appeared today to the universe"** (*Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον*); instead of the Trisagion Hymn, we sing: **"All of you who have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ. Alleluia"** (*Ὅσοι εἰς Χριστὸν ἐβαπτίσθητε, Χριστὸν ἐνεδύσασθε. Ἀλληλούϊα*, Galatians 3:27). The Epistle [Titus 2:11–14; 3:4–7] and the Gospel of the Feast [Matthew 3:13–17]. At **"Especially"**: **"Magnify, O my soul, Her that is more honorable and more glorious than the heavenly hosts. Every tongue is at a loss to praise Thee worthily"** (*Μεγάλυνον ψυχή μου τὴν τιμιωτέραν καὶ ἐνδοξοτέραν τῶν ἄνω στρατευμάτων. Ἀπορεῖ πᾶσα γλῶσσα...*). Communion Verse: **"The grace of God that brings salvation hath appeared unto all men"** (*Ἐπεφάνη ἡ χάρις τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡ σωτήριος πᾶσιν ἀνθρώποις*, Titus 2:11); instead of **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν*), we sing: **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** (*Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*), and the Dismissal.

units.english_cohort_translation: 5.    On that same Friday evening, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 3 Idiomela of the Feast: **"Our illumination"** (*Τὸν φωτισμὸν ἡμῶν*), and 3 Prosomoia of the Forerunner: **"O most praised Forerunner of Christ"** (*Πανεύφημε Πρόδρομε Χριστοῦ*); **"Glory"**: **"O torch incarnate"** (*Ἔνσαρκε λύχνε*); **"Both now and ever"**: **"God the Word appeared in the flesh"** (*Θεὸς λόγος ἐπεφάνη ἐν σαρκί*). Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Great Prokeimenon: **"Our God is in heaven and on earth; all things whatsoever He hath willed, He hath done"** (*Ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ καὶ ἐν τῇ γῇ, πάντα ὅσα ἠθέλησεν ἐποίησεν*, Ps. 113:11 LXX) with its verses. At the Aposticha: the 3 Prosomoia Stichira: **"When he saw Thee, O Master"** (*Ὡς εἶδέ σε Δέσποτα*) and the other two; **"Glory"**: **"As a lover of the Spirit"** (*Ὡς τοῦ Πνεύματος ἐραστής*); **"Both now and ever"**: **"Come, let us imitate the wise virgins"** (*Δεῦτε μιμησώμεθα*); the Dismissal Troparion of Theophany: **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** (*Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*), then that of the Forerunner: **"The memory of the righteous is celebrated with hymns of praise"** (*Μνήμη δικαίου μετ’ ἐγκωμίων*)...[^224]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 6.    Τῷ Σαββάτῳ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Προδρόμου καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος· Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον τῆς ἡμέρας, τὰ β΄ Καθίσματα Τοῦ Ἰησοῦ γεννηθέντος καὶ τὸ Ἐν τοῖς ῥείθροις βλέψας σε τοῦ Ἰορδάνου ἐκ δευτέρου, καὶ ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα, ὁ Κανὼν τῆς ἑορτῆς Βυθοῦ ἀνεκάλυψε μετὰ Στίχου Δόξα σοι ὁ Θεὸς καὶ ὁ τοῦ Προδρόμου Βαπτιζόμενον, μετὰ Στίχου Ἅγιε τοῦ Θεοῦ· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠ- δῆς τὸ Κάθισμα Ὁ μέγας ὑετὸς καὶ ἕτερον Ἑκὼν προῆλθεν ἐπὶ γῆς·
units.english_cohort_translation: 6.    Τῷ Σαββάτῳ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Προδρόμου καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος· Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος*, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον τῆς ἡμέρας, τὰ β΄ Καθίσματα *Τοῦ Ἰησοῦ γεννηθέντος* καὶ τὸ *Ἐν τοῖς ῥείθροις βλέψας σε τοῦ Ἰορδάνου* ἐκ δευτέρου, καὶ ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα, ὁ Κανὼν τῆς ἑορτῆς *Βυθοῦ ἀνεκάλυψε* μετὰ Στίχου *Δόξα σοι ὁ Θεὸς* καὶ ὁ τοῦ Προδρόμου *Βαπτιζόμενον*, μετὰ Στίχου *Ἅγιε τοῦ Θεοῦ*· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κάθισμα *Ὁ μέγας ὑετὸς* καὶ ἕτερον *Ἑκὼν προῆλθεν ἐπὶ γῆς*· ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τοῦ Προδρόμου καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι μόναι αἱ Ἰαμβικαί, εἶτα ψάλλεται ἡ α΄ Ὠδὴ τῆς Θ΄ μετὰ τῶν Μεγαλυναρίων καὶ ἡ τοῦ Προδρόμου μετὰ Στίχου *Ἅγιε τοῦ Θεοῦ* καὶ ἡ καταβασία *Μεγάλυνον ψυχή μου . . . Ὦ τῶν ὑπὲρ νοῦν*· Ἐξαποστειλάριον τοῦ Προδρόμου καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τὰ Ἰδιόμελα τῆς ἑορτῆς ὡς χθές, *Δόξα*, *Ἄγγελος ἐκ στειρωτικῶν ὠδίνων*, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Σήμερον ὁ Χριστὸς ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ *Μνήμη δικαίου*.

Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τὰ Ἰδιόμελα τῆς ἑορτῆς ὡς χθές, *Δόξα*, *Ἄγγελος ἐκ στειρωτικῶν ὠδίνων*, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Σήμερον ὁ Χριστὸς ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ *Μνήμη δικαίου*.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 6.    On Saturday in Matins, after Psalm 50, the Apolytikion of the
units.english_cohort_translation: 6.    On Saturday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Dismissal Troparion of the Forerunner: **"The memory of the righteous is celebrated with hymns of praise"** (*Μνήμη δικαίου μετ’ ἐγκωμίων*) and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers: **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** (twice), and **"The memory of the righteous"** (once); then the Psalter Kathisma of the day; the 2 Kathismata: **"When Jesus was born"** (*Τοῦ Ἰησοῦ γεννηθέντος*) and **"When he saw Thee in the streams of the Jordan"** (*Ἐν τοῖς ῥείθροις βλέψας σε τοῦ Ἰορδάνου*) twice each, and Psalm 50 [LXX] read. The Canon of the Feast: **"He uncovered the bottom of the deep"** (*Βυθοῦ ἀνεκάλυψε πυθμένα*) with the Verse: **"Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee"** (*Δόξα σοι, ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν, δόξα σοι*), and of the Forerunner: **"Being baptized"** (*Βαπτιζόμενον*) with the Verse: **"Holy forerunner of God, pray for us"** (*Ἅγιε τοῦ Θεοῦ, πρέσβευε ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν*). After the Third Ode, the Kathisma: **"The great rain"** (*Ὁ μέγας ὑετός*) and another: **"Willingly He came forth upon earth"** (*Ἑκὼν προῆλθεν ἐπὶ γῆς*); after the Sixth Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Forerunner, and the Menologion of the day; the Katavasiai are the Iambic ones only: **"The Lord, working wonders"** (*Στείβει θαλάσσης*); then the first Ode of the Ninth Ode is sung with the Megalynaria, and that of the Forerunner with the Verse: **"Holy forerunner of God, pray for us"**, and the Katavasia: **"Magnify, O my soul... units.slavonic_diplomatic: Forerunner and the Exapsalmos. At “God is the Lord”: the Apolytikia as in Vespers, then the Psalter of the day, the 2 Kathismata “When Jesus was born” and “When the great Forerunner saw You in the water of Jordan” twice each, and Psalm 50 read. The Canon of the Feast “He discovered the bottom of the depth of the sea” with the Verse “Glory to You, O God,” and of the Forerunner “Being baptized” with the Verse “Saint of God, pray for us.” After the 3rd Ode, the Kathismata “The mighty rain” and “Of His own will has God”; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Forerunner and the Minologion. The Katavasie (only the Iambic); then is sung the 9th
units.english_cohort_translation: 7.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Antiphons of the Feast as yesterday. Introit: **"Blessed is He that comes in the name of the Lord"** (*Εὐλογημένος ὁ ἐρχόμενος*). Dismissal Troparia: **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"**, **"The memory of the righteous"** [the Dismissal Troparion of the Holy Patron of the Temple is omitted here in the text of Violakis, but is explicitly prescribed in § 39 of the Protheoria, and this omission is noted in the official Diptycha editions of 1980, 1987, 1990, 1992, and 1993], and the Kontakion: **"Thou hast appeared today to the universe"** (*Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον*); instead of the Trisagion Hymn: **"All of you who have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ. Alleluia"** (*Ὅσοι εἰς Χριστὸν ἐβαπτίσθητε, Χριστὸν ἐνεδύσασθε. Ἀλληλούϊα*, Galatians 3:27); the Epistle [Acts 19:1–8] and the Gospel [John 1:29–34] of the Forerunner. At **"Especially"**: **"Magnify, O my soul... O the marvels surpassing understanding"** (*Μεγάλυνον ἡ ψυχή μου... Ὦ τῶν ὑπὲρ νοῦν*). Communion Verse: **"The righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance"** (*Εἰς μνημόσυνον αἰώνιον ἔσται δίκαιος*, Ps. 111:6 LXX); **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"**, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 9.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, Εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον δίς, καὶ τὸ Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ ἅπαξ, εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα καὶ τὰ τῆς ἑορτῆς ἀντὶ τῶν Θεοτοκίων [τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον]. (Ἕνεκα τυπογραφικοῦ λάθους, φαίνεται ὅτι οἱ ὕμνοι ἐν παρενθέσει παρελήφθησαν ὑπὸ τοῦ Βιολάκη εἰς τὴν παροῦσαν παράγραφον.) Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ α΄ τῆς ἑορτῆς (μετὰ τοῦ Στίχου Δόξα σοί, ὁ Θεός). Ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς, τὸ προεόρτιον Κάθισμα·
units.english_cohort_translation: 9.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς Κανών, καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ *Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος*, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον δίς, καὶ τὸ *Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ* ἅπαξ, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος, τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα καὶ τὰ τῆς ἑορτῆς ἀντὶ τῶν Θεοτοκίων [Ὁ Βιολάκης παραλείπει τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, τὴν Ὑπακοήν, τοὺς Ἀναβαθμοὺς καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον τοῦ ἤχου]. Οἱ Κανόνες, ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ α΄ τῆς ἑορτῆς μετὰ Στίχου *Δόξα σοι ὁ Θεός*· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ προεόρτιον Κάθισμα, ἀφ’ ς΄ τὸ Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον. Καταβασίαι, *Στείβει θαλάσσης*, καὶ ἡ πᾶσα τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*, Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ μεθέορτα δ΄, *Δόξα*, τὸ Ἑωθινόν, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Ὑπερευλογημένη*, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ *Σήμερον σωτηρία*.

units.slavonic_incipit: ἀπὸ ς΄, Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ
units.slavonic_diplomatic: ἀπὸ ς΄, Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον [τῆς ἡμέρας]. Αἱ Καταβασίαι Στείβει θαλάσσης καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου. Εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ μεθέορτα δ΄, Δόξα τὸ Ἑωθινόν, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία.
units.english_cohort_translation: 10.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄ καὶ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Κανόνος τῆς ἑορτῆς εἰς δ΄. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ *Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ* καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, Κοντάκιον *Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον*, ὁ Ἀπόστολος καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς μετὰ τὰ Φῶτα. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως, *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, Κοινωνικὸν *Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 10.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄ καὶ δ΄ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Κανόνος τῆς ἑορτῆς. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ, καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ. Κοντάκιον Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς μετὰ τὰ Φῶτα. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, Κοινωνικὸν Αἰνεῖτε, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.
units.english_cohort_translation: 11. units.slavonic_diplomatic: Triadic “It is meet”; then the Trisagion, the Apolytikion “When You, O
units.english_cohort_translation: 9.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon and the Triadic hymns: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion: **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"**, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion (twice), and **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** (once); the Psalter and the Amomos [Psalm 118 LXX]; the Resurrectional Kathismata and those of the Feast in place of the Theotokia [the editio princeps of Violakis inadvertently omits the Sunday Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon]. The Canons: the Resurrectional Canon and the First Canon of the Feast with the Verse: **"Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee"** (*Δόξα σοι, ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν, δόξα σοι*). After the Third Ode, the pre-festal Kathisma; after the Sixth Ode, the Resurrectional Kontakion and Ikos, and the Menologion of the day. Katavasiai: **"The Lord, working wonders"** (*Στείβει θαλάσσης*), and the entire order of the Resurrectional Morning Gospel. The Magnificat: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrectional Exapostilarion and that of the Feast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrectional Stichira and 4 of the Afterfeast; **"Glory"**: the appointed Resurrectional Eothinon Doxastikon; **"Both now and ever"**: **"Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις*); Great Doxology, and **"Today is salvation come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Lord were baptized in Jordan” and the Exapsalmos. At “God is the Lord”:
units.english_cohort_translation: 10.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Typika and the Beatitudes of the Tone for 4 troparia, and 4 from the Sixth Ode of the Canon of the Feast. After the Little Entrance: the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"**, and the Dismissal Troparion of the Holy Patron of the Temple; Kontakion: **"Thou hast appeared today to the universe"** (*Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον*); the Epistle [Ephesians 4:7–13] and the Gospel [Matthew 4:12–17] of the Sunday after the Lights. At **"Especially"**: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*). Communion Verse: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 148:1 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν*), and Dismissal.

The Apodosis of the Feast is celebrated on the following Saturday [January 14] in the same manner as the Feast itself was celebrated, omitting the Old Testament Readings at Vespers, and without the Lite, the Polyeleos, or the Gospel at Matins; at the Divine Liturgy, the Epistle [Colossians 1:3–6] and the Gospel [Luke 16:10–15] of the Saturday after the Lights are read.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 14.    Τῷ αὐτῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακόν, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ δ΄, τῆς ἑορτῆς γ΄, τοῦ Προδρόμου γ΄. Δόξα, Ἔνσαρκε λύχνε, Καὶ νῦν, Θεὸς λόγος ἐπεφάνη ἐν σαρκί. Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρὸν καὶ τὸ Μ. Προκείμενον Ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ καὶ ἐν τῇ γῇ μετὰ τῶν Στίχων αὐτοῦ. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά. Δόξα, Ὡς τοῦ πνεύματος ἐραστής, Καὶ νῦν, Δεῦτε μιμησώμεθα· τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τοῦ Προδρόμου Μνήμη δικαίου, τὸ Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.
units.english_cohort_translation: 14. Εἴσοδος, *Φῶς ἱλαρόν*, καὶ τὸ Μ. Προκείμενον *Ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ καὶ ἐν τῇ γῇ*, μετὰ τῶν Στίχων αὐτοῦ. units.slavonic_diplomatic: 15.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν καὶ τὰ [Τριαδικὰ] Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Προδρόμου καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα καὶ ἀνὰ ἓν τῆς ἑορτῆς Τοῦ Ἰησοῦ γεννηθέντος καὶ Ἐν τοῖς ῥείθροις βλέψας σε τοῦ Ἰορδάνου·
units.english_cohort_translation: 15.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς Κανών, καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Προδρόμου, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος*, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος, τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα, καὶ ἀνὰ ἓν τῆς ἑορτῆς *Τοῦ Ἰησοῦ γεννηθέντος* καὶ *Ἐν τοῖς ῥείθροις*, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ τοῦ ἤχου, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Οἱ Κανόνες, ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος, τῆς ἑορτῆς μετὰ Στίχου *Δόξα σοι ὁ Θεὸς*, καὶ τοῦ Προδρόμου μετὰ Στίχου *Ἅγιε τοῦ Θεοῦ*· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος, καὶ τὰ Καθίσματα τοῦ Προδρόμου *Ὁ μέγας ὑετὸς* καὶ *Ἑκὼν προῆλθεν ἐπὶ γῆς*· ἀφ’ ς΄ τὸ Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος τοῦ Προδρόμου καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον. units.english_cohort_translation: 14.    On that same Saturday evening: after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), 10 Stichira: 4 Resurrectional, 3 of the Feast: **"Our illumination"** (*Τὸν φωτισμὸν ἡμῶν*), and 3 of the Forerunner: **"O most praised Forerunner of Christ"** (*Πανεύφημε Πρόδρομε Χριστοῦ*); **"Glory"**: **"O torch incarnate"** (*Ἔνσαρκε λύχνε*); **"Both now and ever"**: **"God the Word appeared in the flesh"** (*Θεὸς λόγος ἐπεφάνη ἐν σαρκί*). Entrance with the censer, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Great Prokeimenon in Tone 7: **"Our God is in heaven and on earth; all things whatsoever He hath willed, He hath done"** (*Ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ καὶ ἐν τῇ γῇ, πάντα ὅσα ἠθέλησεν ἐποίησεν*, Ps. 113:11 LXX) with its verses. At the Aposticha: the Resurrectional Stichira; **"Glory"**: **"As a lover of the Spirit"** (*Ὡς τοῦ Πνεύματος ἐραστής*); **"Both now and ever"**: **"Come, let us imitate the wise virgins"** (*Δεῦτε μιμησώμεθα*); Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, that of the Forerunner: **"The memory of the righteous is celebrated with hymns of praise"** (*Μνήμη δικαίου μετ’ ἐγκωμίων*), and that of the Feast: **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** (*Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 13.    On Saturday, the Matins of the Feast, the Great Blessing of the
units.english_cohort_translation: 15.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon and the Triadic hymns: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Forerunner, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; the Psalter and the Polyeleos; the Resurrectional Kathismata, and one each of the Feast: **"When Jesus was born"** (*Τοῦ Ἰησοῦ γεννηθέντος*) and **"When he saw Thee in the streams of the Jordan"** (*Ἐν τοῖς ῥείθροις βλέψας σε τοῦ Ἰορδάνου*); the Sunday Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe of the Tone, the Anavathmoi, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: the Resurrectional Canon, the Canon of the Feast with the Verse: **"Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee"** (*Δόξα σοι, ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν, δόξα σοι*), and that of the Forerunner with the Verse: **"Holy forerunner of God, pray for us"** (*Ἅγιε τοῦ Θεοῦ, πρέσβευε ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν*). After the Third Ode: the Resurrectional Kontakion and Ikos, and the Kathismata of the Forerunner: **"The great rain"** (*Ὁ μέγας ὑετός*) and **"Willingly He came forth upon earth"** (*Ἑκὼν προῆλθεν ἐπὶ γῆς*); after the Sixth Ode: the Kontakion and Ikos of the Forerunner, and the Menologion of the day. Katavasiai: **"The Lord, working wonders"** (*Στείβει θαλάσσης*), and the Resurrectional Morning Gospel; then the Ninth Ode is sung with the Megalynaria of the Feast: **"Every tongue is at a loss to praise Thee worthily"** (*Ἀπορεῖ πᾶσα γλῶσσα*), and that of the Forerunner with the Verse: **"Holy forerunner of God, pray for us"**...[^227]

At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; the Psalter and the Polyeleos; the Resurrectional Kathismata, and one each of the Feast: **"When Jesus was born"** (*Τοῦ Ἰησοῦ γεννηθέντος*) and **"When he saw Thee in the streams of the Jordan"** (*Ἐν τοῖς ῥείθροις βλέψας σε τοῦ Ἰορδάνου*); the Sunday Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe of the Tone, the Anavathmoi, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: the Resurrectional Canon, the Canon of the Feast with the Verse: **"Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee"** (*Δόξα σοι, ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν, δόξα σοι*), and that of the Forerunner with the Verse: **"Holy forerunner of God, pray for us"** (*Ἅγιε τοῦ Θεοῦ, πρέσβευε ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν*). After the Third Ode: the Resurrectional Kontakion and Ikos, and the Kathismata of the Forerunner: **"The great rain"** (*Ὁ μέγας ὑετός*) and **"Willingly He came forth upon earth"** (*Ἑκὼν προῆλθεν ἐπὶ γῆς*); after the Sixth Ode: the Kontakion and Ikos of the Forerunner, and the Menologion of the day. Katavasiai: **"The Lord, working wonders"** (*Στείβει θαλάσσης*), and the Resurrectional Morning Gospel; then the Ninth Ode is sung with the Megalynaria of the Feast: **"Every tongue is at a loss to praise Thee worthily"** (*Ἀπορεῖ πᾶσα γλῶσσα*), and that of the Forerunner with the Verse: **"Holy forerunner of God, pray for us"**...[^227]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 16.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν τὰ Ἀντίφωνα τῆς ἑορτῆς ὡς χθές· εἰς τὸ δεύτερον Σῶσον ἡμᾶς . . . ὁ ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ ὑπὸ Ἰωάννου . . . Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν . . . ὁ ἀναστὰς ἐκ νεκρῶν, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τοῦ Προδρόμου καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς. [Τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ παραλείπεται εἰς §15, σελ. 149 τοῦ Τυπικοῦ. Παρουσιάζεται ὅμως εἰς §9, σελ. 33 τῆς Προθεωρίας].
units.english_cohort_translation: 16.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Ἀντίφωνα τῆς ἑορτῆς ὡς χθές, μετὰ τοῦ Στίχου τοῦ β΄ Ἀντιφώνου *Ὁ ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*. Εἰσοδικὸν *Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν . . . ὁ ἀναστὰς ἐκ νεκρῶν*. Ἀπολυτίκια, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τοῦ Προδρόμου *Μνήμη δικαίου* καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς *Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ* [τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ παραλείπεται ἐδῶ· βλέπε § 39 τῆς Προθεωρίας], Κοντάκιον *Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον*, ἀντὶ τοῦ Τρισαγίου *Ὅσοι εἰς Χριστὸν*, ὁ Ἀπόστολος καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Προδρόμου. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως, *Μεγάλυνον ψυχή μου . . . Ὦ τῶν ὑπὲρ νοῦν*. Κοινωνικὸν *Εἰς μνημόσυνον αἰώνιον*, τὸ *Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 17.    Ἡ Ἀπόδοσις τῆς ἑορτῆς συμπίπτει κατὰ τὴν περίπτωσιν ταύτην τῇ Κυριακῇ τῆς προσεχοῦς ἑβδομάδος (ΙΔ΄ τοῦ μηνός)· ἡ δὲ Ἀκολουθία ψάλλεται ὡς ἑξῆς· Τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακόν, καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ δ΄ καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς Τὸν φωτισμὸν ἡμῶν ς΄. Δόξα, Ὑπέκλινας κάραν, Καὶ νῦν τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά. Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Τὸν ἐκ Παρθένου ἥλιον, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς δὶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.
units.english_cohort_translation: 18.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς Κανών, καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ *Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. At the Praises: 4 Resurrectional Stichira and 4 of the Feast: **"Light from Light"** (*Φῶς ἐκ φωτός*); **"Glory"**: **"An angel from barren pangs"** (*Ἄγγελος ἐκ στειρωτικῶν ὠδίνων*); **"Both now and ever"**: **"Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις*); Great Doxology, and **"Today is salvation come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, that of the Forerunner: **"The memory of the righteous is celebrated with hymns of praise"** (*Μνήμη δικαίου μετ’ ἐγκωμίων*), and that of the Feast: **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** (*Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*) [the Dismissal Troparion of the Holy Patron of the Temple is omitted here in Violakis, but see § 39 of the Protheoria]; Kontakion: **"Thou hast appeared today to the universe"** (*Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον*); instead of the Trisagion Hymn: **"All of you who have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ. Alleluia"** (*Ὅσοι εἰς Χριστὸν ἐβαπτίσθητε, Χριστὸν ἐνεδύσασθε. Ἀλληλούϊα*, Galatians 3:27); the Epistle [Acts 19:1–8] and the Gospel [John 1:29–34] of the Forerunner. At **"Especially"**: **"Magnify, O my soul... O the marvels surpassing understanding"** (*Μεγάλυνον ψυχή μου... Ὦ τῶν ὑπὲρ νοῦν*). Communion Verse: **"The righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance"** (*Εἰς μνημόσυνον αἰώνιον ἔσται δίκαιος*, Ps. 111:6 LXX); **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"**, and Dismissal.

units.english_cohort_translation: 17.    The Apodosis of the Feast is celebrated on the following Sunday (January 14). On Saturday evening: after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and Kathisma 1 of the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), 4 Resurrectional Stichira and 6 of the Feast: **"Our illumination"** (*Τὸν φωτισμὸν ἡμῶν*); **"Glory"**: **"Thou hast bowed Thy head unto the Forerunner"** (*Ὑπέκλινας κάραν τῷ Προδρόμῳ*); **"Both now and ever"**: the first Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with the censer, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon of the day: **"The Lord is King, He is clothed with majesty"** (*Ὁ Κύριος ἐβασίλευσεν*, Ps. 92:1 LXX). At the Aposticha: the Resurrectional Stichira; **"Glory... Both now and ever..."**: **"The Sun born of a virgin"** (*Τὸν ἐκ Παρθένου ἥλιον*); Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, and that of the Feast: **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** (twice), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_incipit: Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ οἱ
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ οἱ δύο τῆς ἑορτῆς μετὰ Στίχου Δόξα σοι ὁ Θεός· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς ἡ Ὑπακοὴ τῆς ἑορτῆς Ὅτε τῇ ἐπιφανείᾳ σου· ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων τῆς ἡμέρας· αἱ Καταβασίαι διπλαῖ καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα ψάλλονται καὶ οἱ δύο τῆς θ΄ Ὠδῆς Κανόνες μετὰ τῶν Μεγαλυναρίων, Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς δίς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς Φῶς ἐκ φωτὸς δ΄. Δόξα, Νάματα Ἰορδάνεια, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία.
units.english_cohort_translation: οἱ Κανόνες, ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ἀμφότεροι τῆς ἑορτῆς μετὰ Στίχου *Δόξα σοι ὁ Θεὸς*· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς ἡ Ὑπακοὴ τῆς ἑορτῆς *Ὅτε τῇ ἐπιφανείᾳ σου*, ἀφ’ ς΄ τὸ Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον. Καταβασίαι διπλαῖ, καὶ τὸ Ἑωθινὸν Εὐαγγέλιον, αἱ Θ΄ Ὠδαὶ ἀμφοτέρων τῶν Κανόνων μετὰ τῶν Μεγαλυναρίων, Ἐξαποστειλάρια, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς δίς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς *Φῶς ἐκ φωτὸς* δ΄, *Δόξα*, *Νάματα Ἰορδάνεια*, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Ὑπερευλογημένη*, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ *Σήμερον σωτηρία*.
units.slavonic_text: Προκείμενον. units.slavonic_diplomatic: Resurrection, and the Minologion of the Saints of the day Both [double]
units.english_cohort_translation: ...The Canons: the Resurrectional Canon and both Canons of the Feast with the Verse: **"Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee"** (*Δόξα σοι, ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν, δόξα σοι*). After the Third Ode, the Hypakoe of the Feast: **"When at Thy manifestation"** (*Ὅτε τῇ ἐπιφανείᾳ σου*); after the Sixth Ode, the Resurrectional Kontakion and Ikos, and the Menologion of the day. Both double Katavasiai: **"He uncovered the bottom of the deep"** (*Βυθοῦ ἀνεκάλυψε πυθμένα*) and **"The Lord, working wonders"** (*Στείβει θαλάσσης*), and the Resurrectional Morning Gospel; the Ninth Odes of both Canons are sung with their Megalynaria. Exapostilaria: the Resurrectional Exapostilarion and that of the Feast (twice). At the Praises: 4 Resurrectional Stichira and 4 of the Feast: **"Light from Light"** (*Φῶς ἐκ φωτός*); **"Glory"**: **"O Savior, Who clothedst Thyself with the waters of Jordan"** (*Νάματα Ἰορδάνεια*); **"Both now and ever"**: **"Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις*); Great Doxology, and **"Today is salvation come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Katavasie, and the entire order of the Morning Gospel. Then we sing the 9th
units.english_cohort_translation: 19.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Antiphons of the Feast as in § 16, with the verse of the Second Antiphon: **"Who wast baptized by John in the Jordan"** (*Ὁ ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*). Introit of the Feast with **"Who art risen from the dead"** (*Ὁ ἀναστὰς ἐκ νεκρῶν*). Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, and that of the Feast: **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** [the Dismissal Troparion of the Holy Patron of the Temple is omitted here in Violakis, but see § 39 of the Protheoria]; Kontakion: **"Thou hast appeared today to the universe"** (*Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον*); the Trisagion Hymn; the Epistle [Ephesians 4:7–13] and the Gospel [Matthew 4:12–17] of the Sunday after the Lights (since on the preceding Sunday the lections of the Forerunner were proclaimed). At **"Especially"**: **"Magnify, O my soul... O the marvels surpassing understanding"** (*Μεγάλυνον ψυχή μου... Ὦ τῶν ὑπὲρ νοῦν*). Communion Verse: **"The grace of God that brings salvation hath appeared unto all men"** (*Ἐπεφάνη ἡ χάρις τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡ σωτήριος πᾶσιν ἀνθρώποις*, Titus 2:11); **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"**, and Dismissal.

units.english_cohort_translation: 20.    On Friday morning: only the Great Hours are chanted, with the Troparion: **"Make ready, O Zebulun"** (*Ἑτοιμάζου Ζαβουλών*) and the Kontakion: **"Today the Lord hath appeared in the streams of the Jordan"** (*Ἐν τοῖς ῥείθροις σήμερον*); after the Prayer of the Ninth Hour, the Dismissal takes place. At table, dispensation for all foods [without fasting] is observed, because the strict fast of the Paramony is transferred to Saturday.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 19.    In the Liturgy, the Antiphons of the Feast; at the second Antiphon “Save us . . . Who were baptized by John in Jordan.” The Entrance Hymn of the Feast with “Who is risen from the dead.” The Resurrection
units.english_cohort_translation: 21.    On that same Friday evening: Forefeast Vespers is sung according to the Menaion; after **"Lord, now lettest Thou Thy servant depart"** (*Νῦν ἀπολύεις*, Luke 2:29–32), the Canon is sung, and after the Ninth Ode, the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion: **"The river Jordan once turned back"** (*Ἀπεστρέφετό ποτε*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 23.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοί, Τροπάρια ἐκ τῆς γ΄ καὶ ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ προεορτίου Κανόνος. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν . . . ὁ ἐν Ἁγίοις θαυμαστός, τὸ Προεόρτιον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ καὶ Κοντάκιον Ἐν τοῖς ῥείθροις σήμερον, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Σαββάτου πρὸ τῶν Φώτων.
units.english_cohort_translation: ἀναγινώσκονται χῦμα τὰ Καθίσματα, ὁ Προεόρτιος Κανὼν καὶ ὁ τῶν Ἁγίων τῆς ἡμέρας. Εἶτα ψάλλονται αἱ Καταβασίαι *Βυθοῦ ἀνεκάληψε πυθμένα* [ἀνεκάληψε *sic*], καὶ ἀκολούθως στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν* καὶ τὸ Προεόρτιον Ἐξαποστειλάριον δίς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τὰ δ΄ τῆς ἡμέρας Προσόμοια *Τί ἀμφιγνοεῖς Βαπτιστὰ οἰκονομίαν;* *Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν*, *Ἰωάννη Βαπτιστα* (ζήτει εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τῶν Αἴνων), Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον *Ἀπεστρέφετό ποτε*.

units.slavonic_incipit: Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως, Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, Κοινωνικὸν
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως, Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, Κοινωνικὸν τῆς ἡμέρας, καὶ τὸ Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς. Μετὰ τὸ Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου, ψάλλονται τὰ Ἰδιόμελα τοῦ Ἁγιασμοῦ Φωνὴ Κυρίου ἐπὶ τῶν ὑδάτων κτλ. καὶ τελεῖται ὁ Ἁγιασμὸς κατὰ τὴν ἐν τῷ Μηναίῳ διάταξιν. Ἐν τῇ τραπέζῃ κατάλυσις οἴνου καὶ ἐλαίου.
units.english_cohort_translation: 23.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοί, Τροπάρια ἐκ τῆς γ΄ καὶ ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ προεορτίου Κανόνος. units.slavonic_diplomatic: 23.    In the Liturgy, the Typika and the Beatitudes, hymns from the 3rd and 6th Ode of the Canon of the Pre-feast. After the Entrance, "Come let us worship... who are wonderful in Your Saints." The Apolytikion of the Pre- feast, the Apolytikion of the Saint of the Church and the Kontakion "Today has the Lord appeared on the waters of Jordan," Apostolos and Gospel of the Saturday before Epiphany. At "Especially," "It is meet," Communion
units.english_cohort_translation: 23.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Typika and the Beatitudes, with troparia from the Third and Sixth Odes of the Forefeast Canon. After the Little Entrance: **"Come, let us worship and bow down before Christ. Save us, O Son of God, Who art wonderful in Thy saints..."** (*Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν . . . ὁ ἐν ἁγίοις θαυμαστός*); the Forefeast Dismissal Troparion, that of the Holy Patron of the Temple, and the Kontakion: **"Today the Lord hath appeared in the streams of the Jordan"** (*Ἐν τοῖς ῥείθροις σήμερον*); the Epistle [1 Timothy 3:14–4:5] and the Gospel [Matthew 3:1–11] of the Saturday before the Lights [Epiphany]. At **"Especially"**: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); the Communion Verse of the day, and **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν*). After **"Blessed be the name of the Lord"** (*Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου*), the Idiomela of the Blessing of the Waters are sung: **"The voice of the Lord is upon the waters"** (*Φωνὴ Κυρίου ἐπὶ τῶν ὑδάτων*), etc., and the Blessing of the Waters is performed according to the order in the Menaion. At table, dispensation for wine and oil is permitted.

units.english_cohort_translation: 24.    On that same Saturday evening: Great Vespers of the Feast is chanted, in which we chant nothing of the Resurrection, but all of the Feast as follows: after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant the Idiomela: **"Our illumination"** (*Τὸν φωτισμὸν ἡμῶν*) for 6 stichira [repeating the first two]; **"Glory... Both now and ever..."**: **"Thou didst bow Thy head to the Forerunner"** (*Ὑπέκλινας κάραν τῷ Προδρόμῳ*). Entrance with the Gospel Book, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Old Testament Readings with their Troparia and their verses; the Epistle, the Gospel, and the rest, as appointed in Situation One, § 2. At the Aposticha: the Idiomela: **"When John saw Thee in the river Jordan, O Christ God"** (*Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ ποταμῷ ἰδών σε ὁ Ἰωάννης*) and the other two; **"Glory... Both now and ever..."**: **"The Sun born of a Virgin"** (*Τὸν ἐκ Παρθένου ἥλιον*); **"Lord, now lettest Thou Thy servant depart"** (*Νῦν ἀπολύεις*, Luke 2:29–32); the Trisagion Prayers; the Dismissal Troparion: **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** (*Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*) thrice, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 28.    Ἡ Ἀπόδοσις συμπίπτει τῇ ἐπιούσῃ ἡμέρᾳ Δευτέρᾳ (ΙΔ΄ τοῦ μηνός), ἐν ᾗ ψάλλονται ἅπαντα τὰ τῆς ἑορτῆς, ὡς προδιετάχθη ἐν περιπτώσει Α΄ § 11. Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον λέγονται τῆς ἡμέρας, Κοινωνικὸν Ἐπεφάνη ἡ χάρις, Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.english_cohort_translation: **The Apodosis** 28.    The Apodosis falls on the following day, Monday (the 14th of the month), on which all the services of the Feast are chanted, as previously appointed in Situation One, § 11. The Epistle and the Gospel of the day are read; Communion Verse: **"The grace of God that brings salvation hath appeared unto all men"** (*Ἐπεφάνη ἡ χάρις τοῦ Θεοῦ*, Titus 2:11); **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** (*Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*), and Dismissal.

units.english_cohort_translation: 29.    If the Feast of Holy Theophany falls on a Monday: on Friday morning (the 3rd of the month), after the appointed Matins office, only the Great Royal Hours are chanted, and the Troparion: **"Make ready, O Zebulun"** (*Ἑτοιμάζου Ζαβουλών*) and the Kontakion: **"Today the Lord hath appeared in the streams of the Jordan"** (*Ἐν τοῖς ῥείθροις σήμερον*) are said; after the Prayer of the Ninth Hour, the Dismissal takes place.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 32.    On Saturday evening and Sunday morning, the Service of the
units.english_cohort_translation: 31.    On Saturday at Matins: after the Midnight Service, etc., at **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*), the Dismissal Troparion: **"Make ready, O Zebulun"** (twice); Canons: the Forefeast Canon: **"Traversing the deep on foot as on dry land"** (*Ὡς ἐν ἠπείρῳ πεζεύσας*) and that of the Seventy Apostles: **"Having been discipled unto Christ"** (*Χριστῷ μαθητεύσαντες*, seek on the 4th of the month); after the Sixth Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Forefeast, and the Menologion of the Saints of the day; then the Heirmos of the Eighth Ode, and we recite the Magnificat: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilarion of the Seventy Apostles: **"Having forsaken the world"** (*Καταλιπόντες κόσμον*) and the Forefeast Exapostilarion: **"Begotten timelessly of the Father"** (*Ὁ ἐκ Πατρὸς ἀχρόνως*); at the Praises: **"To Thee belongs glory"** (*Σοὶ δόξα πρέπει*), and the Aposticha. At the Divine Liturgy: the Epistle [1 Timothy 3:14–4:5] and the Gospel [Matthew 3:1–11] of the Saturday before the Lights [Epiphany]; Communion Verse: **"Blessed are they whom Thou hast chosen and taken unto Thyself, O Lord"** (*Μακάριοι οὓς ἐξελέξω καὶ προσελάβου, Κύριε*, Ps. 64:5 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Sunday before Epiphany is sung together with the Liturgy of Chrysostom and the Blessing of the Waters, as prescribed in Situation Two, Paragraphs 4, 5, 6. At table, wine and oil are permitted.
units.english_cohort_translation: 32.    On Saturday evening and Sunday morning: the office of the Sunday before the Lights [Epiphany] is chanted, together with the Divine Liturgy of Saint John Chrysostom and the Blessing of the Waters, as formulated in Situation Two, § 4, 5, and 6. At table, dispensation for wine and oil is permitted.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 39.    Εἰ τύχοι τῇ Κυριακῇ μετὰ τὰ Φῶτα, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ δ΄, μεθέορτα γ΄ Εἶδες πῶς περίκειμαι καὶ τοῦ Ὁσίου γ΄, Δόξα μεθέορτον, Καὶ νῦν τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τοῦ Ὁσίου. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, Δόξα τοῦ Ὁσίου, Καὶ νῦν μεθέορτον· τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τοῦ Ὁσίου, τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 40.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος· τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα καὶ τὰ τῆς ἑορτῆς, ἀντὶ Θεοτοκίων· εἰς δὲ τὴν γ΄ Στιχολογίαν τὸ τοῦ Ὁσίου καὶ τὸ μεθέορτον· τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ τοῦ ἤχου, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος, ὁ τῆς ἑορτῆς, καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ὁσίου· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κάθισμα τοῦ Ὁσίου καὶ μεθέορτον, ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων τῆς ἡμέρας· αἱ Καταβασίαι Στείβει θαλάσσης καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἐξαποστειλάριον τοῦ Ὁσίου καὶ τὸ μεθέορτον Βαβαὶ τῶν θείων ἔργων σου. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ μεθέορτα δ΄ (ὅπου δ’ ἐπισημότερον ἑορτάζεται ὁ Ὅσιος, λέγονται ἀντὶ τῶν μεθεόρτων οἱ Αἶνοι τοῦ Ἁγίου εἰς δ΄). Δόξα τὸ Ἑωθινόν, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία.

Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος, ὁ τῆς ἑορτῆς, καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ὁσίου· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κάθισμα τοῦ Ὁσίου καὶ μεθέορτον, ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων τῆς ἡμέρας· αἱ Καταβασίαι *Στείβει θαλάσσης* καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἐξαποστειλάριον τοῦ Ὁσίου καὶ τὸ μεθέορτον *Βαβαὶ τῶν θείων ἔργων σου*. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ μεθέορτα δ΄ (ὅπου δ’ ἐπισημότερον ἑορτάζεται ὁ Ὅσιος, λέγονται ἀντὶ τῶν μεθεόρτων οἱ Αἶνοι τοῦ Ἁγίου εἰς δ΄). *Δόξα* τὸ Ἑωθινόν, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Ὑπερευλογημένη*, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ *Σήμερον σωτηρία*.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 41.    In the Liturgy, the Typika and 4 Beatitudes of the Mode and 4 hymns from the 6th Ode of the Canon of the Feast. After the Entrance, the
units.english_cohort_translation: 40.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon and the Triadic hymns: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion: **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** (*Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*), and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; then the Psalter and the Amomos [Psalm 118 LXX]; the Resurrectional Kathismata and those of the Feast in place of the Theotokia; at the third Stichologia [Stasis], the Kathisma of the Righteous Saint and that of the Afterfeast; the Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe of the Tone, the Anavathmoi, and the Prokeimenon. Canons: the Resurrectional Canon, that of the Feast, and that of the Righteous Saint; after the Third Ode, the Kathisma of the Righteous Saint and that of the Afterfeast; after the Sixth Ode, the Resurrectional Kontakion and Ikos, and the Menologion of the Saints of the day; Katavasiai: **"The Lord, working wonders"** (*Στείβει θαλάσσης*), and the entire order of the Resurrectional Morning Gospel; then we recite the Magnificat: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*); the Resurrectional Exapostilarion, that of the Righteous Saint, and that of the Afterfeast: **"O the wonder of Thy divine works!"** (*Βαβαὶ τῶν θείων ἔργων σου*). At the Praises: 4 Resurrectional Stichira and 4 of the Afterfeast (where the Righteous Saint is celebrated with greater solemnity, instead of the afterfeast stichira, the 4 Praises of the Saint are chanted); **"Glory"**: the appointed Resurrectional Eothinon Doxastikon; **"Both now and ever"**: **"Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις*); Great Doxology, and **"Today is salvation come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Apolytikia of the Resurrection, of the Feast, of the Righteous Saint and of the Saint of the Church, Kontakion "You have appeared today." Apostolos of the Righteous Saint and Gospel of the Sunday after Epiphany. At "Especially," "It is meet," Communion Hymn "Praise [the Lord]," "We have seen the [true] light," and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 41.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Typika and the Beatitudes of the Tone for 4 troparia, and 4 from the Sixth Ode of the Canon of the Feast; after the Little Entrance: the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, that of the Feast, that of the Righteous Saint, and that of the Holy Patron of the Temple; Kontakion: **"Thou hast appeared today to the universe"** (*Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον*); the Epistle of the Righteous Saint [2 Corinthians 4:6–15] and the Gospel of the Sunday after the Lights [Epiphany, Matthew 4:12–17]. At **"Especially"**: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Verse: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 148:1 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν*), and Dismissal.[^233]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Σημ. Δεῖ γινώσκειν ὅτι τὸ Ἅγιον Πάσχα κατέρχεται μέχρι τῆς ΚΒ΄ τοῦ Μαρτίου μηνός, καὶ ἀνέρχεται μέχρι τῆς ΚΔ΄ τοῦ Ἀπριλίου, ἑπομένως καὶ τὸ Τριῴδιον ἄρχεται κατὰ μὲν τὴν πρώτην περίστασιν, τῇ ΙΑ΄ Ἰανουαρίου, κατὰ δὲ τὴν δευτέραν, τῇ ΙΓ΄ Φεβρουαρίου. Περὶ τούτου ὅρα τὸν Ἑορτοδρόμιον Πίνακα.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 43.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ· εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος· τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα μετὰ τῶν μεθεόρτων ἀντὶ Θεοτοκίων, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ τοῦ ἤχου, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ τοῦ Τριῳδίου μετὰ Στίχου Δόξα σοι ὁ Θεὸς καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ὁσίου· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῆς Ὀκτωήχου, εἶτα Κάθισμα τοῦ Ὁσίου καὶ τοῦ Τριῳδίου· ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων τῆς ἡμέρας, καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τοῦ Τριῳδίου· αἱ Καταβασίαι Στείβει θαλάσσης, εἶτα τὸ Πᾶσα πνοὴ καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ὄρθρου, τὸ Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ, καὶ ψάλλεται ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμός, Δόξα, Τῆς μετανοίας ἄνοιξόν μοι καὶ τὰ λοιπὰ δύο Τροπάρια, τὸ Σῶσον ὁ Θεὸς τὸν λαόν σου καὶ ἀκολούθως στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν. Ἐξαποστειλάρια, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τὸ τοῦ Ὁσίου καὶ τὸ τοῦ Τριῳδίου. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ μεθέορτα δ΄ (ἐκτὸς ἂν ἐπισήμως ἑορτάζηται ὁ Ἅγιος, ὅτε καὶ λέγονται ἀντὶ τῶν μεθεόρτων Αἶνοι ἐκ τοῦ Ἁγίου). Δόξα τοῦ Τριῳ- δίου, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία.

Καθίσματα μετὰ τῶν μεθεόρτων ἀντὶ Θεοτοκίων, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ
Ὑπακοὴ τοῦ ἤχου, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ
Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ τοῦ Τριῳδίου μετὰ Στίχου Δόξα σοι ὁ Θεὸς καὶ
ὁ τοῦ Ὁσίου· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῆς Ὀκτωήχου, εἶτα
Κάθισμα τοῦ Ὁσίου καὶ τοῦ Τριῳδίου· ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος
τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων τῆς ἡμέρας, καὶ τὸ
Ὑπόμνημα τοῦ Τριῳδίου· αἱ Καταβασίαι Στείβει θαλάσσης, εἶτα τὸ
Πᾶσα πνοὴ καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ὄρθρου, τὸ Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ,

units.english_cohort_translation: 42.    If the period of the Lenten Triodion begins on January 11 and this coincides with the Sunday after the Lights [Epiphany], the office is chanted as follows: at Vespers on Saturday evening, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and Kathisma 1 of the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant 10 Stichira: 4 Resurrectional, 3 of the Triodion, and 3 of our Righteous Father Theodosios; **"Glory"**: **"Almighty Lord"** (*Παντοκράτορ Κύριε*); **"Both now and ever"**: the first Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with the censer, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon of the day, and the Old Testament Readings of the Righteous Saint. At the Aposticha: the Resurrectional Stichira; **"Glory"**: of the Righteous Saint; **"Both now and ever"**: of the Triodion; Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, that of the Righteous Saint, that of the Feast, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Stichira, Glory of the Righteous Saint, Now and ever of the Triodion. The
units.english_cohort_translation: 43.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon and the Triadic hymns: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion: **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** (*Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*), and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; then the Psalter and the Amomos [Psalm 118 LXX]; the Resurrectional Kathismata with those of the Afterfeast in place of the Theotokia; the Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe of the Tone, the Anavathmoi, and the Prokeimenon. Canons: the Resurrectional Canon and that of the Triodion with the Verse: **"Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee"** (*Δόξα σοι, ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν, δόξα σοι*), and that of the Righteous Saint; after the Third Ode, the Resurrectional Kontakion and Ikos of the Octoechos, then the Kathisma of the Righteous Saint and that of the Triodion; after the Sixth Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Triodion, the Menologion of the Saints of the day, and the Synaxarion / Commentary [Hypomnema] of the Triodion; Katavasiai: **"The Lord, working wonders"** (*Στείβει θαλάσσης*); then **"Let every breath"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*) and the Resurrectional Morning Gospel; **"Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ"** (*Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ θεασάμενοι*); and Psalm 50 [LXX] is chanted; **"Glory"**: **"Open to me the doors of repentance, O Giver of Life"** (*Τῆς μετανοίας ἄνοιξόν μοι πύλας, Ζωοδότα*) and the remaining two penitential troparia [**"Guide me in the paths of salvation"** and **"As I ponder the multitude of evil deeds"**]; the litany: **"Save, O God, Thy people"** (*Σῶσον, ὁ Θεός, τὸν λαόν σου*); and following this we recite the Magnificat: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrectional Exapostilarion, that of the Righteous Saint, and that of the Triodion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrectional Stichira and 4 of the Afterfeast (unless the Righteous Saint is celebrated with greater solemnity, when the Praises of the Saint are chanted instead of the afterfeast stichira); **"Glory"**: of the Triodion; **"Both now and ever"**: **"Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις*); Great Doxology, and **"Today is salvation come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon and the Triadic hymns: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion: **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** (*Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*), and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; then the Psalter and the Amomos [Psalm 118 LXX]; the Resurrectional Kathismata with those of the Afterfeast in place of the Theotokia; the Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe of the Tone, the Anavathmoi, and the Prokeimenon. Canons: the Resurrectional Canon and that of the Triodion with the Verse: **"Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee"** (*Δόξα σοι, ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν, δόξα σοι*), and that of the Righteous Saint; after the Third Ode, the Resurrectional Kontakion and Ikos of the Octoechos, then the Kathisma of the Righteous Saint and that of the Triodion; after the Sixth Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Triodion, the Menologion of the Saints of the day, and the Synaxarion / Commentary [Hypomnema] of the Triodion; Katavasiai: **"The Lord, working wonders"** (*Στείβει θαλάσσης*); then **"Let every breath"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*) and the Resurrectional Mornin

units.slavonic_diplomatic: εἰς δ΄ καὶ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Κανόνος τοῦ Τριῳδίου δ΄. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ τοῦ Ὁσίου καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, Κοντάκιον Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον, ὁ Ἀπόστολος τῆς Κυριακῆς μετὰ τὰ Φῶτα καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Τελώνου καὶ Φαρισαίου. units.slavonic_diplomatic: 45.    Εἰ τύχοι ἄρχεσθαι τὸ Τριῴδιον τῇ ΙΒ΄ ἢ τῇ ΙΓ΄ τοῦ μηνός, ἡ Ἀκολουθία τῆς Κυριακῆς μετὰ τὰ Φῶτα καὶ ἡ τοῦ Τριῳδίου ψάλλονται ὡς ἐφεξῆς· Τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ δ΄, τοῦ Τριῳδίου γ΄ καὶ μεθέορτα γ΄ Ὕμνον νῦν μεθέορτον (ὅρα 12 Ἰανουαρίου), Δόξα τοῦ Τριῳδίου, Καὶ νῦν τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου, Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρὸν καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, Δόξα τοῦ Τριῳδίου, Καὶ νῦν μεθέορτον Ὁρῶσά σε ἡ φύσις ἅπασα, (ὅρα Δοξαστικὸν τῶν Ἀποστίχων Ἑσπερινοῦ τῆς 12ης Ἰανουαρίου), τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.english_cohort_translation: 45.    If the Triodion begins on January 12 or 13, the office of the Sunday after the Lights and that of the Triodion are chanted as follows: On Saturday evening, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the Psalter [Kathisma 1], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant 4 Resurrectional Stichira, 3 of the Triodion, and 3 Afterfeast stichira: **"Now let us sing an afterfeast hymn"** (*Ὕμνον νῦν μεθέορτον*, see January 12); **"Glory..."**: of the Triodion; **"Both now and ever..."**: the first Theotokion of the Tone; Entrance with censer, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon of the day. At the Aposticha: the Resurrectional Stichira; **"Glory..."**: of the Triodion; **"Both now and ever..."**: Afterfeast stichiron: **"All creation beholding Thee"** (*Ὁρῶσά σε ἡ φύσις ἅπασα*, see the Doxastikon of the Aposticha at Vespers on January 12); the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, that of the Feast, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_incipit: Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode and the Prokimenon.
units.english_cohort_translation: 46.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon and the Triadic hymns **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** (*Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*), and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion twice, and **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** once; then the Psalter and the Amomos [Psalm 118 LXX]; the Resurrectional Kathismata with the afterfeast hymns in place of Theotokia; the Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. Canons: the Resurrectional Canon, that of the Triodion, and that of the Feast; after the Third Ode, the Resurrectional Kontakion with its Ikos, and the Kathisma of the Triodion and the Afterfeast; after the Sixth Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Triodion, the Menologion of the Saints of the day, and the Commentary [Synaxarion] of the Triodion; the Katavasiai: **"The Lord traversing the deep"** (*Στείβει θαλάσσης*), and the entire order of the Morning Gospel appointed for the Sundays of the Triodion (see the order in § 43); then we recite the Magnificat: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrectional Exapostilarion, that of the Triodion, and that of the Feast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrectional Stichira and 4 Afterfeast stichira; **"Glory..."**: **"By boasting of works"** (*Ταῖς ἐξ ἔργων καυχήσεσι*); **"Both now and ever..."**: **"Most blessed art thou"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις*); Great Doxology, and **"Today salvation is come unto the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

units.english_cohort_translation: 48.    If the Triodion begins on the 14th of the month, the Apodosis of the Feast is anticipated and chanted on Saturday the 13th; the Epistle and Gospel of the Saturday after the Lights are read; and the office of the Sunday of the Publican and the Pharisee, together with the Sunday Resurrectional hymns, is chanted according to custom (see Note 2 in Situation Two, § 16).

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 3.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανών, ἡ Λιτὴ τοῦ Ὁσίου καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ὁσίου καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα κατὰ σειράν, καὶ τὰ τῆς γ΄ Στιχολογίας τοῦ Ὁσίου μετὰ τοῦ Θεοτοκίου· τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ὁσίου· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κοντάκιον καὶ τὸ Κάθισμα τοῦ Ὁσίου, καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον, ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα, καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον· αἱ Καταβασίαι Χέρσον ἀβυσσοτόκον καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν. Ἐξαποστειλάρια, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τὸ τοῦ Ὁσίου καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τοῦ Ὁσίου

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Entrance, "O Gladsome Light," the Prokimenon and the Readings. At the
units.english_cohort_translation: 2.    If it falls on Sunday: on Saturday evening, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the Psalter [Kathisma 1], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant 6 Resurrectional Stichira and 4 of the Righteous Saint; **"Glory..."**: of the Righteous Saint; **"Both now and ever..."**: the first Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with censer, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Readings of the Saint [Wisdom 3:1–9; Wisdom 5:15–6:3; Wisdom 4:7–15]. At the Aposticha: the Resurrectional Stichira; **"Glory..."**: of the Righteous Saint; **"Both now and ever..."**: **"O Virgin Unwedded"** (*Ἀνύμφευτε Παρθένε*); the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, that of the Righteous Saint: **"Emulating the zealous Elijah in thy ways"** (*Ζηλωτὴν Ἠλίαν*), the Theotokion, and Dismissal.
