units.slavonic_diplomatic: 3.    On Thursday evening after the Introductory Psalm, at "Lord, I have cried," we sing the 3 Prosomia Stichira "The eternal will" (twice each), Glory, Now and ever, "Sent from heaven." Entrance, "O Gladsome Light," the Prokimenon of the day and the Readings. At the Aposticha: the 3 Idiomela "In the sixth month," Glory, Now and ever, "Today marks the crowning of our salvation" (three times), and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: **Great Vespers** 3.    On Thursday evening [Eve of the Feast], after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing the 3 Prosomia Stichira: **"The pre-eternal counsel"** (*Βουλὴν προαιώνιον*) doubled to 6; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"He was sent from heaven"** (*Ἀπεστάλη ἐξ οὐρανοῦ*). Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon of the day, and the Readings. At the Aposticha: the 3 Idiomela: **"In the sixth month"** (*Τῷ ἕκτῳ μηνί*); "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"Today are the glad tidings of joy"** (*Σήμερον χαρᾶς Εὐαγγέλια*); the Dismissal Troparion: **"Today is the crowning of our salvation"** (*Σήμερον τῆς Σωτηρίας*) three times, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_incipit: καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον Ἀναστᾶσα Μαριάμ, ὁ
units.slavonic_diplomatic: καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον Ἀναστᾶσα Μαριάμ, ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα, Δόξα, Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου, Καὶ νῦν, τὸ αὐτό, ὁ Στίχος Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεὸς καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Εὐαγγελίζεται ὁ Γαβριήλ, ὁ Κανὼν εἰς ς΄ ἄνευ Στίχου· εἰς τὰ τελευταῖα Τροπάρια, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κάθισμα Ὁ λόγος τοῦ Θεοῦ ἅπαξ, ἀφ᾿ ς΄ τὸ Κοντάκιον Τῇ ὑπερμάχῳ καὶ ὁ Οἶκος Ἄγγελος πρωτοστάτης καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου, καὶ ψάλλεται ἡ θ΄ Ὠδὴ μετὰ τοῦ Μεγαλυναρίου Εὐαγγελίζου γῆ χαρὰν μεγάλην . . . Ὡς ἐμψύχῳ Θεοῦ κιβωτῷ· εἶτα τὰ δύο Ἐξαποστειλάρια. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τὰ γ΄ Προσόμοια Τῶν οὐρανίων ἁψίδων εἰς δ΄, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Τὸ ἀπ᾿ αἰῶνος μυστήριον, Δοξολογία Μ. καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον Σήμερον τῆς Σωτηρίας.

units.slavonic_incipit: and ever, repeat the same; then
units.slavonic_diplomatic: and ever, repeat the same; then the Verse "Have mercy on me, O God" and the Idiomelon "Today Gabriel announces"; the Canon in six, without verses; at the last hymns we use Glory, Now and ever. After the 3rd Ode, the Kathisma "The Word of God" (once); after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion "To the Champion General" and the Ikos "An chief angel was sent" and the Minologion. The Katavasie "I shall open my mouth," and the 9th Ode of the Canon is sung with the Megalynarion "O Earth, announce great tidings . . . As a live ark of God"; then the 2 Exapostilaria. At the Praises: the 3 Prosomia "From the heavenly arches" (repeating the first one). Glory, Now and ever, "The mystery before all time," the Great Doxology and the Apolytikion "Today marks the crowning of our salvation."
units.english_cohort_translation: and ever...": repeat the same; then the Verse: "Have mercy on me, O God, according to Thy great mercy" [Ps. 50:3 LXX], and the Idiomelon: **"Gabriel announces"** (*Εὐαγγελίζεται ὁ Γαβριήλ*); the Canon in 6 without biblical verses; at the concluding troparia we say: "Glory... Both now and ever...". After the 3rd Ode, the Kathisma: **"The Word of God"** (*Ὁ λόγος τοῦ Θεοῦ*) once; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion: **"To thee, the Champion Leader"** (*Τῇ ὑπερμάχῳ*), the Ikos: **"An archangel was sent"** (*Ἄγγελος πρωτοστάτης*), and the Menologion. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*); and the 9th Ode of the Canon is sung with the Megalynarion: **"O earth, announce good tidings of great joy . . . As a living ark of God"** (*Εὐαγγελίζου γῆ χαρὰν μεγάλην . . . Ὡς ἐμψύχῳ Θεοῦ κιβωτῷ*); then the 2 Exapostilaria. At the Praises: the 3 Prosomia: **"From the heavenly vaults"** (*Τῶν οὐρανίων ἁψίδων*) repeating the first one to make 4; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"The mystery hidden from all eternity"** (*Τὸ ἀπ᾿ αἰῶνος μυστήριον*); the Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion: **"Today is the crowning of our salvation"** (*Σήμερον τῆς Σωτηρίας*).

units.slavonic_incipit: Τὸ Εἰσοδικόν· Εὐαγγελίζεσθε ἡμέραν ἐξ ἡμέρας
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Τὸ Εἰσοδικόν· Εὐαγγελίζεσθε ἡμέραν ἐξ ἡμέρας τὸ σωτήριον τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν· Σῶσον ἡμᾶς Υἱὲ Θεοῦ ὁ δι᾿ ἡμᾶς σαρκωθείς, ψάλλοντάς Σοι Ἀλληλούϊα, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον Σήμερον τῆς σωτηρίας, τὸ Κοντάκιον Τῇ ὑπερμάχῳ, τὸ Τρισάγιον, ὁ Ἀπόστολος Ὁ ἁγιάζων καὶ οἱ ἁγιαζόμενοι, τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον Ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις συνέλαβεν Ἐλισάβετ, καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία τοῦ Χρυσοστόμου. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως Εὐαγγελίζου γῆ χαρὰν μεγάλην . . . Ὡς ἐμψύχῳ Θεοῦ κιβωτῷ· Κοινωνικὸν Ἐξελέξατο Κύριος τὴν Σιών, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 6.    Τῇ αὐτῇ Παρασκευῇ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακόν, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα τὰ γ΄ τῆς ἑορτῆς Προσόμοια Βουλὴν προαιώνιον, καὶ γ΄ τοῦ Ἀρχαγγέλου Γαβριὴλ (Ὅρα, τῇ ΚΣΤ΄)· Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Ἀπεστάλη ἐξ οὐρανοῦ. Εἴσοδος Φῶς ἱλαρόν, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον τῆς ἡμέρας. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ γ΄ Ἰδιόμελα Τῷ ἕκτῳ μηνί, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Σήμερον χαρᾶς εὐαγγέλια, καὶ μετὰ τὸ Νῦν ἀπολύεις ψάλλεται τὸ Τῇ Ὑπερμάχῳ ἀργῶς καὶ ἀναγινώσκονται οἱ Οἶκοι τῆς Θεοτόκου ὡς εἴθισται· μετὰ τὸ τέλος τῶν Οἴκων, τὸ Τῇ ὑπερμάχῳ αὖθις σύντομον, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον ἐκ τρίτου, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: The Entrance Hymn "Proclaim the good news of His salvation from day to day. (95:2) O Son of God, incarnate for our sake, save us who sing to You: Alleluia." The Apolytikion "Today marks the crowning of our salvation," the Kontakion "To the Champion General." The Trisagios Hymn, the Apostolos "For both He who sanctifies and those who are being sanctified" [Hebrews 2:11-18] the Gospel "In those days Elizabeth conceived" (Luke 1:24-38) etc. and the remaining Liturgy of Chrysostom. At "Especially," "O Earth, announce good tidings of great joy: . . . As a live ark of God," Communion Hymn "The Lord has chosen Zion," "We have seen the [true] Light" and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: The Entrance Hymn (Eisodikon): **"Proclaim the good news of His salvation from day to day"** (*Εὐαγγελίζεσθε ἡμέραν ἐξ ἡμέρας τὸ σωτήριον τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν*, Ps. 95:2 LXX); **"Save us, O Son of God, incarnate for our sake, who sing to Thee: Alleluia!"** (*Σῶσον ἡμᾶς Υἱὲ Θεοῦ ὁ δι᾿ ἡμᾶς σαρκωθείς*). The Dismissal Troparion: **"Today is the crowning of our salvation"** (*Σήμερον τῆς σωτηρίας*); the Kontakion: **"To thee, the Champion Leader"** (*Τῇ ὑπερμάχῳ*); the Trisagion; the Epistle: **"For both He who sanctifies and they who are sanctified are all of one"** (*Ὁ ἁγιάζων καὶ οἱ ἁγιαζόμενοι*, Hebrews 2:11–18); the Gospel: **"In those days Elizabeth conceived"** (*Ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις συνέλαβεν Ἐλισάβετ*, Luke 1:24–38); and then the Liturgy of Saint John Chrysostom follows in due order. At "Especially": **"O earth, announce good tidings of great joy . . . As a living ark of God"** (*Εὐαγγελίζου γῆ χαρὰν μεγάλην . . . Ὡς ἐμψύχῳ Θεοῦ κιβωτῷ*); Communion Verse: **"The Lord hath chosen Zion; He hath chosen it for His habitation"** (*Ἐξελέξατο Κύριος τὴν Σιών*, Ps. 131:13 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 6.    On Friday evening, following the Introductory Psalm at "Lord I have cried" we chant the 3 Prosomia of the Feast "The eternal will" and the 3 of the Archangel Gabriel (see the 26th of the month); Glory, Now and ever, "Sent from heaven." Entrance, "O Gladsome Light," and the Prokimenon of the day. At the Aposticha: the 3 Idiomela "In the sixth month," Glory, Now and ever, "Today is the announcement of joy," and after "Lord, now let your servant," "To the Champion General" is sung slowly, and, as is customary, the Iki of the Theotokos are read; at the conclusion of the Iki, immediately "To the Champion General" at a quicker tempo, the Trisagion, the Apolytikion 3 times and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: **The Apodosis** 6.    On the same Friday evening, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant the 3 Prosomia of the Feast: **"The pre-eternal counsel"** (*Βουλὴν προαιώνιον*), and 3 of the Archangel Gabriel (see March 26); "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"He was sent from heaven"** (*Ἀπεστάλη ἐξ οὐρανοῦ*). Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon of the day. At the Aposticha: the 3 Idiomela: **"In the sixth month"** (*Τῷ ἕκτῳ μηνί*); "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"Today are the glad tidings of joy"** (*Σήμερον χαρᾶς εὐαγγέλια*); and after **"Now let Thy servant depart"** (*Νῦν ἀπολύεις*), **"To thee, the Champion Leader"** (*Τῇ Ὑπερμάχῳ*) is sung slowly, and the Oikoi of the Theotokos [the Akathist Hymn] are read as is customary. At the conclusion of the Oikoi, **"To thee, the Champion Leader"** again at a brisk tempo, the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion three times, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_incipit: τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἀρχαγγέλου·
units.slavonic_diplomatic: τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἀρχαγγέλου· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Καθίσματα τοῦ Ἀρχαγγέλου Ὁ μέγας Γαβριὴλ καὶ ἕτερον Τῶν ἀσωμάτων λειτουργῶν, ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῆς ἡμέρας· αἱ Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου καὶ μετὰ Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, τὰ δύο τῆς ἑορτῆς Ἐξαποστειλάρια. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τὰ Προσόμοια τῶν Αἴνων τῆς ἑορτῆς, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Εὐφραινέσθωσαν οἱ Οὐρανοί. Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 8.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Ἀντίφωνα τῆς ἑορτῆς· εἰς τὴν Εἴσοδον Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν . . . ὁ δι᾿ ἡμᾶς σαρκωθείς, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τοῦ Ἀρχαγγέλου, τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, καὶ Κοντάκιον Τῇ ὑπερμάχῳ· τὸν Ἀπόστολον (ζήτει Σεπτεμβρίου ς΄) καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον (Νοεμβρίου Η΄). Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, Κοινωνικὸν Ὁ ποιῶν τοὺς Ἀγγέλους, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 9.    Εἰ τύχοι τῷ Σαββάτῳ τῆς Γ΄ ἑβδομάδος, τῇ Πέμπτῃ πρωῒ εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα τὰ γ΄ τῆς σειρᾶς τοῦ Τριῳδίου Προσόμοια, καὶ γ΄ Προεόρτια Κεκρυμμένον μυστήριον, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Εὐαγγελίζεται ὁ Γαβριήλ, τὸ Φῶς ἱλαρὸν καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τῆς ἡμέρας· τὸ Ἰδιόμελον τῶν Ἀποστίχων δίς, καὶ τὸ Μαρτυρικὸν ἅπαξ· Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Γλῶσσαν ἣν οὐκ ἔγνω, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Θεοτόκε Παρθένε, Κύριε ἐλέησον μ΄, Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, τὸ Ἐπουράνιε, τὸ Παναγία Τριάς, τὸ Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα, τὸ Εὐλογήσω τὸν Κύριον καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

Τῇ Παρασκευῇ ἑσπέρας, ἐν τῷ Μεγάλῳ Ἑσπερινῷ μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα τὰ γ΄ τῆς ἑορτῆς Προσόμοια Βουλὴν προαιώνιον εἰς ἕξ, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Ἀπεστάλη ἐξ οὐρανοῦ, Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον τῆς ἡμέρας, καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ γ΄ Ἰδιόμελα, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Σήμερον χαρᾶς εὐαγγέλια· μετὰ τὸ Νῦν ἀπολύεις ψάλλεται τὸ Τῇ Ὑπερμάχῳ ἀργῶς καὶ ἀναγινώσκεται ἡ γ΄ Στάσις τῶν Οἴκων τῆς Θεοτόκου, ὡς εἴθισται· μετὰ τὸ τέλος τῶν Οἴκων Τῇ ὑπερμάχῳ

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 8.    In the Liturgy, the Antiphons of the Feast; at the Entrance, "O come let us worship . . . incarnate for our sake," the Apolytikion of the Feast, of the Archangel, of the Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion "To the Champion General." The Apostolos (see September 6) and the Gospel [Luke 10:16-21] (see November 8). At "Especially," "It is meet," Communion Hymn "You make Your angels," "We have seen the [true] Light" and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 8.    At the Divine Liturgy, the Antiphons of the Feast; at the Entrance: **"O come, let us worship and bow down before Christ... incarnate for our sake"** (*Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν . . . ὁ δι᾿ ἡμᾶς σαρκωθείς*); the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, that of the Archangel, that of the Patron Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion: **"To thee, the Champion Leader"** (*Τῇ ὑπερμάχῳ*). The Epistle (seek September 6 [Hebrews 2:2–10]) and the Gospel (seek November 8 [Luke 10:16–21]). At "Especially": **"It is truly right to call thee blessed"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Verse: **"Who makes His angels spirits, and His ministers a flame of fire"** (*Ὁ ποιῶν τοὺς Ἀγγέλους*, Ps. 103:4 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 9.    If the Feast occurs on Saturday of the 3rd Week, on Thursday morning, at the Vespers, following the Introductory Psalm at "Lord, I have cried" we chant the 3 Prosomia of the sequence of the Triodion, and the 3 of the Pre-feast "Hidden mystery." Glory, Now and ever, "Gabriel proclaims." {Entrance}, "O Gladsome Light" and the Readings of the day. The Idiomelon of the Aposticha are sung twice and the Martyrikon once; Glory, Now and ever, "The language that I knew not," the Trisagion, "Theotokos Virgin" "Lord, have mercy" (40 times), "More honorable," "Heavenly King," "All-Holy Trinity," "Blessed be the name," "I will bless the Lord at all times," and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 9.    If the Feast occurs on Saturday of the 3rd Week: on Thursday morning, at Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant the 3 Prosomia of the sequence of the Triodion, and 3 Forefeast Prosomia: **"A hidden mystery"** (*Κεκρυμμένον μυστήριον*); "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"Gabriel announces"** (*Εὐαγγελίζεται ὁ Γαβριήλ*); Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Readings of the day. The Idiomelon of the Aposticha is sung twice and the Martyrikon once; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"A tongue which she knew not"** (*Γλῶσσαν ἣν οὐκ ἔγνω*); the Trisagion Prayers, **"Virgin Theotokos, rejoice"** (*Θεοτόκε Παρθένε*), "Lord, have mercy" (40 times), **"More honorable than the Cherubim"**, **"O Heavenly King"** (*Ἐπουράνιε Βασιλεῦ*), **"All-Holy Trinity"** (*Παναγία Τριάς*), **"Blessed be the name of the Lord"** (*Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα*, Ps. 112:2 LXX), **"I will bless the Lord at all times"** (*Εὐλογήσω τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 33:2 LXX), and Dismissal.

units.english_cohort_translation: 10.    On Friday evening, in Great Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant the 3 Prosomia of the Feast: **"The pre-eternal counsel"** (*Βουλὴν προαιώνιον*) doubled to 6; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"He was sent from heaven"** (*Ἀπεστάλη ἐξ οὐρανοῦ*). Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon of the day, and the Readings. At the Aposticha: the 3 Idiomela; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"Today are the glad tidings of joy"** (*Σήμερον χαρᾶς εὐαγγέλια*); and after **"Now let Thy servant depart"** (*Νῦν ἀπολύεις*), **"To thee, the Champion Leader"** (*Τῇ Ὑπερμάχῳ*) is sung slowly, and the third Stasis of the Oikoi of the Theotokos [Akathist Hymn] is read, as is customary; at the conclusion of the Oikoi, immediately **"To the[^288]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 11.    Τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα Ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ δ΄, τοῦ Σταυροῦ γ΄ καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς γ΄, Δόξα, Χριστὲ ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν (τοῦ Τριῳδίου), Καὶ νῦν, τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, Δόξα, Ὁ συμμαχήσας Κύριε, Καὶ νῦν, Σήμερον χαρᾶς Εὐαγγέλια, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ τοῦ Σταυροῦ, τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 11.    On Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm and the reading from the Psalter, at "Lord, I have cried" we chant 4 Stichira of the Resurrection, 3 of the Cross and 3 of the Feast, Glory, "O Christ our God" {of the Triodion}, Now and ever of the Feast. Entrance, "O Gladsome Light," and the Prokimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory, "O Lord, the ally," Now and ever, "Today is the announcement of joy." The Apolytikia: of the Resurrection, of the Cross, of the Feast and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: **The Apodosis** 11.    On Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the reading from the Psalter [Kathisma 1, Pss. 1–8 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant 4 Resurrection Stichira, 3 of the Precious Cross, and 3 of the Feast; "Glory...": **"O Christ our God"** (*Χριστὲ ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν*) [from the Triodion]; "Both now and ever...": of the Feast. Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; "Glory...": **"O Lord, who didst fight alongside"** (*Ὁ συμμαχήσας Κύριε*); "Both now and ever...": **"Today are the glad tidings of joy"** (*Σήμερον χαρᾶς Εὐαγγέλια*). The Dismissal Troparia: of the Resurrection, of the Cross, of the Feast, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 12.    If the Feast occurs on the Third Sunday of Lent, Friday morning at Vespers of the Pre-sanctified, after the Introductory Psalm and "To the Lord," at "Lord, I have cried" we chant the Idiomelon "In the manner of the Prodigal" (twice), the 4 Martyrika in the Mode of the Week and the 4 of the Pre-feast "Hidden mystery," Glory, Now and ever, "Gabriel announces." Entrance, "O Gladsome Light" and the Readings of the day [Genesis 8:4-21, Proverbs 10:31 - 11:12]. Then "Let my prayer arise" and the rest of the Liturgy of the Pre-sanctified Gifts.
units.english_cohort_translation: 12.    If the Feast occurs on the Third Sunday of the Great Fast [Sunday of the Veneration of the Precious Cross]: on Friday morning at Vespers of the Presanctified, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and "Unto the Lord" [Kathisma 18, Pss. 119–133 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant the Idiomelon: **"In the manner of the prodigal"** (*Ἀσώτου δίκην*) twice, the 4 Martyrika in the Tone occurring, and 4 Forefeast Prosomia: **"A hidden mystery"** (*Κεκρυμμένον μυστήριον*); "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"Gabriel announces"** (*Εὐαγγελίζεται ὁ Γαβριήλ*). Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Readings of the day [Genesis 8:4–21; Proverbs 10:31 – 11:12]. Then **"Let my prayer arise"** (*Κατευθυνθήτω*, Ps. 140:2 LXX), and the rest of the Liturgy of the Presanctified Gifts follows in due order.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 15.    Τῷ αὐτῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα Ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ γ΄, τοῦ Σταυροῦ γ΄ καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς Βουλὴν προαιώνιον εἰς δ΄, Δόξα, Χριστὲ ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν (τοῦ Τριῳδίου), Καὶ νῦν, Ἀπεστάλη ἐξ Οὐρανοῦ.
units.english_cohort_translation: Πνεύματος, καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῆς ἡμέρας· ἀφ᾿ θ΄ (η΄)* ψάλλεται τῆς η΄ (θ΄)* Ὠδῆς ὁ Εἱρμός, καὶ μετὰ Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον Ὡς δῶρα προεόρτια δίς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τὰ ἑσπέρια τοῦ μικροῦ Ἑσπερινοῦ Κατοικτιρήσας τὸ ποίημα ὁ πλάστης (ψαλλόμενα εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα)· Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Τῷ ἕκτῳ μηνί, Σοὶ δόξα πρέπει, καὶ μετὰ τὴν Ἐκτενῆ τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τοῦ μικροῦ Ἑσπερινοῦ Ἄρχων τῶν ἄνω δυνάμεων, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Γλῶσσαν ἣν οὐκ ἔγνω, τὸ Ἀγαθὸν τὸ ἐξομολογεῖσθαι, τὸ Τρισάγιον, καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον.

units.slavonic_incipit: Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον καὶ
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, Δόξα, Ὁ συμμαχήσας Κύριε, Καὶ νῦν, Σήμερον χαρᾶς Εὐαγγέλια, Ἀπολυτίκια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τοῦ Σταυροῦ, τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.
units.english_cohort_translation: 14.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ τῆς ἡμέρας Ἀντίφωνα· εἰς τὴν Εἴσοδον Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν . . . Ὁ ἐν Ἁγίοις θαυμαστός, τὸ προεόρτιον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, καὶ τὸ προεόρτιον Κοντάκιον· Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς ἡμέρας, τὸ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, Κοινωνικὸν τῆς ἡμέρας, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 16.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸ Εὐλογητὸς ὁ Θεός, τὸ Τρισάγιον, καὶ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ψάλλεται ἡ Λιτὴ (καταλιμπανομένου τοῦ Τριαδικοῦ κανόνος), Δόξα, ἐκ τοῦ Τριῳδίου, Καὶ νῦν, τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς· εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον τῆς ἡμέρας, καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος τῆς ἑορτῆς.
units.english_cohort_translation: 15.    Τῷ αὐτῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα Ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ γ΄, τοῦ Σταυροῦ γ΄ καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς Βουλὴν προαιώνιον εἰς δ΄, Δόξα, Χριστὲ ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν (τοῦ Τριῳδίου), Καὶ νῦν, Ἀπεστάλη ἐξ Οὐρανοῦ. Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, Δόξα, Ὁ συμμαχήσας Κύριε, Καὶ νῦν, Σήμερον χαρᾶς Εὐαγγέλια, Ἀπολυτίκια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τοῦ Σταυροῦ, τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_incipit: ἡ Αἴτησις, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ
units.slavonic_diplomatic: ἡ Αἴτησις, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον τῆς ἑορτῆς Εὐαγγελίζεσθε ἡμέραν ἐξ ἡμέρας, τὸ Πᾶσα πνοὴ καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον Ἀναστᾶσα Μαριάμ, τὸ Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ καὶ ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα, Δόξα, Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου, Καὶ νῦν, τὸ αὐτό, ὁ Στίχος Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεὸς καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Εὐαγγελίζεται ὁ Γαβριήλ. ἡ Αἴτησις, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον
τῆς ἑορτῆς Εὐαγγελίζεσθε ἡμέραν ἐξ ἡμέρας, τὸ Πᾶσα πνοὴ
καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον Ἀναστᾶσα Μαριάμ, τὸ Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ
καὶ ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα, Δόξα, Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου, Καὶ νῦν, τὸ αὐτό,
ὁ Στίχος Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεὸς καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Εὐαγγελίζεται
ὁ Γαβριήλ. Κανόνες ὁ τοῦ Τριῳδίου, οὗ πρῶτον ψάλλεται ὁ Εἱρμὸς
Ὁ θειότατος δίς, εἰς τὸ δεύτερον Τροπάριον Στίχος· Δόξα τῇ

units.slavonic_incipit: the Kathisma of the Pre-feast; after
units.slavonic_diplomatic: the Kathisma of the Pre-feast; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion "Through the descent of the holy Spirit" and the Minologion of the day; after the 8th {9th}* Ode and "More honorable," the Irmos of the 9th {8th}* Ode is chanted; the Exapostilarion of the Pre-feast "As pre-festal gifts" (twice). At the Praises: the hymns of the Small Vespers "Having great pity upon Your creation" {sung at Lord I have cried}, Glory, Now and ever, "The sixth month" the Lesser Doxology "To You belongs glory"; and after the petitions, the Aposticha of the Small Vespers "Magistrate of the powers above," Glory, Now and ever, "The language that I knew not"; then "It is good to give thanks," Trisagion, and the Apolytikion.
units.english_cohort_translation: the Forefeast Kathisma; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion: **"Upon the descent of the All-Holy Spirit"** (*Ἐπελεύσει Πνεύματος τοῦ Παναγίου*), and the Menologion of the day; after the 9th [8th]* Ode and **"More honorable than the Cherubim"**, the Heirmos of the 8th [9th]* Ode is chanted; the Forefeast Exapostilarion: **"As pre-festal gifts"** (*Ὡς δῶρα προεόρτια*) twice. At the Praises: the stichira from Small Vespers: **"Having compassion on His handiwork, the Creator"** (*Κατοικτιρήσας τὸ ποίημα ὁ πλάστης*) [which were chanted at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*)]; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"In the sixth month"** (*Τῷ ἕκτῳ μηνί*); the Lesser Doxology: **"To Thee belongs glory"** (*Σοὶ δόξα πρέπει*); and after the Litany, the Aposticha from Small Vespers: **"O prince of the hosts on high"** (*Ἄρχων τῶν ἄνω δυνάμεων*); "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"A tongue which she knew not"** (*Γλῶσσαν ἣν οὐκ ἔγνω*); then **"It is good to give thanks unto the Lord"** (*Ἀγαθὸν τὸ ἐξομολογεῖσθαι*, Ps. 91:2 LXX), the Trisagion Prayers, and the Forefeast Dismissal Troparion.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 14.    At the Liturgy, the Antiphons of the day; at the Entrance, "Come let us worship... who is wondrous in Your Saints," the Apolytikion of the Pre-feast, the Apolytikion of the Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion of the Pre-feast, Apostolos and Gospel of the day. "It is meet," Communion Hymn of the day, "We have seen the [true] light," and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 14.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Antiphons of the day; at the Little Entrance: **"O come, let us worship and fall down before Christ. Save us, O Son of God, Who art wonderful in Thy saints..."** (*Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν . . . Ὁ ἐν Ἁγίοις θαυμαστός*); the Forefeast Dismissal Troparion, that of the Patron Saint of the Church, and the Forefeast Kontakion. The Epistle and Gospel of the day; **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); the Communion Verse of the day; **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 15.    Saturday evening at Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm and the reading from the Psalter, at "Lord, I have cried" we chant 3 Stichira of the Resurrection, 3 of the Cross and 4 of the Feast "The pre-eternal Will." Glory, "O Christ our God" {of the Triodion}, Now and ever of the Feast "Sent from heaven." Entrance, "O Gladsome Light," the Prokimenon and the Readings of the Feast. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory, "O Lord the ally," Now and ever, "Today is the announcement of joy." The Apolytikia: of the Resurrection, of the Cross, of the Feast and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 15.    On the same Saturday evening [Eve of the Third Sunday of Great Lent, Sunday of the Cross], after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the reading of the Psalter [Kathisma 1, Pss. 1–8 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant 3 Resurrection Stichira, 3 of the Precious Cross, and 4 of the Feast: **"The pre-eternal counsel"** (*Βουλὴν προαιώνιον*); "Glory...": **"O Christ our God"** (*Χριστὲ ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν*) [from the Triodion]; "Both now and ever...": **"He was sent from heaven"** (*Ἀπεστάλη ἐξ Οὐρανοῦ*). Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon, and the Readings of the Feast. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; "Glory...": **"O Lord, Who didst fight alongside"** (*Ὁ συμμαχήσας Κύριε*); "Both now and ever...": **"Today are the glad tidings of joy"** (*Σήμερον χαρᾶς Εὐαγγέλια*). Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrection Troparion, that of the Cross, that of the Feast, and Dismissal.

units.english_cohort_translation: 16.    On Sunday at Matins, after **"Blessed is our God"** (*Εὐλογητὸς ὁ Θεός*), the Trisagion Prayers, and Psalm 50 [LXX], the Liti is chanted (omitting the Triadic Canon); "Glory...": from the Triodion; "Both now and ever...": of the Feast; then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers, the Psalter of the day, and the Polyeleos of the Feast. The Kathismata at the First and Second Psalter readings [Stichologiai]: two of the Resurrection and one of the Feast; at the third reading, that of the Cross and those of the Feast; the Litany, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon of the Feast: **"Proclaim His salvation from day to day"** (*Εὐαγγελίζεσθε ἡμέραν ἐξ ἡμέρας*, Ps. 95:2 LXX). Then **"Let everything that hath breath"** (*Πᾶσα πνοὴ*), and the Gospel: **"Mary arose"** (*Ἀναστᾶσα Μαριάμ*, Luke 1:39–49, 56). Then **"Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ"** (*Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ θεασάμενοι*), Psalm 50 [LXX] read plainly; "Glory...": **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos"** (*Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου*); "Both now and ever...": repeat the same. The Verse: **"Have mercy on me, O God, according to Thy great mercy"** (*Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός*, Ps. 50:3 LXX), and the Idiomelon: **"Gabriel announces"** (*Εὐαγγελίζεται ὁ Γαβριήλ*). units.slavonic_incipit: ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῆς
units.slavonic_diplomatic: ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Μηνολόγιον καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τοῦ Τριῳδίου· αἱ Καταβασίαι Ὁ θειότατος προετύπωσε, εἶτα ψάλλεται ἡ θ΄ τῆς ἑορτῆς Εὐαγγελίζου γῆ χαρὰν . . . Ὡς ἐμψύχῳ Θεοῦ, ἡ Καταβασία Ὦ Μῆτερ Παρθένε, Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τὸ τοῦ Σταυροῦ καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα β΄, τοῦ Σταυροῦ γ΄, καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς γ΄, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Τὸ ἀπ᾿ αἰῶνος μυστήριον, Δοξολογία Μ. Κατὰ δὲ τὸ Τρισάγιον τῆς Δοξολογίας τελεῖται ἡ τάξις τῆς Εἰσόδου τοῦ Τιμίου Σταυροῦ, ὡς εἴθισται· μετὰ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Δεῦτε πιστοί, λέγεται τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία.

units.english_cohort_translation: 18. units.slavonic_diplomatic: 17.    At the Liturgy, the Antiphons of the Feast (See Situation One, Paragraph 5); at the 2nd Antiphon "Incarnate for our sake." Entrance Hymn "Proclaim His salvation from day to day . . . Save us . . . who is risen from the dead." The Apolytikia: of the Resurrection, of the Cross, of the Feast and the Kontakion "To the Champion General." Instead of the Trisagios Hymn, we chant "We venerate Your Cross." The Apostolos of the Sunday [Hebrews 4:14 - 5:6] the Gospel "In those days Elizabeth conceived" (Luke 1:24-38). At "Especially," "O Earth, announce good tidings of great joy . . . As a live ark of God." Communion Hymn "The Lord has chosen Zion; He wants to make it his home," "We have seen the [true] Light" and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 18.    That Sunday evening, following the Introductory Psalm, at "Lord I have cried" we chant the 3 Prosomia of the Feast "The pre-eternal will" and the 3 of the Archangel Gabriel (see the 26th of this month); Glory, Now and ever, "Sent from heaven." Entrance, "O Gladsome Light" and the Prokimenon of the day. At the Aposticha: the 3 Idiomela "In the sixth month," Glory, Now and ever, "Today is the announcement of joy." The Apolytikion "Today marks the crowning of our salvation" (3 times) and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: **The Apodosis** 18.    On that same Sunday evening, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant the 3 Prosomia: **"The pre-eternal counsel"** (*Βουλὴν προαιώνιον*), and 3 of the Archangel: **"Gabriel, the supreme intellect"** (*Γαβριὴλ ὁ μέγιστος ὁ νοῦς*, see March 26); "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"He was sent from heaven"** (*Ἀπεστάλη ἐξ οὐρανοῦ*). Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon of the day. At the Aposticha: the 3 Idiomela: **"In the sixth month"** (*Τῷ ἕκτῳ μηνί*); "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"Today are the glad tidings of joy"** (*Σήμερον χαρᾶς εὐαγγέλια*); the Dismissal Troparion: **"Today is the crowning of our salvation"** (*Σήμερον τῆς σωτηρίας*) three times, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 20.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ ἑορτὴ τῇ Τρίτῃ τῆς Δ΄, Ε΄ καὶ ΣΤ΄ ἑβδομάδος, τῇ Κυριακῇ ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακόν, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα τὰ δ΄ τοῦ ἤχου κατανυκτικά, τοῦ Τριῳδίου Προσόμοια γ΄ καὶ τὰ γ΄ προεόρτια Κεκρυμμένον μυστήριον, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Εὐαγγελίζεται ὁ Γαβριήλ, Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, καὶ τὸ Μέγα Προκείμενον, μετὰ τῶν Στίχων αὐτοῦ. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τὸ Ἰδιόμελον δίς, καὶ τὸ Μαρτυρικὸν ἅπαξ (ἐκ τοῦ Τριῳδίου), Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Γλῶσσαν ἣν οὐκ ἔγνω, Νῦν ἀπολύεις, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Θεοτόκε Παρθένε, τὸ Κύριε ἐλέησον μ΄, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Τὴν τιμιωτέραν τῶν Χερουβίμ, τὸ Ἐπουράνιε Βασιλεῦ, τὰς Μετανοίας (ὑπονοεῖται ἡ Προσευχὴ τοῦ Ἁγίου Ἐφραίμ), τὴν Συγχώρησιν, ὡς εἴθισται (πιθανὸν λάθος, διότι τὸ Τυπικὸν τοῦ Τριῳ- δίου δίχνει ὅτι ἡ Συγχώρησις γίνεται μόνον εἰς τὴν παραμονὴν τῆς Μεγάλης Τεσσαρακοστῆς, δηλ. εἰς τὸν ἑσπερινὸν τὸ ἑσπέρας τῆς Κυριακῆς τῆς Τυροφάγου), καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 20.    If the Feast occurs on Tuesday of the 4th, 5th or 6th Week, on Sunday evening at Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm, at "Lord, I have cried" we chant the 4 Penitential Hymns of the Mode, 3 Prosomia of the Triodion, and 3 of the Pre-feast "Hidden mystery." Glory, Now and ever, "Gabriel announces." Entrance, "O Gladsome Light" and the Great Prokimenon with its verses. At the Aposticha: the Idiomelon (twice) and the Martyrikon (once) {these are from the Triodion}. Glory, Now and ever, "The language that I knew not." Then "Lord, now let," the Trisagion, "Theotokos Virgin," "Lord, have mercy" (40 times), Glory, Now and ever, "More honorable than the Cherubim," "Heavenly King," the Prostrations {the Prayer of Saint Ephraim is implied here}, the Forgiveness Rite, as is customary {this could be an error, since the Typikon for the Triodion indicates that the Forgiveness Rite is only done on the Eve of Great Lent, that is, in the Vespers on the evening of Cheesefare Sunday}, and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 20.    If the Feast occurs on Tuesday of the 4th, 5th, or 6th Week: on Sunday evening at Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant the 4 Penitential Stichira of the Tone, 3 Prosomia of the Triodion, and 3 Forefeast Prosomia: **"A hidden mystery"** (*Κεκρυμμένον μυστήριον*); "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"Gabriel announces"** (*Εὐαγγελίζεται ὁ Γαβριήλ*). Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Great Prokeimenon with its verses. At the Aposticha: the Idiomelon twice and the Martyrikon once [from the Triodion]; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"A tongue which she knew not"** (*Γλῶσσαν ἣν οὐκ ἔγνω*); **"Now let Thy servant depart"** (*Νῦν ἀπολύεις*), the Trisagion Prayers, **"Virgin Theotokos, rejoice"** (*Θεοτόκε Παρθένε*), "Lord, have mercy" (40 times); "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"More honorable than the Cherubim"**, **"O Heavenly King"** (*Ἐπουράνιε Βασιλεῦ*), the Prostrations [the Prayer of Saint Ephraim is understood], the Rite of Mutual Forgiveness as is customary [an apparent typographical erratum in earlier rubrics, since the Typikon of the Triodion indicates that the General Rite of Forgiveness takes place only on the threshold of Great Lent, namely at Vespers on the evening of Cheesefare Sunday], and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 22.    If the Feast occurs on Friday of the 4th week, on Wednesday morning following the Introductory Psalm, and "To the Lord," at "Lord, I have cried," we chant the 2 Idiomela of the sequence of the Triodion, the Martyrikon and the 3 of the Pre-feast "Hidden mystery." Glory, Now and ever, "Today the unapproachable in essence." Entrance, "O Gladsome Light" and the Readings of the day. Then "Let my prayer arise," and the rest of the Liturgy of the Pre-sanctified Gifts.
units.english_cohort_translation: 22.    If the Feast occurs on Friday of the 4th Week: on Wednesday morning, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and "Unto the Lord" [Kathisma 18, Pss. 119–133 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant the 2 Idiomela of the sequence of the Triodion, the Martyrikon, and 3 Forefeast Prosomia: **"A hidden mystery"** (*Κεκρυμμένον μυστήριον*); "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"Today He Who is unapproachable in essence"** (*Σήμερον ὁ ἀπρόσιτος τῇ οὐσίᾳ*). Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Readings of the day, **"Let my prayer arise"** (*Κατευθυνθήτω*, Ps. 140:2 LXX), and the rest of the Liturgy of the Presanctified Gifts follows in due order.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 25.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα καὶ ἀνὰ ἓν τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ τοῦ ἤχου, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον, Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Καθίσματα τοῦ Ἀρχαγγέλου Ὁ Μέγας στρατηγὸς καὶ Τῶν Ἀσωμάτων λειτουργῶν (Ὅρα τῇ Κς΄)· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος, τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ ἐν ταῖς Κυριακαῖς τοῦ Τριῳδίου διάταξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, εἶτα μετὰ Τὴν τιμιωτέραν Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον καὶ τὰ τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄, καὶ τοῦ Ἀρχαγγέλου δ΄ (ὧδε ἀποδίδοται ἡ ἑορτή), Δόξα, τῶν Αἴνων Δεῦτε ἐργασώμεθα, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μ. Σήμερον σωτηρία καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία τοῦ Μ. Βασιλείου. Κοντάκιον Τῇ ὑπερμάχῳ.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 25.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Triadic Canon and the Triadic "It is meet"; then the Trisagion, the Apolytikion of the Feast, and the Exapsalmos. At "God is the Lord": the Apolytikia as at Vespers, the Psalter of the day, and the Amomos. Kathismata at the 1st and 2nd Stasis [Stichologie], 2 of the Resurrection and one of the Feast. The Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode, and the Prokimenon. Canons of the Resurrection and of the Feast. At the 3rd Ode, the Kathismata of the Archangel "The great general" and "Of the incorporeal liturgists" (see the 26th of the month); at the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrection, and the Minologion. The Katavasie "I shall open my mouth" and the entire order of the Sunday Matins Gospel as prescribed in the Sundays of the Triodion; then "More honorable." Exapostilaria of the Resurrection and of the Feast. At the Praises: 4 of the Resurrection and 4 of the Archangel (at which point the Leave-taking of the Feast occurs). Glory of the Praises "Come, let us work," Now and ever, "Most blessed," Great Doxology, "Today salvation" and the Liturgy of Basil the Great. Kontakion "To the Champion General."
units.english_cohort_translation: 25.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon and the Triadic hymn: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers, the Psalter of the day, and the Amomos [Kathisma 17, Ps. 118 LXX]. The Kathismata at the First and Second Psalter readings [Stichologiai]: two of the Resurrection and one of the Feast. The Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe of the Tone, the Anavathmoi, and the Prokeimenon. Canons: that of the Resurrection and that of the Feast. After the 3rd Ode, the Kathismata of the Archangel: **"The great leader of the hosts"** (*Ὁ Μέγας στρατηγὸς*) and **"Of the bodiless ministers"** (*Τῶν Ἀσωμάτων λειτουργῶν*, see March 26); after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrection, and the Menologion. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*), and the entire Sunday Matins Gospel order as prescribed for the Sundays of the Triodion; then **"More honorable than the Cherubim"**. Exapostilaria: the Resurrection Exapostilarion and those of the Feast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Archangel (at this point the Apodosis of the Feast takes place); "Glory..." at the Praises: **"Come, let us work in the mystical vineyard"** (*Δεῦτε ἐργασώμεθα*); "Both now and ever...": **"Most blessed art thou"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); Great Doxology; **"Today is salvation"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*), and following in order the Divine Liturgy of Saint Basil the Great. Kontakion: **"To thee, the Champion Leader"** (*Τῇ ὑπερμάχῳ*).

At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers, the Psalter of the day, and the Amomos [Kathisma 17, Ps. 118 LXX]. The Kathismata at the First and Second Psalter readings [Stichologiai]: two of the Resurrection and one of the Feast. The Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe of the Tone, the Anavathmoi, and the Prokeimenon. Canons: that of the Resurrection and that of the Feast. After the 3rd Ode, the Kathismata of the Archangel: **"The great leader of the hosts"** (*Ὁ Μέγας στρατηγὸς*) and **"Of the bodiless ministers"** (*Τῶν Ἀσωμάτων λειτουργῶν*, see March 26); after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrection, and the Menologion. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*), and the entire Sunday Matins Gospel order as prescribed for the Sundays of the Triodion; then **"More honorable than the Cherubim"**. Exapostilaria: the Resurrection Exapostilarion and those of the Feast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichi

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 26.    If the Feast occurs on the 4th Sunday of Lent, Friday at Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm and "To the Lord," at "Lord, I have cried," we chant the Idiomelon "Having enslaved the passions" (twice), the 4 Martyrika of the Mode and 4 of the Pre-feast, Glory, Now and ever, "Gabriel proclaims." Entrance, "O Gladsome Light" and the Readings of the day. Then "Let my prayer arise" and the rest of the Liturgy of the Pre-sanctified Gifts.
units.english_cohort_translation: 26.    If the Feast occurs on the 4th Sunday of Great Lent: on Friday at Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and "Unto the Lord" [Kathisma 18, Pss. 119–133 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant the Idiomelon: **"Having enslaved my soul to passions"** (*Τοῖς πάθεσι δουλώσας*) twice, the 4 Martyrika of the Tone, and 4 Forefeast Stichira; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"Gabriel announces"** (*Εὐαγγελίζεται ὁ Γαβριήλ*). Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Readings of the day [Genesis 12:1–7; Proverbs 14:15–26]. Then **"Let my prayer arise"** (*Κατευθυνθήτω*, Ps. 140:2 LXX), and the rest of the Liturgy of the Presanctified Gifts follows in due order.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 28.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸ Εὐλογητὸς ὁ Θεὸς τὸ Τρισάγιον, ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς (καταλιμπανομένου τοῦ Τριαδικοῦ κανόνος, ψάλλεται ἡ Λιτὴ τῆς ἑορτῆς), εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον τῆς ἡμέρας καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος τῆς ἑορτῆς. Καθίσματα ἐν μὲν τῇ α΄ καὶ β΄ Στιχολογίᾳ ἀνὰ δύο Ἀναστάσιμα καὶ ἀνὰ ἓν τῆς ἑορτῆς, ἐν δὲ τῇ γ΄ μόνα τὰ τῆς ἑορτῆς, ἡ Αἴτησις, καὶ μετ᾿ αὐτὴν ἡ Ὑπακοὴ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ Προκείμενον τῆς ἑορτῆς Εὐαγγελίζεσθε ἡμέραν ἐξ ἡμέρας, τὸ Πᾶσα πνοή, καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον Ἀναστᾶσα Μαριάμ, τὸ Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ καὶ ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα, Δόξα, Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου, Καὶ νῦν, τὸ αὐτό, ὁ Στίχος Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεὸς καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Εὐαγγελίζεται ὁ Γαβριήλ, Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Κοντάκιον μετὰ τοῦ Οἴκου, εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα Ὁ Λόγος τοῦ Θεοῦ ἅπαξ· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου, καὶ ἡ θ΄ τῆς ἑορτῆς· Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, καὶ τὰ τῆς ἑορτῆς· εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς δ΄, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Τὸ ἀπ᾿ αἰῶνος μυστήριον, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ Σήμερον Σωτηρία.

Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν τὰ Ἀντίφωνα τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Εἰσοδικὸν Εὐαγγελίζεσθε ἡμέραν ἐξ ἡμέρας . . . ὁ ἀναστὰς ἐκ νεκρῶν, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Κοντάκιον Τῇ ὑπερμάχῳ, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως τὸ Εὐαγγελίζου γῆ (χαρὰν μεγάλην . . . Ὡς ἐμψύχῳ θεοῦ κιβωτῷ), Κοινωνικὸν τῆς ἑορτῆς, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις. Ἡ Ἀκολουθία τοῦ Ὁσίου (Ἰωάννου) ψάλλεται ἐν τοῖς Ἀποδείπνοις.

units.english_cohort_translation: 27.    On Saturday at Great Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the reading of the Psalter [Kathisma 1, Pss. 1–8 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant 4 Resurrection Stichira and 6 of the Feast; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"He was sent from heaven"** (*Ἀπεστάλη ἐξ οὐρανοῦ*). Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Readings of the Feast. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"Today are the glad tidings of joy"** (*Σήμερον χαρᾶς εὐαγγέλια*); the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Feast twice, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Communion Hymn of the Feast, "We have seen the [true] light" and the
units.english_cohort_translation: 28.    On Sunday at Matins, after **"Blessed is our God"** (*Εὐλογητὸς ὁ Θεός*), the Trisagion Prayers, and Psalm 50 [LXX] (the Triadic Canon being omitted, the Liti of the Feast is chanted); then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers, the Psalter reading of the day, and the Polyeleos of the Feast. Kathismata: at the First and Second Psalter readings [Stichologiai], two of the Resurrection and one of the Feast; at the third reading, those of the Feast alone; the Litany, and after it the Hypakoe of the Tone and the Anavathmoi; the Prokeimenon of the Feast: **"Proclaim His salvation from day to day"** (*Εὐαγγελίζεσθε ἡμέραν ἐξ ἡμέρας*, Ps. 95:2 LXX). Then **"Let everything that hath breath"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*), and the Gospel: **"Mary arose"** (*Ἀναστᾶσα Μαριάμ*, Luke 1:39–49, 56). Then **"Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ"** (*Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ θεασάμενοι*), Psalm 50 [LXX] read plainly; "Glory...": **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos"** (*Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου*); "Both now and ever...": repeat the same; the Verse: **"Have mercy on me, O God, according to Thy great mercy"** (*Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός*, Ps. 50:3 LXX), and the Idiomelon: **"Gabriel announces"** (*Εὐαγγελίζεται ὁ Γαβριήλ*). Canons: that of the Resurrection and that of the Feast. After the 3rd Ode, the Resurrection Kontakion with the Ikos, then the Kathisma: **"The Word of God"** (*Ὁ Λόγος τοῦ Θεοῦ*) once; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Feast, and the Menologion. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*), and the 9th Ode of the Feast. Exapostilaria: the Resurrection Exapostilarion and those of the Feast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Feast; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"The mystery hidden from all eternity"** (*Τὸ ἀπ᾿ αἰῶνος μυστήριον*); Great Doxology, and **"Today is salvation"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 31    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ προεόρτιον Ἀπολυτίκιον, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ τοῦ Τριῳδίου καὶ τὸ Προεόρτιον, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον τοῦ ἤχου, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ (κανονικὰ, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ προηγεῖται τῶν Ἀναβαθμῶν). Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ Προεόρτιος, οὗ ὁ Στίχος Δόξα, σοι ὁ Θεός· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ προεόρτιον Κάθισμα Σήμερον ἅπασα ἅπαξ· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα τὸ Μηνολόγιον, καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τοῦ Τριῳδίου· αἱ Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου καὶ ἅπασα ἡ ἐν ταῖς Κυριακαῖς τοῦ Τριῳδίου διάταξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου·
units.english_cohort_translation: 30.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ ἑορτὴ τῇ Δευτέρᾳ τῆς Ε΄ καὶ ΣΤ΄ ἑβδομάδος, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄, Προεόρτια γ΄, καὶ τοῦ Τριῳδίου γ΄. Δόξα, Γλῶσσαν ἣν οὐκ ἔγνω, Καὶ νῦν, τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, Δόξα, τοῦ Τριῳδίου, Καὶ νῦν, Εὐαγγελίζεται ὁ Γαβριήλ, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τὸ Προεόρτιον, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ Προεόρτια Κατοικτιρήσας τῷ Πλάσματι ὁ Πλάστης δ΄. Δόξα τοῦ Τριῳδίου, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μ. Σήμερον σωτηρία, καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία τοῦ Μ. Βασιλείου, ἐν ᾗ ψάλλονται τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοί, Κοντάκιον Ἐπελεύσει Πνεύματος, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς, Κοινωνικὸν Αἰνεῖτε, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Pre-feast "The Creator pitying His creature," Glory of the Triodion, Now and ever, "Most blessed," Great
units.english_cohort_translation: 30.    If the Feast occurs on Monday of the 5th Week [the printed text adds: "and the 6th Week", which is a typographical error; it must be the 5th Week, since Situations 11–15 treat the intervening days]: on Saturday at Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the reading of the Psalter [Kathisma 1, Pss. 1–8 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant 4 Resurrection Stichira, 3 of the Forefeast, and 3 of the Triodion; "Glory...": **"A tongue which she knew not"** (*Γλῶσσαν ἣν οὐκ ἔγνω*); "Both now and ever...": the first Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; "Glory...": of the Triodion; "Both now and ever...": **"Gabriel announces"** (*Εὐαγγελίζεται ὁ Γαβριήλ*); the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Triodion, that of the Forefeast, and Dismissal.

units.english_text: 30.    If the Feast occurs on Monday of the 5th Week [the printed text adds: "and the 6th Week", which is a typographical error; it must be the 5th Week, since Situations 11–15 treat the intervening days]: on Saturday at Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the reading of the Psalter [Kathisma 1, Pss. 1–8 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant 4 Resurrection Stichira, 3 of the Forefeast, and 3 of the Triodion; "Glory...": **"A tongue which she knew not"** (*Γλῶσσαν ἣν οὐκ ἔγνω*); "Both now and ever...": the first Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; "Glory...": of the Triodion; "Both now and ever...": **"Gabriel announces"** (*Εὐαγγελίζεται ὁ Γαβριήλ*); the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Triodion, that of the Forefeast, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Doxology, "Today salvation." Then follows the Liturgy of Saint Basil, in which we sing the Typika and the Beatitudes. Kontakion "Through the descent of the Holy Spirit," Apostolos and Gospel of the Sunday, Commun- ion Hymn "Praise," "We have seen the [true] Light" and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 31.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon and the Triadic hymn: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); the Trisagion Prayers, the Forefeast Dismissal Troparion, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Triodion, and that of the Forefeast; the Psalter and the Amomos [Kathisma 17, Ps. 118 LXX]. The Resurrection Kathismata, the Evlogitaria, the Anavathmoi, and the Prokeimenon of the Tone, then the Hypakoe (canonically, the Hypakoe precedes the Anavathmoi). Canons: that of the Resurrection and that of the Forefeast, with the Verse: "Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee." After the 3rd Ode, the Forefeast Kathisma: **"Today the entire creation"** (*Σήμερον ἅπασα*) once; after the 6th Ode, the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, the Menologion, and the Synaxarion of the Triodion. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*), and the entire order of the Sunday Matins Gospel as prescribed for the Sundays of the Triodion; then **"More honorable than the Cherubim"**. Exapostilaria: the Resurrection Exapostilarion, that of the Triodion, and that of the Forefeast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Forefeast: **"Having compassion on His handiwork, the Creator"** (*Κατοικτιρήσας τῷ πλάσματι ὁ πλάστης*); "Glory...": of the Triodion; "Both now and ever...": **"Most blessed art thou"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); Great Doxology, **"Today is salvation"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*), and following in order the Divine Liturgy of Saint Basil the Great, in which the Typika and the Beatitudes are sung. Kontakion: **"Upon the descent of the All-Holy Spirit"** (*Ἐπελεύσει Πνεύματος τοῦ Παναγίου*); Epistle and Gospel of the Sunday; Communion Verse: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον ἐκ τῶν οὐρανῶν*, Ps. 148:1 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 32.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ ἑορτὴ τῇ Τετάρτῃ τῆς Ε΄ ἑβδομάδος, τῇ Δευτέρᾳ πρωῒ ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακόν, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν τὰ γ΄ τῆς σειρᾶς τοῦ Τριῳδίου Προσόμοια, καὶ τὰ γ΄ Προεόρτια Κεκρυμμένον μυστήριον, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Εὐαγγελίζεται ὁ Γαβριήλ, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τῆς ἡμέρας. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ δύο τοῦ Τριῳδίου Ἰδιόμελα Ὡς ὁ περιπεσών, τὸ Ἀποσφαλέντες ἐκ παραβάσεως, καὶ τὸ Μαρτυρικόν· εἶτα τὰ κατ᾿ ἀλφάβητον Στιχηρὰ Ἅπας ὁ βίος μου, ὧν ὁ Στίχος Δόξα, σοι, ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν, δόξα σοι, μέχρι τέλους· Νῦν ἀπολύεις, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Θεοτόκε παρθένε μετὰ Μενοιῶν καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 33.    Τὸ ἑσπέρας τῆς Τετάρτης, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακόν, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα τὰ γ΄ τῆς ἑορτῆς Προσόμοια καὶ γ΄ τοῦ Ἀρχαγγέλου· Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Ἀπεστάλη ἐξ οὐρανοῦ, Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον τῆς ἡμέρας. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ γ΄ τῆς ἑορτῆς Ἰδιόμελα, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Σήμερον χαρᾶς Εὐαγγέλια, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον ἐκ τρίτου καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 32.    If the Feast occurs on Wednesday of the 5th Week, on Monday morning at Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm, at "Lord, I have cried"
units.english_cohort_translation: 32.    If the Feast occurs on Wednesday of the 5th Week: on Monday morning at Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant the 3 Prosomia of the order of the Triodion, and the 3 Forefeast Prosomia: **"A hidden mystery"** (*Κεκρυμμένον μυστήριον*); "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"Gabriel announces"** (*Εὐαγγελίζεται ὁ Γαβριήλ*). Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Readings of the day [Genesis 19:1–14; Proverbs 15:20 – 16:9]. At the Aposticha: the 2 Idiomela of the Triodion: **"As one who hath fallen among thieves"** (*Ὡς ὁ περιπεσών*) and **"Having stumbled through transgression"** (*Ἀποσφαλέντες ἐκ παραβάσεως*), and the Martyrikon; then the Alphabetical Stichira: **"All my life"** (*Ἅπας ὁ βίος μου*), with the Verse: "Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee" unto the end. Then **"Lord, now lettest Thou Thy servant depart"** (*Νῦν ἀπολύεις*, Luke 2:29–32), the Trisagion Prayers, **"Rejoice, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Θεοτόκε Παρθένε*) with prostrations, and Dismissal.

units.english_cohort_translation: On Tuesday morning, the Office of the Paramony is chanted as prescribed in Situation One, § 2. At the Aposticha: the Idiomelon: **"My wounded soul"** (*Τὴν τετραυματισμένην μου ψυχήν*) and the Martyrikon; "Glory... units.slavonic_diplomatic: On Tuesday morning, the Service of the Eve is celebrated as prescribed in Situation One, Paragraph 2. At the Aposticha: the Idiomelon "My wounded soul," and the Hymn to the Martyrs, Glory, Now and ever, "The language I knew not." Then "It is good to confess." The Trisagion.
units.english_cohort_translation: **The Apodosis** 33.    On Wednesday evening, following the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant the 3 Prosomia of the Feast and 3 of the Archangel; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"He was sent from heaven"** (*Ἀπεστάλη ἐξ οὐρανοῦ*). Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon of the day. At the Aposticha: the 3 Idiomela of the Feast; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"Today are the glad tidings of joy"** (*Σήμερον χαρᾶς εὐαγγέλια*); the Dismissal Troparion three times, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_incipit: Εἶτα ἀντὶ τῆς ζ΄ Ὠδῆς, οἱ
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Εἶτα ἀντὶ τῆς ζ΄ Ὠδῆς, οἱ ἐν τῷ Τριῳδίῳ Μακαρισμοὶ μετὰ Στίχου Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός, ἐλέησόν με· ἡ η΄ καὶ θ΄ Ὠδὴ τοῦ Ἀρχαγγέλου καὶ τὰ Τριῴδια τῆς η΄ Ὠδῆς καὶ τῆς θ΄. Εἶτα Αἰνοῦμεν, εὐλογοῦμεν καὶ ὁ Εἱρμὸς Ὃν στρατιαί· μετὰ Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, τὸ Ἀσπόρου συλλήψεως, τὸ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, τὸ Φωταγωγικόν, τὸ Σοὶ δόξα πρέπει καὶ μετὰ τὴν Ἐκτενῆ, τὸ Ἰδιόμελον τῶν Ἀποστίχων Ταῖς λῃ- στρικαῖς ἐφόδοις δίς, καὶ τὸ Μαρτυρικόν.    Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Εὐφραινέσθωσαν οἱ οὐρανοί, Ἀγαθὸν τὸ ἐξομολογεῖσθαι τῷ Κυρίῳ, τὸ Τρισάγιον, Ἐν τῷ Ναῷ ἑστῶτες, τὸ Κύριε ἐλέησον μ΄, Ὁ ὢν εὐλογητός, τὸ Ἐπουράνιε Βασιλεῦ, τὰς τρεῖς Μετανοίας (ἐδῶ ὑπονοεῖται ἡ Προσευχὴ τοῦ Ἁγίου Ἐφραίμ)·
units.english_cohort_translation: Στιχολογία τῶν θ΄ Ὠδῶν καὶ ἡ α΄ καὶ γ΄ Ὠδὴ τοῦ Κανόνος τοῦ Ἀρχαγγέλου, ὁ Εἱρμός, ἡ Αἴτησις καὶ τὰ Καθίσματα τῆς γ΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Ἀρχαγγέλου, εἶτα ἡ δ΄ Ὠδὴ μετὰ τοῦ Τριῳδίου καὶ ἡ ε΄ καὶ ἡ ς΄ Ὠδὴ τοῦ Ἀρχαγγέλου· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ ὁ Εἱρμός, ἡ Αἴτησις, τὸ Κοντάκιον Ψυχή μου, ψυχή μου, τὸ Μηνολόγιον καὶ τὸ ὑπόμνημα τοῦ Τριῳδίου. Εἶτα ἀντὶ τῆς ζ΄ Ὠδῆς, οἱ ἐν τῷ Τριῳδίῳ Μακαρισμοὶ μετὰ Στίχου Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός, ἐλέησόν με· ἡ η΄ καὶ θ΄ Ὠδὴ τοῦ Ἀρχαγγέλου καὶ τὰ Τριῴδια τῆς η΄ Ὠδῆς καὶ τῆς θ΄. Εἶτα Αἰνοῦμεν, εὐλογοῦμεν καὶ ὁ Εἱρμὸς Ὃν στρατιαί· μετὰ Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, τὸ Ἀσπόρου συλλήψεως, τὸ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, τὸ Φωταγωγικόν, τὸ Σοὶ δόξα πρέπει καὶ μετὰ τὴν Ἐκτενῆ, τὸ Ἰδιόμελον τῶν Ἀποστίχων Ταῖς λῃστρικαῖς ἐφόδοις δίς, καὶ τὸ Μαρτυρικόν.    Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Εὐφραινέσθωσαν οἱ οὐρανοί, Ἀγαθὸν τὸ ἐξομολογεῖσθαι τῷ Κυρίῳ, τὸ Τρισάγιον, Ἐν τῷ Ναῷ ἑστῶτες, τὸ Κύριε ἐλέησον μ΄, Ὁ ὢν εὐλογητός, τὸ Ἐπουράνιε Βασιλεῦ, τὰς τρεῖς Μετανοίας (ἐδῶ ὑπονοεῖται ἡ Προσευχὴ τοῦ Ἁγίου Ἐφραίμ)· καὶ ἀναγινώσκονται αἱ Ὧραι λιταί, Ἀπολυτίκιον Τῶν οὐρανίων στρατιῶν καὶ Κοντάκιον Ψυχή μου, ψυχή μου μετὰ τὴν θ΄ οἱ Μακαρισμοί, καὶ ἄρχεται ὁ Ἑσπερινός.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 35.    Εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινὸν μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὰ Πρὸς Κύριον εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Αὐτεξουσίως ἐξεδύθην δίς, καὶ τὸ Μαρτυρικὸν ἅπαξ, καὶ γ΄ Προσόμοια τοῦ Ἀρχαγγέλου. Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Τῷ ἕκτῳ μηνί, Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὰ δύο Ἀναγνώσματα τοῦ Τριῳδίου, καὶ τὸ ἐν τῷ Μηναίῳ Κύριος ἔκτησέ με, τὸ Κατευθυνθήτω, καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία τῶν Προηγιασμένων, Κοινωνικὸν Γεύσασθε.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Small Compline; after "Glory in the highest," the Canon was sung; after the 9th Ode, the Irmos "Of conception without seed." The Trisagion, the
units.english_cohort_translation: Biblical Odes [Stichologia of the 9 Odes], and the 1st and 3rd Odes of the Canon of the Archangel, the Heirmos, the Litany, and the Kathismata of the 3rd Ode of the Archangel; then the 4th Ode with that of the Triodion, and the 5th and 6th Odes of the Archangel; after the 6th Ode, the Heirmos, the Litany, the Kontakion: **"My soul, my soul"** (*Ψυχή μου, ψυχή μου*), the Menologion, and the Synaxarion of the Triodion. Then, instead of the 7th Ode, the Beatitudes in the Triodion with the Verse: **"Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy on me"** (*Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός, ἐλέησόν με*); then the 8th and 9th Odes of the Archangel, and the Triodia of the 8th and 9th Odes. Then **"We praise, bless, and worship the Lord"** (*Αἰνοῦμεν, εὐλογοῦμεν*) and the Heirmos: **"Whom the hosts of heaven glorify"** (*Ὃν στρατιαὶ οὐρανῶν*); following **"More honorable than the Cherubim"**, we chant the Heirmos: **"Of conception without seed"** (*Ἀσπόρου συλλήψεως*). Then **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*), the Exaposteilarion, **"To Thee belongs glory"** (*Σοὶ δόξα πρέπει*), and following the Litany, the Idiomelon of the Aposticha: **"By the assaults of thieves"** (*Ταῖς λῃστρικαῖς ἐφόδοις*) twice, and the Martyrikon; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"Let the heavens rejoice"** (*Εὐφραινέσθωσαν οἱ οὐρανοί*); **"It is good to give thanks unto the Lord"** (*Ἀγαθὸν τὸ ἐξομολογεῖσθαι*, Ps. 91:2 LXX), the Trisagion Prayers, **"Standing in the temple of Thy glory"** (*Ἐν τῷ ναῷ ἑστῶτες*), **"Lord, have mercy"** (40 times), **"He that is blessed"** (*Ὁ ὢν εὐλογητός*), **"O Heavenly King"** (*Ἐπουράνιε Βασιλεῦ*), the three Great Prostrations (here the Prayer of Saint Ephraim is understood); and the plain Hours are read. Dismissal Troparion: **"O commanders of the heavenly hosts"** (*Τῶν οὐρανίων στρατιῶν*) and Kontakion: **"My soul, my soul"** (*Ψυχή μου, ψυχή μου*); after the 9th Hour, the Beatitudes, and then Vespers begins.

units.english_cohort_translation: 35.    At Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and "Unto the Lord" [Kathisma 18, Pss. 119–133 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant the Idiomelon: **"Of my own free will was I stripped"** (*Αὐτεξουσίως ἐξεδύθην*) twice, the Martyrikon once, and 3 Prosomia of the Archangel; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"In the sixth month"** (*Τῷ ἕκτῳ μηνί*). Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the two Readings from the Triodion [Genesis 18:20–33; Proverbs 16:17 – 17:17], and the one from the Menaion: **"The Lord created me"** (*Κύριος ἔκτησέ με*, Proverbs 8:22–30). Then **"Let my prayer arise"** (*Κατευθυνθήτω*, Ps. 140:2 LXX), and the rest of the Liturgy of the Presanctified Gifts follows in order; Communion Verse: **"O taste and see that the Lord is good"** (*Γεύσασθε καὶ ἴδετε*, Ps. 33:9 LXX).

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Thursday morning, the Matins and the Pre-sanctified Liturgy were cel- ebrated as above in Paragraphs 34, 35.
units.english_cohort_translation: *Note*: In 1881, during the patriarchate of Joachim III, the Feast of the Annunciation occurred on Wednesday of the 5th Week, and by Synodical decision, the Great Canon was celebrated in this manner: on Wednesday evening, following the complete Dismissal of the Vespers of the Apodosis of the Feast, immediately **"Blessed is our God"** (*Εὐλογητὸς ὁ Θεός*), and Small Compline; after **"Glory to God in the highest"** (*Δόξα ἐν ὑψίστοις*), the Great Canon was sung; after the 9th Ode, the Heirmos: **"Of conception without seed"** (*Ἀσπόρου συλλήψεως*). The Trisagion Prayers, the Kontakion: **"My soul, my soul"** (*Ψυχή μου, ψυχή μου*); **"Lord, have mercy"** (40 times), **"Thou Who at all times and at every hour"** (*Ὁ ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ*), **"O Lady, Bride of God, spotless, undefiled"** (*Ἄσπιλε, ἀμόλυντε*), etc., and Dismissal. On Thursday morning, Matins and the Presanctified Liturgy were celebrated as above in §§ 34 and 35.[^298]

units.english_text: *Note*: In 1881, during the patriarchate of Joachim III, the Feast of the Annunciation occurred on Wednesday of the 5th Week, and by Synodical decision, the Great Canon was celebrated in this manner: on Wednesday evening, following the complete Dismissal of the Vespers of the Apodosis of the Feast, immediately **"Blessed is our God"** (*Εὐλογητὸς ὁ Θεός*), and Small Compline; after **"Glory to God in the highest"** (*Δόξα ἐν ὑψίστοις*), the Great Canon was sung; after the 9th Ode, the Heirmos: **"Of conception without seed"** (*Ἀσπόρου συλλήψεως*). The Trisagion Prayers, the Kontakion: **"My soul, my soul"** (*Ψυχή μου, ψυχή μου*); **"Lord, have mercy"** (40 times), **"Thou Who at all times and at every hour"** (*Ὁ ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ*), **"O Lady, Bride of God, spotless, undefiled"** (*Ἄσπιλε, ἀμόλυντε*), etc., and Dismissal. On Thursday morning, Matins and the Presanctified Liturgy were celebrated as above in §§ 34 and 35.[^298]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 36.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ ἑορτὴ τῇ Πέμπτῃ τοῦ Μεγάλου Κανόνος, τῇ Τρίτῃ πρωῒ ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα τὰ τῆς σειρᾶς τοῦ Τριῳδίου γ΄ Προσόμοια, καὶ τὰ γ΄ Προεόρτια. Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Εὐαγγελίζεται ὁ Γαβριήλ, Φῶς ἱλαρὸν καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τῆς ἡμέρας. τὰ δύο Ἰδιόμελα τῶν Ἀποστίχων, τὸ Μαρτυρικὸν καὶ τὰ κατ᾿ ἀλφάβητον Στιχηρὰ Ἅπας ὁ βίος μου, ὁ Στίχος Δόξα σοι ὁ Θεός, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, Θεοτόκε Παρθένε, Κύριε ἐλέησον μ΄, Ἐπουράνιε Βασιλεῦ, τὰς γ΄ Μετανοίας, (ὑπονοεῖται ἐδῶ ἡ Προσευχὴ τοῦ Ἁγίου Ἐφραίμ) τὴν εὐχὴν Παναγία Τριάς, τὸ Εὐλογήσω τὸν Κύριον, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 37.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ ἑορτὴ τῇ Παρασκευῇ τῆς Ε΄ ἑβδομάδος, τῇ Τετάρτῃ πρωῒ ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὰ Πρὸς Κύριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ἱστῶμεν Στίχους ιστ΄, ἀρχόμενοι ἀπὸ τοῦ Στίχου Ἐν ὁδῷ ταύτῃ ᾗ ἐπορευόμην, καὶ ψάλλομεν τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Τοῖς τῶν ἐμῶν λογισμῶν δίς, καὶ τὸ Μαρτυρικὸν ἅπαξ, εἶτα ἐκ τῶν κατ᾿ ἀλφάβητον Στιχηρῶν Ἅπας ὁ βίος μου ι΄, καὶ γ΄ Προεόρτια· Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Εὐαγγελίζεται ὁ Γαβριήλ. Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τὸ Κατευθυνθήτω, καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία τῶν Προηγιασμένων.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Alphabetic Stichira "I have wasted all my life," the Verse "Glory to You, O God"; then the Trisagion, "Theotokos, Virgin" "Lord, have mercy" (40 times), "O heavenly King," the three Prostrations {this is understood to mean the Prayer of Saint Ephraim}, the Prayer "All-holy Trinity," the "I will bless the Lord," and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 36.    If the Feast occurs on Thursday of the Great Canon: on Tuesday morning at Vespers, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant the 3 Prosomia of the order of the Triodion, and the 3 Forefeast Prosomia; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"Gabriel announces"** (*Εὐαγγελίζεται ὁ Γαβριήλ*). Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Readings of the day [Genesis 15:1–15; Proverbs 15:7–19]. The 2 Idiomela of the Aposticha, the Martyrikon, and the Alphabetical Stichira: **"All my life"** (*Ἅπας ὁ βίος μου*), with the Verse: "Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee"; then the Trisagion Prayers, **"Rejoice, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Θεοτόκε Παρθένε*), **"Lord, have mercy"** (40 times), **"O Heavenly King"** (*Ἐπουράνιε Βασιλεῦ*), the three Great Prostrations (here the Prayer of Saint Ephraim is understood), the Prayer: **"All-Holy Trinity"** (*Παναγία Τριάς*), **"I will bless the Lord at all times"** (*Εὐλογήσω τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 33:2 LXX), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 37.    If the Feast occurs on Friday of the 5th Week, on Wednesday morning at Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm and "To the Lord," at "Lord, I have cried," we insert 16 verses beginning with the Verse "On the road upon which I was walking" {Psalm 141:4} and we sing the Idiomelon "In my thoughts" twice and the Hymn to the Martyrs once, then from the
units.english_cohort_translation: 37.    If the Feast occurs on Friday of the 5th Week: on Wednesday morning at Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and "Unto the Lord" [Kathisma 18, Pss. 119–133 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we insert 16 verses beginning from the verse: **"In the way wherein I walked"** (*Ἐν ὁδῷ ταύτῃ ᾗ ἐπορευόμην*, Ps. 141:4 LXX), and we chant the Idiomelon: **"To the movements of my thoughts"** (*Τοῖς τῶν ἐμῶν λογισμῶν*) twice, and the Martyrikon once; then 10 of the Alphabetical Stichira: **"All my life"** (*Ἅπας ὁ βίος μου*), and 3 of the Forefeast; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"Gabriel announces"** (*Εὐαγγελίζεται ὁ Γαβριήλ*). Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Readings of the Triodion [Genesis 17:1–9; Proverbs 15:20 – 16:9], **"Let my prayer arise"** (*Κατευθυνθήτω*, Ps. 140:2 LXX), and the rest of the Liturgy of the Presanctified Gifts follows in order.

units.slavonic_incipit: ὁ Εἱρμός, ἡ Αἴτησις, τὸ Κοντάκιον
units.slavonic_diplomatic: ὁ Εἱρμός, ἡ Αἴτησις, τὸ Κοντάκιον Ἐπελεύσει Πνεύματος καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον· εἶτα οἱ ἐν τῷ Τριῳδίῳ Μακαρισμοὶ καὶ τοῦ προεορτίου Κανόνος ἡ ζ΄ Ὠδή, ὡς καὶ ἡ η΄ καὶ θ΄ καὶ αἱ τοῦ Τριῳδίου η΄ καὶ θ΄, Αἰνοῦμεν, εὐλογοῦμεν, ὁ Εἱρμὸς τῆς η΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Τριῳδίου, καὶ μετὰ Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον Ὡς δῶρα προεόρτια, τὸ Σοὶ δόξα πρέπει· μετὰ τὴν Ἐκτενῆ, τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Ταῖς λῃ- στρικαῖς ἐφόδοις δίς, καὶ τὸ Μαρτυρικὸν ἅπαξ. Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Γλῶσσαν ἣν οὐκ ἔγνω, τὸ Ἀγαθὸν τὸ ἐξομολογεῖσθαι, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον Σήμερον τῆς Παγκοσμίου, τὸ Κύριε ἐλέησον μ΄. Ὁ ὢν εὐλογητός, ἡ εὐχὴ Ἐπουράνιε Βασιλεῦ καὶ αἱ Ὧραι λιταί, λεγομένων ἐν ἑκάστῃ Ἀπολυτικίου καὶ Κοντακίου Προεορτίων, μετὰ τὴν εὐχὴν τῆς στ΄ Ὥρας, Ἀπόλυσις.
units.english_cohort_translation: 38. Κανόνος ἡ ζ΄ Ὠδή, ὡς καὶ ἡ η΄ καὶ θ΄ καὶ αἱ τοῦ Τριῳδίου η΄ καὶ θ΄,
Αἰνοῦμεν, εὐλογοῦμεν, ὁ Εἱρμὸς τῆς η΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Τριῳδίου, καὶ μετὰ
Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον Ὡς δῶρα προεόρτια, τὸ
Σοὶ δόξα πρέπει· μετὰ τὴν Ἐκτενῆ, τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Ταῖς λῃ-

ἐλέησον μ΄. Ὁ ὢν εὐλογητός, ἡ εὐχὴ Ἐπουράνιε Βασιλεῦ
καὶ αἱ Ὧραι λιταί, λεγομένων ἐν ἑκάστῃ Ἀπολυτικίου καὶ

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 39.    Τῇ Παρασκευῇ ἑσπέρας ἀποδίδοται ἡ ἑορτή, ὡς διετάχθη ἐν περιπτώσει Γ΄ § 18. Μετὰ τὸ Νῦν ἀπολύεις ψάλλεται Τὸ προσταχθὲν μυστικῶς ἀργῶς δίς, καὶ τὸ γ΄ σύντομον καὶ ἀναγινώσκεται ἡ α΄ Στάσις τῶν Οἴκων, εἶτα ψάλλεται ὁ Κανὼν Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου εἰς ς΄· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς ψάλλεται τὸ Τῇ ὑπερμάχῳ ἀργῶς καὶ ἀναγινώσκεται ἡ β΄ Στάσις, ἔπειτα ἄρχεται ὁ β΄ Χορὸς τὴν δ΄ τοῦ Κανόνος Ὠδήν· μετὰ τὴν ς΄ Ὠδήν, τὸ Τῇ ὑπερμάχῳ σύντομον καὶ ἀναγινώσκεται ἡ γ΄ τῶν Οἴκων Στάσις, ἀκολούθως ψάλλεται ἡ ζ΄, η΄ καὶ θ΄ τοῦ Κανόνος Ὠδή, ἀπὸ δὲ τῆς θ΄ ὁ α΄ Χορὸς Τῇ ὑπερμάχῳ σύντομον, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον Σήμερον τῆς σωτηρίας ἐκ τρίτου καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.english_cohort_translation: 38.    On Thursday morning after the Midnight Service, the Hexapsalmos, **"Alleluia"** (*Ἀλληλούϊα*) with the Verses: **"From the night my spirit seeks Thee early, O God"** (*Ἐκ νυκτὸς ὀρθρίζει τὸ πνεῦμά μου*, Isaiah 26:9 LXX), the Psalter, the penitential Kathismata of the Octoechos, and those of the Triodion. Then Psalm 50 [LXX], the chanting of the 9 Biblical Odes and the Forefeast Canon: **"The world joyously"** (*Ὁ κόσμος περιχαρῶς*), the 1st and 3rd Odes, the Litany and the Forefeast Kathisma of the 3rd Ode: **"Today all"** (*Σήμερον ἅπασα*), then the 4th Ode of the Triodion after the 4th of the Forefeast, and the 5th and 6th Odes of the same; the Heirmos, the Litany, the Kontakion: **"Upon the descent of the All-Holy Spirit"** (*Ἐπελεύσει Πνεύματος τοῦ Παναγίου*) and the Menologion; then the Beatitudes in the Triodion and the 7th Ode of the Forefeast Canon, as also the 8th and 9th Odes and those of the Triodion; **"We praise, bless, and worship the Lord"** (*Αἰνοῦμεν, εὐλογοῦμεν*), and the Heirmos of the 8th Ode of the Triodion; following **"More honorable than the Cherubim"**, the Exapostilarion: **"As forefeast gifts"** (*Ὡς δῶρα προεόρτια*), **"To Thee belongs glory"** (*Σοὶ δόξα πρέπει*), and following the Augmented Litany, the Idiomelon of the Aposticha: **"By the assaults of thieves"** (*Ταῖς λῃστρικαῖς ἐφόδοις*) twice, and the Martyrikon once; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"A tongue which she knew not"** (*Γλῶσσαν ἣν οὐκ ἔγνω*). Then **"It is good to give thanks unto the Lord"** (*Ἀγαθὸν τὸ ἐξομολογεῖσθαι*, Ps. 91:2 LXX), the Trisagion Prayers, the Forefeast Dismissal Troparion: **"Today is the prelude of universal joy"** (*Σήμερον τῆς παγκοσμίου χαρᾶς*), **"Lord, have mercy"** (40 times), **"He that is blessed"** (*Ὁ ὢν εὐλογητός*), the Prayer: **"O Heavenly King"** (*Ἐπουράνιε Βασιλεῦ*), and the plain Hours are read, with the Forefeast Dismissal Troparion and Kontakion recited in each one of the Hours; after the Prayer of the 6th Hour, Dismissal.

units.english_cohort_translation: **The Apodosis** 39.    On Friday evening, we celebrate the Apodosis of the Feast as prescribed in Situation Three, § 18. After **"Lord, now lettest Thou Thy servant depart"** (*Νῦν ἀπολύεις*, Luke 2:29–32), we sing: **"Taking knowledge of the secret command"** (*Τὸ προσταχθὲν μυστικῶς*) twice slowly and a third time quickly, and the First Stasis of the Ikoi is read. Then we chant the Canon: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*) to 6; after the 3rd Ode, **"To thee, the Champion Leader"** (*Τῇ ὑπερμάχῳ*) is chanted slowly and the Second Stasis is read; then the Second Choir begins the 4th Ode of the Canon; after the 6th Ode, **"To thee, the Champion Leader"** (*Τῇ ὑπερμάχῳ*) quickly, and the Third Stasis of the Ikoi is read; following this, the 7th, 8th, and 9th Odes of the Canon are chanted; after the 9th Ode, the First Choir chants **"To thee, the Champion Leader"** (*Τῇ ὑπερμάχῳ*) quickly, the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion: **"Today is the fountainhead of our salvation"** (*Σήμερον τῆς σωτηρίας ἡμῶν τὸ κεφάλαιον*) three times, and Dismissal.[^300]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 40.    Τῷ Σαββάτῳ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον μετὰ τὸ Μεσονυκτικόν, Τὸ προσταχθὲν μυστικῶς καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὸ Τροπάριον Τὸ προσταχθὲν δὶς [πιθανὸν τυπογραφικὸν λάθος διότι τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον μίας μόνον ἑορτῆς ψάλλεται τρεῖς φορὲς σχεδὸν πάντοτε, π.χ. τοῦ Εὐαγγελισμοῦ, τῶν Θεοφανείων, τῶν Χριστουγέννων, τοῦ Σαββάτου τοῦ Λαζάρου, τῆς Πεντηκοστῆς], καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον [τὸ 16ον Κάθισμα], τὸ ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κάθισμα Ὁ μέγας Γαβριὴλ καὶ ἕτερον Τῶν ᾀσμάτων [ὀρθότερον ἀσωμάτων] λειτουργῶν [ζήτει τῇ 26ῃ Μαρτίου], ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμός, ὁ Κανὼν Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἀρχαγγέλου· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κάθισμα Ὁ μέγας στρατηγὸς [ζήτει εἰς τὴν ἑορτήν]· ἐν τῇ ς΄ Ὠδῇ λέγονται καὶ τὰ Μαρτυρικὰ Τριῴ- δια ὡς καὶ ἐν τῇ ζ΄, η΄ καὶ θ΄· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ τὸ Κοντάκιον Τῇ ὑπερμάχῳ καὶ ὁ Οἶκος Ἄγγελος πρωτοστάτης, τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῆς ἡμέρας καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τῆς Ἀκαθίστου· αἱ Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου καὶ στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν. Καταβασία Ἅπας γηγενής. Ἐξαποστειλάριον Τὸ ἀπ᾿ αἰῶνος σήμερον δίς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τὰ Προσόμοια Κεκρυμμένον μυστήριον εἰς δ΄. Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Γλῶσσαν ἣν οὐκ ἔγνω, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ Τὸ προσταχθὲν μυστικῶς.

Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὸ Τροπάριον Τὸ προσταχθὲν δὶς [πιθανὸν τυπογραφικὸν λάθος διότι τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον μίας μόνον ἑορτῆς ψάλλεται τρεῖς φορὲς σχεδὸν πάντοτε, π.χ. τοῦ Εὐαγγελισμοῦ, τῶν Θεοφανείων, τῶν Χριστουγέννων, τοῦ Σαββάτου τοῦ Λαζάρου, τῆς Πεντηκοστῆς], καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον [τὸ 16ον Κάθισμα], τὸ ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κάθισμα Ὁ μέγας Γαβριὴλ καὶ ἕτερον Τῶν ᾀσμάτων [ὀρθότερον ἀσωμάτων] λειτουργῶν [ζήτει τῇ 26ῃ Μαρτίου], ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμός, ὁ Κανὼν Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἀρχαγγέλου· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κάθισμα Ὁ μέγας στρατηγὸς [ζήτει εἰς τὴν ἑορτήν]· ἐν τῇ ς΄ Ὠδῇ λέγονται καὶ τὰ Μαρτυρικὰ Τριῴδια ὡς καὶ ἐν τῇ ζ΄, η΄ καὶ θ΄· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ τὸ Κοντάκιον Τῇ ὑπερμάχῳ καὶ ὁ Οἶκος Ἄγγελος πρωτοστάτης, τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῆς ἡμέρας καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τῆς Ἀκαθίστου· αἱ Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου καὶ στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν. Καταβασία Ἅπας γηγενής. Ἐξαποστειλάριον Τὸ ἀπ᾿ αἰῶνος σήμερον δίς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τὰ Προσόμοια Κεκρυμμένον μυστήριον εἰς δ΄. Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Γλῶσσαν ἣν οὐκ ἔγνω, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ Τὸ προσταχθὲν μυστικῶς.

units.english_cohort_translation: 40.    On Saturday at Matins, following the Midnight Service, **"Taking knowledge of the secret command"** (*Τὸ προσταχθὲν μυστικῶς*) and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparion: **"Taking knowledge of the secret command"** (*Τὸ προσταχθὲν μυστικῶς*) twice [this may be a typographical error, since almost always the Dismissal Troparion of a single feast is sung three times, e.g., Annunciation, Theophany, Nativity, the Saturday of Lazarus, Pentecost], and the Psalter [the 16th Kathisma, Pss. 109–117 LXX]. After the 3rd Ode, the Kathisma: **"The great Gabriel"** (*Ὁ μέγας Γαβριήλ*) and another: **"Of the incorporeal ministers"** (*Τῶν ἀσωμάτων λειτουργῶν*, seek on March 26); Psalm 50 [LXX], the Canon: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*) and that of the Archangel; after the 3rd Ode, the Kathisma: **"The great commander"** (*Ὁ μέγας στρατηγός*, seek in the Feast); at the 6th Ode, we add also the Triodion Canons of the Martyrs, as also at the 7th, 8th, and 9th Odes. After the 6th Ode, the Kontakion: **"To thee, the Champion Leader"** (*Τῇ ὑπερμάχῳ*) and the Ikos: **"A chief angel was sent"** (*Ἄγγελος πρωτοστάτης*), the Menologion of the day, and the Synaxarion of the Akathist. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*), and we chant the biblical ode with **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Katavasia: **"Let every earthborn mortal"** (*Ἅπας γηγενής*). Exapostilarion: **"The mystery hidden from all eternity"** (*Τὸ ἀπ᾿ αἰῶνος σήμερον*) twice. At the Praises: the Prosomia: **"A hidden mystery"** (*Κεκρυμμένον μυστήριον*) to 4 [i.e., repeating the first]; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"A tongue which she knew not"** (*Γλῶσσαν ἣν οὐκ ἔγνω*); Great Doxology, and **"Taking knowledge of the secret command"** (*Τὸ προσταχθὲν μυστικῶς*).

units.english_cohort_translation: 41.    At the Divine Liturgy, the Typika [Pss. 102, 145 LXX] and the Beatitudes, with Troparia from the 3rd and 6th Odes of the Canon of the Theotokos. After the Little Entrance: **"O come, let us worship and bow down before Christ... Who is wonderful in His saints"** (*Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν . . . ὁ ἐν Ἁγίοις θαυμαστός*); **"Taking knowledge of the secret command"** (*Τὸ προσταχθὲν μυστικῶς*), **"To thee, the Champion Leader"** (*Τῇ ὑπερμάχῳ*); Epistle: **"The first tabernacle had ordinances"** (*Εἶχεν ἡ πρώτη σκηνή*, Hebrews 9:1–7), and the Gospel: **"Mary arose"** (*Ἀναστᾶσα Μαριάμ*, Luke 1:39–49, 56). At "Especially": **"Let every earthborn mortal"** (*Ἅπας γηγενής*); Communion Verse: **"I will take the cup of salvation"** (*Ποτήριον σωτηρίου λήψομαι*, Ps. 115:4 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Αὐτεξουσίως ἐξεδύθην δίς, καὶ τὸ Μαρτυρικὸν (Μάρτυρες Κυρίου) ἅπαξ, τὰ τῆς σειρᾶς τοῦ Τριῳδίου γ΄ Προσόμοια (Ἠλούμενος, Κύριε, Σταυρῷ, Νηστείας λαμπρότητι ποτέ, καὶ Τὸν ζωοποιὸν προσκυνοῦντές σου Σταυρόν,) καὶ τὰ δ΄ Προεόρτια [τὸ ὅλον 10 Στιχηρά]. Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Εὐαγγελίζεται ὁ Γαβριήλ, Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρὸν καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τῆς ἡμέρας, τὸ Κατευθυνθήτω, καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία τῶν Προηγιασμένων.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 43.    Τῷ Σαββάτῳ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, Εὐλογητὸς ὁ Θεός, τὸ Τρισάγιον, ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς καὶ ψάλλεται ἡ Λιτή, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον ἐκ τρίτου, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος, τὰ Καθίσματα κατὰ σειρὰν τὸ α΄ καὶ τὸ τελευταῖον ἐκ δευτέρου, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον Εὐαγγελίζεσθε ἡμέραν ἐξ ἡμέρας, τὸ Πᾶσα πνοὴ καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον Ἀναστᾶσα Μαριάμ, ὁ Ν΄ χῦμα, Δόξα, Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου, Καὶ νῦν τὸ αὐτό, Στίχος Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεὸς καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Εὐαγγελίζεται ὁ Γαβριήλ, τὸ Σῶσον ὁ Θεὸς τὸν λαόν σου, καὶ μετὰ τὸ Ἐλέει καὶ οἰκτιρμοῖς ψάλλεται ἀργῶς τὸ Τῇ ὑπερμάχῳ, καὶ ἀναγινώσκεται ἡ α΄ Στάσις τῶν Οἴκων· μετὰ τὸ τέλος, αὖθις τὸ Τῇ ὑπερμάχῳ, ἀργοσύντομον, καὶ ἀναγινώσκεται ἡ β΄ Στάσις, εἶτα ὁ Κανὼν τῆς ἑορτῆς εἰς ἕξ, μετὰ τὴν γ΄ Ὠδήν Τῇ ὑπερμάχῳ, καὶ ἀναγινώσκεται ἡ γ΄ Στάσις, εἰς τὸ τέλος ἡ Αἴτησις καὶ ψάλλεται τὸ Κάθισμα Ὁ λόγος τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ τὸ Ἀπεστάλη Γαβριήλ, εἶτα ἡ δ΄, ε΄ καὶ ς΄ Ὠδὴ τοῦ Κανόνος καὶ μετὰ τὴν Καταβασίαν τῆς ς΄ Ἐβόησε προτυπῶν, Τῇ ὑπερμάχῳ , καὶ ἀναγινώσκεται ἡ δ΄ τῶν Οἴκων Στάσις, ἡ Αἴτησις, τὸ Κοντάκιον, ὁ Οἶκος, τὸ Μηνολόγιον καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τοῦ Τριῳδίου, εἶτα ἡ ζ΄ καὶ η΄ Ὠδὴ τοῦ Κανόνος, καὶ μετὰ τὴν Καταβασίαν τῆς η΄ Ὠδῆς Ἄκουε Κόρη (Παρθένε ἁγνή), Τὴν Θεοτόκον καὶ

units.english_cohort_translation: however, the placement of the readings for the Fifth Week of Great Lent, as found in the Psalter, indicates that rather the 12th Kathisma of the Psalter (Psalms 85–90 [LXX]) should be read at this point]; at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant the Idiomelon: **"Of my own free will was I stripped"** (*Αὐτεξουσίως ἐξεδύθην*) twice, and the Martyrikon: **"O martyrs of the Lord"** (*Μάρτυρες Κυρίου*) once, then the 3 Prosomia from the order of the Triodion: **"Nailed, O Lord, upon the Cross"** (*Ἠλούμενος, Κύριε, Σταυρῷ*), **"Once by the splendor of the fast"** (*Νηστείας λαμπρότητι ποτέ*), and **"Worshipping Thy life-giving Cross"** (*Τὸν ζωοποιὸν προσκυνοῦντές σου Σταυρόν*), and 4 of the Forefeast [making a total of 10 Stichira]; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"Gabriel announces"** (*Εὐαγγελίζεται ὁ Γαβριήλ*). Little Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Readings of the day [Genesis 18:20–33; Proverbs 16:17 – 17:17], **"Let my prayer arise"** (*Κατευθυνθήτω*, Ps. 140:2 LXX), and the rest of the Liturgy of the Presanctified Gifts follows in order.
