units.slavonic_diplomatic: 2.    At Matins, the Canon of the Feast and that of the Saints, the Katavasie of the Feast, “More honorable,” the Exapostilarion of the Saints and that of the Feast. At the Praises: the 4 Stichira of the Saint, Glory of the Saints, Now and ever of the Feast, Great Doxology and the Apolytikion of the Saints. Then follows the Liturgy, in which we chant the Antiphons and Entrance Hymn of Easter. After the Entrance, the Apolytikia of the Feast, of the Saints, of the Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion of the Feast; Apostolos and Gospel of the Saints. At “Especially,” “It is meet,” Communion Hymn “To all the earth,” the Apolytikion “Christ is risen,” “Blessed be the name of the Lord” and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 2.    At Matins, the Canon of the Feast and that of the Saints; the Katavasiai of the Feast; **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*); the Exapostilarion of the Saints and that of the Feast. At the Praises: the 4 Stichira of the Saints; "Glory...": of the Saints; "Both now and ever...": of the Feast; Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion of the Saints. Then follows the Divine Liturgy, in which we chant the Antiphons and Entrance Hymn [Eisodikon] of Pascha. After the Entrance, the Dismissal Troparia: of the Feast, of the Saints, and of the Patron Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion of the Feast; the Epistle and Gospel of the Saints. At "Especially" [Megalynarion], **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Hymn: **"Unto all the earth"** (*Εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν*, Ps. 18:5 LXX); **"Christ is risen"** (*Χριστὸς ἀνέστη*), **"Blessed be the name of the Lord"** (*Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου*, Ps. 112:2 LXX), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 3.    If the Feast of the Saints* occurs on the Sunday of the Samaritan Woman, the Service of Mid-Pentecost is omitted; only the Apolytikion is sung at Vespers and at Matins, as well as at the Entrance in the Liturgy. The Services are done as follows: On Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter, at “Lord, I have cried,” we sing 4 Resurrection Stichira, 2 of the Samaritan Woman and 4 of the Saints. Glory of the Saints, Now and ever of the Samaritan Woman. Entrance, “O Gladsome Light,” the Prokimenon, and the Readings of the Saints. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichiron of the Mode and “A sacred Pascha,” Glory of the Saints, Now and ever of the Samaritan Woman. Apolytikia: of the Resurrection, of the Saints, and of the Feast and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 3.    If the Feast of the Saints occurs on the Sunday of the Samaritan Woman, the service of Mid-Pentecost is omitted; only the Dismissal Troparion is sung at Vespers and at Matins, as well as after the Entrance in the Divine Liturgy. The services are performed as follows: On Saturday evening, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the Psalter reading, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we sing 4 Resurrection Stichira, 2 of the Samaritan Woman, and 4 of the Saints; "Glory...": of the Saints; "Both now and ever...": of the Samaritan Woman. Little Entrance, **"Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Readings of the Saints. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichiron of the Tone and the Paschal Stichira: **"A sacred Pascha"** (*Πάσχα ἱερόν*); "Glory...": of the Saints; "Both now and ever...": of the Samaritan Woman. The Dismissal Troparia: of the Resurrection, of the Saints, and of the Feast, and Dismissal.

If the Feast of the Saints occurs on the Sunday of the Samaritan Woman, the service of Mid-Pentecost is omitted; only the Dismissal Troparion is sung at Vespers and at Matins, as well as after the Entrance in the Divine Liturgy. The services are performed as follows: On Saturday evening, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the Psalter reading, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we sing 4 Resurrection Stichira, 2 of the Samaritan Woman, and 4 of the Saints; "Glory...": of the Saints; "Both now and ever...": of the Samaritan Woman. Little Entrance, **"Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Readings of the Saints. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichiron of the Tone and the Paschal Stichira: **"A sacred Pascha"** (*Πάσχα ἱερόν*); "Glory...": of the Saints; "Both now and ever...": of the Samaritan Woman. The Dismissal Troparia: of the Resurrection, of the Saints, and of the Feast, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_incipit: Θεοτοκίου, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ τοῦ
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Θεοτοκίου, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ τοῦ ἤχου, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον· ὁ Κανὼν τοῦ Πάσχα, ὁ τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὰ β΄ Θεοτοκία· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος τῆς Σαμαρείτιδος, εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τῆς Σαμαρείτιδος· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τοῦ Ἁγίου, τὸ Μηνολόγιον, καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τῆς Σαμαρείτιδος, αἱ Καταβασίαι τοῦ Πάσχα καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα ψάλλεται ἡ θ΄ τοῦ Πάσχα καὶ ἡ τοῦ Ἁγίου μετὰ τῶν β΄ Θεοτοκίων καὶ τῶν Μεγαλυναρίων, Ἐξαποστειλάριον τοῦ Πάσχα, τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τῆς Σαμαρείτιδος. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα γ΄, τοῦ Ἁγίου γ΄ καὶ τὰ Πάσχα ἱερόν. Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν τῆς Σαμαρείτιδος, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία.

Ἀπόστολος τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως, Ὁ Ἄγγελος ἐβόα . . . Φωτίζου φωτίζου, Κοινωνικὸν τοῦ Πάσχα, Χριστὸς ἀνέστη, Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: The Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi of the Mode, the Anavathmi, and the Prokimenon. The Canon of Pascha, the Canon of the Saints and the two Theotokia. After the 3rd Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Samaritan Woman, then the Kathisma of the Saints and that of the Samaritan Woman; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saints, the Minologion, and the Postscript of the Samaritan Woman. The Katavasie of Pascha, and the entire order of the Matins Gospel; then the 9th Ode of Pascha, then the 9th Ode of the Saints, and the 2 Theotokia with the Megalynaria. The Exapostilaria: of Pascha, of the Saints, and of the Samaritan Woman. At the Praises: 3 Resurrection Stichira, 3 Stichira of the Saints, and the Stichira “A sacred Pascha,” Glory of the Saints, Now and ever of the Samaritan Woman, Great Doxology and “Today salvation.”
units.english_cohort_translation: ...its Theotokion. The Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe of the Tone, the Anavathmoi, and the Prokeimenon. The Canon of Pascha, that of the Saints, and the two Theotokia. After Ode 3, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Samaritan Woman, then the Sessional Hymn of the Saints and that of the Samaritan Woman; after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saints, the Menologion, and the Sunday Synaxarion [Hypomnema] of the Samaritan Woman. The Katavasiai of Pascha, and the entire order of the Matins Gospel; then are sung Ode 9 of Pascha and that of the Saints with the 2 Theotokia and the Megalynaria. The Exapostilaria: of Pascha, of the Saints, and of the Samaritan Woman. At the Praises: 3 Resurrection Stichira, 3 Stichira of the Saints, and the Paschal Stichira: **"A sacred Pascha"** (*Πάσχα ἱερόν*); "Glory...": of the Saints; "Both now and ever...": of the Samaritan Woman; Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion **"Today salvation"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

units.english_cohort_translation: 5.    In the Divine Liturgy, the Antiphons and the Entrance Hymn [Eisodikon] of Pascha. units.slavonic_diplomatic: 11.    Εἰ τύχοι τῇ Κυριακῇ τῶν Ἁγίων Πατέρων, (ἡ ἀκολουθία τῆς Ἀναλήψεως καταλιμπάνεται, καὶ ἡ ἀκολουθία ἡ ἀναστάσιμος, τῶν Ἁγίων, καὶ τῶν Πατέρων ψάλλονται ὡς ἑξῆς·) τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄, τῶν Πατέρων γ΄, καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου γ΄³. Δόξα, Τὰς μυστικὰς σήμερον, Καὶ νῦν, τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον, καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα, δύο τῶν Πατέρων, καὶ ἓν τοῦ Ἁγίου. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν τῶν Πατέρων, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τῶν Πατέρων, τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς (τῆς Ἀναλήψεως).
units.english_cohort_translation: 10.    Εἰ τύχοι ἐν ταῖς μεθεόρτοις ἡμέραις τῆς ἑορτῆς ταύτης, ἡ Ἀκολουθία ψάλλεται ὡς ἐστι διατεταγμένη ἐν τῷ Μηναίῳ μετὰ τῶν μεθεόρτων. Εἰς τὴν θ΄ στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν. Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν . . . ὁ ἐν δόξῃ ἀναληφθείς, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ἁγίου, Κοινωνικὸν Εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν, καὶ Ἀνελήφθης ἐν δόξῃ.

units.english_cohort_translation: 10.    If the Feast (May 21) occurs on the days of the Afterfeast of the Ascension, the service is celebrated as prescribed in the Menaion together with the Afterfeast hymns. At the Ninth Ode we chant **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). In the Divine Liturgy, at the Little Entrance: **"O come, let us worship and fall down before Christ; save us, O Son of God, Who wast taken up in glory"** (*Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν . . . ὁ ἐν δόξῃ ἀναληφθείς*); the Epistle and Gospel of the Saints are read; Communion Hymn: **"Unto all the earth"** (*Εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν*, Ps. 18:5 LXX); and the Dismissal Troparion **"Thou hast ascended in glory, O Christ our God"** (*Ἀνελήφθης ἐν δόξῃ*).

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 10.    If the Feast (May 21) occurs on the days of the Post-feast of the Ascension, the Service is celebrated as prescribed in the Mineon together with the Post-feast hymns. At the 9th Ode we chant “More honorable.” In the Liturgy, at the Entrance “O come let us worship . . . who ascended in glory,” Apostolos and Gospel of the Saints, Communion Hymn “To all the earth,” and the Apolytikion “You ascended in glory.” SITUATION EIGHT 11.    If the Feast of Saints occurs on the Sunday of the Holy Fathers, {the Service of the Ascension is omitted, and the Service of the Resurrection, of the Saints and of the Fathers is sung as follows:} On Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter, at “Lord, I have cried” we sing 4 Resurrection Stichira, 3 of the Fathers and 3 of the Saints³. Glory of the Fathers “Let us acclaim today,” Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, “O Gladsome Light,” the Prokimenon, and the Readings: two of the Fathers and one of the Saints. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory of the Saints, Now and ever of the Fathers. The Apolytikia: of the Resurrection, of the Fathers, of the Saints and of the Feast [of the Ascension].
units.english_cohort_translation: 11.    If the Feast of the Saints occurs on the Sunday of the Holy Fathers, (the service of the Ascension is omitted, and the services of the Resurrection, of the Saints, and of the Fathers are sung as follows:) On Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the Psalter reading, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we sing 4 Resurrection Stichira, 3 of the Fathers, and 3 of the Saints. "Glory...": of the Fathers: **"Let us acclaim today the mystical trumpets of the Spirit"** (*Τὰς μυστικὰς σήμερον*); "Both now and ever...": the first Theotokion of the Tone. Little Entrance, **"Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Readings: 2 of the Fathers and 1 of the Saints. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; "Glory...": of the Saints; "Both now and ever...": of the Fathers. The Dismissal Troparia: of the Resurrection, of the Fathers, of the Saints, and of the Feast [of the Ascension].

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 12.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς Κανών, ἡ Λιτὴ τοῦ Ἁγίου, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν, Ἀποστολικῶν παραδόσεων, καὶ τὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῶν Πατέρων καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος, τὰ Καθίσματα εἰς τὴν α΄ καὶ β΄ Στιχολογίαν, ἀνὰ ἓν Ἀναστάσιμον, τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον, εἰς τὴν γ΄ Στιχολογίαν τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ τοῦ ἤχου, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος κανών, ὁ τῶν Πατέρων, καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἁγίου· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κοντάκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ ὁ Οἶκος, εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τῶν Πατέρων Φωστῆρες ὑπέρλαμπροι. ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῶν Πατέρων, τὸ Μηνολόγιον τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τῆς Κυριακῆς. Αἱ Καταβασίαι Θείῳ καλυφθείς, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἐξαποστειλάριον, τῶν Πατέρων, τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 13.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Ἀντίφωνα τῆς ἑορτῆς, Εἰσοδικόν, Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν . . . ὁ ἀναστὰς ἐκ νεκρῶν. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τῆς ἑορτῆς τῶν Πατέρων, τοῦ Ἁγίου, τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, καὶ Κοντάκιον Τὴν ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν· Ἀπόστολος τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς· εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, Κοινωνικὸν Αἰνεῖτε, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον Ἀνελήφθης ἐν δόξῃ, Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 14.    Εἰ τύχοι τῷ Σαββάτῳ τῶν Ψυχῶν, ἡ Ἀκολουθία τοῦ Ἁγίου προψάλλεται τῇ Παρασκευῇ μετὰ τῆς Ἀκολουθίας τῆς Ἀναλήψεως ὡς ἑξῆς· Τῇ Πέμπτῃ ἑσπέρας· μετὰ τὴν α΄ Στάσιν τοῦ Ψαλτηρίου, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν τῆς ἑορτῆς Ἰδιόμελα ς΄ καὶ δ΄ τοῦ Ἁγίου. Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον τῆς ἡμέρας καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τοῦ Ἁγίου, τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τῆς ἑορτῆς, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τοῦ Ἁγίου, αὖθις τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_incipit: of the Saints, Glory of the
units.slavonic_diplomatic: of the Saints, Glory of the Saints, Now and ever, “Of the apostolic traditions,” and the “It is meet”; the Trisagion, the Apolytikion of the Fathers and the Exapsalmos. At “God is the Lord”: the Apolytikia as in Vespers, the Psalter and the Polyeleos. At the 1st and 2nd Stasis [Stichologia] the Kathismata of the Resurrection, then that of the Saints followed by the Theotokion; and in the 3rd Stasis, the Kathisma of the Saints and the Theotokion. The Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi of the Mode, the Anavathmi and the Prokimenon. The Canon of the Resurrection, that of the Fathers, and that of the Saints. After the 3rd Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saints, then the Kathisma of the Saints and that of the Fathers “All-shining luminaries”; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Fathers, the Minologion of the Saints, and the Postscript of the Sunday. The Katavasie “Covered by a divine cloud,” and the entire order of the Matins Gospel; then we chant “More honorable.” The Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection, of the Fathers, of the Saints and of the Feast.
units.english_cohort_translation: ...of the Saints; "Glory...": of the Saints; "Both now and ever...": **"Of the apostolic traditions"** (*Ἀποστολικῶν παραδόσεων*), and the Trinity Hymns **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Fathers, and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; the Psalter reading and the Polyeleos. At the first and second Kathisma [Stichologia], one Resurrection Sessional Hymn, one of the Saints, and the Theotokion; and at the third Kathisma [Stichologia], the Sessional Hymn of the Saints and the Theotokion. The Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe of the Tone, the Anavathmoi, and the Prokeimenon. The Resurrection Canon, that of the Fathers, and that of the Saints. After Ode 3, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saints, then the Sessional Hymn of the Saints and that of the Fathers **"All-shining luminaries"** (*Φωστῆρες ὑπέρλαμπροι*); after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Fathers, the Menologion of the Saints, and the Sunday Synaxarion [Hypomnema] of the Sunday. units.slavonic_diplomatic: 13.    In the Liturgy, the Antiphons of the Feast, the Entrance Hymn “O come let us worship . . . who is risen from the dead”; after the Entrance, the Resurrection Apolytikion, the Apolytikion of the Feast, that of the Fathers, that of the Saints, that of the Saint of the Church and the Kontakion “When, for us, You had fulfilled Your dispensation.” Apostolos of the Saints and Gospel of the Sunday. At “Especially,” “It is meet,” Communion Hymn “Praise the Lord,” the Apolytikion “You ascended in glory,” “Blessed be the Name” and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 13.    In the Divine Liturgy, the Antiphons of the Feast; Entrance Hymn [Eisodikon]: **"O come, let us worship and fall down before Christ; save us, O Son of God, Who art risen from the dead"** (*Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν . . . ὁ ἀναστὰς ἐκ νεκρῶν*). After the Little Entrance, the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, that of the Fathers, that of the Saints, that of the Patron Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion: **"When for us Thou hadst fulfilled Thy dispensation"** (*Τὴν ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν*); the Epistle of the Saints and the Gospel of the Sunday. At "Especially" [Megalynarion], **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Hymn: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε*, Ps. 148:1 LXX); the Dismissal Troparion **"Thou hast ascended in glory, O Christ our God"** (*Ἀνελήφθης ἐν δόξῃ*), **"Blessed be the name of the Lord"** (*Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου*, Ps. 112:2 LXX), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 14.    If the Feast (May 21) occurs on the Saturday of the Souls, the Service of the Saint is celebrated in anticipation on Friday together with the Service of the Ascension as follows: On Thursday evening after the 1st Stasis of the Psalter, at “Lord, I have cried” we sing 6 Idiomela of the Feast and 4 of the Saints. Glory of the Saints, Now and ever of the Feast. Entrance, “O Gladsome Light,” the Prokimenon of the day and the Readings of the Saints. The Aposticha of the Feast, Glory of the Saints, Now and ever of the Feast. The Apolytikia: of the Feast, of the Saints and again that of the Feast and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 14.    If the Feast (May 21) occurs on the Saturday of Souls, the service of the Saints is celebrated in anticipation on Friday together with the service of the Ascension as follows: On Thursday evening, after the first Kathisma [Stichologia] of the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we sing 6 Idiomela of the Feast and 4 of the Saints; "Glory...": of the Saints; "Both now and ever...": of the Feast. Little Entrance, **"Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon of the day, and the Old Testament Readings of the Saints. The Aposticha of the Feast; "Glory...": of the Saints; "Both now and ever...": of the Feast. The Dismissal Troparia: of the Feast, of the Saints, and again that of the Feast, and Dismissal.[^350]

The Aposticha of the Feast; "Glory...": of the Saints; "Both now and ever...": of the Feast. The Dismissal Troparia: of the Feast, of the Saints, and again that of the Feast, and Dismissal.[^350]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 15.    Τῇ Παρασκευῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ἡ Λιτὴ τοῦ Ἁγίου ὡς καὶ τὸ Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Κύριε τὸ μυστήριον (ζήτει εἰς τὴν Λιτήν), τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος τοῦ Ἁγίου, τὰ Καθίσματα τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὰ τῆς ἑορτῆς ἀντὶ Θεοτοκίων, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον Ὕψωσα ἐκλεκτὸν ἐκ τοῦ λαοῦ μου, Πᾶσα Πνοή, καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ὄρθρου τοῦ Ἁγίου, ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα, Δόξα, Ταῖς τῶν θεοστέπτων, Καὶ νῦν, Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου, ὁ Στίχος Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός, καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Τοῦ εὐσεβοῦς Κωνσταντίνου ἡ μνήμη (ζήτει εἰς τὴν Λιτήν), οἱ Κανόνες τῆς ἑορτῆς, καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἁγίου· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κάθισμα τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι Θείῳ καλυφθείς· εἶτα ψάλλεται ἡ θ΄ Ὠδὴ τῆς ἑορτῆς μετὰ τῶν Μεγαλυναρίων, καὶ ἡ τοῦ Ἁγίου μετὰ Στίχου Ἅγιε τοῦ Θεοῦ, τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ αὖθις τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Προσόμοια τῆς ἑορτῆς γ΄ καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου γ΄. Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς. Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου.

units.slavonic_incipit: Τῇ αὐτῇ Παρασκευῇ ἑσπέρας καὶ τῷ
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Τῇ αὐτῇ Παρασκευῇ ἑσπέρας καὶ τῷ Σαββάτῳ πρωΐ, ψάλλεται ἡ Ἀκολουθία τῶν Ψυχῶν ὡς ἐστι διατετυπωμένη ἐν τῷ Πεντηκοσταρίῳ. Ἐὰν δὲ ᾖ ὁ ναὸς τοῦ ἁγίου Κωνσταντίνου, πρὸ τῆς Λειτουργίας ψάλλεται τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ ἡ εὐλόγησις τῶν Ἄρτων, μετὰ τὸ Πλούσιοι ἐπτώχευσαν τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον Ὁ βάθει σοφίας, καὶ ἡ Λειτουργία ὡς συνήθως.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 15.    On Friday at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Liti and the Glory of the Saints, Now and ever, “O Lord, having fulfilled the mystery” (look for this in the Liti); the Trisagion, the Apolytikion of the Saints, and the Exapsalmos. At “God is the Lord”: the Apolytikia as in Vespers, the Psalter and the Polyeleos of the Saints. The Kathismata of the Saints and those of the Feast in place of the Theotokia. The Anavathmi, the 1st Antiphon of Mode IV, the Prokimenon “I have raised a chosen one from among my people.” Then “Let everything that breathes,” and the Matins Gospel of the Saints, Psalm 50 (read), Glory, “Through the intercessions of the God-crowned ones,” Now and ever, “Through the intercessions of the Theotokos,” the Verse “O God, have mercy on me” and the Idiomelon “Today, the memory of the pious Constantine” (look for this in the Liti). The Canons of the Feast and of the Saints. After the 3rd Ode, the Kathisma of the Saints and that of the Feast; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saints, and the Minologion. The Katavasie “Covered by a divine cloud”; then we sing the 9th Ode of the Feast with its Megalynaria, and that of the Saints with the Verse “Holy One of God.” The Exapostilaria: of the Feast, of the Saints, and again that of the Feast. At the Praises: 3 Prosomia of the Feast and 3 of the Saints. Glory of the Saints, Now and ever of the Feast, Great Doxology and the Apolytikion of the Saints.

units.english_cohort_translation: 16.    In the Divine Liturgy, the Antiphons and the Entrance Hymn [Eisodikon] of the Feast [of the Ascension]. units.slavonic_diplomatic: On Friday evening and Saturday morning, the Service of the Saturday of the Souls is chanted as prescribed in the Pentikostarion. If the Parish Church is dedicated to Saint Constantine, before the Liturgy, the Apolytikion of the Saints is sung and the Blessing of the Loaves [Artoclasia] is performed with the “The rich became poor,” the Apolytikion “Out of the depths of wisdom,” and the Liturgy as usual.
units.english_cohort_translation: On the same Friday evening and Saturday morning, the service of the Saturday of Souls is sung as prescribed in the Pentecostarion. units.slavonic_diplomatic: 18.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ἡ Λιτὴ τῆς ἑορτῆς, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος· εἰς τὴν α΄ στιχολογίαν Καθίσματα τῆς ἑορτῆς πρῶτον, εἶτα τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ αὖθις τῆς ἑορτῆς· εἰς τὴν β΄ καὶ γ΄ λέγομεν ἀνὰ ἓν τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς· οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον Τὸ πνεῦμά σου τὸ ἀγαθόν, τὸ Πᾶσα πνοή, καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ὄρθρου τῆς ἑορτῆς, εἶτα ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα· Δόξα, Ταῖς τῶν Ἀποστόλων, Καὶ νῦν, Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου, ὁ Στίχος Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός, καὶ τὸ Βασιλεῦ οὐράνιε, οἱ Κανόνες τῆς ἑορτῆς, καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἁγίου· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος τοῦ Ἁγίου, εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Μηνολόγιον τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τῆς ἑορτῆς· αἱ Καταβασίαι διπλαῖ, καὶ ἡ θ΄ Ὠδή, τὸ α΄ Ἐξαποστειλάριον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ τὸ ἕτερον τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τῆς ἑορτῆς Προσόμοια γ΄ καὶ γ΄ τοῦ Ἁγίου· Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Βασιλεῦ οὐράνιε, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς.

Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος· εἰς τὴν α΄ στιχολογίαν Καθίσματα τῆς ἑορτῆς πρῶτον, εἶτα τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ αὖθις τῆς ἑορτῆς· εἰς τὴν β΄ καὶ γ΄ λέγομεν ἀνὰ ἓν τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς· οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον Τὸ πνεῦμά σου τὸ ἀγαθόν, τὸ Πᾶσα πνοή, καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ὄρθρου τῆς ἑορτῆς, εἶτα ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα· Δόξα, Ταῖς τῶν Ἀποστόλων, Καὶ νῦν, Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου, ὁ Στίχος Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός, καὶ τὸ Βασιλεῦ οὐράνιε, οἱ Κανόνες τῆς ἑορτῆς, καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἁγίου· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος τοῦ Ἁγίου, εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Μηνολόγιον τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τῆς ἑορτῆς· αἱ Καταβασίαι διπλαῖ, καὶ ἡ θ΄ Ὠδή, τὸ α΄ Ἐξαποστειλάριον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ τὸ ἕτερον τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τῆς ἑορτῆς Προσόμοια γ΄ καὶ γ΄ τοῦ Ἁγίου· Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Βασιλεῦ οὐράνιε, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς.

Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Ἀντίφωνα καὶ τὸ Εἰσοδικὸν τῆς ἑορτῆς [τῆς Πεντηκοστῆς], τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ Κοντάκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Ὅσοι εἰς Χριστόν, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως Μὴ τῆς φθορᾶς, Κοινωνικὸν τῆς ἑορτῆς Τὸ πνεῦμά σου τὸ Ἅγιον, τὸ Εὐλογητὸς εἶ Χριστέ, Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου, Ἀπόλυσις καὶ ἀκολούθως ὁ Ἑσπερινὸς τῆς Γονυκλισίας.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Liti of the Feast, Glory of the Saints, Now and ever of the Feast; then the Trisagion, the Apolytikion of the Feast, and the Exapsalmos. At “God is the Lord”: the Apolytikia as in Vespers, the Psalter and the Polyeleos. At the 1st Stasis [Stichologia]: the Kathismata of the Feast, then those of the Saints and again those of the Feast; at the 2nd and 3rd Stasis, we chant one of the Saints followed by one of the Feast; the Anavathmi, the 1st Antiphon of Mode IV, the Prokimenon “Your good Spirit.” Then “Let everything that breathes,” and the Matins Gospel of the Feast, Psalm 50 (read), Glory, “Through the intercessions of the Apostles,” Now and ever, “Through the intercessions of the Theotokos,” the Verse “O God, have mercy on me” and the “Heavenly King.” The Canons of the Feast and of the Saints. After the 3rd Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saints, then the Kathisma of the Saints and that of the Feast; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Feast, the Minologion of the Saints, and the Postscript of the Feast. Both [double] Katavasie and the 9th Ode. The Exapostilaria: of the Feast, of the Saints and the other of the Feast. At the Praises: 3 Prosomia of the Feast and 3 of the Saints. Glory, Now and ever, “Heavenly King,” Great Doxology and the Apolytikion of the Feast.
units.english_cohort_translation: 18.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Litiya of the Feast; "Glory...": of the Saints; "Both now and ever...": of the Feast; then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; the Psalter reading and the Polyeleos. At the first Kathisma [Stichologia]: the Sessional Hymns of the Feast first, then those of the Saints, and again those of the Feast; at the second and third Kathisma [Stichologia], we chant one of the Saints followed by one of the Feast. The Anavathmoi: the first Antiphon of Tone 4; the Prokeimenon: **"Thy good Spirit shall lead me into the land of uprightness"** (*Τὸ πνεῦμά σου τὸ ἀγαθόν*, Ps. 142:10 LXX). Then **"Let everything that hath breath"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*), and the Matins Gospel of the Feast; Psalm 50 [LXX] read plainly; "Glory...": **"Through the intercessions of the Apostles"** (*Ταῖς τῶν Ἀποστόλων*); "Both now and ever...": **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos"** (*Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου*); the Verse: **"Have mercy on me, O God"** (*Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός*, Ps. 50:1 LXX), and the Sticheron: **"O Heavenly King, the Comforter"** (*Βασιλεῦ οὐράνιε*). The Canons of the Feast and of the Saints. After Ode 3, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saints, then the Sessional Hymn of the Saints and that of the Feast; after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Feast, the Menologion of the Saints, and the Synaxarion [Hypomnema] of the Feast. Both [double] Katavasiai and the Ninth Ode. The Exapostilaria: first of the Feast, that of the Saints, and the other of the Feast. At the Praises: 3 Prosomoia of the Feast and 3 of the Saints; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"O Heavenly King, the Comforter"** (*Βασιλεῦ οὐράνιε*); Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 19.    In the Liturgy, the Antiphons and the Entrance Hymn of the Feast {of Pentecost}. After the Entrance, the Apolytikion of the Feast, that of the Saints, and the Kontakion of the Feast. Instead of the Trisagios Hymn, we chant “As many as have been baptized”; Apostolos and Gospel of the Feast. At “Especially,” “You who without experience of corruption,” Communion Hymn of the Feast “Your good Spirit,” the Apolytikion “Blessed are You, O Christ,” “Blessed be the name of the Lord,” and Dismissal, and immediately the Vespers of the Kneeling [Gonyklisia].
units.english_cohort_translation: 19.    In the Divine Liturgy, the Antiphons and the Entrance Hymn [Eisodikon] of the Feast [of Pentecost]. After the Little Entrance, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, that of the Saints, and the Kontakion of the Feast. Instead of the Trisagion Hymn, we chant **"As many of you as have been baptized into Christ"** (*Ὅσοι εἰς Χριστόν*); Epistle and Gospel of the Feast. At "Especially" [Megalynarion], the Heirmos: **"Without experience of corruption"** (*Μὴ τῆς φθορᾶς*); Communion Hymn of the Feast: **"Thy Holy Spirit"** (*Τὸ πνεῦμά σου τὸ Ἅγιον*, Ps. 142:10 LXX); the Dismissal Troparion **"Blessed art Thou, O Christ our God"** (*Εὐλογητὸς εἶ Χριστέ*), **"Blessed be the name of the Lord"** (*Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου*, Ps. 112:2 LXX), Dismissal, and immediately the Vespers of Genuflection [Gonyklisia].

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 21.    Τῇ Δευτέρᾳ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ἡ Λιτὴ τοῦ Ἁγίου, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος· τὰ Καθίσματα τῆς α΄ καὶ β΄ Στιχολογίας τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἐν τῇ γ΄ τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ τὸ Μετὰ τὴν ἔγερσιν Χριστέ (ζήτει τῇ Κυριακῇ τῆς Πεντηκοστῆς). Οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον Ὕψωσα ἐκλεκτὸν ἐκ τοῦ λαοῦ μου, τὸ Πᾶσα πνοή, καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ὄρθρου τοῦ Ἁγίου, εἶτα ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα, Δόξα, Ταῖς τῶν θεοστέπτων, Καὶ νῦν, Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου, ὁ Στίχος Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεὸς καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Τοῦ εὐσεβοῦς Κωνσταντίνου ἡ μνήμη. Οἱ Κανόνες τῆς ἑορτῆς, καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἁγίου· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος τοῦ Ἁγίου, εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς Τὸ Πανάγιον Πνεῦμα· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων, καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τῆς Δευτέρας τοῦ Ἁγίου Πνεύματος. Αἱ Καταβασίαι Θείῳ καλυφθείς, καὶ ἡ θ΄ τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ ἕτερον τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τὰ γ΄ τῆς ἑορτῆς Ἰδιόμελα Ἐν τοῖς Προφήταις ἀνήγγειλας, καὶ γ΄ Προσόμοια [τῆς Πεντηκοστῆς], τοῦ Ἁγίου, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου Ὁ τῶν Ἀνάκτων Ἄναξ, Καὶ νῦν, Γλῶσσαί ποτε, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Εὐλογητὸς εἶ Χριστὲ ὁ Θεός.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 21.    On Monday at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Liti of the Saints, Glory of the Saints, Now and ever of the Feast. The Trisagion, the Apolytikion of the Feast, and the Exapsalmos. At “God is the Lord”: the Apolytikia as in Vespers, the Psalter and the Polyeleos. The Kathismata: at the 1st and 2nd Stasis, the Kathisma of the Saints and that of the Feast; at the 3rd Stasis, one Kathisma of the Saints followed by “After You had risen from the tomb” (see the Sunday of Pentecost). The Anavathmi, the 1st Antiphon of Mode IV, the Prokimenon “I have raised a chosen one from among my people.” Then “Let everything that breathes,” and the Matins Gospel of the Saints, Psalm 50 (read), Glory, “Through the intercessions of the God-crowned ones,” Now and ever, “Through the intercessions of the Theotokos,” the Verse “O God, have mercy on me” and the Idiomelon “Today, the memory of the pious Constantine.” The Canons of the Feast and of the Saints. After the 3rd Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saints, the Kathisma of the Saints and that of the Feast “The All-holy Spirit”; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Feast, the Minologion of the Saints, and the Postscript of the Monday of the Holy Spirit. The Katavasie “Covered by a divine cloud,” and the 9th Ode of the Feast. The Exapostilaria: of the Feast, of the Saints and the other one of the Feast. At the Praises: 3 Prosomia of the Feast “In the prophets You announced” and 3 of the Saints. Glory of the Saints “The King of Kings,” Now and ever, “Tongues in days of old,” Great Doxology and the Apolytikion “Blessed are You, O Christ our God.”
units.english_cohort_translation: 21.    On Monday at Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Litiya of the Saints; "Glory...": of the Saints; "Both now and ever...": of the Feast. The Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; the Psalter reading and the Polyeleos. The Sessional Hymns: at the first and second Kathisma [Stichologia], the Sessional Hymn of the Saints and that of the Feast; at the third Kathisma [Stichologia], one Sessional Hymn of the Saints followed by **"After Thy resurrection, O Christ"** (*Μετὰ τὴν ἔγερσιν Χριστέ*; see the Sunday of Pentecost). The Anavathmoi: the first Antiphon of Tone 4; the Prokeimenon: **"I have raised up one chosen out of My people"** (*Ὕψωσα ἐκλεκτὸν ἐκ τοῦ λαοῦ μου*, Ps. 88:20 LXX). Then **"Let everything that hath breath"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*), and the Matins Gospel of the Saints; Psalm 50 [LXX] read plainly; "Glory...": **"Through the intercessions of the God-crowned ones"** (*Ταῖς τῶν θεοστέπτων*); "Both now and ever...": **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos"** (*Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου*); the Verse: **"Have mercy on me, O God"** (*Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός*, Ps. 50:1 LXX), and the Idiomelon: **"Today the memory of the pious Constantine"** (*Τοῦ εὐσεβοῦς Κωνσταντίνου ἡ μνήμη*). The Canons of the Feast and of the Saints. After Ode 3, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saints, the Sessional Hymn of the Saints and that of the Feast: **"The All-Holy Spirit"** (*Τὸ Πανάγιον Πνεῦμα*); after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Feast, the Menologion of the Saints, and the Synaxarion [Hypomnema] of the Monday of the Holy Spirit. The Katavasiai: **"Covered by a divine cloud"** (*Θείῳ καλυφθείς*), and the Ninth Ode of the Feast. The Exapostilaria: of the Feast, of the Saints, and the other one of the Feast. At the Praises: 3 Idiomela of the Feast: **"In the prophets Thou didst announce"** (*Ἐν τοῖς Προφήταις ἀνήγγειλας*), and 3 Prosomoia of the Saints; "Glory...": of the Saints: **"The King of Kings"** (*Ὁ τῶν Ἀνάκτων Ἄναξ*); "Both now and ever...": **"Tongues in days of old were confounded"** (*Γλῶσσαί ποτε*); Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion **"Blessed art Thou, O Christ our God"** (*Εὐλογητὸς εἶ Χριστὲ ὁ Θεός*).

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 22.    In the Liturgy, the Antiphons and the Entrance Hymn of the Feast {of Pentecost}. After the Entrance, the Apolytikion of the Feast, that of the Saints, and the Kontakion of the Feast. Instead of the Trisagios Hymn we chant “As many as have been baptized,” Apostolos of the Saints and Gospel of the day. At “Especially,” “Hail, O Queen,” Communion Hymn of the Feast “Your good Spirit,” “We have seen the [true] light,” “Blessed be the name of the Lord” and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 22.    In the Divine Liturgy, the Antiphons and the Entrance Hymn [Eisodikon] of the Feast [of Pentecost]. After the Little Entrance, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, that of the Saints, and the Kontakion of the Feast. Instead of the Trisagion Hymn, we chant **"As many of you as have been baptized into Christ"** (*Ὅσοι εἰς Χριστόν*); the Epistle of the Saints and the Gospel of the day. At "Especially" [Megalynarion], the Heirmos: **"Hail, O Queen"** (*Χαίροις Ἄνασσα*); Communion Hymn of the Feast: **"Thy good Spirit shall lead me"** (*Τὸ Πνεῦμά σου τὸ ἀγαθόν*, Ps. 142:10 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), **"Blessed be the name of the Lord"** (*Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου*, Ps. 112:2 LXX), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 24.    Εἰ τύχοι ἐν τῇ Ἀποδόσει τῆς Πεντηκοστῆς, ἡ ἀκολουθία τοῦ Ἁγίου μετὰ τῆς ἑορτῆς ψάλλεται ἀπαραλλάκτως ὡς ἐν τῇ ἰδίᾳ ἡμέρᾳ· ἀλλ’ ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ λέγονται μόνα τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τοῦ Ἁγίου. Ἐν τῷ Ὄρθρῳ (ὅρα τὴν διάταξιν ἐν τῇ Ἀποδόσει τῆς ἑορτῆς τῆς Ἀναλήψεως § 15, 16), αἱ Καταβασίαι τῆς ἑορτῆς διπλαῖ, ἐν δὲ τῇ Λειτουργίᾳ, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ Κοινωνικὸν τῆς ἑορτῆς.

Ἐν τῷ Ὄρθρῳ (ὅρα τὴν διάταξιν ἐν τῇ Ἀποδόσει τῆς ἑορτῆς τῆς Ἀναλήψεως § 15, 16), αἱ Καταβασίαι τῆς ἑορτῆς διπλαῖ, ἐν δὲ τῇ Λειτουργίᾳ, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ Κοινωνικὸν τῆς ἑορτῆς.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 25.    Εἰ τύχοι τῇ Κυριακῇ τῶν Ἁγίων Πάντων, ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ δ΄, τῶν Ἁγίων Πάντων γ΄ καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου γ΄. Δόξα, Μαρτύρων θεῖος χορός, Καὶ νῦν, τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον, τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα δύο ἐκ τοῦ Πεντηκοσταρίου καὶ ἓν τοῦ Ἁγίου. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν τῶν Ἁγίων Δεῦτε πιστοί, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τῶν Ἁγίων Πάντων, τοῦ Ἁγίου, τὸ Θεοτοκίον, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 26.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανών, ἡ Λιτὴ τῶν Ἁγίων, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν τοῦ Πεντηκοσταρίου Τῇ νῦν πανηγύρει, καὶ τὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῶν Ἁγίων καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος· Καθίσματα εἰς τὴν α΄ καὶ β΄ Στιχολογίαν τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα, τὰ τοῦ Ἁγίου μετὰ τῶν Θεοτοκίων τοῦ Πεντηκοσταρίου· εἰς τὴν γ΄ τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου μετὰ τοῦ Θεοτοκίου αὐτοῦ, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ τοῦ ἤχου, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον, ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος κανών, ὁ τῶν Ἁγίων Πάντων, καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἁγίου· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος τοῦ Ἁγίου, εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα τῶν Ἁγίων, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου μετὰ τοῦ Θεοτοκίου· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Entrance, “O come let us worship . . . Save us, O Good Comforter.” At “Especially,” “It is meet,” the Communion Hymn of the Saints {“To all the earth,”} and “We have seen the [true] light,” etc.
units.english_cohort_translation: ...Entrance: **"O come, let us worship and fall down before Christ; save us, O Good Comforter"** (*Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν . . . Σῶσον ἡμᾶς Παράκλητε ἀγαθέ*). units.slavonic_diplomatic: 24.    If the Feast [May 21] occurs on the Leave-taking of Pentecost, the Service of the Saints is sung together with that of the Feast as on the day of the Feast; but in Vespers, we read only the 3 Readings of the Saints. In Matins (see the order on the Leave-taking of the Feast of the Ascension, Paragraphs 15, 16). Both [double] Katavasie of the Feast. In the Liturgy, Apostolos and Gospel of the Saints and Communion Hymn of the Feast.
units.english_cohort_translation: 24.    If the Feast [May 21] occurs on the Apodosis of Pentecost, the service of the Saints is sung together with that of the Feast exactly as on the day of the Feast; but in Vespers, we read only the 3 Old Testament Readings of the Saints. In Matins (see the order on the Apodosis of the Feast of the Ascension, Paragraphs 15, 16), both [double] Katavasiai of the Feast. In the Divine Liturgy, the Epistle and Gospel of the Saints, and the Communion Hymn of the Feast.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 25.    If the Feast [May 21] occurs on the Sunday of All-Saints, in Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter, at “Lord, I have cried” we sing 4 Resurrection Stichira, 3 of Stichira of All-Saints, and 3 Prosomia of the Saints; Glory, “O divine choir of Martyrs,” Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, “O Gladsome Light,” the Prokimenon, and the Readings: 2 from the Pentikostarion and 1 of the Saints. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory of the Saints, Now and ever of the Saints “Come, O you faithful.” The Apolytikia: of the Resurrection, of All-Saints, of the Saints, the Theotokion and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 25.    If the Feast [May 21] occurs on the Sunday of All Saints, in Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the Psalter reading, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we sing 4 Resurrection Stichira, 3 Stichira of All Saints, and 3 Prosomoia of the Saints; "Glory...": **"O divine choir of Martyrs"** (*Μαρτύρων θεῖος χορός*); "Both now and ever...": the first Theotokion of the Tone. Little Entrance, **"Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Readings: 2 from the Pentecostarion and 1 of the Saints. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; "Glory...": of the Saints; "Both now and ever...": of All Saints: **"Come, O ye faithful"** (*Δεῦτε πιστοί*). The Dismissal Troparia: of the Resurrection, of All Saints, of the Saints, the Theotokion, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: καὶ Οἶκος τῶν Ἁγίων Πάντων, τὸ Μηνολόγιον τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τοῦ Πεντηκοσταρίου· αἱ Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἐξαποστειλάριον, τῶν Ἁγίων, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα β΄, τῶν Ἁγίων γ΄ καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου γ΄. Δόξα, Εἰς τὸ ὄρος τοῖς Μαθηταῖς, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Τροπάριον Σήμερον σωτηρία.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 27.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄ καὶ δ΄ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Πεντηκοσταρίου. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τῶν Ἁγίων, τοῦ Ἁγίου Κωνσταντίνου, τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, καὶ Κοντάκιον Ὡς ἀπαρχὰς τῆς φύσεως. Ἀπόστολος τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς. units.slavonic_incipit: Ἐὰν δὲ ἡ τοῦ Ἁγίου μνήμη
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Ἐὰν δὲ ἡ τοῦ Ἁγίου μνήμη τύχῃ ἐν ἄλλῃ ἡμέρᾳ ἔξω τοῦ Πεντηκοσταρίου, ἡ Ἀκολουθία ψάλλεται ὡς ἐστι διατεταγμένη ἐν τῷ Μηναίῳ. Αἱ Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου, Κοντάκιον Προστασία τῶν Χριστιανῶν, καὶ Κοινωνικὸν Εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν.

units.slavonic_incipit: Σημειωτέον ὅτι ἡ μνήμη τοῦ ἁγίου
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Σημειωτέον ὅτι ἡ μνήμη τοῦ ἁγίου Κωνσταντίνου δυνατὸν νὰ συμπέσῃ ἐν τῷ Πεντηκοσταρίῳ ἀπὸ τοῦ Σαββάτου τῆς τοῦ Παραλύτου ἑβδομάδος μέχρι τῆς Κυριακῆς τῶν Ἁγίων Πάντων, ἔξω δὲ τοῦ Πεντηκοσταρίου μέχρι τῆς Πέμπτης τῆς πρώτης μετὰ τὴν Κυριακὴν τῶν Ἁγίων Πάντων ἑβδομάδος. (Ὅρα τὸν Ἑορτοδρόμιον Πίνακα).

The Katavasie “I shall open my mouth,” and the entire order of the Matins Gospel; then “More honorable.” The Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection, of All-Saints, of the Saints and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 2 Stichira of the Resurrection, 3 Prosomia of All-Saints, and 3 of the Saints. Glory, “As the disciples were hastening on the mountain,” Now and ever, “Most blessed,” Great Doxology and “Today salvation.” 27.    In the Liturgy, the Typika and the Beatitudes: 4 of the Mode and 4 of the 6th Ode of the Pentikostarion. After the Entrance, the Resurrection Apolytikion, that of All-Saints, that of Saint Constantine [and Helen], that of the Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion “As the first fruits of nature,” Apostolos of the Saints and Gospel of the Sunday. At “Especially,” “It is meet,” Communion Hymn “Rejoice, O righteous ones, in the Lord,” “We have seen the [true] Light,” and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: ...and Ikos of All Saints, the Menologion of the Saint, and the Synaxarion [Hypomnema] of the Pentecostarion. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*), and the entire order of the Matins Gospel; then we chant the Magnifications: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). The Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection, of All Saints, of the Saints [Constantine and Helen], and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 2 Resurrection Stichira, 3 Stichira of All Saints, and 3 of the Saints; "Glory...": the Sunday Gospel Sticheron **"Unto the mountain to the disciples"** (*Εἰς τὸ ὄρος τοῖς Μαθηταῖς*); "Both now and ever...": **"Most blessed art thou"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion **"Today salvation"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

units.slavonic_incipit: If the Feast of the Saints
units.slavonic_diplomatic: If the Feast of the Saints [May 21] occurs on a day outside the period of the Pentikostarion, the Service is chanted as prescribed in the Mineon. Katavasie “I shall open my mouth,” Kontakion “Protection of all Christians” and Communion Hymn “To all the earth.”
units.english_cohort_translation: 27.    In the Divine Liturgy, the Typika and the Beatitudes of the Tone: 4, and 4 from the Sixth Ode of the Pentecostarion. After the Little Entrance, the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of All Saints, that of Saint Constantine [and Helen], that of the Patron Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion: **"As the firstfruits of nature"** (*Ὡς ἀπαρχὰς τῆς φύσεως*); Epistle of the Saints and Gospel of the Sunday. At "Especially" [Megalynarion], **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Hymn: **"Rejoice in the Lord, O ye righteous"** (*Ἀγαλλιᾶσθε δίκαιοι*, Ps. 32:1 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_incipit: Note that the Feast of Saint
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Note that the Feast of Saint Constantine [and Helen] can occur in the period of the Pentikostarion from the Saturday of the Week of the Paralytic until the Sunday of All-Saints; outside of the Pentikostarion period, on the other hand, until the Thursday after the Sunday of All-Saints. (See the Chart of Celebrations).
units.english_cohort_translation: If the feast of the Saint occurs on another day outside the period of the Pentecostarion, the service is chanted as prescribed in the Menaion. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*); Kontakion: **"Protection of Christians"** (*Προστασία τῶν Χριστιανῶν*); and Communion Hymn: **"Into all the earth"** (*Εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν*, Ps. 18:5 LXX).

The Apolytikion of the Feast, that of the Forerunner, and again that of the Feast and the Dismissal.

units.slavonic_incipit: διάταξιν τοῦ Μηναίου. Οἱ Κανόνες τῆς
units.slavonic_diplomatic: διάταξιν τοῦ Μηναίου. Οἱ Κανόνες τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ τοῦ Προδρόμου, Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τοῦ Προδρόμου καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι τῆς ἑορτῆς, καὶ ἡ Θ΄ Ὠδὴ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ τοῦ Προδρόμου, τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ τοῦ Προδρόμου καὶ αὖθις τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Προσόμοια τῆς ἑορτῆς γ΄ καὶ γ΄ τοῦ Προδρόμου, Δόξα τοῦ Προδρόμου, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ἡ Λειτουργία, ἐν ᾗ ψάλλομεν τὰ Ἀντίφωνα καὶ τὸ Εἰσοδικὸν τοῦ Πάσχα. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς τοῦ Προδρόμου, τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, καὶ τὸ Κοντάκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Προδρόμου. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως Ἀλλότριον τῶν μητέρων, Κοινωνικὸν τῆς ἑορτῆς, Χριστὸς ἀνέστη καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: of the Feast and of the Forerunner, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Forerunner and the Minologion. The Katavasie of the Feast and the 9th Ode of the Feast and of the Forerunner. The Exapostilarion of the Feast, that of the Forerunner and again that of the Feast. At the Praises: 3 Prosomia of the Feast and 3 of the Forerunner, Glory of the Forerunner, Now and ever of the Feast; Great Doxology and the Apolytikion of the Feast; and the Liturgy, in which we sing the Antiphons and the Entrance Hymn of Easter. After the Entrance, we chant the Apolytikion of the Feast, that of the Forerunner, that of the Saint of the Church and the Kontakion of the Feast; Apostolos and Gospel of the Forerunner. At “Especially,” “Virginity is alien to motherhood,” Communion Hymn of the Feast, the Apolytikion “Christ is risen,” and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: ...order of the Menaion. The Canons of the Feast and of the Forerunner; the Kontakion and Ikos of the Forerunner, and the Menologion. The Katavasiai of the Feast, and the Ninth Ode of the Feast and of the Forerunner. The Exapostilarion of the Feast, that of the Forerunner, and again that of the Feast. At the Praises: 3 Prosomoia of the Feast and 3 of the Forerunner; "Glory...": of the Forerunner; "Both now and ever...": of the Feast; Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast; and the Divine Liturgy, in which we sing the Antiphons and the Entrance Hymn [Eisodikon] of Pascha. After the Little Entrance, we chant the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, that of the Forerunner, that of the Patron Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion of the Feast; the Epistle and Gospel of the Forerunner. At "Especially" [Megalynarion], **"Virginity is alien to mothers"** (*Ἀλλότριον τῶν μητέρων*); Communion Hymn of the Feast; the Dismissal Troparion **"Christ is risen"** (*Χριστὸς ἀνέστη*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 8.    Εἰ τύχοι τῇ Κυριακῇ τῆς Πεντηκοστῆς, ἡ Ἀκολουθία τοῦ Προδρόμου μετατίθεται καὶ ψάλλεται τῇ Δευτέρᾳ τοῦ ἁγίου Πνεύματος ὡς ἑξῆς. Τῇ Κυριακῇ τῆς Πεντηκοστῆς, ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ τῆς Γονυκλισίας, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλονται τῆς ἑορτῆς Παράδοξα σήμερον γ΄ καὶ γ΄ τοῦ Προδρόμου. Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς, καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ τάξις τῆς Γονυκλισίας, τὰ Ἀπόστιχα καὶ τὸ Δοξαστικὸν τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τοῦ Προδρόμου, αὖθις τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

Τῇ Δευτέρᾳ πρωΐ, εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, τὰ Καθίσματα τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὰ τῆς ἑορτῆς, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον Ἐκεῖ ἐξανατελῶ κέρας τῷ Δαβίδ, τὸ Πᾶσα πνοὴ καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ὄρθρου τοῦ Προδρόμου, ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα, Δόξα τοῦ Προδρόμου, Καὶ νῦν, Ταῖς τῆς θεοτόκου, ὁ Στίχος Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεὸς καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Ἡ τῶν θείων ἐννοιῶν (ζήτει εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τοῦ Μηναίου). Οἱ Κανόνες τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ τοῦ Προδρόμου· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κάθισμα Τὸ πανάγιον πνεῦμα, ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Μηνολόγιον καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τῆς ἑορτῆς, αἱ Καταβασίαι Θείῳ καλυφθείς, καὶ ἡ Θ΄ Ὠδὴ τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τοῦ Προδρόμου καὶ τὸ ἕτερον τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τῆς ἑορτῆς Ἰδιόμελα γ΄ καὶ τοῦ Προδρόμου Προσόμοια γ΄, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, Ἀπόστολος τοῦ Προδρόμου, Εὐαγγέλιον καὶ Κοινωνικὸν τῆς ἑορτῆς.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 8.    If the Feast [May 25] occurs on the Sunday of Pentecost, the Service of the Forerunner is moved to and celebrated on the Monday of the Holy Spirit as follows: On Sunday at the Vespers of the Kneeling Service, after the Introductory Psalm, at “Lord, I have cried” we sing the 3 Idiomela of the Feast, “Today strange things,” and 3 Prosomia of the Forerunner; Glory, Now and ever, “Heavenly King,” and the rest of the Service of the Kneeling. The Aposticha and Glory, Now and ever of the Feast. The Apolytikia: of the Feast, of the Forerunner and again of the Feast, and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 8.    If the feast falls on the Sunday of Pentecost, the service of the Forerunner is transferred and celebrated on the Monday of the Holy Spirit as follows: On Sunday at the Vespers of Genuflection [Gonyklisia], after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we sing 3 Idiomela of the Feast: **"Strange marvels were seen today"** (*Παράδοξα σήμερον*), and 3 Prosomoia of the Forerunner; "Glory... Both now and ever...": of the Feast: **"O Heavenly King, the Comforter"** (*Βασιλεῦ οὐράνιε*), and the rest of the order of Genuflection [Gonyklisia]. The Aposticha and the Doxastikon of the Feast. The Dismissal Troparia: of the Feast, of the Forerunner, and again that of the Feast, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 9.    On Monday morning at “God is the Lord”: the Apolytikia as in Vespers and the Psalter. The Kathismata: of the Forerunner and of the Feast; the Anavathmi, the 1st Antiphon of Mode IV, the Prokimenon “There I will raise the pride of David.” Then “Let everything that breathes,” and the Matins Gospel of the Forerunner, Psalm 50 (read), Glory, “Through the intercessions of the Forerunner,” Now and ever, “Through the intercessions of the Theotokos,” the Verse “O God, have mercy on me” and “Of the divine thoughts” (see the Aposticha of the Mineon). The Canons of the Feast and of the Forerunner. After the 3rd Ode, the Kathisma of the Feast “Now the All-holy Spirit”; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Feast, the Minologion of the Forerunner, and the Postscript of the Monday of the Holy Spirit. The Katavasie “Covered by a divine cloud,” and the 9th Ode of the Feast. The Exapostilaria: of the Feast, of the Forerunner and the other one of the Feast. At the Praises: 3 Idiomela of the Feast and 3 Prosomia of the Forerunner, Glory, Now and ever of the Feast. Great Doxology and the Apolytikion of the Feast. In the Liturgy, Apostolos of the Forerunner, Gospel and Communion Hymn of the Feast.
units.english_cohort_translation: 9.    On Monday morning, at "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; the Psalter reading; the Sessional Hymns of the Saint and those of the Feast; the Anavathmoi: the first Antiphon of Tone 4; the Prokeimenon: **"There will I bring forth a horn for David"** (*Ἐκεῖ ἐξανατελῶ κέρας τῷ Δαβίδ*, Ps. 131:17 LXX); then **"Let everything that hath breath"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*), and the Matins Gospel of the Forerunner; Psalm 50 [LXX] read plainly; "Glory...": **"Through the intercessions of Thy Forerunner"** (*Ταῖς τοῦ σοῦ Προδρόμου*); "Both now and ever...": **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos"** (*Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου*); the Verse: **"Have mercy on me, O God"** (*Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός*, Ps. 50:1 LXX), and the Idiomelon: **"The treasury of divine thoughts"** (*Ἡ τῶν θείων ἐννοιῶν*; look for this in the Aposticha of the Menaion). The Canons of the Feast and of the Forerunner. After Ode 3, the Sessional Hymn of the Feast: **"The All-holy Spirit"** (*Τὸ πανάγιον πνεῦμα*); after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Feast, the Menologion of the Forerunner, and the Synaxarion [Hypomnema] of the Monday of the Holy Spirit. The Katavasiai: **"Covered by a divine cloud"** (*Θείῳ καλυφθείς*), and the Ninth Ode of the Feast. The Exapostilaria: of the Feast, of the Forerunner, and the other one of the Feast. At the Praises: 3 Idiomela of the Feast and 3 Prosomoia of the Forerunner; "Glory... Both now and ever...": of the Feast; Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast. In the Divine Liturgy: the Epistle of the Forerunner, and the Gospel and Communion Hymn of the Feast.[^357]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 12.    Εἰ τύχοι ἐν Κυριακῇ ἔξω τοῦ Πεντηκοσταρίου, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν ἀναστάσιμα ς΄, Καὶ τοῦ Προδρόμου δ΄, Δόξα τοῦ Προδρόμου, Καὶ νῦν, τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου, Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, Δόξα τοῦ Προδρόμου, Καὶ νῦν, Ὢ θαύματος καινοῦ (ὅρα Καὶ νῦν Ἀποστίχων τοῦ Σαββάτου εἰς ἦχον β΄), τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τοῦ Προδρόμου, τὸ Θεοτοκίον, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 13.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανών, καὶ τὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Προδρόμου καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα καὶ ἀνὰ ἓν τοῦ Προδρόμου μετὰ τῶν Θεοτοκίων, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον· ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος κανών, καὶ ὁ τοῦ Προδρόμου· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τοῦ Προδρόμου, εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα μετὰ τοῦ Θεοτοκίου, ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων τῆς ἡμέρας, αἱ Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἐξαποστειλάριον, τοῦ Προδρόμου, καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. units.slavonic_diplomatic: 12.    If the Feast [May 25] occurs on a Sunday outside the period of the Pentikostarion, in Vespers on Saturday evening, after the Psalter at “Lord, I have cried” we sing 6 Stichira of the Resurrection, and 4 of the Forerunner. Glory of the Forerunner, Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, “O Gladsome Light,” and the Prokimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory of the Forerunner, Now and ever, “O wondrous event” {see Now and ever of the Saturday Aposticha of Mode II}. The Apolytikia: of the Resurrection, of the Forerunner, the Theotokion and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 12.    If the feast falls on a Sunday outside the period of the Pentecostarion, at Vespers on Saturday evening, after the Psalter reading, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we sing 6 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Forerunner; "Glory...": of the Forerunner; "Both now and ever...": the first Theotokion of the Tone. Little Entrance, **"Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; "Glory...": of the Forerunner; "Both now and ever...": **"O new wonder"** (*Ὢ θαύματος καινοῦ*; see the Theotokion "Both now and ever" of the Saturday Aposticha of Tone 2). The Dismissal Troparia: of the Resurrection, of the Forerunner, the Theotokion, and Dismissal.

At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; "Glory...": of the Forerunner; "Both now and ever...": **"O new wonder"** (*Ὢ θαύματος καινοῦ*; see the Theotokion "Both now and ever" of the Saturday Aposticha of Tone 2). units.slavonic_diplomatic: 13.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Triadic Canon, and the Triadic “It is meet”; then the Trisagion, the Apolytikion of the Forerunner and the Exapsalmos. At “God is the Lord”: the Apolytikia as in Vespers; then the Psalter and the Amomos. The Resurrection Kathismata and one of the Forerunner with its Theotokion. The Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode and the Prokimenon. The Canons of the Resurrection and of the Forerunner. After the 3rd Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Forerunner, then the Kathisma of the Forerunner and the Theotokion; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrection, and the Minologion of the Saint of the day. The Katavasie “I shall open my mouth,” and the entire order of the Morning Gospel; then we sing “More honorable.” Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection, of the Forerunner and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Forerunner, Glory the Eothinon, Now and ever, “Most blessed,” Great Doxology
units.english_cohort_translation: 13.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Trinity Canon, and the Trinity Hymns **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Forerunner, and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; then the Psalter reading and the 17th Kathisma [Amomos]. The Resurrection Sessional Hymns and one of the Forerunner with its Theotokion. The Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons of the Resurrection and of the Forerunner. After Ode 3, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Forerunner, then the Sessional Hymn of the Forerunner with its Theotokion; after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrection, and the Menologion of the Saint of the day. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*), and the entire order of the Sunday Matins Gospel; then we chant the Magnifications: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). The Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection, of the Forerunner, and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Forerunner; "Glory...": the Sunday Gospel Sticheron [Eothinon]; "Both now and ever...": **"Most blessed art thou"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); Great Doxology...[^358]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 14.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄ καὶ δ΄ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Κανόνος τοῦ Προδρόμου. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως, Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, Κοινωνικὸν Αἰνεῖτε, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_incipit: Σημειωτέον ὅτι ἡ γ΄ Εὕρεσις τῆς
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Σημειωτέον ὅτι ἡ γ΄ Εὕρεσις τῆς τιμίας Κεφαλῆς τοῦ Προδρόμου δυνατὸν νὰ συμπέσῃ ἐντὸς τοῦ Πεντηκοσταρίου, ἀπὸ τῆς Τετάρτης Ἀποδόσεως τῆς Μεσοπεντηκοστῆς μέχρι τῆς Κυριακῆς τῶν Ἁγίων Πάντων, ἐπέκεινα δὲ μέχρι τῆς Δευτέρας τῆς β΄ ἑβδομάδος μετὰ τὴν Πεντηκοστήν. (Ὅρα τὸν Ἑορτοδρόμιον Πίνακα).

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 1.    Ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὴν α΄ Στάσιν τοῦ Ψαλτηρίου, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα, ψάλλομεν τὰ Ἰδιόμελα Λύει τοῦ Ζαχαρίου τὴν σιωπὴν εἰς η΄, Δόξα, Σήμερον τοῦ φωτὸς ὁ λύχνος, Καὶ νῦν, Ἡ Ἐλισάβετ συνέλαβε, Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον τῆς ἡμέρας καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ Ἰδιόμελα, Δόξα, Ἠσαΐου νῦν τοῦ προφήτου, Καὶ νῦν, Βλέπε τὴν Ἐλισάβετ, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον Προφῆτα καὶ Πρόδρομε, καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον Τὸ ἀπ᾿ αἰῶνος ἀπόκρυφον καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ Ἰδιόμελα, Δόξα, Ἠσαΐου νῦν τοῦ προφήτου, Καὶ νῦν, Βλέπε τὴν Ἐλισάβετ, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον Προφῆτα καὶ Πρόδρομε, καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον Τὸ ἀπ᾿ αἰῶνος ἀπόκρυφον καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 2.    Εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ἡ Λιτή, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον δὶς καὶ ἅπαξ τὸ Θεοτοκίον· εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος, τὰ Καθίσματα κατὰ σειράν, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον Καὶ σὺ παιδίον προφήτης Ὑψίστου κληθήσῃ, Πᾶσα πνοή, καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον, ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα, Δόξα, Ταῖς τοῦ σοῦ Προδρόμου, Καὶ νῦν, Ταῖς τῆς θεοτόκου, Στίχος Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεὸς καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Ὁ ἐκ κοιλίας μητρὸς ἁγιασθείς. Οἱ Κανόνες ἀμφότεροι μετὰ Στίχου Ἅγιε τοῦ Θεοῦ, πρέσβευε ὑπὲρ

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 14.    In the Liturgy, we sing the Typika and 4 Beatitudes of the Mode and 4 hymns from the 6th Ode of the Canon of the Forerunner. After the Entrance, the Apolytikia: of the Resurrection, of the Forerunner, of the Saint of the Church and the Kontakion “Protection of all Christians”; Apostolos of the Forerunner and Gospel of the Sunday, Communion Hymn “Praise,” “We have seen the [true] light” and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 14.    In the Divine Liturgy, the Typika and 4 Beatitudes of the Tone, and 4 hymns from the Sixth Ode of the Canon of the Forerunner. After the Little Entrance, the Dismissal Troparia: of the Resurrection, of the Forerunner, of the Patron Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion: **"Protection of Christians"** (*Προστασία τῶν Χριστιανῶν*); the Epistle of the Forerunner and Gospel of the Sunday; Communion Hymn: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε*, Ps. 148:1 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Note that the 3rd Finding of the Sacred Head of the Forerunner may occur in the period of the Pentikostarion, from the Wednesday of the Leave-taking of Mid-Pentecost until the Sunday of All-Saints, and occasionally until the Monday of the second week after Pentecost. (See the Chart of Celebrations).

(See the Calendar Table of Feasts).

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 1.    In Vespers following the Introductory Psalm and the First Stasis of the Psalter, at “Lord, I have cried” we sing the Idiomela “He unties the silence of Zachariah” in 8, Glory, “Today the lamp of the light,” Now and ever, “Elizabeth conceived.” “O Gladsome Light,” the Prokimenon of the day and the Readings. At the Aposticha: the Idiomela, Glory, “Of Isaiah the prophet now,” Now and ever, “Look at Elizabeth.” The Apolytikion “O Prophet and Forerunner” and the Theotokion “The mystery hidden before all time” and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: **June 24: The Nativity of the Honorable and Glorious Prophet, Forerunner and Baptist John** 1.    At Vespers, following the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the first Kathisma [Stasis] of the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we sing the Idiomela: **"He unties the silence of Zacharias"** (*Λύει τοῦ Ζαχαρίου τὴν σιωπὴν*) to 8; "Glory...": **"Today the lamp of the Light"** (*Σήμερον τοῦ φωτὸς ὁ λύχνος*); "Both now and ever...": **"Elizabeth conceived"** (*Ἡ Ἐλισάβετ συνέλαβε*). Little Entrance, **"Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon of the day, and the Old Testament Readings. At the Aposticha: the Idiomela; "Glory...": **"Of Isaiah the prophet now"** (*Ἠσαΐου νῦν τοῦ προφήτου*); "Both now and ever...": **"Behold Elizabeth"** (*Βλέπε τὴν Ἐλισάβετ*). The Dismissal Troparion: **"O Prophet and Forerunner"** (*Προφῆτα καὶ Πρόδρομε*), and the Theotokion: **"The mystery hidden from all ages"** (*Τὸ ἀπ᾿ αἰῶνος ἀπόκρυφον*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 2.    At Matins, after Psalm 50, the Liti, then the Trisagion, the Apolytikion and the Exapsalmos. At “God is the Lord”: the Apolytikion twice and the Theotokion once; then the Psalter and the Polyeleos. The Kathismata in order, the Anavathmi, the First Antiphon of Mode IV and the Prokimenon “And you, child, will be called prophet of the Most High.” Then “Let everything that breathes” and the Gospel, Psalm 50 read, Glory, “Through the intercessions of Your Forerunner,” Now and ever, “Through the intercessions of the Theotokos,” the Verse “O God, have mercy on me” and the Idiomelon “He who was sanctified from the womb of the mother,”
units.english_cohort_translation: 2.    At Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Litiya, then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion, and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparion twice and the Theotokion once; then the Psalter reading and the Polyeleos. The Sessional Hymns in order; the Anavathmoi: the first Antiphon of Tone 4; and the Prokeimenon: **"And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Most High"** (*Καὶ σὺ παιδίον προφήτης Ὑψίστου κληθήσῃ*, Lk. 1:76); then **"Let everything that hath breath"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*), and the Gospel; Psalm 50 [LXX] read plainly; "Glory...": **"Through the intercessions of Thy Forerunner"** (*Ταῖς τοῦ σοῦ Προδρόμου*); "Both now and ever...": **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos"** (*Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου*); the Verse: **"Have mercy on me, O God"** (*Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός*, Ps. 50:1 LXX), and the Idiomelon: **"He who was sanctified from his mother's womb"** (*Ὁ ἐκ κοιλίας μητρὸς ἁγιασθείς*). Both Canons with the Verse: **"Holy saint of God, intercede for us"** (*Ἅγιε τοῦ Θεοῦ, πρέσβευε ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν*)...[^359]

units.slavonic_incipit: ἡμῶν· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κάθισμα
units.slavonic_diplomatic: ἡμῶν· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κάθισμα καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ τὸ Κοντάκιον, ὁ Οἶκος καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου, εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον, καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τὰ Προσόμοια Ὢ τοῦ παραδόξου θαύματος εἰς δ΄. Δόξα, Ἀστὴρ ἀστέρων Πρόδρομος, Καὶ νῦν, Θεοτόκε σὺ εἶ ἡ ἄμπελος, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 3.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοί, Τροπάρια ἐκ τῆς γ΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ α΄ καὶ τῆς ς΄ τοῦ β΄ Κανόνος. Εἰ τύχοι ἐν Σαββάτῳ, τὸ ἑσπέρας τῆς αὐτῆς ἡμέρας, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα, ψάλλομεν Ἀναστάσιμα ς΄ καὶ τοῦ Προδρόμου δ΄ (τὰ τοῦ μικροῦ Ἑσπερινοῦ)· Δόξα, Ἡ Ἐλισάβετ συνέλαβε, Καὶ νῦν, τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. units.slavonic_diplomatic: 5.    Εἰ τύχοι ἐν Κυριακῇ, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τοῦ Προδρόμου ς΄, Δόξα τοῦ Προδρόμου, Καὶ νῦν, τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου, Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τοῦ Προδρόμου. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Βλέπε τὴν Ἐλισάβετ, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τοῦ Προδρόμου, τὸ Θεοτοκίον καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: both Canons with the Verse “Saint of God, pray for us.” After the 3rd Ode, the Kathisma and the Theotokion; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion, Ikos and the Minologion. The Katavasie “I shall open my mouth,” then we sing “More honorable”; the Exapostilarion and the Theotokion. At the Praises: the four Prosomia “O, of the wondrous miracle!” Glory, “The Forerunner, the star of stars,” Now and ever, “O Theotokos, you are the [true] vine,” Great Doxology and the Apolytikion.
units.english_cohort_translation: ...intercede for us." After Ode 3, the Sessional Hymn and the Theotokion; after Ode 6, the Kontakion, the Ikos, and the Menologion. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*); then we chant the Magnifications: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*); the Exapostilarion and the Theotokion. At the Praises: the 4 Prosomoia: **"O, of the strange wonder!"** (*Ὢ τοῦ παραδόξου θαύματος*); "Glory...": **"The Forerunner, the star of stars"** (*Ἀστὴρ ἀστέρων Πρόδρομος*); "Both now and ever...": **"O Theotokos, Thou art the vine"** (*Θεοτόκε σὺ εἶ ἡ ἄμπελος*); Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion.

At the Praises: the 4 Prosomoia: **"O, of the strange wonder!"** (*Ὢ τοῦ παραδόξου θαύματος*); "Glory...": **"The Forerunner, the star of stars"** (*Ἀστὴρ ἀστέρων Πρόδρομος*); "Both now and ever...": **"O Theotokos, Thou art the vine"** (*Θεοτόκε σὺ εἶ ἡ ἄμπελος*); Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion.

If the Feast of the Forerunner occurs on a Saturday, that evening at Vespers, at “Lord, I have cried,” we sing 6 Resurrection Stichira and four of the Forerunner (those of the Small Vespers) Glory, “Elizabeth conceived,” Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory, Now and ever, “Look at Elizabeth.” The Apolytikion of the Resurrection, that of the Forerunner, the Theotokion, Dismissal and the Leave-taking of the Feast.
units.english_cohort_translation: 4.    If the feast of the Forerunner occurs on a Saturday, on the evening of the same day at Vespers, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we chant 6 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Forerunner (those of Small Vespers); "Glory...": **"Elizabeth conceived"** (*Ἡ Ἐλισάβετ συνέλαβε*); "Both now and ever...": the first Theotokion of the Tone. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"Look at Elizabeth"** (*Βλέπε τὴν Ἐλισάβετ*). The Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Forerunner, the Theotokion, Dismissal, and the Apodosis of the Feast.

If the Feast of the Forerunner occurs on a Sunday, in Vespers on Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter at “Lord, I have cried” we sing 4 Stichira of the Resurrection, and 6 of the Forerunner. Glory of the Forerunner, Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, “O Gladsome Light” and the Readings of the Forerunner. units.slavonic_incipit: Κάθισμα τοῦ Προδρόμου καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον·
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Κάθισμα τοῦ Προδρόμου καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τοῦ Προδρόμου καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, εἶτα μετὰ Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἐξαποστειλάριον, τοῦ Προδρόμου καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τοῦ Προδρόμου δ΄, Δόξα τοῦ Προδρόμου, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 1.    Ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὴν α΄ Στάσιν τοῦ Ψαλτηρίου, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα τὰ γ΄ Προσόμοια Ποίοις εὐφημιῶν εἰς ς΄, Δόξα, Τῷ τριττῷ τῆς ἐρωτήσεως, Καὶ νῦν, [Ὁ] διὰ σὲ θεοπάτωρ, Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ γ΄ Ἰδιόμελα, Δόξα, Ἑορτὴ χαρμόσυνος, Καὶ νῦν, Θεοτόκε σὺ εἶ ἄμπελος, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον Οἱ τῶν Ἀποστόλων πρωτόθρονοι, τὸ Θεοτοκίον Τὸ ἀπ᾿ αἰῶνος ἀπόκρυφον, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 1.    In Vespers following the Introductory Psalm and the First Stasis of the Psalter at “Lord, I have cried” we sing the 3 Prosomia “With what garlands of praise” repeating each twice, Glory, “Christ by asking three times,” Now and ever, “The Prophet David, ancestor of God.” Entrance, “O Gladsome Light,” the Prokimenon and the Readings. At the Aposticha: the three Idiomela, Glory, “A joyful feast,” Now and ever, “O Theotokos, you are the true vine.” The Apolytikion “First in eminence among the Apostles” and the Theotokion “The mystery hidden before all time” and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: **June 29: The Holy, Glorious and Chief Apostles Peter and Paul** 1.    At Vespers, following the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the first Kathisma [Stasis] of the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we chant the 3 Prosomoia: **"With what garlands of praise"** (*Ποίοις εὐφημιῶν*) doubled to 6; "Glory...": **"By His threefold questioning"** (*Τῷ τριττῷ τῆς ἐρωτήσεως*); "Both now and ever...": **"David, the ancestor of God"** (*Ὁ διὰ σὲ θεοπάτωρ*). Little Entrance, **"Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Readings. At the Aposticha: the 3 Idiomela; "Glory...": **"A joyful feast"** (*Ἑορτὴ χαρμόσυνος*); "Both now and ever...": **"O Theotokos, Thou art the vine"** (*Θεοτόκε σὺ εἶ ἡ ἄμπελος*). The Dismissal Troparion: **"First in prominence among the Apostles"** (*Οἱ τῶν Ἀποστόλων πρωτόθρονοι*), the Theotokion: **"The mystery hidden from all ages"** (*Τὸ ἀπ᾿ αἰῶνος ἀπόκρυφον*), and Dismissal.

units.english_cohort_translation: 2.    At Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Litiya, then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion, and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparion twice and the Theotokion once; then the Psalter reading and the Polyeleos. The Sessional Hymns in order; the Anavathmoi: the first Antiphon of Tone 4; the Prokeimenon: **"Their sound hath gone forth into all the earth"** (*Εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν*, Ps. 18:5 LXX); then **"Let everything that hath breath"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*), and the Gospel; Psalm 50 [LXX] read plainly; "Glory...": **"Through the intercessions of the Apostles"** (*Ταῖς τῶν Ἀποστόλων*); "Both now and ever...": **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos"** (*Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου*); the Verse: **"Have mercy on me, O God"** (*Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός*, Ps. 50:1 LXX), and the Idiomelon: **"O Peter, pinnacle of the Apostles"** (*Πέτρε κορυφαῖε*; look for this in the Litiya). Both Canons. After Ode 3, the Hypakoe: **"What prison held thee not"** (*Ποία φυλακή*); after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos, and the Menologion. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ...*)[^361]

Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον Οἱ τῶν Ἀποστόλων πρωτόθρονοι, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ καὶ τὸ Κοντάκιον Προστασία τῶν Χριστιανῶν, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῶν Ἀποστόλων. units.slavonic_diplomatic: 5.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ, εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ψάλλεται ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανών, ἡ Λιτὴ τῶν Ἀποστόλων καὶ τὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῶν Ἀποστόλων καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος, τὰ Καθίσματα, ἓν Ἀναστάσιμον καὶ ἓν τῶν Ἀποστόλων μετὰ τοῦ Θεοτοκίου· ἐν δὲ τῇ γ΄ Στιχολογίᾳ τῶν Ἀποστόλων καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ τοῦ ἤχου, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον, ὁ ἀναστάσιμος Κανὼν καὶ οἱ δύο τῶν Ἀποστόλων· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος, (εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα τῶν Ἀποστόλων μετὰ τοῦ Θεοτοκίου)· {Οἱ ὕμνοι ἐντὸς παρενθέσεως δὲν ψάλλονται ἐδῶ ἀλλὰ μόνον ἡ Ὑπακοὴ - μία παράβλεψις τοῦ Βιολάκη}· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῶν Ἀποστόλων, καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἐξαποστειλάριον, τῶν Ἀποστόλων μετὰ τοῦ Θεοτοκίου. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τῶν Ἀποστόλων δ΄· Δόξα, Ἡ πάνσεπτος τῶν Ἀποστόλων, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία.

Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος, τὰ Καθίσματα, ἓν Ἀναστάσιμον καὶ ἓν τῶν Ἀποστόλων μετὰ τοῦ Θεοτοκίου· ἐν δὲ τῇ γ΄ Στιχολογίᾳ τῶν Ἀποστόλων καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ τοῦ ἤχου, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον, ὁ ἀναστάσιμος Κανὼν καὶ οἱ δύο τῶν Ἀποστόλων· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος, (εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα τῶν Ἀποστόλων μετὰ τοῦ Θεοτοκίου)· {Οἱ ὕμνοι ἐντὸς παρενθέσεως δὲν ψάλλονται ἐδῶ ἀλλὰ μόνον ἡ Ὑπακοὴ - μία παράβλεψις τοῦ Βιολάκη}· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῶν Ἀποστόλων, καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἐξαποστειλάριον, τῶν Ἀποστόλων μετὰ τοῦ Θεοτοκίου. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τῶν Ἀποστόλων δ΄· Δόξα, Ἡ πάνσεπτος τῶν Ἀποστόλων, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: 3.    In the Liturgy, the Typika and the Beatitudes, 4 hymns from the 3rd Ode of the First Canon and 4 hymns from the 6th Ode of the Second Canon. units.english_cohort_translation: 3.    In the Divine Liturgy, the Typika and the Beatitudes: 4 Troparia from Ode 3 of the First Canon and 4 from Ode 6 of the Second Canon. units.slavonic_diplomatic: 4.    If the Feast of the Apostles occurs on a Sunday, in Vespers on Saturday evening following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter at “Lord, I have cried” we sing 4 Stichira of the Resurrection and 6 of the Apostles. Glory of the Apostles, Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, “O Gladsome Light,” the Prokimenon and the Readings of the Apostles. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory, “A joyful feast,” Now and ever, “My creator and savior.” The Apolytikia: of the Resurrection, of the Apostles, the Theotokion and Dismissal.
units.english_cohort_translation: 4.    If the feast of the Apostles occurs on a Sunday, at Vespers on Saturday evening, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the Psalter reading, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we chant 4 Resurrection Stichira and 6 of the Apostles; "Glory...": of the Apostles; "Both now and ever...": the first Theotokion of the Tone. Little Entrance, **"Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Lessons of the Apostles. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; "Glory...": **"A joyful feast"** (*Ἑορτὴ χαρμόσυνος*); "Both now and ever...": **"My Creator and Redeemer"** (*Ὁ ποιητὴς καὶ λυτρωτής μου*). The Dismissal Troparia: of the Resurrection, of the Apostles, the Theotokion, and Dismissal.
